rows.title: Insights Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
The PureGym WayThe PureGym Group is a global gym business with a community of more than 700 gyms and over 2 million members. At PureGym, everything we do comes back to one simple idea: helping you feel good.We're proud of our people and have a strong focus on internal progression. Championing diversity, we are committed to providing an excellent employee experience and workplace culture. As such, we are a Disability Confident Committed employer, and offer interviews to candidates who meet the essential criteria for a role, and opt-in to the scheme on their application form.Our gyms are friendly, supportive, and judgement-free spaces where everybody can come in, work out and leave Feeling PureGym Good. We are proud to be certified by Top Employers Institute. See our careers page for full benefits.
We offerFree nationwide gym membership for you + 1Hybrid workingA truly flexible working culturePersonal private healthcare, including digital GPLife insurance x4Company pension contribution25 days annual leave, plus 1 personal dayOption to purchase additional holiday (up to 5 days)Great learning & development resourcesEnhanced maternity pay, paternity and adoption leave
Location: Hybrid- London (3 days in the office)Type: Full TimeContract type: Permanent We are a value business, focused on making gyms and fitness accessible to as many people as possible. Data is at the heart of how we run our business, starting from where to open our gyms, through what we offer within them, to how we engage with past, current, and future members. Combining the data from our 2.5+ million members with data about locations, operations, and performance allows us to unlock industry leading insights and drive a better member experience and commercial performance.As an Insights Analyst you will be at the heart of solving some of the hardest data challenges in the business, turning data into insights and business value through a combination of in-depth analysis and reporting creation. You will be leveraging one of the biggest fitness data assets in the world, and working with state-of-the-art technologies, to help determine what drives member behaviour and commercial outcomes across all our operating geographies.
The RoleAs a small, agile team, Insights works closely with its stakeholders, putting data at the heart of decision making across the business. While reporting to the Insights Manager, in this role you get to work closely with stakeholders at all levels across the business. You will also work in close collaboration with the wider Insights & Analytics functions, which provides ample opportunity to learn from a group of talented and experienced Data Scientists and Data Engineers.In this role, you will have the opportunity to:Work on business-critical analytics projects and reporting, identifying outcomes and communicating findings and recommendations to stakeholders across the business - Commercial, Finance, Operational and Marketing teams, in addition to Data Science and Data Engineering.Build and maintain the central data product serving KPIs and insights to the entire organisation.Work with Azure Databricks, PowerBI and dbt technology, leveraging modern cloud-native technologies and data lakehouse architecture.Drive continuous improvement to how we enable data driven decision making in PureGym.
The PersonWe would expect some or all of the following:Experience in data analytics / insightsProficient with SQL, Power BI, Excel and PowerPointAdditionally, experience with dbt would be an advantageA drive to turn insights into compelling stories for stakeholders to understand, for them to make more effective, data-led decisionsStrong commercial awareness with an interest in B2CWe are looking for an ambitious individual with a passion for leveraging analytics to drive business outcomes. The following core attributes are essential:Excellent problem-solving: someone who enjoys applying their mind to many and varied business problems and be a driving force behind solving themInnovative and curious: constantly seek to learn and find new and better ways of doing things; not just solving problems but seeking them out; always interested to find new and better methods and technologiesBiased towards action: take the initiative and get things done under their own steam and in collaboration with othersCollaborative: driven to engage with colleagues from across the business and support and enable your team membersA great communicator: able to translate complex concepts and analyses into digestible recommendations that can be easily interpreted and acted upon
PureGym is proud to be an equal opportunities employer. Our company mantra is ‘Everybody Welcome’ and we are dedicated to promoting a diverse and inclusive place to work. From a hiring standpoint, we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to ensuring that our PureGym colleagues reflect the diversity of the nation as well as our millions of gym members we serve.
Please note: Qualifications and Skills represent the essential criteria for the role, which need to be met to be offered an interview under the Disability Confident Scheme. Volume of eligible applications may impact everyone being able to be offered an interview.Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the advert may be withdrawn at any time. Early application is encouraged.

rows.title: Junior Product Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
London, UK (Hybrid - Tues, Wed and Thurs in office)£35,000 - £40,000 + equity
Muzz is the world's biggest dating and marriage app for Muslims, but we've still got a way to go! We need a smart and ambitious data analyst, with real entrepreneurial flair to join our Data team to understand our members and all the metrics that matter. Love numbers and love being commercial? This is the role for you.
You’ll be joining a dynamic data team whose goal is to grow the company and optimise our products as we expand into new markets around the worldYou’ll be understanding our user behaviour on the app with a view to generating actionable insights in terms of both product and marketingYou’ll analyse funnels and conversion across key user journeys, identifying drop-off points and opportunities to improve the experienceYou’ll own reporting - set up and maintain dashboards in Data Studio to assess KPIs whilst enabling self-serviceYou’ll work with product managers to define KPIs and metrics, and compare performance across our marketsYou’ll own event tracking in Mixpanel, working with mobile and backend engineers to define tracking requirements and make sure key user actions are captured accuratelyYou’ll provide analytical support across all areas of the product development lifecycle, from opportunity to product strategy, feature analysis and experimentation, including supporting the design and analysis of A/B testsYou’ll provide continuous training of business users to get the most out of Data Studio
Requirements and skills needed
1+ years of experience in a data, product or similar analyst roleStrong SQL skills, with an interest in writing efficient, maintainable queriesExperience with a BI tool (e.g. Data Studio, Looker, Tableau, Power BI)Excellent communication skills and presenting to non-technical audiencesAbility to work collaboratively in cross-functional teamsA curious, proactive mindset and comfort working with ambiguity
Nice to have
Experience with BigQueryExperience with Mixpanel or similar product analytics toolsExperience in designing and conducting A/B experiments

rows.title: Quantitative Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Ingeus is a leading human services provider helping people, business and communities thrive through employment, skills and health & wellbeing services. We are a trusted partner to government and industry delivering services that create positive social impact and transform lives.



Job Description

Experience within healthcare, health assessment, disability services, the NHS, or public services is preferred but not essential.



The Quantitative Analyst transforms complex clinical data into actionable intelligence that supports clinical governance, service improvement, project prioritisation and strategic decision-making across HAAS.

The postholder uses statistical analysis, trend monitoring, risk stratification and predictive techniques to identify emerging patterns, early warning signs and opportunities for intervention. They will translate analysis into clear recommendations for Clinical Excellence and senior stakeholders, enabling the service to move from retrospective reporting towards proactive, evidence-led management.

The role liaises primarily with Clinical Excellence and in partnership with Clinical Operations, Data and Insights, Learning & Development, and other relevant functions. It provides analytical support to clinical projects, evaluates the impact of interventions and strengthens the evidence base for future service design.



Qualifications

Essential qualifications and experience

Degree or equivalent professional experience in data analytics, statistics, mathematics, health informatics, public health, operational research or a related discipline. Substantial experience in an analytical, business intelligence, healthcare analytics or comparable evidence-led role. Demonstrable experience analysing complex datasets and translating findings into practical recommendations. Experience designing dashboards, scorecards and reports for senior decision-makers. Experience supporting projects or improvement activity through baseline analysis, evaluation and benefits measurement. Experience working with sensitive or regulated data and applying strong information governance controls. Essential technical capability and behaviours

Advanced Excel and strong proficiency in Power BI or an equivalent visualisation platform. Practical SQL capability and experience preparing, joining and validating data from multiple sources. Competence in statistical analysis, including selection and explanation of appropriate methods. Ability to create clear, reproducible analytical outputs and maintain robust documentation. Excellent written, verbal and visual communication skills, with the ability to explain technical findings to non-technical audiences. Selects proportionate methods, challenges assumptions and avoids overstating what the data can prove. Connects analysis to quality, safety, fairness, practitioner practice and customer experience. Turns complex findings into a clear narrative, decision points and practical recommendations. Investigates unexpected variation and seeks the underlying drivers rather than accepting headline measures. Works effectively across clinical, operational and technical disciplines while maintaining analytical independence. Plans work, manages priorities and produces accurate outputs to agreed standards and timescales. Uses data ethically, protects sensitive information and is transparent about quality and limitations. Desirable criteria

Knowledge of clinical governance, quality assurance, risk management or continuous improvement methodologies. Experience using Python, R or another statistical programming language. Experience of predictive analytics, control charts, natural language analysis or machine-learning methods. Understanding of benefits realisation, service evaluation and evidence-based decision-making.

rows.title: Payment Specialist - Compliance Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. 

We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. 

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. 

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. 

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

About The Team

Our Sanctions Screening team keeps our merchants and their customers safe. We run and constantly improve the real-time screening that checks payments and customers against sanctions and watchlists. We're scaling it fast as we move into new markets and payment types.

The role

This is an associate-level role for a sharp, hands-on data analyst. You'll help with the day-to-day running and improvement of our screening systems, making them faster, more accurate and more resilient. Sanctions screening, compliance and fincrime experience is a plus, not a must.

Strong data analysts from adjacent payments, fintech or similar fields are welcome to apply.

What you'll do

Support the day-to-day running of our screening platform (Fircosoft Continuity, the system that checks payments and customers against watchlists), keeping it healthy and reliable.Design and test rules that cut false positives and reduce manual case work.Manage watchlist updates and configurations to stay ahead of regulatory change.Extend screening to new payment types and build automated testing so improvements stick.

What success looks like

False positives and manual workload fall measurably, without weakening detection.Screening runs reliably and no longer depends on any single person.New payment types and controls are supported quickly as the business grows.

What you'll bring

2–3 years' experience in a data analyst or data-focused role.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. You turn data into decisions.Hands-on data skills with SQL/BigQuery and/or Python. You don't need to be an expert, but you'll need to be comfortable extracting, compiling, querying data and presenting insights.Clear communication with technical and non-technical people.Comfort in a fast-moving, high-performance and high-growth environment.

Nice to have

Experience in sanctions screening, AML, fraud or transaction monitoring.Experience configuring screening tools and designing screening rules.Exposure to crypto or other emerging payment types.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

rows.title: 2027 Data Management and Analysis Placement – Hilton Safety & Security
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

As a participant in our 12-month Corporate Placements Programme in the Safety & Security Department, you’re not just gaining hands-on experience in data analysis and project management at our Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA) Headquarters in Watford – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by contributing to the memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Here’s what you can look forward to as a programme participant:

Prepare for a career in hospitality: Embark on a 12-month transformative journey, encompassing a structured framework of learning and development opportunities, business support activities, and ownership of your own project-based initiatives.Gain hands-on operational experience: From day one, you’ll be fully integrated into Team Hilton. Connect with professionals across the business and gain insight into Safety & Security. Take the opportunity to gain insight into at least one other business area, paving the way for valuable future relationships.Work on real-world projects: Apply your skills on the job through business-driven projects to reinforce your learning and gain hands-on experience.Develop your skills through world-class training and support: Access Hilton University’s e-learning modules and business library while building knowledge through business-driven projects.Grow with personalised guidance: Benefit from regular feedback and coaching to ensure your progress is supported at every stage of the programme.Hilton Perks: Including our Go Hilton Team Member Travel Program, which provides you with access to heavily reduced hotel room rates for you, your family & friends. Salary & Benefits: £27,500 gross per annum & private healthcare. Location: At our EMEA Headquarters in Watford, with some flexibility depending on team and business need. You will benefit from a subsidised restaurant, a games area and a free in-house gym.  

Our Placement Opportunities

Step into a pivotal role supporting Hilton's Global Safety & Security team and regional directors in safeguarding one of the world's most iconic hospitality brands. This 12-month placement offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the protection of Hilton's guests, team members, assets, and reputation across our owned, managed, and franchised properties.

Support in a Data Management & Analysis capacity across key areas:

Occupational Health & Safety.Food Safety & Fire Safety.Security & Crisis Management.Trading Standards & Public Health.Team Member Housing (where applicable).Disability Compliance.

Collaborate on global safety and security projects, using your analytical insights to support operational decisions, assessments, and forecasting for high-risk areas across hotels and corporate offices. Analyse accident and claim data, insurance reports, guest assistance records, and vendor incidents logs to inform mitigation strategies.

This Placement Offers

Exposure to global safety operations in a world-class hospitality brand.Hands-on experience in data analysis, risk management, and strategic planning.Mentorship from industry leaders in safety, security, and intelligence.A chance to make a real impact on the wellbeing of millions of guests and team members.

What We’re Looking For

We are seeking individuals who embody the Hilton Values in addition to the following criteria:

A strong sense of alignment to our culture and values.A current bachelor’s or master’s student completing a degree that includes a required 12-month year in industry placement.A Social, Political, Policy Sciences, Criminology & Security Studies, Security with Intelligence Analysis, Risk & Security Management, Safety & Risk Management, Food Safety Management, Health, Safety & Fire Safety Management or related degree is preferred.Availability to begin full-time employment on 5th July 2027, for a full-time 12-month placement.You must have the independent right to work in the UK for the full duration of the 12-month placement. Please note that this role is not eligible for visa sponsorship under the Skilled Worker route, so we are unable to consider applications from candidates who would require sponsorship. If you hold a visa or status that allows you to work in the UK full-time without sponsorship (e.g. Settled Status, Pre-Settled Status, where a 12-month work placement is a permitted, required & assessed part of your UK University degree, or other independent work permissions), you are welcome to apply.Fluency in English (spoken and written).You should be able to demonstrate a genuine interest in Safety & Security.Risk Assessment & Mitigation: Ability to identify potential threats and propose solutions.Data Analysis: Comfortable working with incident reports, accident statistics, and insurance claims to spot trends and vulnerabilities.Knowledge of Safety Standards: Familiarity with regulations like ISO 45001 (Occupational Health & Safety), HACCP (Food Safety), and fire safety codes.Security Principles: Understanding of physical and digital security protocols, access control, and surveillance systems.Incident Reporting Tools: Experience with platforms like Microsoft Excel, Power BI, or safety management systems.Project Management: Supporting safety initiatives and tracking progress.Crisis Management Awareness: Understanding business continuity planning and emergency response.Ethical Judgement: Handling sensitive data and decisions with integrity.

Click here to learn more about Hilton's Corporate Placements

Selection Process

Applications are now open—don’t miss your chance to apply! Submissions close on Sunday 1st November 2026.

Our selection process is designed to bring out your best and help us get to know you. It includes:

Online assessments.In-person or virtual interview.

While the process is rigorous, it’s also the first step in your personal growth journey with Hilton. If selected, you’ll begin developing the skills, connections, and confidence to thrive in your career.

To ensure every application receives fair consideration, invitations to final-stage interviews will be issued after applications have closed. Please complete each stage promptly and keep an eye on your inbox for updates.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing reasonable adjustments for applicants and employees with disabilities. If you require any support or adjustments during the recruitment process or to carry out the essential requirements of the role, please contact us.

rows.title: Unity Programme - Data Business Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
About The Job

Job summary

Discover a career in your hands at HMRC. Whether you're seeking purpose, growth, or a workplace that gives you a true sense of belonging, hear from some of our employees as they share their story about what it's really like to work at HMRC.

Visit our  YouTube channel  to watch the full series and come and discover your potential.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join the major cross government Unity Programme which will bring together Shared Services for His Majesty's Revenue and Customs (HMRC), Department for Transport (DFT) and Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government (MHCLG).

The programme aims to deliver the tools in Human Resources (HR), Finance, Payroll, and Procurement to enable the user to complete administration tasks, whether Finance, HR, or Procurement quickly and with minimal effort by modernising our IT Platform, bringing together our shared services teams, standardising our data and cutting through processes that cost our departments time and money.

Job Description

We have an exciting opportunity for a Business Analyst to help drive delivery of various components for the shared solution for the Unity cluster.

The Process Transformation and UCD team is a key component of the Unity Programme, developing processes for Department for Transport, HMRC and the MHCLG under a single Shared Services umbrella. In this unique and dynamic position, you will provide analytical leadership that supports transformation at pace, ensures public value, and strengthens future service delivery. You will bring order and clarity to complex, cross departmental challenges. Take ownership of ambiguous work, structure it, progress it, and ensure it results in clear, practical decisions and deliverable outcomes.

A problem solver with a curious mindset, you will be forward thinking and take responsibility for progressing complex pieces of work independently and driving them to completion. Working with the team to identify what is needed, plan the approach, bring together the right people, and deliver high quality outputs without over reliance on direction.

There may be occasional travel involved in this role to attend cross-government and cross department meetings.

Key Responsibilities Departmental Challenges.

Take ownership of ambiguous work, structure it, progress it, and ensure it results in clear, practical decisions and deliverable outcomes. quality outputs without over reliance on direction.Take responsibility for progressing complex pieces of work independently and driving them to completion.Identify what is needed, plan the approach, bring together the right people, and deliver high quality outputs without reliance on direction. quality outputs without reliance on direction.Ensure materials are decision ready, accessible, and aligned with programme objectives and governance standards. ready, accessible, and aligned with programme objectives and governance standards.Lead workshops with departmental leaders, subject matter experts, delivery partners and operational teams.Shape and assess delivery options, considering feasibility, policy alignment, risks, and service impact.Distil wide-ranging viewpoints into clear recommendations that support evidence-based decision-making based decision-making.Contribute to transformation planning, readiness assessment and transition design.Work closely with operational leaders to ensure new processes, roles, and services are understood and viable.Work effectively with stakeholders across multiple government departments, agencies, and delivery partners.Act as a trusted analytical lead who can operate through influence, not authority.

Person specification

The ideal candidate will have strong Business Analysis experience within large-scale transformation. You will bring proven capability in some or all areas of process design, service design, target operating model development, and requirements definition and will be confident navigating change in fast-paced environments. You will be a confident facilitator with experience leading cross-functional and cross-organisational workshops and have familiarity with planning change and implementation approaches, including readiness, transition design, and adoption.

With adaptability, resilience, and a proactive approach to problem-solving, you are a collaborative team player, able to translate complex information into clear, actionable insights for a range of audiences.

Essential Criteria

Takes Ownership and accountability; sees things through, drives progress, and delivers what is needed.Has Analytical clarity: able to cut through complexity and produce simple, logical outputs.Is Curious and improvement driven: always looking for better ways of working.Is Pragmatic and grounded: focuses on what is deliverable within constraints.Is Resilient: maintains momentum and constructive focus when faced with ambiguity or challenge.Is Influential: able to bring people with you without relying on authority.Is Collaborative: operates effectively across departments, professions, and delivery partners.Is a Clear communicator: able to articulate complex information in a way that supports decision-making.

Desirable Criteria: 

ServiceNow experience including involvement in UX / CX design.Experience with ERP systems, particularly SAP S/4HANA, including involvement in design, testing, and deployment phases.

Further Location Information

Please ensure that you only apply for a location that you are willing and able to work from, as we will only make one offer of employment. Any additional notes included in a 'Further Location Preferences (optional)' field within the application form, will not be considered. Please be aware that you cannot change your location preference after submitting your application.

Office closures

For more information on where you might be working,  review this information on our locations .

If your location preference is for one of the following sites, it's important to note that these are not long-term sites for HMRC and we will require you to move to a new building in the future, subject to our location strategy and the applicable employee policies at that time.

This Site Is

Benton Park View, Newcastle - moving to Pilgrims Quarter, Newcastle

You will be given more information about what this means at the job offer stage.

Behaviours

We'll assess you against these behaviours during the selection process:

Changing and ImprovingSeeing the Big PictureCommunicating and InfluencingManaging a Quality Service

Benefits

Alongside your salary of £58,541, HM Revenue and Customs contributes £16,959 towards you being a member of the Civil Service Defined Benefit Pension scheme.  Find out what benefits a Civil Service Pension provides (opens in a new window).

HMRC operates both Flexible and Hybrid Working policies, allowing you to balance your work and personal commitments. We welcome applications from those who need to work a more flexible arrangement and will agree to requests where possible, considering our operational and customer service needs.

We offer a generous leave allowance, starting at 25 days and increasing by a day for every year of qualifying service up to a maximum of 30 days.

 Pension - We make contributions to our colleagues' Alpha pension equal to at least 28.97% of their salary.  Family friendly policies.  Personal support.  Coaching and development. 

To find out more about HMRC  benefits  and find out what it's really like to work for HMRC  hear from our insiders  or visit  Thinking of joining the Civil Service .

Things you need to know

Artificial intelligence

Artificial intelligence can be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action. Please see our candidate guidance (opens in a new window) for more information on appropriate and inappropriate use.

Selection process details

This vacancy is using Success Profiles (opens in a new window), and will assess your Behaviours, Strengths and Experience.

How To Apply

As part of the application process, you will be asked to provide the following:

A name-blind CV including your job history and previous experiences. A 750-word personal statement. Your Personal Statement should be used to describe how your skills and experience would be suitable for the advertised role, making reference to the essential criteria and person specification outlined in the advert.

Please complete a separate statement (Max 250 words) for the Desirable Criteria where applicable. This is not essential for the role but may be considered by the vacancy-holder where candidates have the same scores at interview.

Further details around what this will entail are listed on the application form.

Sift

In the event of a large number of applications being received, an initial sift may be held on your Personal Statement.

At full sift, your CV, and your Personal Statement, will be assessed, with the successful candidates being invited to interview.

We may also raise the score required at any stage of the process if we receive a high number of applications.

Interview

During the panel interview, you will be asked behaviour-based questions to explore in detail what you are capable of, and you will also be asked strength-based questions to also explore what you enjoy and your motivations relevant to the job role.

This Is An Example Of a Strengths-based Question

"It is often said that the customer's needs should come first. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?"

There is no expectation or requirement for you to prepare for the strengths-based questions in advance of the interview, though you may find it helpful to spend some time reflecting on what you enjoy doing and what you do well.

Interviews will take place via video link. Sift and Interview dates to be confirmed. Please note that circumstances may arise that require the planned interview format to change. We will endeavour to provide you with as much notice of any change as possible.

Eligibility

Please take extra care to tick the correct boxes in the eligibility sections of your application form. Mistakes sometimes happen but if you contact us later than two working days (Monday-Friday) before the vacancy closes, we may not be able to reopen your application for you . If you do make a mistake with your eligibility form, or have withdrawn yourself in error and need your application reinstated whilst the campaign is still live, please contact us via: unitybusinessservicesrecruitmentresults@hmrc.gov.uk - Use the subject line to insert appropriate wording for example - 'Please re-open my application - [insert vacancy ref] & vacancy closing date [insert date]'

To check that you are eligible to apply for this role, please review the eligibility information before submitting your application .

Exceptionally, candidates who are not successful at this grade may be considered for appointment to similar roles at a lower grade where the eligibility criteria are met. If this applies, we will contact you directly.

 The HMRC app can help you with your application 

The  HMRC app  can provide you with your past 5 years' employment history, making the process of filling in your application quicker and easier.

If successful in your application, you will need your National Insurance number for the onboarding process.

Download the  HMRC app  now and save your National Insurance number to your digital phone wallet.

 How to download the HMRC app and sign up for an account 

Download the free  HMRC app  from the App Store or Google Play store.

If you have an HMRC online account already, sign straight in using your ID and password. If not, you can prove your identity by answering some questions or providing your photo ID.

You'll then be able to access the app quickly and easily by signing in using a 6-digit PIN, your fingerprint, or facial recognition.

You can find guidance for technical issues on GOV.UK:  Technical support with HMRC online services .

Reserve List 

A reserve list may be held for up to 12 months from which further appointments may be made for the same or similar roles - if this applies to you, we'll let you know via your Civil Service Jobs account.

Criminal Record Check 

Applications received from candidates with a criminal record are considered fairly in accordance with the DBS Code of Practice and the Recruitment of ex-offenders Policy.

Merit List 

After interview, a single merit list will be created, and you will only be considered for posts in locations you have expressed a preference for. Appointments will be made in strict merit order in line with the set number of roles in each location.

Hybrid working at HMRC

HMRC is an office-based organisation, and colleagues are expected to spend 60% of their working time in the office. Our offices provide opportunity for interaction, collaboration which aids learning and development and a sense of community. Where the role allows it, and where the home environment is suitable, colleagues can work from home for up to 2 days a week, averaged over a calendar month (or a proportionate amount of time for colleagues who work less than full time).

 Reasonable Adjustments 

We want to make sure no one is put at a disadvantage during our recruitment process. To assist you with this, we will reduce or remove any barriers where possible and provide additional support where appropriate.

If you need a change to be made so that you can make your application, you should:

 Contact the UBS Recruitment Team via unitybusinessservicesrecruitmentresults@hmrc.gov.uk as soon as possible before the closing date to discuss your needs. 

Complete the "Assistance required" section in the "Additional requirements" page of your application form to tell us what changes or help you might need further on in the recruitment process. For instance, you may need wheelchair access at interview, or if you're deaf, a Language Service Professional.

 Technical Support 

If you are experiencing problems that cannot be resolved by our '  help  ' section, then  technical support  is available. You will receive a reply in 2 working days.

Important Information For Existing HMRC Contractual Homeworkers

This role may be suitable for existing HMRC employees who are contractual homeworkers. Occasional attendance to the office will be required where there is a business need. Please consider the advertised office locations for this role when applying and only select locations from the 'location preferences' section that you can travel to.

Terms and Conditions

Current Civil Servants (all contract types) will need to ensure that they are still employed as a Civil Servant on or beyond the start date for the post. If their contract ends (for example due to the end of Fixed Term Appointment contract or resignation) at any point during the application process for the advertised role, they will no longer be eligible and may be withdrawn.

Customer facing roles in HMRC require the ability to converse at ease with members of the public and provide advice in accurate spoken English and/or Welsh where required. Where this is an essential requirement, this will be tested as part of the selection process.

HMRC has a presence in every region of the UK. For more information on where you might be working, review this information on our locations .

The Civil Service values honesty and integrity and expects all candidates to abide by these principles. The evidence you provide in your application must relate to your own experiences.

Any instances of plagiarism or other forms of cheating will be investigated and, if proven, the relevant application(s) will be withdrawn from the process.

Recording of interviews is prohibited unless explicit agreement is sought in line with the UK General Data Protection Regulations.

Questions relating to an individual application must be emailed as detailed later in this advert.

Applicants who are successful at interview will be, as part of pre-employment screening, subject to a check on the Internal Fraud Database (IFD). This check will provide information about employees who have been dismissed for fraud or dishonesty offences. This check also applies to employees who resign or otherwise leave before being dismissed for fraud or dishonesty had their employment continued. Any applicant's details held on the IFD will be refused employment.

A candidate is not eligible to apply for a role within the Civil Service if the application is made within a 5 year period following a dismissal for carrying out internal fraud against government.

Please note that, if you are applying for roles on a part-time basis, the salary agreed will be pro-rata, reflective of the working hours agreed within your contract.

If you experience accessibility problems with any attachments on this advert, please contact the email address in the 'Contact point for applicants' section.

For more Information for people applying for, or thinking of applying for, roles at HM Revenue and Customs, please see link: Working for HMRC: information for applicants - GOV.UK .

Feedback will only be provided if you attend an interview or assessment.

Security

Successful candidates must undergo a standard (or equivalent) criminal record check.

People working with government assets must complete baseline personnel security standard (opens in new window) checks.

rows.title: AI Accelerator for Drug Discovery - Talent Pool
rows.descriptionText:
The AI Accelerator is a brand-new, London-based hub, within @computationalinnovation, comprising computational biology, human genetics, data and AI expertise. 

The purpose of the AI Accelerator is to provision production-quality, versatile, foundational biomedical AI capabilities that can be adapted and deployed to improve and accelerate portfolio decision-making, furthering understanding of the biology driving patient outcomes and identifying mechanisms that increase probability of success. 

To achieve this purpose, the AI Accelerator is organised around three key capabilities - AI Systems, focussing on neural methods, AI Reasoning, focussing on causality and knowing why, and AI Enablement, powering AI Systems and AI Reasoning with big data provisioning, MLOps and AI infrastructure. 

AI Systems will exploit neural-based methods to integrate data and impute and infer across the biomedical landscape. It could be electronic health records and medical imaging to support patient segmentation. It could be ‘omics data to understand gene regulation and identify novel therapeutic concepts; it could be predicting transcriptional change for a given disease-causing variant
AI Reasoning will supplement AI Systems by focussing on developing approaches to identify cause and effect, predict the outcome of an intervention, provide a rationale for a model decision. It could be providing causal structure to multi-omics data; it could be providing orthogonal rationale to a black-box model generated hypothesis; it could be identifying features that are driving model predictions. 
AI Enablement will support AI Systems and AI Reasoning by provisioning harmonised multimodal data for distributed training, managing the model lifecycle and partnering with the IT organisation to ensure AI Systems, AI Reasoning and downstream beneficiaries have the necessary infrastructure and tooling to prototype, implement, adapt and deploy AI capabilities to advance the portfolio



None of the above can be achieved without people. We are looking for AI scientists, machine learning engineers, research engineers, data engineers, MLOps engineers and AI infrastructure engineers from senior up to senior staff level and people leaders in AI science and engineering.
If you are passionate about using your talents to build state-of-the-art AI approaches that will advance the portfolio and skilled in the required disciplines, please register your interest. 

Apply Now to register interest by joining our AI Accelerator talent pool.

Please note that this is a talent community, not a particular recruitment process. There will be no follow up communication on this application. By applying you agree to being contacted by us, should there be a new opening in the future, matching your professional profile and/or interest in a particular position stated by you in your application form. Our Company Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,300 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com. Why Boehringer Ingelheim? With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations. Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

Leadership & Capability Development

Strategic & Business Skills

Deep understanding of Talent Intelligence, Planning, Talent Analytics, Workforce Evolution and Talent Strategy.Strong consulting, stakeholder management, and executive influence capabilities.Ability to align talent analytics outcomes with broader business objectives.Strong commercial acumen and understanding of organizational transformation.

Analytics & Data Science Skills

Advanced statistical analysis and predictive modelling, Machine Learning and AI solution design, Experimental design and causal inference methodologies, Skills intelligence and talent marketplace analytics, Expertise in data storytelling and executive reporting.

AI & Emerging Technology Skills

Generative AI solutions design and implementation, Microsoft Copilot ecosystem expertise, Copilot Studio and conversational AI development, Agentic AI architecture and orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) patterns, Prompt engineering and AI governance, Responsible AI and model explainability, Knowledge management and semantic search solutions.

Leadership Competencies

Job Requirements:

Certification Requirements:

Higher professional or master’s qualification in a related discipline is preferred, not requiredActive membership in related professional bodies or industry groups is preferred, not requiredMicrosoft certifications in MS Fabric, Copilot, Copilot Studio, AI, Machine Learning, Data Science, or Product Management certifications.Professional certifications related to Planning, People Analytics, or Human Capital Management.

rows.title: Marketing Executive, FT Specialist Events, FT Live
rows.descriptionText:
About Us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Here, you’re given the chance to reach millions, create work that matters and deliver impartial journalism in a polarised world.

In our warm, collaborative culture, you’ll connect with a diverse community of experts who support your growth, career aspirations and wellbeing.

Your future at the FT will be filled with opportunities that challenge and inspire you. With no fixed path, you’ll discover new skills and forge a career that can take you anywhere.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We believe in the power of unique perspectives and want all voices in our organisation to be heard, respected and valued. A supportive workplace is one where employees feel they can be themselves and operate to their full potential. We are committed to removing barriers for everyone, with a focus on addressing those faced by underrepresented groups.

The Role

We are looking for a proactive, organised and commercially minded Marketing Executive to join the FT Specialist Events team, part of FT Live, the Financial Times' global events division.

FT Specialist provides specialist insight and intelligence to professional audiences worldwide, covering sectors including asset and wealth management, financial advice, banking, economic development and investment, and corporate governance. Alongside its publications and digital products, FT Specialist delivers a growing portfolio of conferences, awards, webinars and partner events.

In this role, you will support the planning and delivery of multi-channel marketing campaigns that attract high-quality audiences, drive event registrations and generate delegate revenue.

Working closely with the Head of Marketing, you will handle campaigns across multiple events, from audience research and campaign planning through to execution, optimisation and performance reporting. You'll use audience insights and data to develop targeted marketing activity, create engaging content and find opportunities to reach new audiences.

You'll also collaborate with colleagues across content, sales, operations, design and wider FT marketing teams to ensure our campaigns support each event's commercial objectives while attracting the relevant, senior professional audiences associated with the Financial Times.

This is an opportunity to develop your marketing skills across a varied international events portfolio, contribute creative ideas and see the direct impact of your work.

Key Responsibilities

Campaign management and audience acquisition

Plan and deliver multi-channel marketing campaigns to drive event registrations, paid delegate revenue and high-quality audience acquisition across conferences, awards, webinars and partner events. Coordinate marketing activity across email, organic and paid social media, digital and print advertising, partnerships and FT promotional channels. Research prospective audiences, organisations and market segments to find opportunities for audience growth. Develop targeted audience segments and tailor campaign messaging to different industries, seniority levels, geographical markets and audience needs. Write clear, engaging and persuasive marketing copy for emails, event websites, social media and other promotional materials. Monitor registrations, engagement and campaign performance, using data to optimise marketing activity and improve results. Maintain event websites, registration pages and marketing content, ensuring information remains accurate, relevant and consistent with FT brand standards. 

Relationship management and commercial support

Work closely with content, sales and operations teams to align marketing campaigns with event programmes, speakers, sponsors and commercial objectives. Brief and coordinate with FT Live's design team to produce effective marketing assets and collateral on schedule. Support agreed sponsor and partner marketing activity, including promotional coordination and campaign reporting. Provide audience insights, marketing materials and relevant performance data to support event sales activity. Identify cross-promotional opportunities with colleagues across FT Specialist, FT Live and the wider Financial Times. 

Reporting and continuous improvement

Track registrations, delegate revenue and campaign performance against agreed targets, providing regular updates and recommendations. Produce post-event marketing analysis to evaluate channel effectiveness, audience composition and campaign results. Develop an understanding of FT Specialist's markets and professional audiences, keeping informed about relevant industry, competitor and marketing trends. Contribute ideas and test new approaches to improve audience acquisition, engagement and campaign effectiveness. 

Required Skills And Experience

Strong organisational and project management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple campaigns in a timely manner. Excellent written communication and copywriting skills, with the ability to create engaging content for different audiences and channels. A high level of attention to detail and commitment to producing accurate, high-quality work. A proactive, curious and commercially aware approach, with the confidence to take ownership of activities and suggest improvements. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an interest in using data to evaluate performance and inform decisions. Effective interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build positive working relationships across different teams. Adaptability and the ability to prioritise effectively in a fast-paced environment. Confidence using Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace, particularly spreadsheets and presentation tools. 

Desirable

Previous experience in marketing, particularly within events, media, publishing, financial services or B2B environments. Experience supporting or delivering digital marketing campaigns, including email marketing and organic or paid social media. Familiarity with CRM systems, email marketing platforms, event registration tools or marketing automation software. An understanding of audience segmentation, database marketing and campaign performance metrics. A degree or equivalent professional qualification in marketing, business or a related field is beneficial but not essential. 

What's in it for You?

Our benefits vary by location but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, medical cover, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

We currently operate a hybrid model which requires staff to work onsite 50% of the time, subject to role requirements & regular review. While flexible working requests will be considered, not all patterns are suitable for all roles. We believe this balanced approach supports flexibility and protects our culture, making collaboration and communication easier, building stronger relationships and team cohesion, and supporting peer learning. We reserve discretion on reasonable notice to change this approach either generally or for specific individuals or teams.

Accessibility

We are a disability confident employer and Valuable 500 signatory.

Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments/personalisation as part of the application process or to enable you to attend an interview. If you would like to discuss your requirements or have any questions, email talent@ft.com and a member of our team will be happy to help.

Further Information

At the FT, we embrace innovation and the use of technology and appreciate that individuals may use AI tools as part of their job application process. Whilst we are happy for you to use AI to assist with your application, it is essential that all information provided is authentic and accurately represents your skills, experience, and qualifications.

Candidates should be aware that the use of AI throughout the application process may be monitored to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process for all.

Please beware of fraudulent job postings and offers claiming to be from the Financial Times. All legitimate opportunities will direct you to apply through the official Financial Times careers site, and the FT will never ask for financial information, payments, or referrals to third parties during the hiring process. If you have any concerns about the legitimacy of a job posting or suspect any scam activity, please contact talent@ft.com.

Interested in the FT but don’t see the right role yet? Join our Talent Community to receive exclusive updates, featured jobs, and insights into working at the FT.

Operating out of a vibrant London office, this business combines premium product design with a strong purpose-driven ethos.
Reporting directly to the Head of Digital, you will lead the email and CRM programme, turning one-time buyers into repeat customers through a data-led lifecycle of campaigns and automated flows. ClarusONE Sourcing Services, LLP, provides strategic generic pharmaceutical services for both Walmart Stores, Inc. and McKesson Corporation. Its’ mission is to enable access to affordable medicines, which it has successfully been doing since its inception in 2016.

ClarusONE is a joint venture between Walmart and McKesson, two of the top 10 biggest corporations in the USA, according to the Fortune 500 list. They have more than two decades of history working together to improve the quality and lower the cost of pharmaceutical care to patients. This partnership leverages McKesson’s demonstrated strength and expertise in global pharmaceutical sourcing in conjunction with Walmart’s strength and commitment to delivering leading health and wellness services to their customers.

ClarusONE Sourcing Services is headquartered in London and prides itself on its can-do attitude that has ensured millions of Americans pay less when buying generic pharmaceuticals every day.

About the Role: 

The Associate Pricing Analyst will support the Pricing & Commercial Operations Lead and act as a central analytical and commercial resource for pricing across the Sourcing organisation. The role will combine accurate execution of pricing activity with proactive identification, analysis and delivery of pricing opportunities across suppliers, products and sourcing programmes.

The Pricing Analyst will evaluate supplier pricing behaviour, market dynamics, pricing-rule adherence and member economics to identify commercial risks and value opportunities. The role will develop fact-based supplier negotiation strategies, lead defined pricing discussions within agreed authority levels, and support broader initiatives to strengthen pricing consistency, supplier accountability and commercial outcomes.

The position will also contribute to the continued development of ClarusONE’s pricing framework, analytics capabilities and supplier-management approach, helping ensure that pricing rules remain commercially effective, operationally practical and aligned with member objectives.

What You'll Do: 

Build and maintain effective relationships with suppliers and key stakeholders to support commercial objectives.Prepare negotiation strategies through analysis of historical pricing, market intelligence, supplier performance, and commercial benchmarks.Conduct detailed pricing, spend, and market analysis to identify cost-saving opportunities, commercial risks, and value creation initiatives.Monitor supplier pricing trends, market dynamics, inflationary pressures, and competitive movements to support sourcing and procurement strategies.Develop analytical models and reporting to assess pricing performance, supplier behaviour, and category-level opportunities.Own or support cross-functional pricing projects from problem definition through analysis, recommendation, implementation and benefit tracking.Develop regular reporting that distinguishes submitted activity from value influenced or delivered by the pricing function.Produce regular reporting on pricing trends, savings delivery, supplier performance, and procurement initiatives.Measure and communicate the financial impact of projects, negotiations, and process improvements.Develop supplier scorecards and performance metrics to evaluate commercial performance, responsiveness, reliability, and compliance.Monitor supplier activity and identify indicators of commercial risk, value leakage, or performance concerns.


Basic Requirements:

Typically, minimum 0-2 years of relevant experience. May have degree or equivalent.Experience in pricing, commercial analytics, strategic sourcing, finance and/or supplier management.Demonstrated ability to convert complex datasets into commercial actions and recommendations.Experience preparing for or participating in supplier or customer negotiations.Experience assessing financial impact, constructing commercial scenarios and tracking realised value.Pharmaceutical, healthcare distribution, procurement or generic-drug market experience preferred.Experience delivering analytical or process-improvement projects across multiple function.


Preferred Skills/Experience: 

Strong commercial judgement and ability to recognise value opportunities beyond basic rule compliance.Advanced Excel capability and working knowledge of BI, dashboarding or analytical tools.Ability to analyse pricing at product, family, supplier and portfolio levels.Confident presentation and storytelling skills, with the ability to communicate recommendations to senior stakeholders.Effective negotiation, influencing and challenge skills.Ability to operate within legal, contractual and confidentiality guardrails when providing supplier pricing guidance. Existing guidance materials specifically emphasise avoiding disclosure of one supplier’s pricing or how guidance was derived.Ability to balance member economics, sourcing strategy, supplier relationships, compliance and operational feasibility.Strong project management skills, including ownership of milestones, risks, benefits and stakeholder actions.


Physical Requirements: 

This is a Hybrid role in London, GBR. Candidate will be required to be onsite 2 days per week. This role is Fixed Term (12 months). 


McKesson has become aware of online recruiting-related scams in which individuals who are not affiliated with or authorized by McKesson are using McKesson’s (or affiliated entities, like CoverMyMeds or RxCrossroads) name in fraudulent emails, job postings or social media messages. In light of these scams, please bear the following in mind:

McKesson Talent Advisors will never solicit money or credit card information in connection with a McKesson job application.

McKesson Talent Advisors do not communicate with candidates via online chatrooms or using email accounts such as Gmail or Hotmail. Note that McKesson does rely on a virtual assistant (Gia) for certain recruiting-related communications with candidates.

Your role

You will work closely with experienced colleagues across the Payments and Treasury function to ensure processes are completed efficiently and in line with established controls.

This role offers an excellent opportunity to build your knowledge of payment operations, develop strong analytical skills, and gain exposure to key stakeholders across the business. You will report directly to the Payments Operations leadership team and regularly collaborate with Treasury Operations, Client Services, and other internal teams.

What You'll Be Doing

How We Work

Assigned workspace in the UK office - The Point, 37 North Wharf Road, London, W2 1AFCompany-issued equipmentFormal, hands-on trainingSupport and guidance from senior team members

Supporting the accurate and timely processing of payment instructions.Processing incoming and outgoing payments in line with internal procedures.Ensuring payment activities are completed in compliance with client requirements, regulatory obligations, and internal controls.Developing knowledge across a range of payment workflows and end-to-end payment processes.Working closely with Treasury Operations, Client Services, and internal stakeholders to support client transactions.Investigating and resolving payment-related queries in a timely and professional manner.Building and maintaining effective working relationships with internal teams and external counterparties.Escalating payment issues or exceptions as appropriate.Taking ownership of personal development by learning from senior team members.Supporting a high standard of service delivery, accuracy, and risk management.

Pay Transparency

The final offer will be determined based on objective, gender-neutral criteria including relevant skills, professional experience, and qualifications. Corpay is a global technology organization that is leading the future of commercial payments with a culture of innovation that drives us to constantly create new and better ways to pay. Our specialized payment solutions help businesses control, simplify, and secure payment for fuel, general payables, toll and lodging expenses. Millions of people in over 80 countries around the world use our solutions for their payments.

At Corpay, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful workplace where employees are valued for their diverse perspectives, experiences, and contributions. We believe that diversity, equity, and inclusion strengthen our teams, drive innovation, and support our continued success globally.

As part of our hiring process, offers of employment may be subject to the successful completion of pre-employment screening conducted by an authorized third-party provider, in accordance with applicable laws and Corpay policies. Screening requirements may include employment references, identity verification, criminal record checks, financial or sanctions screening, and other background checks relevant to the role and permitted by local law.

Notice to Recruitment Agencies and Search Firms: Corpay does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies or search firms without a valid written agreement in place. Any unsolicited candidate submissions will become the property of Corpay, and no fees will be paid related to such submissions.

Learn more about Corpay: https://www.corpay.com

Transparency & Compliance

Equal Opportunity Employer

Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, marital status, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. These tools are designed to enhance efficiency, consistency, and fairness throughout the hiring process. AI tools do not make final hiring decisions. All employment decisions involve human review. rows.title: Data Scientist/Data Engineer (Cricket Analytics)
rows.descriptionText:
About Summary
CricViz has established itself as a market leader in the collection, analysis, and dissemination of data across the world’s leading cricket competitions, maintaining the largest and most sophisticated database in world cricket. Our work spans several verticals, including Performance Analysis, Broadcast and Media, and Fantasy and Gaming platforms. Our clients include the BBC, Sky, Sony, the ECB, and IPL-winning franchises like RCB.About the Role
We are seeking a talented Data Scientist / Data Engineer with a passion for cricket to join the CricViz team in London. This role focuses on the hands-on development of proprietary metrics, data pipelines, and predictive models derived from high-frequency cricket tracking data.In this role, you will bridge the gap between complex data processing and commercial analytics, converting rich tracking datasets into market-leading analytical products. You will combine quantitative modeling and data engineering best practices with a deep, nuanced understanding of the game of cricket to help answer complex performance questions for elite professional clients.
Key Responsibilities
Metric Development & Data Pipelines: Build and optimize end-to-end data pipelines and algorithms that transform raw ball-tracking and player-tracking data into high-value metrics (e.g., pitch behavior, expected runs/wickets, advanced fielding analysis).Data Engineering & Productionisation: Support the scaling and productisation of predictive models and datasets, ensuring reliable integration into internal tools and client workflows.Bespoke Client Deliverables: Collaborate with senior team members to deliver custom datasets, niche analytics, and predictive modeling for private clients across professional cricket, media, and gaming.Model Validation & Testing: Conduct thorough testing, validation, and optimization of predictive models to maintain high accuracy and data integrity across all operational feeds.Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with internal Product, Engineering, and Broadcast teams to ensure raw feeds and derived insights flow seamlessly into production systems.Cricket & Betting Applications: Work on sports analytics across media, fantasy, gaming, and sports betting applications. Candidates should be comfortable operating in an environment where betting-related data and modeling form part of the commercial landscape.
Requirements
Education: Degree in Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative discipline.Practical Experience: ~2 years of hands-on experience developing data pipelines and applying statistical/data science techniques in a professional or production environment.Data Science & Engineering Skills:Strong proficiency in Python and SQL.Familiarity with the PyData stack (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn, XGBoost, or LightGBM).Experience handling, querying, and structuring structured and semi-structured datasets.Domain Knowledge: Deep understanding of cricket, match dynamics, and tactical nuances, with the ability to reason about how data models reflect real-game scenarios.
Desirable
Tracking Data: Exposure to working with high-frequency spatial, GPS, or tracking data.Software Practices: Knowledge of modern software tools (Git, CI/CD, Docker, or cloud technologies like AWS/GCP).Technical Communication: Ability to explain technical logic and metrics to non-technical stakeholders clearly.
Diversity & Inclusion
CricViz is committed to building an open and inclusive culture that supports personal development and continuous learning. As part of Ellipse, we believe in equal opportunity in employment regardless of race, colour, nationality, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, age, ethnic or national origin, disability, or gender reassignment.
Benefits
25 days annual leave + bank holidaysFlexible hybrid working model with regular collaborative days at our London officeCompany pension schemeLife insurance & eye test contributionsDedicated training and professional development budget
About EllipseCricViz is part of Ellipse, a global leader in sports data and analytics alongside FootballViz, Horse Racing, RugbyViz, and TennisViz. Working with the world’s leading broadcasters, teams, and rights holders, we simplify complex data to tell compelling stories about the sports we love.
