rows.title: Software Engineer - Customer Facing Applied AI
rows.descriptionText:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

The Role

The Applied AI team works embedded with Addepar's strategic clients to figure out where AI can change how they work and then build those capabilities from scratch. You'll spend time understanding a client's world, identify what's worth building, prototype it, prove it works, and then partner with core engineering teams to ship it as product for all customers.

As an Applied AI Engineer, you'll build agentic systems from idea through production. The work starts with understanding the problem well enough to know what to build, then moves fast through prototyping and iteration. You'll design agent behavior, wire up tool integrations, tune evaluations until the AI actually works in practice. You'll sit close to the people who use what you build, and that feedback loop is how both the product and your skills grow fast. The team is new. Your work shapes what we ship.

This role may require occasional work outside standard business hours to accommodate client time zones and up to 15% travel to client sites, including occasional overnight and multi-day engagements.

Applicants must have, and maintain, the right to work in the United Kingdom from the first day of employment. Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

What You'll Do

Build AI-powered agents and tools end-to-end: identify the problem with clients and domain experts, prototype quickly, evaluate rigorously, and ship to productionDesign and implement LLM integrations including prompt engineering, function calling, structured outputs, and retrieval-augmented workflowsDefine evaluation criteria and build test harnesses for AI systems where correctness is ambiguous and domain-specificWork directly with clients to understand their workflows, validate AI behavior, and iterate toward production qualityPartner with core engineering teams to generalize client-specific work into product featuresContribute to shared AI infrastructure (agent frameworks, tool integrations, deployment pipelines)Monitor and maintain production AI systems with attention to reliability, cost, and performance

Who You Are

Prior professional software engineering experienceProfessional experience with Python (the team's primary language)Experience working with LLM APIs (Claude, GPT, or similar) including function calling and structured outputsComfort with SQL for data exploration and building data-grounded AI workflowsExperience with AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Codex, or similar)You've built something from zero to one. You're drawn to figuring out what to build, not just building what's specified.A bias for action. You ship quickly, learn from feedback, and iterate.You see projects through from prototype to production and care about what the client experiences, not what the code doesBS/MS in Computer Science, Mathematics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent experience

Nice to Have

Experience building agentic systems (multi-step tool use, agent orchestration, durable workflows)Experience with additional backend languages (Java is valuable in our environment)Familiarity with financial data (portfolios, transactions, securities, accounting)Exposure to cloud infrastructure (AWS) and container-based deploymentsExperience with evaluation frameworks or methodologies for measuring AI system quality

Our Values 

Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success. Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. 

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

rows.title: Technical Data Operations Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Technical Data Operations Analyst responsible for overseeing the E2E marketing data flow and partnering with IT and BI to operationalize insights through AI agents and workflows. Firmly seated within the digital marketing organization, this role is explicitly differentiated from traditional IT functions; instead, you will serve as the critical bridge, partnering closely with IT for flawless technical execution. Reporting to the Director of Marketing Data and Operations, this leader will drive digital acquisition capabilities, focusing on integrating artificial intelligence, enabling end-to-end performance tracking, and optimizing operational workflows for unprecedented scale and efficiency. The successful candidate will be a creative problem-solver who thrives in a fast-changing environment, acting as the primary operations contact to ensure our technology foundation actively supports aggressive global business growth.

Key Responsibilities

Data Knowledge Base: Serve as a key point of contact for the marketing technology stack—partnering with BI and IT to support operational insights.Privacy Coordinator: Serve as the marketing privacy coordinator and support privacy compliance initiatives in partnership with legal and privacy.Data Governance: Act as the marketing data steward to support data governance and operational transparencyCustomer 360: Support the operationalization of Customer 360 on CDP and enable unified segmentation on unified profiles.AI Implementation: Assist in operationalizing data models and AI by partnering with BI, Analytics, AdTech, and IT.Operational Analysis: Perform quantitative operational analysis and modeling across the marketing landscape and support the execution of optimization programs leveraging AI.Process Efficiency: Contribute to best practices for efficient and effective data operations.Process Documentation: Document and support the implementation of scalable operational processes (SLAs, governance) that optimize workflow efficiency, productivity, and quality across digital operations.

Qualifications

Qualifications 

Experience in Marketing Operations or Digital Marketing roles, with a track record of supporting technical initiatives.Practical experience contributing to the design and implementation of data infrastructure that meets the demands of real-time decisioning.Strong working knowledge of technical integrations across the MarTech stack, including CDPs, CRMs (e.g., Salesforce), and internal data warehousing solutions (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery).Hands-on experience with key operations and orchestration platforms: LeanData, Demandbase, and Allocadia.Technical proficiency in utilizing AI/ML, Generative AI, and predictive modeling for real-time data orchestration.Demonstrated ability to translate business objectives into technical requirements and user stories (PRDs), assisting with development backlog management alongside internal engineering teams.Strong project management skills, utilizing agile methodologies to help coordinate cross-functional technical projects.Clear understanding and practical application of global data privacy and compliance standards (GDPR, CCPA, etc.) and their impact on data usage.

Preferred Qualifications

Proficiency in utilizing SQL and Python for advanced data analysis, modeling, and automated data quality audits.Ability to lead at the intersection of business and technology with a passion for marketing technology, clearly differentiating marketing ecosystem needs from traditional IT infrastructure.Demonstrated success integrating and scaling comprehensive technology solutions: Marketing Automation, CRM, Predictive Analytics, and Data Enrichment.Strong cross-functional relationship development skills, specifically in establishing effective program management processes between Marketing and IT.Comfort with accountability and the ability to navigate ambiguity and manage competing priorities.

Compensation Disclosure

The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and work location. For candidates who receive an offer at the posted level, the starting base salary (for non-sales roles) or base salary + commission target (for sales/com-missioned roles) is expected to be the annual range listed below. The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. A description of our employee benefits may be found here.

$106,000.00 - $170,500.00/yr

Our Commitment 

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

rows.title: Data Analyst, In-Store
rows.descriptionText:
About The Team

The SevenRooms Data & Analytics team is the foundational data hub powering go-to-market, product, finance, and operational decisions across the In-Store business. We design and maintain the pipelines, models, and infrastructure that connect SevenRooms' systems with the broader DoorDash data ecosystem — and we're investing aggressively in making our datasets ready for both human and AI consumption. Within the team, our product-focused analytics work owns the funnels, personas, and feature-adoption insights that inform what products and features get built, how it's launched, and how it performs in the market.

About The Role

We're hiring a Data Analyst to be the data partner for our Product Management, Product Marketing, and executive teams at SevenRooms. You will own the building of data products, feature launch analytics, and the PLG instrumentation that connects product usage signals back into Salesforce, Gainsight, and our outbound motions.

You will report into the Manager, Data & Analytics on our Data & Analytics team in our SevenRooms organization.

You're Excited About This Opportunity Because You Will…

Own product analytics end-to-end — funnels, adoption, retention, and ROI for every major feature launch on the SevenRooms platform.Build net new data products aimed at improving analytic and reporting capabilitiesPartner with Product Managers and Product Marketers on pre-launch hypotheses , beta testing results, post-launch measurement, and ongoing optimization.Design and ship PLG automations that translate product behavior into opportunity tagging, expansion signals, and CSM workflows.Apply GenAI and ML techniques — partnering with our GTM Engineer — to product analytics use cases like web-sourced feature adoption opportunities, transactions predictive modeling, and Add-On ICP scoring.Communicate closely in support of multiple PM’s with reporting and ad-hoc analysis

We're Excited About You Because…

A degree in Math, Physics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or a similar domain2+ years of experience analyzing product data and partnering with Product Management teams in a SaaS environment.Expert SQL skills and proficiency with a cloud BI tool such as Looker, Tableau, or Mode.Hands-on experience with product instrumentation and analytics platforms such as Pendo, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or Heap.Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous product questions into rigorous, scoped analyses that ship recommendations — not just dashboards.Strong written and verbal communication skills, including comfort presenting to product and executive audiences.

Compensation

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

See Below For Paid Time Off Details

For salaried roles: flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year.For hourly roles: vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week).

The national base pay range for this position within the United States, including Illinois and Colorado.

$98,600—$145,000 USD

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Statement of Non-Discrimination: In keeping with our beliefs and goals, no employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on: race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital/domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination and harassment based on “protected categories,” we also strive to prevent other subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (i.e., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our office. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at DoorDash. We value a diverse workforce – people who identify as women, non-binary or gender non-conforming, LGBTQIA+, American Indian or Native Alaskan, Black or African American, Hispanic or Latinx, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, differently-abled, caretakers and parents, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. Thank you to the Level Playing Field Institute for this statement of non-discrimination.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation.

If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.

Notice to Applicants for Jobs Located in NYC or Remote Jobs Associated With Office in NYC Only

We used Covey as part of our hiring and/or promotional process for jobs in NYC and certain features may qualify it as an AEDT in NYC. As part of the hiring and/or promotion process, we provided Covey with job requirements and candidate submitted applications. The Data Analyst MRT s responsible for coordinating all Caminar, Avatar and Electronic Health Record (EHR) related tasks, including collection and entry of members served data (e.g. demographics, diagnosis, service codes, billing codes), running reports, ensuring accuracy of data and reporting back to the program and the payer. The position requires using outcomes data to promote program improvement with a focus on positive outcomes for the members served.

Full-Time | AM | Shifts: 8:00 AM - 5:30 PM | Days: Monday - Friday

Expected starting wage range is $30.22 - $37.35. Telecare applies geographic differentials to its pay ranges. The pay range assigned to this role will be based on the geographic location from which the role is performed. Starting pay is commensurate with relevant experience above the minimum requirements.

What You Bring To The Table (Must Have)

One (1) year of database experience Must be able to communicate effectively with staff and payer representatives One (1) year of EHR or healthcare information system experience in a psychiatric inpatient program, mental health outpatient program or acute hospital setting Knowledge of local, state and federal regulations, survey processes, accreditation standards, and psychiatric requirements Knowledge and application of appropriate coding systems; ICD-10 CM, DSM IV Knowledge of documentation and legal issues pertaining to HIPAA, PHI and other health information

Weekend Shift differentials for hourly staff (5% for Weekend AM Shift, 11% for Weekend PM Shift, 15% for Weekend NOC Shift)Free CEUs, free Supervision for BBS Associate License, coaching, and mentorship Online University Tuition Discount and Company Scholarships Medical, Vision, Dental Insurance, 401K, Employee Stock Ownership Plan For more information visit: https://www.telecarecorp.com/benefits 

Join Our Compassionate Team

Telecare's mission is to deliver excellent and effective behavioral health services that engage individuals in recovering their health, hopes, and dreams. Telecare continues to advance cultural diversity, humility, equity, and inclusion at all levels of our organization by hiring mental health peers, BIPOC, LGBTQIA+, veterans, and all belief systems.

The Muriel Wright Recovery Center SUTS helps people with active substance use issues to transition out of jail more effectively and begin the recovery process in a supportive environment. All services are mental health-informed, using approaches such as Motivational Interviewing and Stages of Change to help engage people in treatment. SUTS services are heavily group-based to build community and support, and are based on the Integrated Dual Disorder Treatment (IDDT) curriculum, a SAMSHA Evidence-Based Practice. Additional services include Medication Assisted Treatment (MAT), relapse prevention, physical health screenings, etc. The Muriel Wright Recovery Center SUTS program is an ASAM Level 3.1 service and is operated under contract with Santa Clara County Behavioral Health Services Department.

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to know our team: 

The Performance Marketing Team of Agoda is a world leader in online marketing. This department is highly data-driven and focused on developing at-scale marketing programs that improve the lifetime value of Agoda customers through measurable marketing programs and channels. The team is a blend of the best analysts, marketing strategists, and data scientists in the world. The marketing leadership at Agoda has deep experience in data science, product, strategy, and other marketing fields and has built an organization that thrives on data, creative ideas, and technology. The Performance Marketing Team also fosters a great learning environment. You will be able to learn and grow by working closely with experts from a variety of backgrounds from all over the world.

Due to continued expansion, there are multiple analyst roles within the marketing team across different marketing channels. While the scope will vary depending on these channels, here are some examples:

Experimentation and optimizing campaign performance: Experiment with ads/campaign structures and bidding& pricing strategies on partners such as Google, Bing, TripAdvisor, Trivago, and other search engines. Adapt to new product features and roll out changes from successful tests.Modeling: Analyze vast amounts of data generated by experiments, develop predictive models using data science techniques (e.g. understanding the impact on bookings from large-scale TV campaigns or demand elasticity from pricing optimization), and liaise with product teams on an implementation roadmapReporting, analysis, and insights: Building dashboards to track performance, derive insights, understand growth levers, and communicate recommendations via presentations to stakeholders

What you’ll Need to Succeed: 

Bachelor’s degree or higher from top university in a quantitative subject e.g. computer science, mathematics, engineering business, science, or relevant field of study4+ years experience in data crunching from top-tier consulting, investment banking, private equity or strategy/business role for a fast-growing global tech companyExperience in one or more data analysis packages or databases, e.g. SQL, SAS, R, SPSS, Python, VBA and visualization tools, e.g. Tableau, Power BI, etc.Excellent verbal and written communication skills in EnglishAbility to move fast and be efficient, making decisions on objective data evidence Innate desire to take ownership, make an impact and influence outcomesExcellent organizational skills, attention to detail and ability to work independently

It’s great if you have: 

Experience in digital marketing or e-commerceExperience with A/B testing and other testing metricsStrong presentation and negotiation skills

rows.title: Technical Data Operations Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Technical Data Operations Analyst responsible for overseeing the E2E marketing data flow and partnering with IT and BI to operationalize insights through AI agents and workflows. Firmly seated within the digital marketing organization, this role is explicitly differentiated from traditional IT functions; instead, you will serve as the critical bridge, partnering closely with IT for flawless technical execution. Reporting to the Director of Marketing Data and Operations, this leader will drive digital acquisition capabilities, focusing on integrating artificial intelligence, enabling end-to-end performance tracking, and optimizing operational workflows for unprecedented scale and efficiency. The successful candidate will be a creative problem-solver who thrives in a fast-changing environment, acting as the primary operations contact to ensure our technology foundation actively supports aggressive global business growth.

Key Responsibilities

Data Knowledge Base: Serve as a key point of contact for the marketing technology stack—partnering with BI and IT to support operational insights.Privacy Coordinator: Serve as the marketing privacy coordinator and support privacy compliance initiatives in partnership with legal and privacy.Data Governance: Act as the marketing data steward to support data governance and operational transparencyCustomer 360: Support the operationalization of Customer 360 on CDP and enable unified segmentation on unified profiles.AI Implementation: Assist in operationalizing data models and AI by partnering with BI, Analytics, AdTech, and IT.Operational Analysis: Perform quantitative operational analysis and modeling across the marketing landscape and support the execution of optimization programs leveraging AI.Process Efficiency: Contribute to best practices for efficient and effective data operations.Process Documentation: Document and support the implementation of scalable operational processes (SLAs, governance) that optimize workflow efficiency, productivity, and quality across digital operations.

Qualifications

Qualifications 

Experience in Marketing Operations or Digital Marketing roles, with a track record of supporting technical initiatives.Practical experience contributing to the design and implementation of data infrastructure that meets the demands of real-time decisioning.Strong working knowledge of technical integrations across the MarTech stack, including CDPs, CRMs (e.g., Salesforce), and internal data warehousing solutions (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery).Hands-on experience with key operations and orchestration platforms: LeanData, Demandbase, and Allocadia.Technical proficiency in utilizing AI/ML, Generative AI, and predictive modeling for real-time data orchestration.Demonstrated ability to translate business objectives into technical requirements and user stories (PRDs), assisting with development backlog management alongside internal engineering teams.Strong project management skills, utilizing agile methodologies to help coordinate cross-functional technical projects.Clear understanding and practical application of global data privacy and compliance standards (GDPR, CCPA, etc.) and their impact on data usage.

Preferred Qualifications

Proficiency in utilizing SQL and Python for advanced data analysis, modeling, and automated data quality audits.Ability to lead at the intersection of business and technology with a passion for marketing technology, clearly differentiating marketing ecosystem needs from traditional IT infrastructure.Demonstrated success integrating and scaling comprehensive technology solutions: Marketing Automation, CRM, Predictive Analytics, and Data Enrichment.Strong cross-functional relationship development skills, specifically in establishing effective program management processes between Marketing and IT.Comfort with accountability and the ability to navigate ambiguity and manage competing priorities.

Compensation Disclosure

The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and work location. For candidates who receive an offer at the posted level, the starting base salary (for non-sales roles) or base salary + commission target (for sales/com-missioned roles) is expected to be the annual range listed below. The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. A description of our employee benefits may be found here.

$106,000.00 - $170,500.00/yr

Our Commitment 

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

Job Details

Job Description:

What if your next project helped power the future of technology?

At Intel, you'll do more than learn, you'll contribute. You'll work side-by-side with industry leaders, gain hands-on experience on meaningful projects, and help solve real-world challenges that affect billions of people worldwide. From advanced semiconductor manufacturing to AI-powered innovations, you'll play a role in technologies that redefine how the world works, learns, and connects.

What makes Intel unique is the opportunity to see the entire technology lifecycle in action. Unlike many companies where hardware, software, and manufacturing operate separately, Intel brings them together, giving you exposure to everything from research and design to advanced semiconductor manufacturing and global deployment.

Whether you're tackling engineering challenges, improving operations, analyzing data, advancing next-generation technologies, or supporting global customers, you'll build valuable skills while contributing to innovations that enable a more sustainable and connected future.

Bring your curiosity, make an impact, and see where your ideas can take you at Intel.

What You'll Do

Within Intel's Sales Management Group, you'll combine your education with immersive, applied learning to understand how Intel brings technology solutions to customers, partners, and markets around the world.

Connect Intel technologies to customer and business outcomes.Support sales teams, customers, or partners with technical insights and solutions.Analyze market, customer, product, and business data.Contribute to solution selling, sales enablement, and technical messaging.Build skills across hardware, software, systems, AI, and customer engagement.

Throughout your internship, you will collaborate with colleagues and global partners, contribute to impactful projects, and gain exposure to how Intel drives business impact across industries.

Where Your Career Could Take You

Opportunities You May Be Considered For Include

Technical SalesSales EngineeringSolution ArchitectureCloud, AI, Systems, and Platform Solutions

Build business, technical, analytical, and communication skills while exploring career paths across sales, marketing, strategy, operations, customer engagement, and technology solutions.

Qualifications

Intel sponsors individuals for employment-based visas for positions where we experience a shortage of U.S. workers. These skills shortage roles are typically STEM positions requiring a Master's or PhD degree, or a Bachelor's degree with at least three years of post-degree related job experience. This position does not qualify for Intel sponsorship because it is either a non-STEM position, or a STEM position that only requires a Bachelor's degree and less than three years' experience.

rows.title: Content Marketing Lead
rows.descriptionText:
Who We Are
The world is moving towards instant digital payments and TabaPay is leading the way. We help thousands of Fintechs in the US and Canada instantly move money in and out of accounts and we are actively expanding into other countries. Our customers represent the hottest verticals in the financial service industry such as neobanks, challenger brokers, gaming and wallets. TabaPay is a highly profitable rocketship that processes billions of dollars each year. To learn more visit www.tabapay.com.
What You’ll Do
As Content Marketing Lead, you will own TabaPay’s content and organic social strategy. You will shape an editorial point of view for priority industries, create high-quality work yourself, and coordinate contributions from executives, Product Marketing, customers, and agency partners. Your work will strengthen TabaPay’s industry authority and support measurable qualified inbound growth.
This is a senior individual contributor role. You will set priorities, build repeatable processes, and have the opportunity to grow into managing a team as the content program expands.
What You’ll Own
Content Strategy and Editorial ProgramDefine content priorities for target industries, audiences, use cases, and products in partnership with Product Marketing Managers.Build and manage an integrated editorial and distribution calendar across the blog, website, social channels, research, events, and campaigns.Write, edit, and publish useful industry, use-case, product, and thought leadership content; repurpose launches, research, events, and executive perspectives across channels.
Executive Thought Leadership and SocialLead the executive LinkedIn program, beginning with Rodney and Meeta and expanding to Manoj and Tim.Develop the company’s organic social strategy, editorial cadence, and channel-specific distribution approach.Work closely with executives to turn their expertise into distinct, accurate points of view and reliable publishing rhythms.
Organic Discovery and GrowthOwn the content plan for search and Answer Engine Optimization, including topic selection, content improvements, and learning from performance.Partner with web, demand generation, and analytics colleagues to improve organic conversion and connect content to qualified inbound opportunities.Build a practical measurement dashboard and use findings to refine the editorial roadmap.
Organic Discovery and GrowthOwn the content plan for search and Answer Engine Optimization, including topic selection, content improvements, and learning from performance.Partner with web, demand generation, and analytics colleagues to improve organic conversion and connect content to qualified inbound opportunities.Build a practical measurement dashboard and use findings to refine the editorial roadmap.
Research, Customer Stories, and Earned VisibilityLead the flagship industry report, from editorial concept and research plan through production and distribution.Develop a case study program and coordinate customer proof points with Sales, Customer Success, and Product Marketing.Set priorities for the PR agency with the VP of Marketing and support speaking opportunities with relevant content and executive perspectives.
Experience
Strong B2B content marketing experience, preferably in fintech, payments, or another regulated industry.Demonstrated ability to set strategy and personally produce strong writing, editing, and content across formats.Experience running executive thought leadership, organic social, and search-led content programs.Ability to make complex payment or financial topics clear and useful to business audiences.Sound editorial judgment, comfort using performance data, and skill coordinating executives, peers, agencies, and customer stakeholders.Interest in building a content function and growing into people leadership.
Success in This Role
Success will be measured by progress across business outcomes and the quality and consistency of the content program:
Growth in qualified nonpaid inbound opportunities and content-influenced pipeline.Improved branded search impressions and organic website conversion.Meaningful engagement with executive and company LinkedIn content.Priority content delivered on schedule, including the flagship report and industry content.An expanded case study program with customer-approved, quantifiable results where available.
First 90 Days
Develop the H1 editorial and distribution calendar and content strategy for priority industries.Launch an executive LinkedIn program and production cadence, starting with Rodney and Meeta.Create a search and Answer Engine Optimization topic plan, set the blog roadmap, and publish the first priority posts.Define the flagship industry report plan, a case study program and roadmap, and a content measurement dashboard.
Compensation
The compensation for this position is $130,000 for candidates living in and around the San Francisco Bay Area. However, base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position offered.
Benefits
TabaPay offers the following benefits:
100% employer-paid health care insurance including medical, dental, vision, and life insurance (for employee only)Employer 401K MatchingGenerous and Flexible PTO
EEO Employer: TabaPay is an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, Veteran status, or any other protected classification.

rows.title: Assistant Manager, CRM & Lifecycle Marketing
rows.descriptionText:
Assistant Manager, CRM & Lifecycle MarketingPay Rate: 40-45 per hourHybrid San Francisco12 month contract to start
Randstad, in partnership with Levi Strauss & Co., is looking for a data-driven Assistant Manager to join our CRM & Lifecycle Marketing team. This role will play a key role in shaping our customer retention strategy across email, mobile messaging, and loyalty experiences. You will leverage customer insights, segmentation, testing, and personalization to optimize lifecycle journeys that drive engagement, repeat purchases, and long-term customer value. Working closely with cross-functional partners, you'll help create customer experiences that reflect our brand's voice and values while delivering a best-in-class experience across eCommerce and retail. This individual will report to the CRM & Lifecycle Marketing Manager.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Support Marketing Manager with strategy, execution, and optimization of CRM lifecycle marketing programs across email and mobile messaging.• Develop and optimize lifecycle programs that leverage segmentation and personalization to drive engagement and retention.• Build and maintain a testing roadmap, leveraging A/B testing and customer insights to continuously improve campaign and journey performance.• Own performance reporting for lifecycle programs, presenting insights, test results, and data-driven recommendations to leadership and cross-functional partners.• Manage the end-to-end execution of lifecycle campaigns, overseeing planning, asset delivery, QA, and deployment to ensure a best-in-class customer experience.• Partner cross-functionally with Loyalty, Retail, Product, Analytics, Data Science, Creative, Merchandising, and external vendors to uncover customer insights, develop audience strategies, and deliver personalized, customer-centric experiences.
QUALIFICATIONS:• BS/BA in marketing, business, or related field, or equivalent experience• At least 2-3 years of experience in B2C marketing or a similar role• Must be a self-starter who takes initiative and demonstrates excellent follow-through• Excellent project management skills with precise attention to detail and natural curiosity• Ability to work under pressure, agile, thrives under a fast-paced environment• Fearless – willing to test new ideas in a channel• Excellent written and verbal communications skills• Must have deep understanding of B2C customer journey from top to bottom of marketing funnel• Strong analytical skills with previous experience using web analytics tools; have the ability to turn numbers into actionable insights• Cordial and Movable Ink experience a plus
Randstad is an at-will employer. This means that either the company or the employee may terminate the employment relationship at any time, for any reason, with or without notice.
Equal Opportunity Employer: Race, Color, Religion, Sex, Sexual Orientation, Gender Identity, National Origin, Age, Genetic Information, Disability, Protected Veteran Status, or any other legally protected group status.
At Randstad, we welcome people of all abilities and want to ensure that our hiring and interview process meets the needs of all applicants. If you require a reasonable accommodation to make your application or interview experience a great one, please contact HRsupport@randstadusa.com.
Pay offered to a successful candidate will be based on several factors including the candidate's education, work experience, work location, specific job duties, certifications, etc. In addition, Randstad offers a comprehensive benefits package, including health, an incentive and recognition program, and 401K contribution (all benefits are based on eligibility).

rows.title: Client Services Associate I, Oncology
rows.descriptionText:
A Rare Opportunity to Shape the Future of Genomics

Join a team of brilliant, passionate innovators determined to transform healthcare. At BillionToOne, we've built a category-defining, publicly traded company on Nasdaq where transparency fuels trust, collaboration drives breakthroughs, and every contribution moves the needle on our mission to make life-changing diagnostics accessible to all. We don't just aim for incremental improvements; we build products that are 10x better than anything that exists today.

Our scientists, engineers, sales executives, and visionaries are united by an unwavering commitment to changing the standard of care in prenatal and cancer diagnostics. This is where cutting-edge science meets human compassion, and every innovation you contribute helps remove the fear of the unknown from some of life's most critical medical moments.

If you're driven by purpose, energized by innovation, and ready to help shape the future of precision medicine at scale, this is where you belong.

We are looking for a Client Services Associate I, Oncology to provide exceptional service and support to BillionToOne's customers. This role is part of a broader Client Services organization.

The Client Services Associate holds a pivotal role in the organization as he/she will act as the face of BillionToOne for our customers including physicians, Oncology clinics, patients, clinical and auxiliary staff. The CSA will be on the front lines of all internal and external customer inquiries supporting BillionToOne’s Oncology tests. The ideal candidate for this role is an ambitious and intelligent individual who is highly self-motivated and can effortlessly help drive and influence a positive patient and customer experience. The Client Services Associate I is a full-time onsite position and reports to the Client Services Manager.

Working hours are Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM PT.

Responsibilities

Engage customers in a positive and courteous manner to resolve issues and deliver the best possible customer experience.Oversee and effectively respond to all types of communication in a professional and articulate manner: phone, email, and web inquiries from customers (physician offices), sales representatives, and patients.Handle a variety of inquiries, including questions about our technology, products, and services, status of test results, costs, billing, and insurance coverage.Keep precise and clear documentation of all communications and follow-up activities.Collaborate with our laboratory to ensure that client information is accurately maintained and help to ensure the timely delivery of test results.Contact physicians and other medical personnel to obtain missing information from test orders.Enter and qualify new customer information into CRM and LIMS systems.Identify issues and trends and collaborate with commercial leadership to develop best practices for internal and external processes.Participate in cross-functional projects that extend beyond routine responsibilities to contribute to building a world-class Customer Service organization.Represent the organization during intra-department meetings or All Hands meetings as needed.

Qualifications

1+ years of prior client-facing experience.4-year college degree (or equivalent in experience).Experience with CRM tools (Salesforce, Zendesk, etc.) is a plus.Advanced organizational skills with the ability to handle multiple assignments simultaneously.Ability to work in a very fast-paced, demanding environment.Outstanding verbal, written, and presentation skills - ability to effectively tailor messages to different audiences.Passion for creating a delightful experience for internal and external customers.Ability to analyze complex situations independently and implement appropriate solutions.

Nice-To-Haves

Proficiency or fluency in Spanish to effectively assist our diverse customer base and ensure a seamless patient and client experience.Customer service experience in diagnostic laboratory setting.

Benefits And Perks

Working alongside brilliant, kind, passionate and dedicated colleagues, in an empowering environment, toward a global vision, striving for a future in which transformative molecular diagnostics can help millions of patientsOpen, transparent culture that includes weekly Town Hall meetingsThe ability to indirectly or directly change the lives of hundreds of thousands patientsMultiple medical benefit options; employee premiums paid 100% of select plans, dependents covered up to 80%Extremely generous Family Bonding Leave for eligible employees (16 weeks, paid at 100%)Supplemental fertility benefits coverage Retirement savings program including a 4% Company matchIncrease paid time off with increased tenureLatest and greatest hardware (laptop, lab equipment, facilities)Daily on-site lunches provided from top eateriesA variety of perks on campus (state of the art gym, restaurant)Free on-site EV charging (compatible with all EVs, including Tesla)

At BillionToOne, we are proud to offer a combination of (1) competitive base pay, (2) generous equity options offering, (3) corporate bonus program, on top of (4) industry leading company benefits (free healthcare options, 401k match, very generous fully paid parental leave, etc.).

For this position, we offer a total compensation package of $66,123 per year, including a base pay of $28.90 per hour.

BillionToOne is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

For more information about how we protect your information, we encourage you to review our Privacy Policy.

BillionToOne is a next-generation molecular diagnostics company on a mission to make powerful, accurate diagnostic tests accessible to everyone. Our revolutionary QCT molecular counting technology enhances disease detection resolution by over a thousandfold using cell-free DNA,a breakthrough that has already transformed the lives of over half a million patients worldwide.

Our Impact

Unity Complete™ is the only non-invasive prenatal screen capable of assessing fetal risk for both common recessive conditions and aneuploidies from a single maternal blood sample.

Unity Confirm™ enables non-invasive confirmation for high-risk screening results through the capture of intact circulating fetal cells using BillionToOne’s Fetal Cell Capture™ Technology.

Our Northstar® liquid biopsy test uniquely combines treatment selection with real-time monitoring, giving oncologists unprecedented precision in cancer care.

Our Growth

From $0 to $400M+ annualized revenue run-rate in just 6 years. In 2025, we completed one of the most successful IPOs for a medical diagnostics company, building on nearly $400M in private funding,including our $130M Series D in 2024 and backed by world-class investors including Hummingbird, Adams Street Partners, Neuberger Berman, Baillie Gifford, and Premji Invest.

Our Recognition

Forbes named us one of America's Best Startup Employers for 2025 and we're Great Place to Work certified, with 100% of our people willing to go the extra mile, even as we've scaled to over 700 employees.

Our Future

Headquartered in Menlo Park with facilities in Union City, CA, and a new lab opening in Austin, TX in 2027, we're continuing to push the boundaries of what's possible in molecular diagnostics. We're just getting started.

Ready to help us change the world, one molecule at a time? Learn more at billiontoone.com

rows.title: Technical Data Operations Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Technical Data Operations Analyst responsible for overseeing the E2E marketing data flow and partnering with IT and BI to operationalize insights through AI agents and workflows. Firmly seated within the digital marketing organization, this role is explicitly differentiated from traditional IT functions; instead, you will serve as the critical bridge, partnering closely with IT for flawless technical execution. Reporting to the Director of Marketing Data and Operations, this leader will drive digital acquisition capabilities, focusing on integrating artificial intelligence, enabling end-to-end performance tracking, and optimizing operational workflows for unprecedented scale and efficiency. The successful candidate will be a creative problem-solver who thrives in a fast-changing environment, acting as the primary operations contact to ensure our technology foundation actively supports aggressive global business growth.

Key Responsibilities

Data Knowledge Base: Serve as a key point of contact for the marketing technology stack—partnering with BI and IT to support operational insights.Privacy Coordinator: Serve as the marketing privacy coordinator and support privacy compliance initiatives in partnership with legal and privacy.Data Governance: Act as the marketing data steward to support data governance and operational transparencyCustomer 360: Support the operationalization of Customer 360 on CDP and enable unified segmentation on unified profiles.AI Implementation: Assist in operationalizing data models and AI by partnering with BI, Analytics, AdTech, and IT.Operational Analysis: Perform quantitative operational analysis and modeling across the marketing landscape and support the execution of optimization programs leveraging AI.Process Efficiency: Contribute to best practices for efficient and effective data operations.Process Documentation: Document and support the implementation of scalable operational processes (SLAs, governance) that optimize workflow efficiency, productivity, and quality across digital operations.

Qualifications

Qualifications 

Experience in Marketing Operations or Digital Marketing roles, with a track record of supporting technical initiatives.Practical experience contributing to the design and implementation of data infrastructure that meets the demands of real-time decisioning.Strong working knowledge of technical integrations across the MarTech stack, including CDPs, CRMs (e.g., Salesforce), and internal data warehousing solutions (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery).Hands-on experience with key operations and orchestration platforms: LeanData, Demandbase, and Allocadia.Technical proficiency in utilizing AI/ML, Generative AI, and predictive modeling for real-time data orchestration.Demonstrated ability to translate business objectives into technical requirements and user stories (PRDs), assisting with development backlog management alongside internal engineering teams.Strong project management skills, utilizing agile methodologies to help coordinate cross-functional technical projects.Clear understanding and practical application of global data privacy and compliance standards (GDPR, CCPA, etc.) and their impact on data usage.

Preferred Qualifications

Proficiency in utilizing SQL and Python for advanced data analysis, modeling, and automated data quality audits.Ability to lead at the intersection of business and technology with a passion for marketing technology, clearly differentiating marketing ecosystem needs from traditional IT infrastructure.Demonstrated success integrating and scaling comprehensive technology solutions: Marketing Automation, CRM, Predictive Analytics, and Data Enrichment.Strong cross-functional relationship development skills, specifically in establishing effective program management processes between Marketing and IT.Comfort with accountability and the ability to navigate ambiguity and manage competing priorities.

Compensation Disclosure

The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and work location. For candidates who receive an offer at the posted level, the starting base salary (for non-sales roles) or base salary + commission target (for sales/com-missioned roles) is expected to be the annual range listed below. The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. A description of our employee benefits may be found here.

$106,000.00 - $170,500.00/yr

Our Commitment 

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

rows.title: Network DevOps engineer
rows.descriptionText:
Payrate: $78.00 - $82.00/hr 
 
Summary:
Company is looking for a Network Engineer to design, deploy, and operate the corporate and datacenter network infrastructure that underpins our global workforce and production environments. You will own the full lifecycle of campus and datacenter networks from access switching and wireless LAN to spine-leaf fabrics and next-generation firewall policy while driving the reliability, security, and scalability of Company’s on-premises infrastructure. This role sits within Global Infrastructure and Platform Services (GIPS) at our headquarters. You will work closely with Security, IT, and Cloud Engineering teams and are encouraged to leverage AI tools to accelerate troubleshooting, documentation, and automation.
 
Responsibilities:Corporate & Campus NetworkingDesign and maintain the corporate LAN, including access/distribution/core switching, VLANs, STP, and QoS for the HQ and remote offices.Manage and optimize the wireless LAN infrastructure (controller-based and cloud-managed), including site surveys, RF planning, SSID design, and client troubleshooting.Administer 802.1X network access control, certificate-based authentication, and guest network segmentation.Datacenter NetworkingOperate and evolve the datacenter network, including spine-leaf architecture, BGP, VxLAN/EVPN overlays, and high-availability designs.Ensure network stability and performance across on-premises datacenter infrastructure by proactively monitoring capacity and latency baselines.Partner with Server, Storage, and Platform Engineering teams on rack-and-stack connectivity, new service deployments, and capacity expansions.Security & Firewall Manage Networks NGFW platforms, including security policy, App-ID, URL filtering, Threat Prevention, and WildFire integration.Administer Global Protect VPN and Prisma Access for remote access and enforce zero-trust network segmentation between zones.Conduct firewall rule reviews, clean up unused policies, and support periodic security audits.Reliability & AutomationMonitor network health using observability tooling (SNMP, streaming telemetry, NetFlow/sFlow) and drive resolution of incidents and root-cause analyses.Develop and maintain automation scripts and configuration management workflows (Python, Ansible, Terraform) to reduce operational toil and improve consistency.Use AI-assisted tools to accelerate log analysis, runbook generation, and network documentation. 
Required Qualifications:4-6 years of hands-on enterprise network engineering experience.Proficiency with Networks, including security policy management, zone-based segmentation, and Global Protect VPN.Solid understanding of routing and switching fundamentals: BGP, OSPF, STP/RSTP, VLANs, LACP, and L2/L3 design.Experience designing and supporting enterprise wireless networks (Cisco Meraki, Aruba, or equivalent), including familiarity with 802.11ax/Wi-Fi 6 and RF optimization.Working knowledge of datacenter networking concepts such as spine-leaf architecture, VxLAN/EVPN, and high-availability failover.Strong troubleshooting methodology with the ability to work through complex, multi-layer production issues.Effective written and verbal communication skills with the ability to produce clear runbooks and incident postmortems. 
Skills:Relevant certifications such as PCNSE, CCNP Enterprise, CWNA/CWSP, or equivalent.Experience with network automation using Python, Ansible, or Terraform.Familiarity with public cloud networking (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and hybrid connectivity solutions such as Direct Connect, ExpressRoute, and VPN.Exposure to load balancers including F5, AVI/NSX ALB, or NGINX and application delivery in datacenter environments.Experience with 802.1X / NAC platforms such as Cisco Client, Aruba ClearPass, or equivalent.Comfort using AI tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) for network operations, documentation, and automation tasks.

Non-exempt positions are eligible for overtime at a rate of 1.5 times the base hourly rate for all hours worked in excess of 40 in a work week, or as required by state or local law. rows.descriptionText:

Open to Relocation? We’ve Got You Covered: This role is open to candidates willing to relocate to one of our hub locations. Hippo offers relocation assistance to support your move, so you can focus on doing impactful work—not the logistics of getting here.
About Hippo:Hippo was built on a promise: make homeownership effortless. Nearly a decade later, that mission still drives us. We use technology and data to help our customers stay ahead of problems and protect what matters most.Today, that same tech-native approach powers our work beyond homeowners. Hippo operates as a diversified carrier platform, partnering with MGAs to deliver tailored program solutions that help them grow and deliver better customer experiences. Must Haves:Bachelor’s degree in statistics, mathematics, actuarial science, computer science, or a another quantitative field; advanced degree a plus5+ years of experience in data science, analytics, or actuarial modeling in insurance, preferably personal lines or propertyWorking knowledge of P&C insurance in loss cost modeling; exposure to demand, underwriting, and/or claims modelingStrong background in statistical modeling: GLMs, regularization, tree-based ensembles (XGBoost, LightGBM), and model validation techniquesKnowledge of actuarial principles as they relate to insurance pricingAdvanced proficiency in Python (pandas, scikit-learn, statsmodels) and SQLExcellent communication skills and ability to build trust with stakeholders at all levels

About the RoleNetwork Engineer to design, deploy, and operate the corporate and datacenter network infrastructure that underpins our global workforce and production environments.

rows.title: Head of Investor Relations & Capital Formation
rows.descriptionText:
ILLUMEN CAPITALHead of Investor Relations & Capital Formation
Firm Overview
Illumen Capital is a multi-strategy investment firm engaged in direct investments, fund-of-funds investments, and public equities. Through these strategies, we strive to address bias in investing. We invest in high-performing venture, growth and private equity funds, and work with those managers and founders to implement research-informed strategies and tools designed to address bias. This work helps fund managers, in particular, to better identify, evaluate, and invest in overlooked and underestimated entrepreneurs, with the aim to drive outperformance and unlock returns. We believe an optimal asset management industry will be a cornerstone of an equal and equitable future.
Illumen Capital invests in leading impact funds across venture capital, growth equity, and private equity, with a focus on health and wellness, education, climate and sustainability, and technologies that advance financial and social inclusion. In 2019, we published peer-reviewed research in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences validating our thesis that race influences professional investors' decision-making. We partner with Stanford SPARQ, a behavioral science "do tank" at Stanford University, to design and apply research-informed tools that address bias, as well as with Impact Experience to deliver experiential learning opportunities for founders, fund managers, and investors. More recently, Illumen launched a new U.S. public equities impact strategy in collaboration with T. Rowe Price.
Position Summary
As Illumen Capital scales toward a $1 billion investment platform, we are hiring a Head of Investor Relations & Capital Formation to lead the firm's fundraising strategy, deepen relationships with existing limited partners, and specifically expand Illumen's institutional investor base. Reporting to the Managing Director and working closely with the investment team and firm leadership, this executive will be charged with hands-on execution: originating and closing commitments, translating Illumen's research-backed approach into an even more compelling investor narrative, and working with the Illumen team to enhance systems and improve the operating cadence required for sustained growth. This is a full-time role that will require meaningful travel to meet with investors and attend conferences, firm events and industry gatherings.
Location: Hybrid out of Illumen's Oakland, California officeTravel Requirement: ~50%
Essential Functions
Develop and execute a comprehensive capital formation strategy across Illumen's investment offerings for progress toward $1 billion in assets under management (AUM).Originate, qualify, cultivate, and close capital commitments from institutional investors, consultants and OCIOs, family offices, foundations, endowments, pension plans, wealth platforms, and high-net-worth individuals.Lead prospective investors through the full fundraising journey - from first meetings and qualification through diligence, negotiation, Investment-Committee approval, and signed subscriptions.Serve as a trusted senior relationship manager for current LPs; strengthen re-ups, referrals, co-investment relationships, and cross-strategy engagement across Illumen's private-market and public-equities offerings.Develop fundraising goals, probability-weighted forecasts, conversion metrics, and a disciplined operating system with clear ownership and accountability.Effectively communicate Illumen's investment performance, its research addressing bias, and its impact thesis for sophisticated investors across private and public markets.Position Illumen effectively across impact-investing, emerging-manager, consultant, institutional, and private-wealth channels; monitor allocation trends, investor sentiment, and competitive fundraising dynamics.Provide actionable market intelligence to firm leadership, including insights that inform fundraising priorities, product development, investor segmentation, and potential new structures or strategies consistent with Illumen's mission.Lead high-quality investor communications and experiences, including LP meetings, quarterly and annual reporting, impact communications, advisory engagement, conferences, regional campaigns, and relationship-building events.Oversee pitch books, fact sheets, due-diligence questionnaires, data-room content, customized investor requests, website and newsletter content, and other external materials, ensuring accuracy and consistency.Partner effectively with Illumen investment, finance, operations, legal, compliance, and impact colleagues, fostering a collaborative, accountable, and team-first culture.
In summary: Build and lead a high-performing investor relations and capital formation operation, including the systems, processes, institutional knowledge, and capabilities required to scale.
Knowledge, Skills, Abilities
A demonstrated passion for building a more equitable world, grounded in the belief that addressing bias in investment decision-making can unlock stronger performance and deeper impact.Significant experience in institutional fundraising, investor relations and capital formation with a record of personally originating relationships and closing meaningful commitments.Active relationships across relevant investor channels - particularly consultants and OCIOs, foundations, endowments, pensions, family offices, wealth platforms, and mission-aligned investors - that can be successfully activated.Experience in multi-asset class strategies is preferred.Strong investment fluency and the ability to communicate, with high conviction, portfolio strategy, performance, attribution, risk, impact, and Illumen's differentiated approach to addressing bias to sophisticated investment committees.The judgment and presence to represent Illumen as a trusted senior external face, with excellent writing, speaking, facilitation, and relationship-management skills.A highly organized, data-driven approach to pipeline management, forecasting, meeting preparation, follow-up, diligence, and reporting; fluency with Affinity, PitchBook, or comparable systems.A builder's orientation and the ability to operate both strategically and hands-on as a senior executive at an entrepreneurial, growing investment firm.A proven team player who collaborates across functions, shares information and credit, supports collective decisions, and contributes to shared outcomes.High integrity, discretion, resilience, curiosity, self-awareness, and a commitment to continuous learning and self-improvement.
Leadership Attributes
Builder: Creates the strategy, systems, materials, and market presence required for Illumen's next stage.Closer: Asks for commitments, responds to questions, and sustains momentum through complex institutional processes.Storyteller: Makes Illumen's performance, research, mission, and differentiated investment strategy clear, vivid and memorable.Trusted Partner: Builds credibility with sophisticated investors and collaborates happily with colleagues.Disciplined Operator: Focuses on pipeline quality, conversion, forecasting, and results.Team-first Leader: Understands shared accountability and helps raise the performance of the entire organization.High Emotional IQ: Listens actively, adapts communication, navigates difficult conversations, and responds constructively to feedback.
Measures of Success
A measurable capital formation plan aligned with Illumen's investment offerings and path toward $1 billion in AUM.A diversified, actionable pipeline with high-quality opportunities across institutional, consultant, family office, foundation, endowment, pension, and private-wealth channels.New commitments from qualified prospects, alongside stronger re-ups, referrals, and cross-strategy relationships.Disciplined forecasting, timely follow-up, compelling materials, reliable reporting, and clear accountability.
Compensation
The base annual salary range for this San Francisco Bay Area-based position will be $225,000 to $250,000. Actual salary offered will be based on the candidate's skill, experience, and qualification for the role. Employees may be eligible for a discretionary bonus, based on factors such as individual and team performance.Employer covered health insurance plans.401(k).Financial support for professional development opportunities.The opportunity to work in a mission-driven environment with access to a distinguished network of investors, fund managers, researchers, leaders, and mentors.
To Apply
To be considered for this position please follow the below directions:
Step 1: Apply through our Job PostingStep 2: Submit both a resume and cover letter (please submit in one document package)Step 3: Complete this anonymous Short Survey (https://illumencapital.typeform.com/IRhiring)
We are an equal opportunity employer.
Illumen Capital is committed to equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at Illumen Capital are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and/or related medical conditions), marital status, religion, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information / predisposition or carrier status, veteran status, citizenship, or any other consideration made unlawful by federal, state, or local laws. Illumen Capital does not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics.
We look forward to reviewing your application!

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to know our team: 

The Performance Marketing Team of Agoda is a world leader in online marketing. This department is highly data-driven and focused on developing at-scale marketing programs that improve the lifetime value of Agoda customers through measurable marketing programs and channels. The team is a blend of the best analysts, marketing strategists, and data scientists in the world. The marketing leadership at Agoda has deep experience in data science, product, strategy, and other marketing fields and has built an organization that thrives on data, creative ideas, and technology. The Performance Marketing Team also fosters a great learning environment. You will be able to learn and grow by working closely with experts from a variety of backgrounds from all over the world.

Due to continued expansion, there are multiple analyst roles within the marketing team across different marketing channels. While the scope will vary depending on these channels, here are some examples:

Experimentation and optimizing campaign performance: Experiment with ads/campaign structures and bidding& pricing strategies on partners such as Google, Bing, TripAdvisor, Trivago, and other search engines.
