Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Technical Data Operations Analyst responsible for overseeing the E2E marketing data flow and partnering with IT and BI to operationalize insights through AI agents and workflows. Firmly seated within the digital marketing organization, this role is explicitly differentiated from traditional IT functions; instead, you will serve as the critical bridge, partnering closely with IT for flawless technical execution. Reporting to the Director of Marketing Data and Operations, this leader will drive digital acquisition capabilities, focusing on integrating artificial intelligence, enabling end-to-end performance tracking, and optimizing operational workflows for unprecedented scale and efficiency. The successful candidate will be a creative problem-solver who thrives in a fast-changing environment, acting as the primary operations contact to ensure our technology foundation actively supports aggressive global business growth.

Key Responsibilities

Data Knowledge Base: Serve as a key point of contact for the marketing technology stack—partnering with BI and IT to support operational insights.Privacy Coordinator: Serve as the marketing privacy coordinator and support privacy compliance initiatives in partnership with legal and privacy.Data Governance: Act as the marketing data steward to support data governance and operational transparencyCustomer 360: Support the operationalization of Customer 360 on CDP and enable unified segmentation on unified profiles.AI Implementation: Assist in operationalizing data models and AI by partnering with BI, Analytics, AdTech, and IT.Operational Analysis: Perform quantitative operational analysis and modeling across the marketing landscape and support the execution of optimization programs leveraging AI.Process Efficiency: Contribute to best practices for efficient and effective data operations.Process Documentation: Document and support the implementation of scalable operational processes (SLAs, governance) that optimize workflow efficiency, productivity, and quality across digital operations.

Qualifications

Qualifications 

Experience in Marketing Operations or Digital Marketing roles, with a track record of supporting technical initiatives.Practical experience contributing to the design and implementation of data infrastructure that meets the demands of real-time decisioning.Strong working knowledge of technical integrations across the MarTech stack, including CDPs, CRMs (e.g., Salesforce), and internal data warehousing solutions (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery).Hands-on experience with key operations and orchestration platforms: LeanData, Demandbase, and Allocadia.Technical proficiency in utilizing AI/ML, Generative AI, and predictive modeling for real-time data orchestration.Demonstrated ability to translate business objectives into technical requirements and user stories (PRDs), assisting with development backlog management alongside internal engineering teams.Strong project management skills, utilizing agile methodologies to help coordinate cross-functional technical projects.Clear understanding and practical application of global data privacy and compliance standards (GDPR, CCPA, etc.) and their impact on data usage.

Preferred Qualifications

Proficiency in utilizing SQL and Python for advanced data analysis, modeling, and automated data quality audits.Ability to lead at the intersection of business and technology with a passion for marketing technology, clearly differentiating marketing ecosystem needs from traditional IT infrastructure.Demonstrated success integrating and scaling comprehensive technology solutions: Marketing Automation, CRM, Predictive Analytics, and Data Enrichment.Strong cross-functional relationship development skills, specifically in establishing effective program management processes between Marketing and IT.Comfort with accountability and the ability to navigate ambiguity and manage competing priorities.

The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. A description of our employee benefits may be found here.

$106,000.00 - $170,500.00/yr

Our Commitment 

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

rows.title: Data Science Institute Graduate Student Intern - Summer 2027
rows.descriptionText:
Company Description

Join us and make YOUR mark on the World!

Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability.

Our mission spans four critical national security areas nuclear deterrence, threat preparedness, energy security, and multi-domain defense empowering teams to take on the toughest challenges of today and tomorrow. With a culture built on innovation and operational excellence, LLNL is a place where your expertise can make a real impact.

Job Description

Positions will close to applicants on January 15, 2027. Data Science Summer Institute mentors will have until February 5, 2027 to make their Summer selections.

We have openings for our Summer Graduate Internship Program. These positions are intended for students who have earned their bachelor’s degree and will be enrolled in a graduate program by Fall 2027. Interns will have the opportunity to participate in hands-on research that supports their educational and professional development. Selected interns will play a key role in providing technical and/or research support to projects in areas such as computer science, numerical methods, mathematics, statistics, physics, chemistry, engineering disciplines, and other related STEM disciplines.

Cohort Option 1: May 17, 2027 – August 6, 2027 Cohort Option 2: June 21, 2027 – September 10, 2027 

Depending on your assignment, this position may offer a hybrid schedule, blending in-person and virtual presence. You may have the flexibility to work from home one or more days per week.

You will 

Provide technical and/or research support to projects in one or more of the above areas, working with scientists, engineers, and technical staff members. Support documentation, testing, creation or modification of Laboratory software, hardware, or Computer operating systems. Conduct research in assigned area under limited direction and supervision. Perform technical assignments of basic to moderate complexity and provide technical support to scientists working on scientific research and development projects. Participate in DSSI curriculum, including a weeks-long team challenge, networking, seminars, tours, and related events. Present individual and team results to Lab staff and your peers through presentations and/or poster sessions. Perform other duties as assigned. 

Qualifications

Must be eligible to access the Laboratory in compliance with Section 3112 of the National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA). See Additional Information section below for details. Must be enrolled as a college or university student by Fall 2027, in good standing at an accredited institution, and pursuing a graduate degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Data Science, Machine Learning, Cybersecurity, Physics, Chemistry, Engineering, or other related STEM fields. Proven ability to adapt and thrive in challenging situations, demonstrating resilience and problem-solving skills to achieve goals while overcoming setbacks. Demonstrated academic achievement in scientific curriculum. Demonstrated effective communication skills. Ability to present and communicate concepts and ideas. Experience applying advanced computational science and/or mathematical principles to solve technical problems. Experience working with computers and familiarity with Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Ability to work in a team environment. Age 18 or older at the start of the internship. Must have GPA of 3.0 or higher. 

Pay

$10,215 Monthly

Please note that the pay is determined by California’s Computer Professional Exemption.

Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Why Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory?

Included in 2026 Best Places to Work by Glassdoor!Holiday PaySick leave accrualIndividual 401(k) contributionsOur values - visit https://www.llnl.gov/inclusion/our-values 

Security Clearance

None required. However, if your assignment is longer than 179 days cumulatively within a calendar year, you must go through the Personal Identity Verification process. This process includes completing an online background investigation form and receiving approval of the background check.

National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA)

The 2025 National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA), Section 3112, generally prohibits citizens of China, Russia, Iran and North Korea without dual US citizenship or legal permanent residence from accessing specific non-public areas of national security or nuclear weapons facilities. The restrictions of NDAA Section 3112 apply to this position. To be qualified for this position, Candidates must be eligible to access the Laboratory in compliance with Section 3112.

Pre-Employment Drug Test

External applicant(s) selected for this position must pass a post-offer, pre-employment drug test. This includes testing for use of marijuana as Federal Law applies to us as a Federal Contractor.

Wireless and Medical Devices

Per the Department of Energy (DOE), Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory must meet certain restrictions with the use and/or possession of mobile devices in Limited Areas. Depending on your job duties, you may be required to work in a Limited Area where you are not permitted to have a personal and/or laboratory mobile device in your possession. This includes, but not limited to cell phones, tablets, fitness devices, wireless headphones, and other Bluetooth/wireless enabled devices.

If you use a medical device, which pairs with a mobile device, you must still follow the rules concerning the mobile device in individual sections within Limited Areas. Sensitive Compartmented Information Facilities require separate approval. Hearing aids without wireless capabilities or wireless that has been disabled are allowed in Limited Areas, Secure Space and Transit/Buffer Space within buildings.

How To Identify Fake Job Advertisements

Please be aware of recruitment scams where people or entities are misusing the name of Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) to post fake job advertisements. LLNL never extends an offer without a personal interview and will never charge a fee for joining our company. All current job openings are displayed on the Career Page under “Find Your Job” of our website. If you have encountered a job posting or have been approached with a job offer that you suspect may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend you do not respond.

To learn more about recruitment scams: https://www.llnl.gov/sites/www/files/2023-05/LLNL-Job-Fraud-Statement-Updated-4.26.23.pdf

Equal Employment Opportunity

We are an equal opportunity employer that is committed to providing all with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, marital status, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, protected veteran status, age, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

Reasonable Accommodation

Our goal is to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates applying and interviewing at the Laboratory. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please use our online form to submit a request.

California Privacy Notice

The California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) grants privacy rights to all California residents. The law also entitles job applicants, employees, and non-employee workers to be notified of what personal information LLNL collects and for what purpose. The Employee Privacy Notice can be accessed here.

We're looking for someone who is unusually curious, technically inclined, and a very good writer. You should be able to understand a complicated idea, figure out what's actually interesting about it, and explain it simply without dumbing it down.

This isn't a traditional writing or editing job. You'll research stories, analyze data, develop ideas with YC partners and founders, help shape videos and podcasts, write and edit articles, and experiment with new kinds of editorial projects.

What You'll Do

Research, write, and edit YC’s written content.Develop ideas and do research for YC videos, podcasts, interviews, and other media.Work directly with YC partners, founders, and the rest of the Media team to turn interesting ideas into great content.Dig into data to find surprising trends about startups, technology, founders, and what people are building.Find interesting people, projects, papers, companies, and ideas before everyone else is talking about them.Help us figure out what YC should be covering and why.Take complicated technical subjects and make them clear, accurate, and interesting.Experiment with new editorial formats and ways of telling stories.

You Might Be a Good Fit If

You're deeply curious about technology and understand the culture around startups, AI, engineering, and the internet.You're an excellent writer and editor. You can make complicated things simple without making them simplistic.You're technical enough to talk to engineers and researchers and understand what they're actually saying.You like going down rabbit holes, reading papers, digging through datasets, talking to experts, and figuring things out for yourself.You have strong editorial judgment. You can recognize when something is genuinely interesting rather than merely popular.You're comfortable working across formats. An idea might become a Substack post, a YouTube video, a podcast conversation, a chart, or something we haven't tried yet.You're opinionated about media and the internet and have good instincts about what smart people actually want to read and watch.You don't need someone to hand you a story. You find them.

There isn't one obvious background for this role. You might be an engineer who loves writing, someone from developer relations, a technical journalist, a data journalist, a researcher, a former founder, or someone who has worked at a think tank. We're much more interested in how you think, how you write, and what you've made than what your previous title was.

Above all, we're looking for someone who is smart, curious, technically adventurous, and wants to make things that smart people genuinely want to read and watch.

Our Media Team works from our Dogpatch offices in San Francisco at least three days per week, with additional in-office days as filming schedules require. rows.title: Simulation, Test and Validation Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
About Poseidon Aerospace

Poseidon Aerospace is reimagining how the world moves goods. We build and operate full-size autonomous cargo aircraft - capable of carrying two tons of payload over a thousand nautical miles. From remote communities to contested logistics operations, our platforms unlock a new cost curve for air freight, making it faster, cheaper, and accessible anywhere it's needed. Headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area with locations in Washington DC, Oregon, and Maine; we're building something consequential.

About The Role

Test and Validation finds problems on the ground before they show up in flight. As a Test and Validation Engineer you will build and run the hardware-in-the-loop benches, simulation environments, and automated validators that every flight software release and every piece of avionics hardware must pass before it goes on the aircraft. You will also design and run environmental and durability tests on aircraft hardware. The faster you find faults, the faster the aircraft flies.

Responsibilities

Bring up and maintain hardware-in-the-loop benches with flight computers, actuators, sensors, and power hardware in the loopMaintain the software-in-the-loop environment and the real-time simulation that drives the benchesIntegrate vehicle, sensor, and actuator models from GNC and flight sciences into the simulationWrite validators: automated checks that evaluate simulation, bench, and flight data against requirementsBuild automated regression testing that runs each flight software release through simulation and hardware-in-the-loopDevelop fault injection for sensor, actuator, data bus, and power failuresBuild data pipelines and analysis tooling for test and flight dataDesign and run environmental and durability tests on aircraft hardware, including vibration, thermal, and ingressIntegrate instrumentation and data acquisition on test rigsWrite test plans and procedures from requirements and failure mode analyses, and report resultsInvestigate anomalies found in test and drive root cause with the owning teamSupport aircraft ground test and flight test with validators and data analysis, including travel to our flight test site

Required Qualifications

B.S. in electrical, mechanical, aerospace, or computer engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience2+ years testing complex electromechanical or embedded systemsProficiency in Python and working knowledge of C or C++Experience building or operating hardware-in-the-loop, software-in-the-loop, or automated test systemsHands-on electrical debugging skills and familiarity with common vehicle data buses

Preferred Qualifications

Test experience on aircraft, UAS, spacecraft, or automotive systemsExperience with real-time simulation platforms such as Speedgoat, dSPACE, or NIExperience with environmental testing to DO-160 or MIL-STD-810Experience with actuators, motor controllers, or power systemsExperience with continuous integration for embedded softwareFamiliarity with FMEA and reliability analysisExperience analyzing flight or vehicle test data

Why this role

Every flight software release and every avionics box passes through what you build before it reaches the aircraft. You will work with nearly every engineering team, see problems before anyone else does, and directly set how fast the program can fly safely.

What You Get From Us

Competitive salary and meaningful early-stage equityRelocation support if applicableEmployee Health Benefit Plans6% Retirement matchingFlexible PTOFree lunches, snacks, and a stocked fridge at our officesAI tools and subscriptions

rows.title: Associate Video Producer, YC Media
rows.descriptionText:
Y Combinator is the leading startup accelerator for entrepreneurs. Since 2005, YC has invested in over 6,000 companies, including Airbnb, Dropbox, OpenAI, Stripe, Reddit, DoorDash, Coinbase, and Instacart. Today, YC has built the most powerful startup community in the world and is committed to supporting founders for the life of their company.

Job Description

Y Combinator is looking for an Associate Video Producer to join the YC Media team. This is a role for someone who is smart, organized, resourceful, and already immersed in startups and technology. You’ll work closely with our Senior Video Producers across videos, podcasts, interviews, and other editorial projects. You’ll help with everything from research and pre-interviews to editing, publishing, scheduling, guest communication, and keeping our production calendar on track.

A lot of this job is making sure things actually get finished. You should be the kind of person who notices what needs to happen next, follows up without being asked, and is happy moving between creative work and the less glamorous details that keep a production running smoothly.

Just as importantly, you should understand the world YC operates in. You follow startups, AI, technology, and the people building them. You know what people in this world are talking about, can quickly understand why something matters, and have enough context to ask good questions rather than starting from zero every time.

What You'll Do

Help produce YC videos and podcasts

Work with Senior Video Producers to move projects from idea to shoot to final publication.Research guests, companies, technologies, and topics.Help write interview questions, briefs, descriptions, and other editorial material.Schedule and conduct pre-interviews, take detailed notes, and report back to producers.Coordinate shoot dates and logistics with founders, companies, and guests.Review edits and help prepare projects for final approval.Edit short-form clips and other video content.

Keep productions organized

Maintain notes and project documentation throughout the production process.Keep project cards, production schedules, shoot calendars, and publishing calendars up to date.Track where every project is in the pipeline and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.Manage transcripts, video files, review links, and other production assets.Download and organize final videos and other assets in Dropbox.Transcribe finished recordings.Send final edits, transcripts, file links, and YouTube links to YC partners and other collaborators.

Help publish and distribute our work

Upload and publish episodes across YouTube, podcast platforms, and other channels.Make sure titles, descriptions, thumbnails, transcripts, chapters, and other publishing assets are ready.Help coordinate the final steps between editorial, production, and distribution.

Help things run smoothly on shoot days

Welcome guests and help get them where they need to be.Make sure guests have water, food, and anything else they need.Help keep sets clean, reset, and ready for the next shoot.Occasionally assist as a camera operator.Help keep our production gear and equipment organized.

You Might Be a Good Fit If

You’re deeply interested in startups, AI, technology, and the internet, and already understand YC and startup culture. You know the companies, people, ideas, and conversations that matter in this world.You’re intellectually curious and learn quickly. You can get up to speed on an unfamiliar company or technical subject without needing everything explained to you.You have some experience producing or editing video, podcasts, or other media.You’re a strong writer and researcher with good editorial instincts. You can recognize what’s actually interesting about a person, company, or idea and explain complicated technical topics clearly.You’re extremely organized, reliable, and comfortable managing lots of small details across several projects at once. You communicate clearly and follow up quickly.You’re willing to do whatever needs to be done to make a production successful, whether that’s editing a clip, researching a guest, updating a calendar, or grabbing lunch for a shoot.You have strong attention to detail. A wrong link, missing file, forgotten follow-up, or stale calendar entry bothers you. You should be able to spot the difference between Arial and Helvetica or know if it's a Dutch or French flag.You have some hands-on experience with cameras, audio, and video production equipment. You don’t need to be an expert, but you should be comfortable helping set up and operate gear on shoots.You’re able to safely lift up to 50 pounds as needed for production gear and shoot setup.This is a good role for someone early in their media career who wants to learn the entire production process rather than specialize in one narrow part of it.You might currently be an assistant producer, production assistant, video editor, podcast producer, editorial assistant, or someone who has been making your own projects and wants to do this professionally. We're less interested in a particular resume than whether you're sharp, curious, capable, and genuinely plugged into the world we cover.The best person for this role will be equally comfortable thinking about what makes a piece of content good and doing the hundred small things required to actually get it published.

Location: YC is headquartered in San Francisco, and candidates must reside in the San Francisco Bay Area. Our Media Team works from our Dogpatch offices in San Francisco at least three days per week, with additional in-office days as filming schedules require. Some projects may also require travel and weekend work.

Description

Landscape Architecture Intern

Westwood Professional Services

The Landscape Architecture Intern will join a design team supporting streetscape, park, trail, and civic space projects for public infrastructure clients, including municipalities, counties, and public agencies. Projects range from small streetscape enhancements to large-scale corridor and public realm improvements that shape how communities experience shared infrastructure. This position offers direct opportunity to apply design coursework to real-world public spaces.

As a Landscape Architecture Intern, the selected candidate will learn to apply relevant design guidelines and accessibility standards — including ADA and local design manuals — while assisting Senior Landscape Architects in the preparation of site plans, planting plans, and construction details. The intern will build foundational proficiency in the design and visualization software used throughout the site design process.

May/June 2027 Start Date

Requirements

Duties and Responsibilities:

Assist with the preparation of site plans, grading concepts, planting plans, and hardscape details for public infrastructure and civic space projects.Support development of design graphics, renderings, and presentation materials for client and public agency meetings.Help research applicable design guidelines, zoning requirements, and ADA accessibility standards to inform design recommendations.Develop an understanding of client interests and help identify approaches to address client and community concerns in the performance of project work.Actively coordinate with internal and external team members across public infrastructure projects to ensure effective communication and project progress.Travel to project sites as necessary to gather field data, take site inventory, and interface directly with clients.

Required Qualifications

Currently enrolled in undergraduate Landscape Architecture program.Effective verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally with clients, management, and design team members.Willingness to learn in a flexible, cross-disciplinary work environment.Willingness to attend site visits and perform work in outdoor field conditions on occasion.Valid driver's license and reliable transportation.Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.Please provide a portfolio along with your application/resume.

Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are preferred but not required for consideration:

Relevant industry experience through design coursework projects or prior internships in landscape architecture or site planning.Experience with technical design software including AutoCAD, SketchUp, or Adobe Creative Suite.

rows.title: Technical Data Operations Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Technical Data Operations Analyst responsible for overseeing the E2E marketing data flow and partnering with IT and BI to operationalize insights through AI agents and workflows. Firmly seated within the digital marketing organization, this role is explicitly differentiated from traditional IT functions; instead, you will serve as the critical bridge, partnering closely with IT for flawless technical execution. Reporting to the Director of Marketing Data and Operations, this leader will drive digital acquisition capabilities, focusing on integrating artificial intelligence, enabling end-to-end performance tracking, and optimizing operational workflows for unprecedented scale and efficiency. The successful candidate will be a creative problem-solver who thrives in a fast-changing environment, acting as the primary operations contact to ensure our technology foundation actively supports aggressive global business growth.

Key Responsibilities

Data Knowledge Base: Serve as a key point of contact for the marketing technology stack—partnering with BI and IT to support operational insights.Privacy Coordinator: Serve as the marketing privacy coordinator and support privacy compliance initiatives in partnership with legal and privacy.Data Governance: Act as the marketing data steward to support data governance and operational transparencyCustomer 360: Support the operationalization of Customer 360 on CDP and enable unified segmentation on unified profiles.AI Implementation: Assist in operationalizing data models and AI by partnering with BI, Analytics, AdTech, and IT.Operational Analysis: Perform quantitative operational analysis and modeling across the marketing landscape and support the execution of optimization programs leveraging AI.Process Efficiency: Contribute to best practices for efficient and effective data operations.Process Documentation: Document and support the implementation of scalable operational processes (SLAs, governance) that optimize workflow efficiency, productivity, and quality across digital operations.

Qualifications

Qualifications 

Experience in Marketing Operations or Digital Marketing roles, with a track record of supporting technical initiatives.Practical experience contributing to the design and implementation of data infrastructure that meets the demands of real-time decisioning.Strong working knowledge of technical integrations across the MarTech stack, including CDPs, CRMs (e.g., Salesforce), and internal data warehousing solutions (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery).Hands-on experience with key operations and orchestration platforms: LeanData, Demandbase, and Allocadia.Technical proficiency in utilizing AI/ML, Generative AI, and predictive modeling for real-time data orchestration.Demonstrated ability to translate business objectives into technical requirements and user stories (PRDs), assisting with development backlog management alongside internal engineering teams.Strong project management skills, utilizing agile methodologies to help coordinate cross-functional technical projects.Clear understanding and practical application of global data privacy and compliance standards (GDPR, CCPA, etc.) and their impact on data usage.

Preferred Qualifications

Proficiency in utilizing SQL and Python for advanced data analysis, modeling, and automated data quality audits.Ability to lead at the intersection of business and technology with a passion for marketing technology, clearly differentiating marketing ecosystem needs from traditional IT infrastructure.Demonstrated success integrating and scaling comprehensive technology solutions: Marketing Automation, CRM, Predictive Analytics, and Data Enrichment.Strong cross-functional relationship development skills, specifically in establishing effective program management processes between Marketing and IT.Comfort with accountability and the ability to navigate ambiguity and manage competing priorities.

Compensation Disclosure

rows.title: AI Trainer - Data Science
rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

Our client is looking for experienced data scientists to evaluate how frontier AI models handle real data science work: an analysis from messy data to a defensible conclusion, an experiment designed and read out correctly, a model built and validated without leakage, SQL and Python that actually does what the ticket asked. You bring the judgment you have built sending back a notebook that passed its cells but not its logic, and knowing the difference between a result and a real result. We bring the model output that judgment is needed to grade.

In this role, you will design challenging, realistic tasks drawn from your own practice, such as an exploratory analysis and write up from a messy dataset, an A/B test design and read out, a feature set and model with validation, a SQL pipeline with data quality checks, a metric definition and dashboard spec, or a forecast with error analysis, run them through frontier AI agents, and evaluate what comes back against a professional standard.

You will work with realistic professional files, the kind a practitioner in your field actually handles, which you assemble yourself. Some tasks are compact, built around a handful of files; others are larger scenarios that take several days to build. In every case the goal is the same: a task a competent professional in your field would complete correctly and a frontier model currently gets wrong.

This is not a traditional data science role. You will be helping build better AI by putting your knowledge to work in a structured, flexible, fully remote environment. The work is long form and self directed, and clear written reasoning matters as much as technical depth.

Responsibilities

Design challenging, realistic data science tasks drawn from your own day to day work: the scenario, a prompt phrased the way you would brief a trusted colleague, and the supporting files a practitioner would need (datasets you construct or anonymize, schemas, notebooks, metric definitions, stakeholder briefs), which you author yourself. Run those tasks through frontier AI models and evaluate the deliverable they produce (the analysis, code, model, query or write up) against the standard you would hold a colleague to. Compare two model outputs on identical prompts and files, decide which performed better, and document where each fell short. Write detailed grading rubrics and, where appropriate, tests that specify what a correct deliverable must contain, such as the right handling of the data quality problem, the right statistical test, the right validation approach and the right interpretation, and explain in writing why a response passes or fails each one. Flag concrete failures with evidence: leakage, confounding, wrong joins, misapplied tests, code that runs but does not do what was asked, fabricated or ignored data, and off brief interpretation of the ask. Contribute across analytics, machine learning, experimentation and data engineering adjacent work, and review and refine tasks built by other experts. 

Domain Qualifications

2+ years of professional applied data science experience preferred (analytics, machine learning, statistical modeling, experimentation, analysis adjacent data engineering) in industry or research. Undergraduate study does not count toward the experience floor. In progress Bachelor’s degree or higher in a quantitative field, completed or in progress. Advanced degree is a plus but optional; practical applied work outweighs credentials; cloud and analytics certifications are neither required nor screened for. Working proficiency in Python and/or SQL. You write, debug and can explain your own analysis code; reading and writing code is part of the work. Depth in at least one of: product or business analytics and BI; applied machine learning; statistics and experimentation (A/B testing, causal inference); forecasting; analysis adjacent data engineering; applied NLP or computer vision with shipped work. Has independently owned a multi step analysis end to end, from raw or messy data through cleaning, modeling and interpretation to a decision, rather than picking up a clean dataset mid pipeline. Can judge whether a result is real and say what it means: leakage, confounding, selection effects, multiple testing, power, and interpreting results in business or scientific terms. 

General requirements

2+ years of hands on experience in your field preferred (see Domain qualifications above). Candidates with less experience are considered where the practical work is real. Able to draw on your own real world experience and day to day workflows to craft scenarios that test whether an AI system can actually do the work. Hands on practitioner: you currently do (or recently did) the work yourself at an individual contributor level, not solely in a managerial capacity. Full professional or native level written and spoken English, with strong written communication. You can explain complex professional reasoning clearly and concisely, and articulate why a result is wrong, not only that it is. Comfort with ambiguity and attention to detail. You can orient in a new set of files and build an accurate, deep working picture of it quickly, especially when the subject sits partly outside your own specialization. You verify what a document claims against the underlying numbers, sources or facts. Capable of interpreting feedback, judging which parts of it are actually correct, and applying it without hand holding. When stuck, you look for the answer rather than waiting for one. Ability to ramp quickly on unfamiliar work from written material and instructions alone, including where that material is incomplete (for example, writing grading rubrics for the first time). General familiarity with AI and LLM tools. You have used models like Claude or ChatGPT in professional work and have the judgment to tell a well reasoned answer from a plausible sounding but incorrect one. Baseline tech literacy: comfortable with cloud file tools (e.g., Google Workspace), managing browser profiles, downloading and installing desktop apps (e.g., Claude), and everyday file handling (e.g., converting between Excel and Google Sheets, zipping files for sharing). Available at least 10 hours per week, with no weekly maximum. Consistent availability is valued and full time hours are available. Based in the United States, Canada, or the UK.

The Tech and Product team of TikTok USDS is missioned to empower TikTok US users to have a great user experience with strong data security and privacy protections, focusing on compliance, reliability, business and product support, and efficiency improvement.

As part of this team, you will build and scale high-impact Machine Learning solutions—including recommendation engines, search relevance, and e-commerce systems—designed specifically to deliver personalized, high-performing experiences while ensuring world-class data governance, privacy compliance, and system security for US users.

We are looking for talented individuals to join our team. As a graduate, you will get opportunities to pursue bold ideas, tackle complex challenges, and unlock limitless growth.

 Design, build, train, and evaluate machine learning models for recommendation systems or search ranking. You will work closely with Product, Operations, Engineering, and Machine Learning Engineering teams, while growing your capabilities in analytics, experimentation, and business judgment through real product challenges.

About Hippo:Hippo was built on a promise: make homeownership effortless. Nearly a decade later, that mission still drives us. About This Role:We’re hiring an actuarial data scientist to lead loss cost modeling for Hippo’s Homeowners program. This role will own the design, development, and deployment of predictive models for frequency and severity, ensuring strong alignment with pricing strategy and business objectives. You’ll build and scale Python- and SQL-based tooling that embeds expected loss ratio and segmentation analytics into reusable, production-ready workflows. In addition to leading loss cost modeling, you’ll have the opportunity to expand the team’s modeling capabilities across demand and aggregation models to inform broader pricing and business mix decisions.
About You:You are a hands-on leader with a strong background in loss modeling. You bring structure to ambiguity and enjoy building scalable work and collaborating with other teams. You think critically about model maintenance cost and you balance scientific rigor with practical business impact. You communicate clearly, document thoroughly, and operate with a strong sense of ownership.
What You’ll Do:Lead homeowners insurance modeling efforts, setting clear priorities, technical standards, and best practices while fostering a culture of ownership, rigor, and continuous improvementOwn the design and annual build of our by-peril loss modelsExpand modeling capabilities across conversion, retention, and aggregation to inform pricing strategy, business mix, and portfolio performanceImplement and scale models within our Airflow-based Python modeling pipeline, ensuring robust testing, validation, reproducibility, and long-term maintainabilityDevelop reusable analytical tooling and workflows that improve efficiency, consistency, and scalability across the actuarial teamPartner cross-functionally with Insurance Product, Underwriting, and Engineering to translate complex modeling insights into clear business recommendations and ensure successful production deployment
Must Haves:Bachelor’s degree in statistics, mathematics, actuarial science, computer science, or a another quantitative field; advanced degree a plus5+ years of experience in data science, analytics, or actuarial modeling in insurance, preferably personal lines or propertyWorking knowledge of P&C insurance in loss cost modeling; exposure to demand, underwriting, and/or claims modelingStrong background in statistical modeling: GLMs, regularization, tree-based ensembles (XGBoost, LightGBM), and model validation techniquesKnowledge of actuarial principles as they relate to insurance pricingAdvanced proficiency in Python (pandas, scikit-learn, statsmodels) and SQLExcellent communication skills and ability to build trust with stakeholders at all levels
Nice to Haves:Actuarial credentials - ACAS/FCASMaster’s degree in a quantitative disciplineExperience working in modern data platforms, including familiarity with cloud infrastructure (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, AWS) and workflow orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow)Experience with catastrophe modeling, geospatial analytics, or climate risk data

rows.title: Editorial Researcher, YC Media
rows.descriptionText:
Y Combinator is the leading startup accelerator for entrepreneurs. Since 2005, YC has invested in over 6,000 companies, including Airbnb, Dropbox, OpenAI, Stripe, Reddit, DoorDash, Coinbase, and Instacart. Today, YC has built the most powerful startup community in the world and is committed to supporting founders for the life of their company.

Job Description

Y Combinator is looking for an Editorial Researcher to join the YC Media team. We make content for people who are curious about startups, technology, AI, science, and the future. That includes videos and podcasts, essays, original research, and new projects built around the enormous amount of knowledge and data that exists inside YC. We're looking for someone who is unusually curious, technically inclined, and a very good writer. You should be able to understand a complicated idea, figure out what's actually interesting about it, and explain it simply without dumbing it down.

This isn't a traditional writing or editing job. You'll research stories, analyze data, develop ideas with YC partners and founders, help shape videos and podcasts, write and edit articles, and experiment with new kinds of editorial projects.

What You'll Do

Research, write, and edit YC’s written content.Develop ideas and do research for YC videos, podcasts, interviews, and other media.Work directly with YC partners, founders, and the rest of the Media team to turn interesting ideas into great content.Dig into data to find surprising trends about startups, technology, founders, and what people are building.Find interesting people, projects, papers, companies, and ideas before everyone else is talking about them.Help us figure out what YC should be covering and why.Take complicated technical subjects and make them clear, accurate, and interesting.Experiment with new editorial formats and ways of telling stories.

You Might Be a Good Fit If

You're deeply curious about technology and understand the culture around startups, AI, engineering, and the internet.You're an excellent writer and editor. You can make complicated things simple without making them simplistic.You're technical enough to talk to engineers and researchers and understand what they're actually saying.You like going down rabbit holes, reading papers, digging through datasets, talking to experts, and figuring things out for yourself.You have strong editorial judgment. You can recognize when something is genuinely interesting rather than merely popular.You're comfortable working across formats. An idea might become a Substack post, a YouTube video, a podcast conversation, a chart, or something we haven't tried yet.You're opinionated about media and the internet and have good instincts about what smart people actually want to read and watch.You don't need someone to hand you a story. You find them.

There isn't one obvious background for this role. You might be an engineer who loves writing, someone from developer relations, a technical journalist, a data journalist, a researcher, a former founder, or someone who has worked at a think tank. We're much more interested in how you think, how you write, and what you've made than what your previous title was.

Above all, we're looking for someone who is smart, curious, technically adventurous, and wants to make things that smart people genuinely want to read and watch.

Location: YC is headquartered in San Francisco, and candidates must reside in the San Francisco Bay Area. Our Media Team works from our Dogpatch offices in San Francisco at least three days per week, with additional in-office days as filming schedules require. Some projects may also require travel and weekend work.

Compensation: $180,000-$200,000 salary (depending on skills and experience).

Benefits: Our full benefits package includes medical, vision, and dental plans, an infertility benefit, STD/LTD, life insurance, commuter benefits, a flexible spending account, a health savings account, a 401(k) with 4% matching, generous parental leave, paid holidays, and a flexible paid time off policy.

Work Authorization: This position does not support work authorization/visa sponsorship.

Y Combinator considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law, including San Francisco’s Fair Chance Ordinance. Y Combinator is committed to protecting the privacy of job applicants' personal information and to complying with the California Consumer Privacy Act. The privacy policy of Ashby, Inc., the hiring platform used by Y Combinator, governs the collection of such data and is available here.

Job Description:Y Combinator is looking for an Associate Video Producer to join the YC Media team. This is a role for someone who is smart, organized, resourceful, and already immersed in startups and technology. You’ll work closely with our Senior Video Producers across videos, podcasts, interviews, and other editorial projects. You’ll help with everything from research and pre-interviews to editing, publishing, scheduling, guest communication, and keeping our production calendar on track.
A lot of this job is making sure things actually get finished. You should be the kind of person who notices what needs to happen next, follows up without being asked, and is happy moving between creative work and the less glamorous details that keep a production running smoothly.
Just as importantly, you should understand the world YC operates in. You follow startups, AI, technology, and the people building them. You know what people in this world are talking about, can quickly understand why something matters, and have enough context to ask good questions rather than starting from zero every time.
What you'll do:Help produce YC videos and podcastsWork with Senior Video Producers to move projects from idea to shoot to final publication.Research guests, companies, technologies, and topics.Help write interview questions, briefs, descriptions, and other editorial material.Schedule and conduct pre-interviews, take detailed notes, and report back to producers.Coordinate shoot dates and logistics with founders, companies, and guests.Review edits and help prepare projects for final approval.Edit short-form clips and other video content.
Keep productions organizedMaintain notes and project documentation throughout the production process.Keep project cards, production schedules, shoot calendars, and publishing calendars up to date.Track where every project is in the pipeline and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.Manage transcripts, video files, review links, and other production assets.Download and organize final videos and other assets in Dropbox.Transcribe finished recordings.Send final edits, transcripts, file links, and YouTube links to YC partners and other collaborators.
Help publish and distribute our workUpload and publish episodes across YouTube, podcast platforms, and other channels.Make sure titles, descriptions, thumbnails, transcripts, chapters, and other publishing assets are ready.Help coordinate the final steps between editorial, production, and distribution.
Help things run smoothly on shoot daysWelcome guests and help get them where they need to be.Make sure guests have water, food, and anything else they need.Help keep sets clean, reset, and ready for the next shoot.Occasionally assist as a camera operator.Help keep our production gear and equipment organized.
You might be a good fit if:You’re deeply interested in startups, AI, technology, and the internet, and already understand YC and startup culture. You know the companies, people, ideas, and conversations that matter in this world.You’re intellectually curious and learn quickly. You can get up to speed on an unfamiliar company or technical subject without needing everything explained to you.You have some experience producing or editing video, podcasts, or other media.You’re a strong writer and researcher with good editorial instincts. You can recognize what’s actually interesting about a person, company, or idea and explain complicated technical topics clearly.You’re extremely organized, reliable, and comfortable managing lots of small details across several projects at once. You communicate clearly and follow up quickly.You’re willing to do whatever needs to be done to make a production successful, whether that’s editing a clip, researching a guest, updating a calendar, or grabbing lunch for a shoot.You have strong attention to detail. A wrong link, missing file, forgotten follow-up, or stale calendar entry bothers you. You should be able to spot the difference between Arial and Helvetica or know if it's a Dutch or French flag.You have some hands-on experience with cameras, audio, and video production equipment. You don’t need to be an expert, but you should be comfortable helping set up and operate gear on shoots.You’re able to safely lift up to 50 pounds as needed for production gear and shoot setup.This is a good role for someone early in their media career who wants to learn the entire production process rather than specialize in one narrow part of it.You might currently be an assistant producer, production assistant, video editor, podcast producer, editorial assistant, or someone who has been making your own projects and wants to do this professionally. We're less interested in a particular resume than whether you're sharp, curious, capable, and genuinely plugged into the world we cover.The best person for this role will be equally comfortable thinking about what makes a piece of content good and doing the hundred small things required to actually get it published.
Location: YC is headquartered in San Francisco, and candidates must reside in the San Francisco Bay Area. Our Media Team works from our Dogpatch offices in San Francisco at least three days per week, with additional in-office days as filming schedules require. Some projects may also require travel and weekend work. Compensation: $180,000-$200,000 salary (depending on skills and experience). Benefits: Our full benefits package includes medical, vision, and dental plans, an infertility benefit, STD/LTD, life insurance, commuter benefits, a flexible spending account, a health savings account, a 401(k) with 4% matching, generous parental leave, paid holidays, and a flexible paid time off policy. Work Authorization: This position does not support work authorization/visa sponsorship. Y Combinator considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law, including San Francisco’s Fair Chance Ordinance. rows.title: Social Media Manager
rows.descriptionText:
The opportunity

The Unity Global Communications team is seeking a Social Media Manager & Content Creator to shape how Unity shows up across social platforms. You’ll develop and execute creative and support data-driven strategies that grow awareness and engagement across LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and YouTube.

What You'll Be Doing

Concept, design, and produce end-to-end visual content, including short-form vertical video (Reels, TikToks, Shorts), graphics, GIFs, carousels, and trend-driven assets. Support building and execute platform-specific social strategies and tactics that drive brand awareness and engagementCollaborate with cross-functional teams to amplify Unity’s campaignsHelp manage the editorial calendar, content pipeline, and publishing processUse performance data to evaluate impact and refine creative strategyStay current on emerging design trends, video editing techniques, and social media best practices

What We're Looking For

Proven experience growing a brand’s social presence Expert knowledge of software like Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or CapCut, with a strong grasp of pacing and visual storytelling for social-first content. Excellent communicator who can simplify technical concepts in relatable waysExperience partnering with influencers or creators to extend brand reachStrong project management and organizational skills, balancing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, distributed teamComfortable on-camera or behind-the-camera, with a creative and analytical mindsetSomeone with a Social-First Mindset: The ability to natively translate complex topics into platform-native formats, hooks, and visual language rather than adapting traditional marketing materials after the fact.

You might also have

Familiarity with Unity’s tech/products, gaming, 3D creation, or real-time technology communitiesAn eye for emerging trends and formats across digital cultureA mix of creative and analytical skills — equally excited by concepting ideas and measuring performanceSocial media community management experience Experience using video editing softwares (like Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or CapCut), Canva, Figma, and social scheduling platforms.

Base Salary Range: We determine the base salary range for this role based on your primary work location:

Zone A: $65,400 - $89,980 USD gross

Zone B: $73,900 - $101,640 USD gross

Zone C: $83,000 - $114,180 USD gross

This range reflects the anticipated base salary for this position. Beyond base salary, this role may be eligible for equity awards and participation in our company incentive plans (such as annual discretionary bonuses or sales commissions). The final offer amount will depend on several factors, including geographic location and the candidate’s relevant experience, professional background, and skill set.

Benefits

At Unity, we want our team members to thrive. We offer a wide range of benefits designed to support well-being and work-life balance.

Please note: Benefits eligibility, specific offerings, and coverage vary based on the country and employment status.

While specific benefits vary, here are some of the ways we strive to take care of our eligible team members globally: Comprehensive health, life, and disability insurance | Commute subsidy | Employee stock ownership | Competitive retirement/pension plans | Generous vacation and personal days | Support for new parents through leave and family-care programs | Office food snacks | Mental Health and Wellbeing programs and support | Employee Resource Groups | Global Employee Assistance Program | Training and development programs | Volunteering and donation matching program

Life at Unity

Unity [NYSE: U] is the world’s leading game engine, powering play for more than 3 billion consumers each month. The top mobile games in the world, the most played PC indie titles, the most innovative console games, and virtually all of the top XR and Web Games are developed, deployed, and grown in Unity. Unity also enables teams across industries like automotive, manufacturing, and healthcare to design, simulate, and collaborate in 3D — closing the gap between ideas and reality. rows.title: Product Marketing Lead
rows.descriptionText:
Who We Are
The world is moving towards instant digital payments and TabaPay is leading the way. We help thousands of Fintechs in the US and Canada instantly move money in and out of accounts and we are actively expanding into other countries. Our customers represent the hottest verticals in the financial service industry such as neobanks, challenger brokers, gaming and wallets. TabaPay is a highly profitable rocketship that processes billions of dollars each year. To learn more visit www.tabapay.com.
What You’ll Do
As Product Marketing Lead, you will lead the Product Marketing team and establish how the function sets priorities, works with partners, and measures results. You will bring clarity to TabaPay’s positioning and buyer needs, guide launches across a broad portfolio, and equip Sales to win in priority industries.
You will manage the PMMs responsible for Sales Enablement and Core Products and for New Products. Working across Marketing, Product, Engineering, PMO, and Sales, you will make tradeoffs clear, resolve competing requests, and keep go-to-market work focused on adoption and revenue.
What You’ll Own
Product Marketing Leadership and Prioritization
Lead the Product Marketing team, define its operating model, and clarify ownership across the Product Marketing Lead and the two PMM roles.Prioritize PMM resources across core products, new products, and emerging industry segments; resolve conflicts among Sales needs, industry programs, and launches.Set industry and product priorities with Sales and company leadership using customer insight and commercial opportunity.
Positioning, Buyers, and Industry Strategy
Define overall TabaPay positioning and translate a broad portfolio into a clear platform narrative.Develop ideal customer profiles, buyer personas, jobs to be done, value propositions, and industry-specific messaging for priority solutions and segments.Synthesize customer conversations, win/loss reviews, competitive research, and Sales feedback to identify where TabaPay wins and where messaging needs to improve.
Product Launches and Adoption
Expand the tiered product launch framework and establish launch priorities, responsibilities, milestones, and measures of effectiveness.Coordinate Marketing, Product, Engineering, PMO, and Sales to bring new capabilities to market with clear positioning and readiness.Review product adoption and new-product revenue with cross-functional partners and refine go-to-market plans based on results.
Sales Enablement and Commercial Performance
Oversee sales training, pitch decks, one-pagers, battlecards, qualification guidance, and objection handling.Partner with Sales leaders to improve opportunity conversion and win rates and understand early-stage and no-decision losses.Set a measurement framework and review cadence with the GTM Strategy and Operations Manager.
Experience
Experience leading a Product Marketing function and managing multiple Product Marketing Managers.Strong B2B fintech or payments experience and the ability to explain complex products in clear buyer-focused language.Demonstrated ownership of positioning, ideal customer profiles, industry messaging, sales enablement, and complex product launches.Ability to prioritize competing needs and influence senior leaders across Product, Sales, Marketing, and Engineering.Strong customer and commercial judgment informed by research, customer conversations, win/loss analysis, and performance data.
Additional Experience That Would Help
Experience positioning a portfolio that includes processing, banking-related, and money services solutions.Experience developing industry-specific go-to-market strategies for regulated markets.Experience establishing product adoption reviews, launch measurement, and repeatable product marketing processes.
Success in This Role
Success will be measured by the quality and adoption of Product Marketing’s work and its contribution to commercial outcomes:
Approved TabaPay positioning and messaging used consistently across Marketing, Sales, Product, and customer-facing materials.Completed and actively used customer profiles, buyer profiles, jobs to be done, and value propositions for priority solutions and industries.New-product adoption and revenue against agreed targets; opportunity conversion and win rates in priority areas.Fewer early-stage and no-decision losses, with clear learning from loss reviews.Sales adoption and effectiveness of enablement assets and training.Clear ownership and effective allocation of work across the Product Marketing team.
First 90 Days
Synthesize customer, competitive, win/loss, and Sales insights into positioning and go-to-market priorities.Develop positioning and messaging for TabaPay processing, TabaBank, and MSB solutions; define their target audiences, buyer needs, and where each may win.Build an end-to-end go-to-market plan for introducing TabaPay as a vertically integrated platform, validating product and regulatory claims with the relevant teams.Clarify the PMM operating model and ownership; expand launch processes and tracking for effectiveness and revenue contribution.Audit sales enablement needs and prioritize the roadmap for collateral, battlecards, objection handling, and training.Agree on adoption, conversion, win-rate, no-decision, and new-product revenue measures with the GTM Strategy and Operations Manager.
Compensation
The compensation for this position is $170,000 for candidates living in and around the San Francisco Bay Area. However, base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position offered.
Benefits
TabaPay offers the following benefits:
100% employer-paid health care insurance including medical, dental, vision, and life insurance (for employee only)Employer 401K MatchingGenerous and Flexible PTO
EEO Employer: TabaPay is an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, Veteran status, or any other protected classification.

rows.descriptionText:
Job Title: Assistant Manager, CRM & Lifecycle MarketingJob Location: San Francisco, CAJob Duration: 12 Months on W2
Job Description:We're looking for a data-driven Assistant Manager to join our CRM & Lifecycle Marketing team. This role will play a key role in shaping our customer retention strategy across email, mobile messaging, and loyalty experiences. You will leverage customer insights, segmentation, testing, and personalization to optimize lifecycle journeys that drive engagement, repeat purchases, and long-term customer value. Working closely with cross-functional partners, you'll help create customer experiences that reflect our brand's voice and values while delivering a best-in-class experience across eCommerce and retail. This individual will report to the CRM & Lifecycle Marketing Manager.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:• Support Marketing Manager with strategy, execution, and optimization of CRM lifecycle marketingprograms across email and mobile messaging.• Develop and optimize lifecycle programs that leverage segmentation and personalization to driveengagement and retention.• Build and maintain a testing roadmap, leveraging A/B testing and customer insights to continuouslyimprove campaign and journey performance.• Own performance reporting for lifecycle programs, presenting insights, test results, and data-drivenrecommendations to leadership and cross-functional partners.• Manage the end-to-end execution of lifecycle campaigns, overseeing planning, asset delivery, QA, anddeployment to ensure a best-in-class customer experience.• Partner cross-functionally with Loyalty, Retail, Product, Analytics, Data Science, Creative,Merchandising, and external vendors to uncover customer insights, develop audience strategies, anddeliver personalized, customer-centric experiences.

rows.descriptionText:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to know our team: 

The Performance Marketing Team of Agoda is a world leader in online marketing. This department is highly data-driven and focused on developing at-scale marketing programs that improve the lifetime value of Agoda customers through measurable marketing programs and channels. The team is a blend of the best analysts, marketing strategists, and data scientists in the world. The marketing leadership at Agoda has deep experience in data science, product, strategy, and other marketing fields and has built an organization that thrives on data, creative ideas, and technology. The Performance Marketing Team also fosters a great learning environment. You will be able to learn and grow by working closely with experts from a variety of backgrounds from all over the world.

Due to continued expansion, there are multiple analyst roles within the marketing team across different marketing channels. While the scope will vary depending on these channels, here are some examples:

Experimentation and optimizing campaign performance: Experiment with ads/campaign structures and bidding& pricing strategies on partners such as Google, Bing, TripAdvisor, Trivago, and other search engines. Adapt to new product features and roll out changes from successful tests.Modeling: Analyze vast amounts of data generated by experiments, develop predictive models using data science techniques (e.g. understanding the impact on bookings from large-scale TV campaigns or demand elasticity from pricing optimization), and liaise with product teams on an implementation roadmapReporting, analysis, and insights: Building dashboards to track performance, derive insights, understand growth levers, and communicate recommendations via presentations to stakeholders

What you’ll Need to Succeed: 

Bachelor’s degree or higher from top university in a quantitative subject e.g. computer science, mathematics, engineering business, science, or relevant field of study4+ years experience in data crunching from top-tier consulting, investment banking, private equity or strategy/business role for a fast-growing global tech companyExperience in one or more data analysis packages or databases, e.g. SQL, SAS, R, SPSS, Python, VBA and visualization tools, e.g. Tableau, Power BI, etc.Excellent verbal and written communication skills in EnglishAbility to move fast and be efficient, making decisions on objective data evidence Innate desire to take ownership, make an impact and influence outcomesExcellent organizational skills, attention to detail and ability to work independently

It’s great if you have: 

Experience in digital marketing or e-commerceExperience with A/B testing and other testing metricsStrong presentation and negotiation skills
