rows.title: Pricing Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
About We Sell Cellular
We Sell Cellular (WSC) is a leading provider in the secondary mobile device industry, specializing in the sourcing, processing, and distribution of pre-owned mobile devices. Through our operations, technology, and industry expertise, we help extend the lifecycle of mobile devices and support a more accessible and sustainable global device ecosystem.
WSC is part of the ITOCHU Group, providing the strength and resources of a global organization while maintaining an entrepreneurial and collaborative working environment. Our team is focused on operational excellence, continued growth, and building a business that delivers long-term value for our customers, employees, and partners.
Position Summary
We Sell Cellular buys used and refurbished mobile devices in volume from carriers, OEM programs, and trade-in channels, and resells them through wholesale and retail channels. Every purchase begins with a bid, and every bid is a pricing judgment: what the device will sell for, what it will cost to grade and refurbish, and what margin remains. This is a developing analytical role designed for an early-career professional who will build expertise in device pricing, purchasing, grading, refurbishment economics, and secondary-market dynamics. The Pricing Analyst will initially work closely with experienced Buyers and the Director of Sourcing and will take on greater ownership of pricing analysis and recommendations as their market knowledge and judgment develop.
This role reports to the Director of Sourcing and supports Buyers and cross-functional teams across Sales, Operations, Finance, and Engineering/Data by analyzing pricing, demand, product condition, and cost data to inform purchasing decisions, monitor margins, and improve pricing accuracy and reporting.
Key Responsibilities
Price Analysis (Purchasing)Market price tracking. Maintain a current view of buy-side and sell-side prices by model, storage, carrier, and grade: daily award prices, secondary-market and wholesale prices, and WSC's own realized sale pricesComparable analysis. Build like-for-like comparisons across sources and time so that a bid can be judged against what the same device actually cost and sold for recentlyMargin visibility. Track the spread between purchase price and realized sale price by category, including grading and refurbishment cost, and flag categories where margin is compressingData hygiene. Keep pricing data sets clean and consistent; flag data quality issues to Engineering / Data rather than working around them
Bid Price Decision SupportBid analysis support. Prepare analysis for lot and program bids, including expected resale value, margin, grade mix, and other key assumptions. Develop pricing recommendations in partnership with Buyers and the Director of Sourcing, taking on greater ownership as market knowledge and experience develop.Scenario analysis. Show how the recommendation changes under different resale prices, grade mixes, or demand conditions, so the Buyer can decide how aggressive to bePricing floor support. Maintain and prepare the data and analysis used by the Director of Sourcing and Buyers to establish and review pricing floors; monitor bids against established parameters and flag exceptions.Post-bid review. Compare bid assumptions with actual outcomes including realized price, grade mix and sell-through and feed the learning back into the next recommendation
Reporting & CommunicationDaily and weekly reporting. Contribute to the daily market report and weekly purchasing KPI review with price movements, margin trends, and notable bidsDocumentation. Record pricing decisions, assumptions, and outcomes so that the team's pricing knowledge accumulates rather than living in individual headsBuyer partnership. Work closely with Buyers on live bids to understand the information needed for purchasing decisions, respond quickly to analytical requests, and progressively build knowledge of WSC's bidding and purchasing process.
QualificationsMust-haveBachelor's degree in business, economics, finance, statistics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experienceStrong numerical judgment and comfort working with prices, margins, and volumes in spreadsheetsAdvanced spreadsheet skills (Google Sheets / Excel): lookups, pivots, scenario tablesClear written communication — able to turn analysis into a one-page recommendation with assumptions and risksMarket curiosity — genuine interest in mobile devices, secondary markets, and how prices moveAttention to detail and ownership of the accuracy of every number handed to a Buyer
PreferredInternship or early-career experience in pricing, purchasing, procurement, finance, merchandising, inventory, supply chain, business analytics, or a related area. Relevant internships, academic projects or equivalent practical experience will be considered. Familiarity with carrier and OEM trade-in programs, device grading, or refurbishment economicsExperience building dashboards or automated reports (Looker Studio, Sheets, or similar)Bilingual (Japanese or Spanish) a plus
Key CompetenciesNumerical judgment — knows when a number looks wrong and checks itDecision support mindset — every analysis ends in a recommendation a Buyer can act onAI adoption — Quick to leverage AI to work faster, with the discipline to double-check all dataMarket awareness — follows device launches, carrier moves, and secondary-market prices as a habitDocumentation discipline — assumptions and outcomes recorded so the team learnsCollaboration — works at the Buyer's pace and in the Buyer's languageLearning orientation — builds device, grading, and market knowledge steadily toward the Buyer track
Working ConditionsThis role is based in Edgewood, NY and requires regular on-site presence to work closely with the Purchasing team and Operations / Grading floor.
Salary & BenefitsCompensation: Base Salary Range: $55,000 - $60,000 annually. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, technical skills, and other job-related factors.Benefits: We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including medical insurance, a 401(k)-retirement plan with company match, paid time off (PTO), and paid company holidays.

Job Summary

The Deal Desk Analyst serves as a critical operational and analytical partner within the Deal Desk organization, supporting the full deal lifecycle from opportunity qualification through contract execution. This role is responsible for maintaining Salesforce data integrity, supporting deal modeling, drafting professional memos, coordinating cross-functional stakeholders, and developing scalable processes that improve deal velocity. The Analyst will leverage strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and pattern recognition to identify trends across pricing, commercial terms, and deal structures. This individual will document best practices, create playbooks and deal matrices, and help establish repeatable frameworks that enable faster decision-making, and operational efficiency across the organization. This position serves as the operational foundation that enables Deal Desk Managers to act as strategic advisors to Sales and Leadership while ensuring disciplined execution of Deal Desk processes. This role reports to the Director, Deal Desk.

Responsibilities

Job Description

Deal Support & Analysis

Support the development and review of financial deal models across all opportunities. Draft professional memos and coordinate supporting documentation for stakeholder and executive approvals. Analyze commercial terms, pricing structures, profitability, and revenue implications to support deal reviews. Facilitate deal progression by partnering with Sales, Finance, Legal, Revenue Operations and Leadership teams. 

Salesforce Data Quality & Operational Excellence

Ensure required fields, pricing data, deal stages, and commercial terms are properly documented and maintained. Support process governance and data validation efforts that improve data accuracy and operational reporting. Identify and resolve data inconsistencies and process gaps that create friction in the deal lifecycle. Ensure deal documentation and financial assumptions are accurately captured. Provide reporting and insights to support executive and business reviews. 

Process Improvement & Enablement

Cross-Functional Partnership

rows.title: Pricing Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
About We Sell Cellular
We Sell Cellular (WSC) is a leading provider in the secondary mobile device industry, specializing in the sourcing, processing, and distribution of pre-owned mobile devices. Through our operations, technology, and industry expertise, we help extend the lifecycle of mobile devices and support a more accessible and sustainable global device ecosystem.
WSC is part of the ITOCHU Group, providing the strength and resources of a global organization while maintaining an entrepreneurial and collaborative working environment. Our team is focused on operational excellence, continued growth, and building a business that delivers long-term value for our customers, employees, and partners.
Position Summary
We Sell Cellular buys used and refurbished mobile devices in volume from carriers, OEM programs, and trade-in channels, and resells them through wholesale and retail channels. Every purchase begins with a bid, and every bid is a pricing judgment: what the device will sell for, what it will cost to grade and refurbish, and what margin remains. This is a developing analytical role designed for an early-career professional who will build expertise in device pricing, purchasing, grading, refurbishment economics, and secondary-market dynamics. The Pricing Analyst will initially work closely with experienced Buyers and the Director of Sourcing and will take on greater ownership of pricing analysis and recommendations as their market knowledge and judgment develop.
This role reports to the Director of Sourcing and supports Buyers and cross-functional teams across Sales, Operations, Finance, and Engineering/Data by analyzing pricing, demand, product condition, and cost data to inform purchasing decisions, monitor margins, and improve pricing accuracy and reporting.
Key Responsibilities
Price Analysis (Purchasing)Market price tracking. Maintain a current view of buy-side and sell-side prices by model, storage, carrier, and grade: daily award prices, secondary-market and wholesale prices, and WSC's own realized sale pricesComparable analysis. Build like-for-like comparisons across sources and time so that a bid can be judged against what the same device actually cost and sold for recentlyMargin visibility. Track the spread between purchase price and realized sale price by category, including grading and refurbishment cost, and flag categories where margin is compressingData hygiene. Keep pricing data sets clean and consistent; flag data quality issues to Engineering / Data rather than working around them
Bid Price Decision SupportBid analysis support. Prepare analysis for lot and program bids, including expected resale value, margin, grade mix, and other key assumptions. Develop pricing recommendations in partnership with Buyers and the Director of Sourcing, taking on greater ownership as market knowledge and experience develop.Scenario analysis. Show how the recommendation changes under different resale prices, grade mixes, or demand conditions, so the Buyer can decide how aggressive to bePricing floor support. Maintain and prepare the data and analysis used by the Director of Sourcing and Buyers to establish and review pricing floors; monitor bids against established parameters and flag exceptions.Post-bid review. Compare bid assumptions with actual outcomes including realized price, grade mix and sell-through and feed the learning back into the next recommendation
Reporting & CommunicationDaily and weekly reporting. Contribute to the daily market report and weekly purchasing KPI review with price movements, margin trends, and notable bidsDocumentation. Record pricing decisions, assumptions, and outcomes so that the team's pricing knowledge accumulates rather than living in individual headsBuyer partnership. Work closely with Buyers on live bids to understand the information needed for purchasing decisions, respond quickly to analytical requests, and progressively build knowledge of WSC's bidding and purchasing process.
QualificationsMust-haveBachelor's degree in business, economics, finance, statistics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experienceStrong numerical judgment and comfort working with prices, margins, and volumes in spreadsheetsAdvanced spreadsheet skills (Google Sheets / Excel): lookups, pivots, scenario tablesClear written communication — able to turn analysis into a one-page recommendation with assumptions and risksMarket curiosity — genuine interest in mobile devices, secondary markets, and how prices moveAttention to detail and ownership of the accuracy of every number handed to a Buyer
PreferredInternship or early-career experience in pricing, purchasing, procurement, finance, merchandising, inventory, supply chain, business analytics, or a related area. Relevant internships, academic projects or equivalent practical experience will be considered. Familiarity with carrier and OEM trade-in programs, device grading, or refurbishment economicsExperience building dashboards or automated reports (Looker Studio, Sheets, or similar)Bilingual (Japanese or Spanish) a plus
Key CompetenciesNumerical judgment — knows when a number looks wrong and checks itDecision support mindset — every analysis ends in a recommendation a Buyer can act onAI adoption — Quick to leverage AI to work faster, with the discipline to double-check all dataMarket awareness — follows device launches, carrier moves, and secondary-market prices as a habitDocumentation discipline — assumptions and outcomes recorded so the team learnsCollaboration — works at the Buyer's pace and in the Buyer's languageLearning orientation — builds device, grading, and market knowledge steadily toward the Buyer track
Working ConditionsThis role is based in Edgewood, NY and requires regular on-site presence to work closely with the Purchasing team and Operations / Grading floor.
Salary & BenefitsCompensation: Base Salary Range: $55,000 - $60,000 annually. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, technical skills, and other job-related factors.Benefits: We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including medical insurance, a 401(k)-retirement plan with company match, paid time off (PTO), and paid company holidays.

Job Title: Quantitative Data Scientist (Modeling and Feature Engineering)Location: New York, NY (In-person) Experience: 2+ yearsCompensation: $80,000-$135,000 base salary + equity
Company Overview: ShotQuality is a leader in AI-driven sports data extraction, combining advanced computer vision and data science to transform video feeds into granular player tracking data and predictive insights. Originally built around basketball, our technology now scales across football, baseball, tennis, and more, powering multi-sport analytics at the enterprise level. Our proprietary models are trusted by industry leaders, enabling sportsbooks, prediction markets, trading firms, and media companies to make confident, data-driven decisions. With 20,000+ games processed across 15+ leagues, ShotQuality turns raw video into actionable intelligence. As we expand our AI and computer vision capabilities, we continue to push the boundaries of real-time sports analytics, delivering the infrastructure that powers the future of data in sports.We are a small team in New York where the work you ship shows up in live products within days, not months.
Job Overview: We are hiring a Quantitative Data Scientist to build the features and predictive models behind ShotQuality's real-time sports products. You will turn raw event, tracking, and market data into signals, test whether they improve on market prices, and get the ones that work into production. This role sits between our data science team and our live products, so you will see your models used in real time by market-facing clients during live games. The ideal candidate comes from a sports and trading background and is energized by fast-moving markets.
Responsibilities:Feature Engineering: Design, build, and maintain features from play-by-play, player tracking, and pricing data that improve predictive accuracy.Predictive Modeling: Develop and refine probability models for in-game and pregame outcomes, with a focus on calibration and real-world performance.Market Analysis: Study how prices move around in-game events and identify where our models add information beyond current market prices.Backtesting and Evaluation: Build rigorous backtests that measure whether a model or signal holds up out of sample, against closing lines and live market prices.Research to Production: Partner with engineering to move models from notebook to live, low-latency pipelines, and monitor them once they are running.Performance Analysis: Track model performance over time, diagnose drift or degradation, and report findings clearly to leadership.Client Support: Handle requests from sophisticated, market-facing clients with fast, well-reasoned analysis.
The Role is for Candidates Who: Have a background in trading, market making, or quantitative research and get excited about finding an edge in live marketsHave built predictive models that were evaluated on real outcomes and real prices, not just a held-out test setEnjoy the feature engineering grind and can explain which features mattered and whyThink in probabilities and expected value, and care about calibration, not just accuracyMove fast, ship quickly, and iterate based on what the data showsAdapt quickly when priorities shift and are comfortable working without a fixed playbookAre comfortable with unstructured hours that follow the sports calendar, including live games on nights and weekends
The Role is NOT for Candidates Who:Have only coursework or Kaggle-style modeling experienceAren't genuinely interested in prediction markets and the sports betting spacePrefer pure research with no path to productionNeed a rigid structure or a predictable 9-to-5 scheduleAre looking for a fully remote role
Requirements:2+ years of professional experience in quantitative research, trading, or data science, ideally at a trading firm, sportsbook, or prediction marketStrong foundation in statistics and probability, including model calibration and evaluationProficiency in Python (pandas, TensorFlow, NumPy, scikit-learn or similar) and SQLHands-on experience with gradient boosting, regression, and time-series or sequential modelingExperience designing backtests and avoiding leakage and overfittingAbility to communicate results clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholdersBachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related quantitative fieldWillingness to be available during some nights and weekends of live games (as necessary)

Experienced in taking models into production through the model risk compliance processCustomer first. You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them. Creative. rows.title: Senior Analyst, Marketing
rows.descriptionText:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Senior Analyst, Marketing

Who is Mastercard?

We are the global technology company behind the world’s fastest payments processing network. We are a vehicle for commerce, a connection to financial systems for the previously excluded, a technology innovation lab, and the home of Priceless®. We ensure every employee has the opportunity to be a part of something bigger and to change lives. We believe as our company grows, so should you. We believe in connecting everyone to endless, priceless possibilities.

 Integrated Campaigns & Thought Leadership: Collaborate with product, sales, regional marketing, and research teams to identify market insights and thought leadership opportunities, translating them into compelling content and integrated B2B marketing campaigns that engage target audiences across digital, social, web, and sales enablement channels. Content Development & Asset Creation: Develop marketing assets that support Digital Payments (including Click to Pay, Tokenization, and Passkeys). Create customer videos, playbooks, research, B2B and B2C toolkits to drive market education and adoption. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with stakeholders across product, marketing operations, media, digital, communications, legal, and agency partners to ensure seamless execution of marketing initiatives and compliance with brand and business requirements. Performance Measurement & Optimization: Monitor, analyze, and report on campaign performance, leveraging data, insights, and AI-enabled tools to optimize marketing effectiveness and inform future strategies.


All About You – Key Qualifications & Skills

 Experience in B2B marketing, with a focus on campaign management or content strategy. Excellent writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts into compelling content and customer value propositions for business audiences. Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities. Experience working effectively in highly cross-functional, global organizations. Familiarity using AI-enabled tools to improve content creation, research, campaign execution, and marketing efficiency.


Beneficial

 Background in payment technologies and products, experience in a B2B sales organization, and familiarity with marketing, analytics, and social media platforms that support digital engagement and demand generation.


Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

Corporate Security Responsibility

 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;Report any suspected information security violation or breach, andComplete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.


In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in the US, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive base salary and may be eligible for an annual bonus or commissions depending on the role. The base salary offered may vary depending on multiple factors, including but not limited to location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Mastercard benefits for full time (and certain part time) employees generally include: insurance (including medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, disability, life insurance); flexible spending account and health savings account; paid leaves (including 16 weeks of new parent leave and up to 20 days of bereavement leave); 80 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time, 25 days of vacation time and 5 personal days, pro-rated based on date of hire; 10 annual paid U.S. observed holidays; 401k with a best-in-class company match; deferred compensation for eligible roles; fitness reimbursement or on-site fitness facilities; eligibility for tuition reimbursement; and many more. Mastercard benefits for interns generally include: 56 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time; jury duty leave; and on-site fitness facilities in some locations.

THIS POSTING RELECTS ONE OR MORE CURRENT VACANCIES ON OUR TEAM, AND MASTERCARD INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY 01/12/2027. If the fill date has passed, Mastercard intends to fill this position as soon as possible.

Pay Ranges

Purchase, New York: $106,000 - $175,000 USD

rows.descriptionText:
We are seeking talented and committed individuals with strong analytical and critical thinking skills to join our Primary Market Research (PMR) practice area as Summer Associates. With a primary focus on PMR responsibilities, the PMR Summer Associates will interact closely with other staff, management, and leadership to deliver actionable and insight driven solutions for clients. This environment provides Summer Associates with exposure to a wide variety of primary market research methods and an opportunity to gain in depth knowledge of how PMR insights drive commercial decision making in the life sciences industry. On each project, Summer Associates help gather information, create and interpret analyses, and develop presentations of research findings. Their work is the base upon which our strategic recommendations that drive our client’s decisions are ultimately grounded. Summer Associates develop their skills through undergoing comprehensive formal and informal training, as well as receiving mentorship that encourages them to stretch their skills.

This is a 9-week, in-person summer internship and the program will run from June 14-August 13, 2027. Interns will be paid $35/hour and can expect to work 40 hours/week.

Essential Functions

Draft materials for research (screeners, discussion guides, stimuli, surveys)Support field work and recruiting of PMR respondentsAnalyze qualitative and quantitative primary market research dataHelp craft takeaways and implications for the client based on study findingsDevelop a highly visual PowerPoint presentation of study findings

Position Requirements

Education: Candidates should be pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in business, sciences, social sciences, mathematics, statistics, engineering or public health and demonstrate interest in the life sciences field. The internship program is reserved for rising seniors or students who have 1 year left in their studies.

Work Experience: 0-2 years of experience in consulting, primary market research or other relevant areas within the life sciences industry

Exhibits strong analytical and critical thinking skillsInterest and knowledge of the life sciences industryProficiency in Excel, Word, and PowerPointExcellent communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal relations skillsAbility to manage multiple priorities concurrentlyDesire and ability to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environmentDemonstrated ability to work in a team environment

Trinity powers the future of life sciences commercialization through the fusion of human and artificial intelligence. By blending deep therapeutic expertise and trusted human ingenuity with a purpose-built technology platform, Trinity accelerates clarity and confidence at every step of the commercialization journey—from pre-launch to scale to loss of exclusivity. For more than 30 years, the world’s leading pharmaceutical, biotech, and medtech companies have relied on Trinity’s foresight, execution, and partnership to deliver confident product launches, decisive market advantage, and measurable patient impact. During that time, Trinity expanded from its first office in Waltham, MA to 1,300 professionals across 14 offices and five continents, setting new industry standards in quality, responsiveness, and client partnership. For more information, visit Trinity at www.trinitylifesciences.com.

rows.title: Pricing Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
About We Sell Cellular
We Sell Cellular (WSC) is a leading provider in the secondary mobile device industry, specializing in the sourcing, processing, and distribution of pre-owned mobile devices. Through our operations, technology, and industry expertise, we help extend the lifecycle of mobile devices and support a more accessible and sustainable global device ecosystem.
WSC is part of the ITOCHU Group, providing the strength and resources of a global organization while maintaining an entrepreneurial and collaborative working environment. Our team is focused on operational excellence, continued growth, and building a business that delivers long-term value for our customers, employees, and partners.
Position Summary
We Sell Cellular buys used and refurbished mobile devices in volume from carriers, OEM programs, and trade-in channels, and resells them through wholesale and retail channels. Every purchase begins with a bid, and every bid is a pricing judgment: what the device will sell for, what it will cost to grade and refurbish, and what margin remains. This is a developing analytical role designed for an early-career professional who will build expertise in device pricing, purchasing, grading, refurbishment economics, and secondary-market dynamics. The Pricing Analyst will initially work closely with experienced Buyers and the Director of Sourcing and will take on greater ownership of pricing analysis and recommendations as their market knowledge and judgment develop.
This role reports to the Director of Sourcing and supports Buyers and cross-functional teams across Sales, Operations, Finance, and Engineering/Data by analyzing pricing, demand, product condition, and cost data to inform purchasing decisions, monitor margins, and improve pricing accuracy and reporting.
Key Responsibilities
Price Analysis (Purchasing)Market price tracking. Maintain a current view of buy-side and sell-side prices by model, storage, carrier, and grade: daily award prices, secondary-market and wholesale prices, and WSC's own realized sale pricesComparable analysis. Build like-for-like comparisons across sources and time so that a bid can be judged against what the same device actually cost and sold for recentlyMargin visibility. Track the spread between purchase price and realized sale price by category, including grading and refurbishment cost, and flag categories where margin is compressingData hygiene. Keep pricing data sets clean and consistent; flag data quality issues to Engineering / Data rather than working around them
Bid Price Decision SupportBid analysis support. Prepare analysis for lot and program bids, including expected resale value, margin, grade mix, and other key assumptions. Develop pricing recommendations in partnership with Buyers and the Director of Sourcing, taking on greater ownership as market knowledge and experience develop.Scenario analysis. Show how the recommendation changes under different resale prices, grade mixes, or demand conditions, so the Buyer can decide how aggressive to bePricing floor support. Maintain and prepare the data and analysis used by the Director of Sourcing and Buyers to establish and review pricing floors; monitor bids against established parameters and flag exceptions.Post-bid review. Compare bid assumptions with actual outcomes including realized price, grade mix and sell-through and feed the learning back into the next recommendation
Reporting & CommunicationDaily and weekly reporting. Contribute to the daily market report and weekly purchasing KPI review with price movements, margin trends, and notable bidsDocumentation. Record pricing decisions, assumptions, and outcomes so that the team's pricing knowledge accumulates rather than living in individual headsBuyer partnership. Work closely with Buyers on live bids to understand the information needed for purchasing decisions, respond quickly to analytical requests, and progressively build knowledge of WSC's bidding and purchasing process.
QualificationsMust-haveBachelor's degree in business, economics, finance, statistics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experienceStrong numerical judgment and comfort working with prices, margins, and volumes in spreadsheetsAdvanced spreadsheet skills (Google Sheets / Excel): lookups, pivots, scenario tablesClear written communication — able to turn analysis into a one-page recommendation with assumptions and risksMarket curiosity — genuine interest in mobile devices, secondary markets, and how prices moveAttention to detail and ownership of the accuracy of every number handed to a Buyer
PreferredInternship or early-career experience in pricing, purchasing, procurement, finance, merchandising, inventory, supply chain, business analytics, or a related area. Relevant internships, academic projects or equivalent practical experience will be considered. Familiarity with carrier and OEM trade-in programs, device grading, or refurbishment economicsExperience building dashboards or automated reports (Looker Studio, Sheets, or similar)Bilingual (Japanese or Spanish) a plus
Key CompetenciesNumerical judgment — knows when a number looks wrong and checks itDecision support mindset — every analysis ends in a recommendation a Buyer can act onAI adoption — Quick to leverage AI to work faster, with the discipline to double-check all dataMarket awareness — follows device launches, carrier moves, and secondary-market prices as a habitDocumentation discipline — assumptions and outcomes recorded so the team learnsCollaboration — works at the Buyer's pace and in the Buyer's languageLearning orientation — builds device, grading, and market knowledge steadily toward the Buyer track
Working ConditionsThis role is based in Edgewood, NY and requires regular on-site presence to work closely with the Purchasing team and Operations / Grading floor.
Salary & BenefitsCompensation: Base Salary Range: $55,000 - $60,000 annually. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, technical skills, and other job-related factors.Benefits: We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including medical insurance, a 401(k)-retirement plan with company match, paid time off (PTO), and paid company holidays.

Research

Morgan Stanley Investment Research is uniquely committed to being an essential part of our clients' investment process. We strive to be the sell-side research provider that best understands the buy side. Through relevant and timely conversations with leading investors, we focus resources on risk-reward essentials: identifying the investor debates, assessing the potential outcomes, and uncovering the evidence our clients need to validate their investment decisions. Our equity analysts cover some 3,000 stocks; our economists, strategists and fixed income analysts cover all major regions and other asset classes around the globe.

Equity Research

The Equity Research department is responsible for researching macroeconomic and microeconomic conditions, along with company fundamentals. It also collects and analyses financial information to make investment recommendations on stocks in specific sectors. Research analysts build financial models to explore alternative scenarios, examine industries and communicate with companies and investors. Equity Research team members discuss their analysis and investment recommendations in research notes. A career in investment research at Morgan Stanley demands a commitment to excellence and a passion for the markets as well as the highest level of integrity.

We are seeking an experienced Analyst/Associate member to join our Airlines & Freight Transportation team in New York City.

The Airlines & Freight Transportation research team covers 30+ stocks across airlines, rails, trucking, parcels, and logistics. The team is known for differentiated, out-of-consensus views that balance timely tactical calls with deep thematic research, including work on technology-driven disruption such as autonomous trucks, drones, eVTOLs, and freight digitization, supported by a highly developed data and modeling platform.

Primary Responsibilities

 Create and maintain financial, valuation, and industry models, leveraging skills in accounting, finance, and economics Translate company, industry, consumer, market, and alternative data into insightful research reports with clear investment debates, differentiated conclusions, and actionable stock calls Develop and maintain relationships with management and investor relations teams of companies under coverage, industry specialists, and other key leaders of opinion Engage with institutional investors by responding to in-depth questions, addressing bespoke requests, discussing companies and investment theses, and helping communicate the team’s highest-conviction views Support internal sales and trading teams with timely analysis of sector breaking news and relevant industry developments Adopt and apply AI-enabled research tools judiciously to accelerate information gathering, model maintenance, data analysis, and workflow execution while maintaining analytical rigor, source verification, data integrity, and quality control Conduct industry diligence and primary research through surveys, expert conference calls, and channel checks to evaluate industry trends and their implications for companies under coverage Collaborate with cross-functional teams to produce larger industry and thematic reports

 Ideally 1-2 years of professional experience in equity research or investment banking Experience or sector knowledge in airlines and/or freight transportation is highly desirable Proven experience using Excel to build and maintain financial models; advanced Excel proficiency is required Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present analysis clearly, defend conclusions, and contribute positively in client-facing discussions Demonstrated interest in public markets and a genuine curiosity about what drives stock performance, investor debates, and valuation Comfort adopting AI-enabled tools and new technologies to improve research efficiency, with the judgment to verify outputs, protect data integrity, and apply tools appropriately Demonstrated attention to detail and commitment to accuracy Ability to adapt quickly and work well under pressure High EQ, strong personal drive, energy, creativity, intellectual curiosity, organizational discipline, and a team-oriented mindset Ability to think independently, develop differentiated views, and operate with a self-starter mentality Experience with Python is a plus but not required CFA designation, or progress toward CFA is a plus but not required

rows.title: Quantitative Data Scientist
rows.descriptionText:
Job Title: Quantitative Data Scientist (Modeling and Feature Engineering)Location: New York, NY (In-person) Experience: 2+ yearsCompensation: $80,000-$135,000 base salary + equity
Company Overview: ShotQuality is a leader in AI-driven sports data extraction, combining advanced computer vision and data science to transform video feeds into granular player tracking data and predictive insights. Originally built around basketball, our technology now scales across football, baseball, tennis, and more, powering multi-sport analytics at the enterprise level. Our proprietary models are trusted by industry leaders, enabling sportsbooks, prediction markets, trading firms, and media companies to make confident, data-driven decisions. With 20,000+ games processed across 15+ leagues, ShotQuality turns raw video into actionable intelligence. As we expand our AI and computer vision capabilities, we continue to push the boundaries of real-time sports analytics, delivering the infrastructure that powers the future of data in sports.We are a small team in New York where the work you ship shows up in live products within days, not months.
Job Overview: We are hiring a Quantitative Data Scientist to build the features and predictive models behind ShotQuality's real-time sports products. You will turn raw event, tracking, and market data into signals, test whether they improve on market prices, and get the ones that work into production. This role sits between our data science team and our live products, so you will see your models used in real time by market-facing clients during live games. The ideal candidate comes from a sports and trading background and is energized by fast-moving markets.
Responsibilities:Feature Engineering: Design, build, and maintain features from play-by-play, player tracking, and pricing data that improve predictive accuracy.Predictive Modeling: Develop and refine probability models for in-game and pregame outcomes, with a focus on calibration and real-world performance.Market Analysis: Study how prices move around in-game events and identify where our models add information beyond current market prices.Backtesting and Evaluation: Build rigorous backtests that measure whether a model or signal holds up out of sample, against closing lines and live market prices.Research to Production: Partner with engineering to move models from notebook to live, low-latency pipelines, and monitor them once they are running.Performance Analysis: Track model performance over time, diagnose drift or degradation, and report findings clearly to leadership.Client Support: Handle requests from sophisticated, market-facing clients with fast, well-reasoned analysis.
The Role is for Candidates Who: Have a background in trading, market making, or quantitative research and get excited about finding an edge in live marketsHave built predictive models that were evaluated on real outcomes and real prices, not just a held-out test setEnjoy the feature engineering grind and can explain which features mattered and whyThink in probabilities and expected value, and care about calibration, not just accuracyMove fast, ship quickly, and iterate based on what the data showsAdapt quickly when priorities shift and are comfortable working without a fixed playbookAre comfortable with unstructured hours that follow the sports calendar, including live games on nights and weekends
The Role is NOT for Candidates Who:Have only coursework or Kaggle-style modeling experienceAren't genuinely interested in prediction markets and the sports betting spacePrefer pure research with no path to productionNeed a rigid structure or a predictable 9-to-5 scheduleAre looking for a fully remote role
Requirements:2+ years of professional experience in quantitative research, trading, or data science, ideally at a trading firm, sportsbook, or prediction marketStrong foundation in statistics and probability, including model calibration and evaluationProficiency in Python (pandas, TensorFlow, NumPy, scikit-learn or similar) and SQLHands-on experience with gradient boosting, regression, and time-series or sequential modelingExperience designing backtests and avoiding leakage and overfittingAbility to communicate results clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholdersBachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related quantitative fieldWillingness to be available during some nights and weekends of live games (as necessary)
Nice to Have:Experience with pricing, market making, or market microstructure in sports betting or prediction marketsA track record of building and running your own models in live marketsExperience with sports data, player tracking data, or play-by-play dataExperience deploying models to real-time or low-latency systemsExposure to AWS or GCP, Docker, and workflow orchestration tools
Benefits:Health, Vision, Dental, and Life Insurance: Comprehensive plans for all full-time employees that are HSA-eligibleUnlimited PTO: Take time off when you need it while owning your responsibilities401(k) benefitsWFH and Mental Health + Wellness stipends to support your home office setup and wellnessFlexible Hours: Flexibility around in-office days, as long as deliverables are achievedLearning and Development: Access to training, courses, and conferences to grow your skillsLive Game Tickets: Tickets to attend live sports games during the yearSubscription to Claude/Codex/Gemini Accounts
Application Process:Assessment: Complete a take-home modeling and feature engineering exercise built on real game and market data.Interview: Walk our data science team through your approach and results.Final Round: Meet leadership in person at our New York office.

rows.descriptionText:
Overview

 JOB DESCRIPTION 

The Jefferies Equity Research Data Strategy Team is a global team embedded within the Equity Research department, responsible for shaping and executing the department's data and AI strategy. On the data side, the team helps incorporate fundamental and alternative datasets into Analyst research reports, combining analysts’ domain expertise with our team’s technical skills to produce thoughtful, defensible, and actionable analysis of real-world behavior at scale. On the AI side, our team is responsible for building internal generative AI tooling along with evaluating third-party AI models and tools to enhance our analysts’ work. We help integrate AI capabilities into analysts’ daily workflows and ensure that first- and third-party datasets are fully AI-accessible to them. Statistics, data engineering, data science, and AI are cornerstones of our work.

As a Data Scientist at Jefferies, your focus will be to support the Research Analysts and the Data Strategy Team’s broader platform. The candidate will use technical and financial skills to implement ideas and requests from the Research Analysts, while also building and maintaining relationships with internal and external stakeholders, working in collaboration with the rest of the Global Data Strategy Team.

Key Responsibilities

 Query, transform, analyze, and combine large datasets in support of solving problems and implementing research ideas across sectors and data categories, occasionally developing statistical models to predict outcomes  Enhance our platform through the creation and maintenance of tools, AI agents, MCP servers, and processes that streamline, scale, and standardize our ability to evaluate, clean, analyze, and disseminate data  Contribute to the data centralization process, ensuring all first- and third-party data assets are AI-accessible and meet quality, lineage, and governance standards  Present highly technical methods to non-technical stakeholders and translate open-ended questions into data-driven insights  Maintain and build relationships with key internal and external stakeholders, including research teams, third-party data vendors, management, and possibly buy-side clients 

Qualifications

Required

 Transferable experience on the sell-side or buy-side, in data science, data research, or similar function  STEM degree with preference for Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, Quantitative Finance, and related disciplines  Strong proficiency with Python, intermediate or better proficiency with SQL and/or Apache Spark  Experience analyzing and visualizing large datasets  Experience with AI-assisted development (Claude Code, GitHub CoPilot, Cursor, etc.)  Familiarity with LLMs, LangChain, vector databases, and RAG pipelines  Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders 

Preferred

 Demonstrated interest in fundamental equity research and financial modelling  Experience with Databricks or Snowflake and cloud platforms such as AWS  Experience with Atlassian project management tools (JIRA, Confluence, Bitbucket)  Experience with knowledge graphs 

Primary Location Full Time Salary Range of $100,000 - $120,000.

About Us

Jefferies is a leading global, full-service investment banking and capital markets firm that provides advisory, sales and trading, research, and wealth and asset management services. With more than 40 offices around the world, we offer insights and expertise to investors, companies, and governments.

At Jefferies, we are committed to building a culture that provides opportunities for all employees regardless of our differences and supports a workforce that is reflective of the communities where we work and live. As a result, we are able to pool our collective insights and intelligence to provide fresh and innovative thinking for our clients.

Jefferies is committed to creating and sustaining a workforce that welcomes individuals from all backgrounds to apply. Our employment decisions are made without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, pregnancy, age, medical condition, physical or mental disability, marital status, domestic partner status, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, genetic information, reproductive health decisions, or any other factor protected by applicable law. We are committed to hiring the most qualified applicants and complying with all federal, state, and local equal employment opportunity laws. As part of this commitment, Jefferies will extend reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities, as required by applicable law.

The salary offered will take into consideration an individual’s experience level and qualifications. In addition to salary, Jefferies Financial Group is proud to offer a comprehensive benefits package to eligible, full-time employees or part-time employees, who are scheduled to work at least 30 hours or more per week, including an annual discretionary incentive and retention bonus, competitive employee benefits, including: medical, dental & vision coverage; 401(k); life, accident, and disability insurance; and wellness programs. FreeWheel, a Comcast company, provides comprehensive ad platforms for publishers, advertisers, and media buyers. Powered by premium video content, robust data, and advanced technology, we’re making it easier for buyers and sellers to transact across all screens, data types, and sales channels. As a global company, we have offices in nine countries and can insert advertisements around the world.

Job Summary

The Deal Desk Analyst serves as a critical operational and analytical partner within the Deal Desk organization, supporting the full deal lifecycle from opportunity qualification through contract execution. This role is responsible for maintaining Salesforce data integrity, supporting deal modeling, drafting professional memos, coordinating cross-functional stakeholders, and developing scalable processes that improve deal velocity. The Analyst will leverage strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and pattern recognition to identify trends across pricing, commercial terms, and deal structures. This individual will document best practices, create playbooks and deal matrices, and help establish repeatable frameworks that enable faster decision-making, and operational efficiency across the organization. This position serves as the operational foundation that enables Deal Desk Managers to act as strategic advisors to Sales and Leadership while ensuring disciplined execution of Deal Desk processes. This role reports to the Director, Deal Desk.

Responsibilities

Job Description

Deal Support & Analysis

Support the development and review of financial deal models across all opportunities. Draft professional memos and coordinate supporting documentation for stakeholder and executive approvals. Analyze commercial terms, pricing structures, profitability, and revenue implications to support deal reviews. Facilitate deal progression by partnering with Sales, Finance, Legal, Revenue Operations and Leadership teams. 

Salesforce Data Quality & Operational Excellence

Maintain accurate and complete Salesforce opportunity records to support pipeline management. Ensure required fields, pricing data, deal stages, and commercial terms are properly documented and maintained. Support process governance and data validation efforts that improve data accuracy and operational reporting. Identify and resolve data inconsistencies and process gaps that create friction in the deal lifecycle. Ensure deal documentation and financial assumptions are accurately captured. Provide reporting and insights to support executive and business reviews. 

Process Improvement & Enablement

Identify recurring deal structures, pricing models, and commercial patterns to develop scalable playbooks and best practices. Build and maintain deal matrices, operating procedures, and decision-making frameworks to improve consistency and efficiency. 

Cross-Functional Partnership

Act as a liaison between Sales, Finance, Legal, Revenue Recognition, Operations, and Leadership teams to find a “path to yes” that drives company growth. Ensure alignment across stakeholders and proactively communicate risks, dependencies, and approval requirements.

Job Description

At American Express, we empower early career data and analytics colleagues to learn, innovate, and make an impact from day one. As an Analyst Data Analytics colleague in Enterprise Technology Services, you will join a full time graduate program and support analytics work that helps technology teams understand portfolio performance, delivery progress, financial trends, resource utilization, and operational outcomes.

This role sits at the intersection of technology, finance, portfolio management, reporting, and data analytics. You may gather and validate data, build reports, analyze financial or delivery metrics, support dashboards, develop insights, and prepare clear recommendations that help leaders and teams make informed technology decisions.

Responsibilities

Collect, clean, validate, and organize data from portfolio, project, financial, operational, and technology delivery sources to support analysis and reporting. Analyze portfolio performance, budget, forecast, resource, delivery, schedule, quality, and risk information to identify trends, insights, and areas for follow up. Create and maintain dashboards, reports, key performance indicators, recurring analytics outputs, and leadership ready summaries for technology stakeholders. Develop financial models, cost views, forecast summaries, scenario analyses, and variance insights that support technology portfolio and project decision making. Partner with technology, finance, product, project, and business teams to understand reporting needs and translate them into accurate analytical outputs. Support Software Development Lifecycle and Agile delivery reporting by analyzing delivery metrics, progress data, dependencies, and execution patterns. Prepare presentations, narratives, and stakeholder updates that communicate data backed insights to technical and non technical audiences. Use Agentic AI, reporting, data analytics, and productivity tools to support research, summarization, analysis, workflow efficiency, and human validated outputs. 

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

Must have earned a Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Information Technology, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Economics, or another relevant field before the full time start date.Students must have a graduation date between December 2026 and June 2027. Interest or experience in data analytics, financial management, portfolio reporting, technology delivery, business intelligence, or data informed decision making. Foundational knowledge of data analytics concepts, including data collection, validation, analysis, visualization, and insight generation. Foundational understanding of financial management principles such as budgeting, forecasting, cost tracking, variance analysis, or financial modeling. Awareness of Software Development Lifecycle and Agile methodology concepts within a technology delivery environment. Foundational understanding of Generative AI concepts, responsible use, appropriate use contexts, prompt based workflows, and human validation of AI generated outputs. Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, communication, organization, problem solving, and collaboration skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

Coursework, projects, internships, student organizations, or extracurricular experience related to data analytics, finance, business analysis, reporting, portfolio management, or technology delivery. Experience using analytical, reporting, or presentation tools such as Excel, PowerPoint, SQL, Python, Tableau, Power BI, or similar platforms. Exposure to financial modeling, dashboard development, key performance indicator reporting, forecast reconciliation, cost analysis, or operational analytics. Interest in technology portfolio management, project performance reporting, resource planning, process improvement, or business intelligence modernization. Familiarity with project or portfolio tools such as Jira, Rally, Confluence, SharePoint, Microsoft Project, or related workflow platforms. Coursework, projects, research, or internship exposure to data requirements, source-to-target mapping, data quality and controls, metadata, lineage, or data governance. Exposure to financial modeling, dashboard development, statistical analysis, scenario analysis, model documentation, data quality review, metadata, or data lineage concepts. Interest in AI governance, model risk management, responsible AI, explainability, enterprise data architecture, predictive analytics, or quantum computing research. Curiosity about Agentic AI reporting, AI enabled analytics, productivity tools, automated insight generation, and responsible validation of AI generated recommendations. Ability to build clear narratives from data, communicate findings clearly, and work effectively across finance, technology, architecture, risk, product, and business teams. 

Employment eligibility to work with American Express in the United States is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for these positions.

About Us

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. Job Title: IT Data Analyst III
Location: Corning, NY - 100% onsite
Duration: 12 Months

Schedule: Mon - Fri 8:00 am - 5:00 pm

Position Purpose
Client is consolidating 29 ERP platforms around the world to unite the organization under one common ERP solution, SAP S/4HANA Private. The Data Validation & Analytics Expert supports this transformation by validating that the correct data is transferred during ERP deployments for Req to Pay (RTP) and by improving how deployment data is analyzed, interpreted, and reported.
This role works closely with the ERP transformation data team, business leads, and key stakeholders to verify data accuracy, completeness, and alignment across deployment activities. The role combines hands-on data validation, profiling, cleansing, and analysis with the development of dashboards, reporting, and practical AI-enabled approaches that improve deployment readiness and business decision-making.

Key Responsibilities
Validate that RTP data is accurately transferred during ERP deployment activities
Partner with the ERP transformation data team, business leads, and users to confirm data requirements, validation criteria, priorities, and status updates
Collect data from primary and secondary sources and maintain relevant databases, files, and data systems that support validation and analysis activities
Develop and implement data collection processes, validation methods, and other strategies that improve data quality, consistency, and efficiency
Filter, cleanse, and review data using reports, reconciliations, and performance indicators to identify issues and improve reliability
Perform data profiling to identify, investigate, and understand anomalies, gaps, inconsistencies, and data transfer risks
Mine and analyze large data sets to draw valid conclusions and support deployment and business decision-making
Use statistical and analytical tools to interpret data sets, with attention to trends, patterns, and insights that may support diagnostic or predictive analytics efforts
Develop dashboards, graphs, visualizations, exception reporting, and reconciliation tools that enable quicker and more effective data analysis
Apply AI-enabled approaches, where appropriate, to support faster issue identification, pattern detection, and insight generation across validation activities
Translate validation and analytical findings into clear updates, recommendations, and reporting for management and stakeholders
Proactively identify trends, risks, and business improvement opportunities and make recommendations to stakeholders
Contribute to stronger data quality, lower deployment risk, and more reliable RTP process outcomes across the ERP transformation

Required Qualifications
Education: Bachelor's degree in IT, Science, or Business
5 year's experience in the following;
Experience in data validation, data analysis, ERP data support, or transformation-related roles
Strong ability to analyze complex data and identify inconsistencies, anomalies, gaps, and quality issues
Experience supporting ERP deployments, data migration, or system implementation activities
Understanding of RTP processes and related business data
Experience developing dashboards, reports, validation tools, or analytical methods to improve data review and decision-making
Experience working with data profiling, cleansing, reconciliation, and trend analysis
Ability to work effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders, and management
Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and follow-through
Strong written and verbal communication skills

Preferred Qualifications
Experience with SAP S/4HANA or similar ERP platforms
Experience supporting RTP data validation, migration, or deployment readiness activities
Familiarity with enterprise data quality, statistical analysis, reconciliation, or validation methods
Experience using AI, automation, or advanced analytics to improve data analysis processes (Databricks)
Experience working in cross-functional global transformation programs

Why This Role Matters
This role helps protect deployment quality by ensuring RTP data is transferred accurately and reliably during ERP go-lives while improving how quickly and effectively deployment data can be analyzed and used. Success in this role will reduce risk, improve business confidence in deployment data, and support a smoother, more insight-driven transition to Client common SAP S/4HANA platform.

Overview

 JOB DESCRIPTION 

The Jefferies Equity Research Data Strategy Team is a global team embedded within the Equity Research department, responsible for shaping and executing the department's data and AI strategy. On the data side, the team helps incorporate fundamental and alternative datasets into Analyst research reports, combining analysts’ domain expertise with our team’s technical skills to produce thoughtful, defensible, and actionable analysis of real-world behavior at scale. On the AI side, our team is responsible for building internal generative AI tooling along with evaluating third-party AI models and tools to enhance our analysts’ work. We help integrate AI capabilities into analysts’ daily workflows and ensure that first- and third-party datasets are fully AI-accessible to them. Statistics, data engineering, data science, and AI are cornerstones of our work.

As a Data Scientist at Jefferies, your focus will be to support the Research Analysts and the Data Strategy Team’s broader platform. The candidate will use technical and financial skills to implement ideas and requests from the Research Analysts, while also building and maintaining relationships with internal and external stakeholders, working in collaboration with the rest of the Global Data Strategy Team.

Key Responsibilities

 Query, transform, analyze, and combine large datasets in support of solving problems and implementing research ideas across sectors and data categories, occasionally developing statistical models to predict outcomes  Enhance our platform through the creation and maintenance of tools, AI agents, MCP servers, and processes that streamline, scale, and standardize our ability to evaluate, clean, analyze, and disseminate data  Contribute to the data centralization process, ensuring all first- and third-party data assets are AI-accessible and meet quality, lineage, and governance standards  Present highly technical methods to non-technical stakeholders and translate open-ended questions into data-driven insights  Maintain and build relationships with key internal and external stakeholders, including research teams, third-party data vendors, management, and possibly buy-side clients 

Qualifications

Required

 Transferable experience on the sell-side or buy-side, in data science, data research, or similar function  STEM degree with preference for Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, Quantitative Finance, and related disciplines  Strong proficiency with Python, intermediate or better proficiency with SQL and/or Apache Spark  Experience analyzing and visualizing large datasets  Experience with AI-assisted development (Claude Code, GitHub CoPilot, Cursor, etc.)  Familiarity with LLMs, LangChain, vector databases, and RAG pipelines  Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders 

Preferred

 Demonstrated interest in fundamental equity research and financial modelling  Experience with Databricks or Snowflake and cloud platforms such as AWS  Experience with Atlassian project management tools (JIRA, Confluence, Bitbucket)  Experience with knowledge graphs 

Primary Location Full Time Salary Range of $100,000 - $120,000.

About Us

Jefferies is a leading global, full-service investment banking and capital markets firm that provides advisory, sales and trading, research, and wealth and asset management services. Jefferies is committed to creating and sustaining a workforce that welcomes individuals from all backgrounds to apply. Our employment decisions are made without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, pregnancy, age, medical condition, physical or mental disability, marital status, domestic partner status, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, genetic information, reproductive health decisions, or any other factor protected by applicable law. rows.title: Analyst, Operational Reporting & Metrics
rows.descriptionText:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Analyst, Operational Reporting & Metrics

The Global Statistics / Quarterly Mastercard Reporting (QMR) group is responsible for the collection, validation, analysis, and reporting of Mastercard’s operational performance metrics. The team plays a critical role in ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and timeliness of quarterly reported data while supporting business partners through data-driven insights, operational reporting, and reporting governance.

As a core member of the QMR team, you will participate in all quarterly reporting activities, partner closely with internal and external stakeholders, and help ensure the completeness and accuracy of customer-reported operational data. This highly visible role requires strong analytical capabilities, attention to detail, stakeholder management skills, and the ability to understand the downstream impact of reporting on operational metrics, financial reporting, and billing processes.

Role

 Support the collection, review, validation, and reporting of quarterly operational data submissions. Analyze customer-reported operational and transaction data to identify discrepancies, anomalies, trends, and potential revenue leakage. Investigate reporting variances and collaborate with customers and internal stakeholders to resolve issues within required timelines. Develop trusted relationships with internal and external stakeholders to support accurate and timely reporting submissions. Understand and assess the downstream impact of reporting activities on billing, operational metrics, and business reporting. Perform root cause analysis on reporting exceptions and recommend corrective actions. Deliver clear and actionable reporting insights to support operational and management discussions. Support quarterly QMR business updates and reporting reviews with regional finance and business partners. Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for inquiries, investigations, and issue resolution. Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes, controls, and operational efficiencies. Contribute to system enhancement initiatives, user acceptance testing, and process improvement projects. Provide customer support, guidance, and training on reporting requirements, reporting standards, and QMR-related processes. Participate in quarterly reporting close activities while ensuring adherence to established controls and governance procedures.


All About You

 Experience working with operational reporting, performance metrics, business reporting, or reporting governance functions. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate issues, identify root causes, and recommend solutions. Experience reviewing and validating large data sets with exceptional attention to detail and accuracy. Demonstrated ability to build trusted stakeholder relationships and effectively manage cross-functional partnerships. Exposure to operational, transactional, customer, or financial data analysis. Ability to communicate complex findings and reporting issues clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Self-starter who thrives in deadline-driven environments and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously. Strong organizational skills and commitment to data quality and process discipline. Experience identifying and implementing process improvements within operational environments. FP&A, operational reporting, revenue operations, reporting governance, or business operations experience preferred. Continuous improvement or Six Sigma experience is a plus. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills with proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and the ability to quickly learn internal systems and reporting tools.


Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

Corporate Security Responsibility

 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;Report any suspected information security violation or breach, andComplete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.


In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in the US, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive base salary and may be eligible for an annual bonus or commissions depending on the role. The base salary offered may vary depending on multiple factors, including but not limited to location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Mastercard benefits for full time (and certain part time) employees generally include: insurance (including medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, disability, life insurance); flexible spending account and health savings account; paid leaves (including 16 weeks of new parent leave and up to 20 days of bereavement leave); 80 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time, 25 days of vacation time and 5 personal days, pro-rated based on date of hire; 10 annual paid U.S. observed holidays; 401k with a best-in-class company match; deferred compensation for eligible roles; fitness reimbursement or on-site fitness facilities; eligibility for tuition reimbursement; and many more. Mastercard benefits for interns generally include: 56 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time; jury duty leave; and on-site fitness facilities in some locations.

Purchase, New York: $79,000 - $126,000 USD

Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

People Tech is a close-knit team of 480+ dedicated, talented and diverse individuals. Experienced in taking models into production through the model risk compliance processCustomer first. You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You have experience in delivering libraries, platforms, or solution level code to existing products.
