Programme start date: September 2027

Please review all the graduate programme opportunities and make one application. 

Our award-winning graduate programme provides the ideal springboard for an exciting and meaningful career in global financial markets.  

As a graduate, you will join the Data and Analytics Division. The division is a dynamic, fast-paced environment where instant reaction and long-term vision are equally important.  

Our Data & Analytics is one of the world’s largest providers of financial data and infrastructure. With over 40,000 customers and 400,000 end users, spanning over approximately 190 markets, Data & Analytics partners with the global financial community supplying extensive, quality data, news, information and analytics that inform investment decisions. 

We are the #1 supplier of real-time market data to the global financial and investor community, carrying up to 176 billion market messages, from over 150,000 data sources every day.  

This dynamic business offers graduates opportunities in London to join Data and Analytics and be aligned to Analytics or Data and Feeds. To allow us to place you in the right area we will get to know your skills and interest and how they align with the needs of the business.

To be eligible you must be a graduate who has completed your studies in 2026 or a final year undergraduate or Master’s student and have completed all the requirements of your course before summer 2027.

Highlights of the Graduate Programme  

Progress through a 12-month development journey aiming to build foundational skills that are key for your future success Build your foundational knowledge of LSEG, Financial Markets and the business during your global induction Divisional-led inductions to immerse graduates into the business through team-led overviews and introductions Participate in group projects which are aligned to LSEG goals Meet in person with your cohort at ‘Ignite’, the programme mid-point skills offsite. Explore key knowledge areas and skills Access opportunities to earn industry recognized qualifications, including 5 study days during programme Connect with global early careers community and opportunities and contribute to wider society via CSR initiatives and volunteering opportunities  

Our graduates join us on a permanent basis, and from day one you will be aligned to Data and Analytics, which will allow you to develop within a secure framework.

 

What we are looking for: 

We are passionate about recruiting people who have a genuine curiosity for Data, who want to understand the full breadth of our organisation, how it fits together, how it functions – and are interested in playing a part of our development, as it grows and diversifies. 

You should have a demonstrable interest in financial markets, which you’ve built through your studies, work experience or extracurricular activities.  A curiosity for data and an ability to analyse information to draw conclusions and propose solutions.  Customer centric and product led mindsetIndividuals who are able to connect the dots and think strategically.   The environment we work in is fast paced, you’ll need to demonstrate focus, resilience and the flexibility to adapt to changing demands.  People who can collaborate with others, using their strong communication skills in the process.  Ideal candidates will have the rights to work in the US without restrictions for the duration of the graduate programme and join us on a permanent basis.   

You will stand out to us if you can demonstrate and recognise that what you achieve is equally important as how you achieve it. 

 

Application close: 28 November, however we recommend an early application because we consider candidates on a rolling basis. Due to the volume of applications, we might close the applications earlier, so we recommend an early application.  

Recruitment Process:

The first stage of the recruitment process involves making an application and submitting your resume. The next stage of the application process is an untimed Immersive Online Assessment. The assessment is designed to give you an insight into what it’s like to work at LSEG. The second stage is a video interview where you will answer a series of questions using a strength-based-interview style The final stage is a half day assessment centre which involves several different types of exercises – further information is provided at the point of invite.  

  

Please review all the graduate programme opportunities and make one application. If you make more than one application, we will review your first application only.

Please note, all our assessment centres are held virtually.

We believe in remunerating our people with a variety of attractive benefits such as:  

Emotional Wellbeing: Annual wellness allowance; Employee assistance programme  Physical Wellbeing: Private Medical Insurance; Optional dental Insurance; Gym membership & discounts  Financial Wellbeing: Life Insurance; Income protection; Pension  Other benefits: MyOffers: access to a range of retail discounts  

We believe hybrid working makes more possible and recognise difference as a good thing. We want to set everyone up to bring their best self to work. Everyone will spend time with colleagues in the office (3 days), but you’ll be trusted to work flexibly, in a way that delivers excellence.

Company Overview: ShotQuality is a leader in AI-driven sports data extraction, combining advanced computer vision and data science to transform video feeds into granular player tracking data and predictive insights. Originally built around basketball, our technology now scales across football, baseball, tennis, and more, powering multi-sport analytics at the enterprise level. Our proprietary models are trusted by industry leaders, enabling sportsbooks, prediction markets, trading firms, and media companies to make confident, data-driven decisions. With 20,000+ games processed across 15+ leagues, ShotQuality turns raw video into actionable intelligence. As we expand our AI and computer vision capabilities, we continue to push the boundaries of real-time sports analytics, delivering the infrastructure that powers the future of data in sports.We are a small team in New York where the work you ship shows up in live products within days, not months.
Job Overview: We are hiring a Quantitative Data Scientist to build the features and predictive models behind ShotQuality's real-time sports products. You will turn raw event, tracking, and market data into signals, test whether they improve on market prices, and get the ones that work into production. This role sits between our data science team and our live products, so you will see your models used in real time by market-facing clients during live games. The ideal candidate comes from a sports and trading background and is energized by fast-moving markets.

The Role is NOT for Candidates Who:Have only coursework or Kaggle-style modeling experienceAren't genuinely interested in prediction markets and the sports betting spacePrefer pure research with no path to productionNeed a rigid structure or a predictable 9-to-5 scheduleAre looking for a fully remote role

Nice to Have:Experience with pricing, market making, or market microstructure in sports betting or prediction marketsA track record of building and running your own models in live marketsExperience with sports data, player tracking data, or play-by-play dataExperience deploying models to real-time or low-latency systemsExposure to AWS or GCP, Docker, and workflow orchestration tools

rows.descriptionText:
Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

Team Description

As part of the US Card data science organization, this team focuses on the customer management business, and builds top tier machine learning solutions to meet the various needs such as real-time customer behavioral prediction and valuation forecasts. We work in a team environment, collaborating closely with cross-functioning teams including the business, engineers, analysts, data science/quants, products.

Role Description

In this role, you will:

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers loveLeverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual dataBuild machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementationFlex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals

The Ideal Candidate is:

Customer first. You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You know at the end of the day it’s about making the right decision for our customers. Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them. Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea. A leader. You challenge conventional thinking and work with stakeholders to identify and improve the status quo. You’re passionate about talent development for your own team and beyond. Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms. Statistically-minded. You’ve built models, validated them, and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series, and deep learning. A data guru. “Big data” doesn’t faze you. You have the skills to retrieve, combine, and analyze data from a variety of sources and structures. You know understanding the data is often the key to great data science.

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date:A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 6 years of experience performing data analyticsA Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) or an MBA with a quantitative concentration plus 4 years of experience performing data analyticsA PhD in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 1 year of experience performing data analyticsAt least 1 year of experience leveraging open source programming languages for large scale data analysisAt least 1 year of experience working with machine learningAt least 1 year of experience utilizing relational databases

(NASDAQ: NFE) is a global energy infrastructure company founded to help alleviate energy poverty and accelerate the world’s transition to reliable, affordable, clean energy. NFE owns and operates natural gas and liquefied natural gas (LNG) infrastructure and an integrated fleet of ships and logistics assets to rapidly deliver turnkey energy solutions worldwide.
ResponsibilitiesAbout the role New Fortress Energy (NFE) is seeking an Enterprise Applications & Master Data Analyst to serve as the first line of support for the company’s Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and Oracle Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) applications, as well as related enterprise systems including Kyriba. Reporting to the Director – Digital, Data & Enterprise Applications within IT, this role combines master data management, user ticket triage, and application support, partnering closely with Accounting, FP&A, Treasury, and Procurement to keep data consistent and processes running smoothly across a complex, multi-entity, publicly traded organization. The role is central to building in-house support capability and alignment between business groups and external support partners. The ideal candidate combines hands-on Oracle experience with strong data discipline and a service-oriented approach to problem solving.
What you will do:Manage master data change requests and additions across Chart of Accounts (COA), supplier, customer, legal entity, and related domains, including maintenance of COA templates.Serve as the first point of contact for all enterprise application user tickets, resolving & facilitating how-to, data, and simple issues in-house and escalating those that require the managed services partner, with clear documentation.Validate data across applications and perform monthly supplier, customer, and COA quality checks, leading clean-up of duplicate and inactive records to reduce reconciliation issues.Maintain system (EPM) dimensions and hierarchies aligned to the Oracle Fusion COA and manage Kyriba data and mappings to keep treasury data consistent with the ERP.Maintain & share reports in Oracle Transactional Business Intelligence (OTBI), BI Publisher, and EPM reporting tools, enabling the business to obtain Master Data & related reports without a partner ticket.Assist with the execution of regression test scripts for each Oracle quarterly update alongside the Oracle Administrator or managed services partner, documenting results and raising defects before changes reach production.Develop job aids and deliver new-user training in support of master data & Oracle-related processes.Support SOX compliance by following change control procedures, maintaining audit-ready documentation for master data changes, and supporting user access reviews.Track and report service metrics to the Enterprise Applications Manager, including ticket resolution, response times, and master data turnaround.Identify recurring issues and recommend process, configuration, or training improvements that reduce ticket volume.
What you bring:Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Accounting, Finance, or a related field.2–5 years of experience in enterprise application support, financial systems, or master data management.Experience maintaining master data such as Chart of Accounts, supplier, customer, or legal entity records.Hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, including General Ledger and supplier and customer data structures.Working knowledge of accounting fundamentals and core finance processes (procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, record-to-report).Strong Excel and data analysis skills with high attention to detail.Clear written and verbal communication skills and a customer-service mindset, with the ability to explain system issues to non-technical users.
Preferred:Experience with Oracle EPM Cloud (FCCS, EPBCS), including dimension and hierarchy maintenance.Experience with Kyriba or another treasury management system.Experience working in an IT service management/ticketing tool and alongside an external managed services partner.Exposure to SOX controls and IT general controls in a public company environment.Experience building reports in SQL, OTBI, and/or BI Publisher.Experience executing test scripts for Oracle quarterly releases.Oracle Cloud certification a plus.

The SevenRooms Data & Analytics team is the foundational data hub powering go-to-market, product, finance, and operational decisions across the In-Store business. We design and maintain the pipelines, models, and infrastructure that connect SevenRooms' systems with the broader DoorDash data ecosystem — and we're investing aggressively in making our datasets ready for both human and AI consumption. Within the team, our product-focused analytics work owns the funnels, personas, and feature-adoption insights that inform what products and features get built, how it's launched, and how it performs in the market.

About The Role

We're hiring a Data Analyst to be the data partner for our Product Management, Product Marketing, and executive teams at SevenRooms. You will own the building of data products, feature launch analytics, and the PLG instrumentation that connects product usage signals back into Salesforce, Gainsight, and our outbound motions.

You will report into the Manager, Data & Analytics on our Data & Analytics team in our SevenRooms organization.

Own product analytics end-to-end — funnels, adoption, retention, and ROI for every major feature launch on the SevenRooms platform.Build net new data products aimed at improving analytic and reporting capabilitiesPartner with Product Managers and Product Marketers on pre-launch hypotheses , beta testing results, post-launch measurement, and ongoing optimization.Design and ship PLG automations that translate product behavior into opportunity tagging, expansion signals, and CSM workflows.Apply GenAI and ML techniques — partnering with our GTM Engineer — to product analytics use cases like web-sourced feature adoption opportunities, transactions predictive modeling, and Add-On ICP scoring.Communicate closely in support of multiple PM’s with reporting and ad-hoc analysis

rows.title: Pricing Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
About We Sell Cellular
We Sell Cellular (WSC) is a leading provider in the secondary mobile device industry, specializing in the sourcing, processing, and distribution of pre-owned mobile devices. Through our operations, technology, and industry expertise, we help extend the lifecycle of mobile devices and support a more accessible and sustainable global device ecosystem.
WSC is part of the ITOCHU Group, providing the strength and resources of a global organization while maintaining an entrepreneurial and collaborative working environment. Our team is focused on operational excellence, continued growth, and building a business that delivers long-term value for our customers, employees, and partners.
Position Summary
We Sell Cellular buys used and refurbished mobile devices in volume from carriers, OEM programs, and trade-in channels, and resells them through wholesale and retail channels. Every purchase begins with a bid, and every bid is a pricing judgment: what the device will sell for, what it will cost to grade and refurbish, and what margin remains. This is a developing analytical role designed for an early-career professional who will build expertise in device pricing, purchasing, grading, refurbishment economics, and secondary-market dynamics. The Pricing Analyst will initially work closely with experienced Buyers and the Director of Sourcing and will take on greater ownership of pricing analysis and recommendations as their market knowledge and judgment develop.
This role reports to the Director of Sourcing and supports Buyers and cross-functional teams across Sales, Operations, Finance, and Engineering/Data by analyzing pricing, demand, product condition, and cost data to inform purchasing decisions, monitor margins, and improve pricing accuracy and reporting.
Key Responsibilities
Price Analysis (Purchasing)Market price tracking. Maintain a current view of buy-side and sell-side prices by model, storage, carrier, and grade: daily award prices, secondary-market and wholesale prices, and WSC's own realized sale pricesComparable analysis. Build like-for-like comparisons across sources and time so that a bid can be judged against what the same device actually cost and sold for recentlyMargin visibility. Track the spread between purchase price and realized sale price by category, including grading and refurbishment cost, and flag categories where margin is compressingData hygiene. Keep pricing data sets clean and consistent; flag data quality issues to Engineering / Data rather than working around them
Bid Price Decision SupportBid analysis support. Prepare analysis for lot and program bids, including expected resale value, margin, grade mix, and other key assumptions. Develop pricing recommendations in partnership with Buyers and the Director of Sourcing, taking on greater ownership as market knowledge and experience develop.Scenario analysis. Show how the recommendation changes under different resale prices, grade mixes, or demand conditions, so the Buyer can decide how aggressive to bePricing floor support. Maintain and prepare the data and analysis used by the Director of Sourcing and Buyers to establish and review pricing floors; monitor bids against established parameters and flag exceptions.Post-bid review. Compare bid assumptions with actual outcomes including realized price, grade mix and sell-through and feed the learning back into the next recommendation
Reporting & CommunicationDaily and weekly reporting. Contribute to the daily market report and weekly purchasing KPI review with price movements, margin trends, and notable bidsDocumentation. Record pricing decisions, assumptions, and outcomes so that the team's pricing knowledge accumulates rather than living in individual headsBuyer partnership. Work closely with Buyers on live bids to understand the information needed for purchasing decisions, respond quickly to analytical requests, and progressively build knowledge of WSC's bidding and purchasing process.
QualificationsMust-haveBachelor's degree in business, economics, finance, statistics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experienceStrong numerical judgment and comfort working with prices, margins, and volumes in spreadsheetsAdvanced spreadsheet skills (Google Sheets / Excel): lookups, pivots, scenario tablesClear written communication — able to turn analysis into a one-page recommendation with assumptions and risksMarket curiosity — genuine interest in mobile devices, secondary markets, and how prices moveAttention to detail and ownership of the accuracy of every number handed to a Buyer
PreferredInternship or early-career experience in pricing, purchasing, procurement, finance, merchandising, inventory, supply chain, business analytics, or a related area. Relevant internships, academic projects or equivalent practical experience will be considered. Familiarity with carrier and OEM trade-in programs, device grading, or refurbishment economicsExperience building dashboards or automated reports (Looker Studio, Sheets, or similar)Bilingual (Japanese or Spanish) a plus
Key CompetenciesNumerical judgment — knows when a number looks wrong and checks itDecision support mindset — every analysis ends in a recommendation a Buyer can act onAI adoption — Quick to leverage AI to work faster, with the discipline to double-check all dataMarket awareness — follows device launches, carrier moves, and secondary-market prices as a habitDocumentation discipline — assumptions and outcomes recorded so the team learnsCollaboration — works at the Buyer's pace and in the Buyer's languageLearning orientation — builds device, grading, and market knowledge steadily toward the Buyer track
Working ConditionsThis role is based in Edgewood, NY and requires regular on-site presence to work closely with the Purchasing team and Operations / Grading floor.
Salary & BenefitsCompensation: Base Salary Range: $55,000 - $60,000 annually. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, technical skills, and other job-related factors.Benefits: We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including medical insurance, a 401(k)-retirement plan with company match, paid time off (PTO), and paid company holidays.

rows.descriptionText:
Brief Description

About Us 

At FreshDirect, we are reinventing the grocery experience.

Since day one, our mission has been simple: bring the best, freshest food directly from the farm to people’s homes — faster, fresher, and smarter than anyone else.

We’re not just a food company. We’re a technology-powered, customer-obsessed team building one of the most innovative end-to-end food supply chains in the industry. From proprietary routing systems to our state-of-the-art fulfillment center, every part of our business is designed to deliver unmatched quality, convenience, and care.

We partner directly with farmers, fishermen, and artisans to source the highest quality ingredients — then use smart data, automation, and logistics to deliver them at peak freshness.

It’s grocery shopping reimagined — and we’re just getting started.

If you’re passionate about innovation, care deeply about what people eat, and want to help build the future of food, we’d love to meet you.

The Role

The Produce Category Analyst provides analytical and operational support to the Produce Merchandising team by transforming data into actionable business insights. This role partners with Category leadership and Buyers to improve sales, profitability, inventory productivity, forecasting, promotions, and supplier performance. The analyst plays a critical role in identifying opportunities through data while ensuring accurate reporting and execution across the produce and floral business. This position requires a highly analytical individual with strong business acumen who can work in a fast-paced, highly perishable environment.

What You’ll Do

 Prepare weekly Produce Market Reports including, USDA market news, Commodity pricing, Weather impacts, growing region transitions, Industry trend, Consumer purchasing behavior. Supports vendor performance reviews. Track vendor on time, in full metrics. Work with Merchant team to improve vendor performance and deliver best cost procurement strategies. Coordinate with Demand Planning team on forecast optimization, promotional forecasting, and new product introduction. Coordinate with Receiving and Ground Ops teams on inbound process optimization. Maintain target in-stock levels across multiple warehouse locations, while balancing inventory days on hand metrics. Collaborate with buyers on managing and reducing excess inventory on hand. Ensure all Supply Planning team members are cross trained in adjacent category processes. Analyze retail pricing and competitive positioning. Measure promotional effectiveness and ROI. Identify opportunities to improve gross margin without sacrificing sales. Manage key vendor accounts and support seasonal availability/crop planning with grower partners.

What You’ll Bring

Bachelor’s degree required or combination of experience + educationPrior experience working with advanced ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, etc Knowledge of SAP MM PP modules preferred Knowledge of Microsoft Office Experience managing procurement and vendor management across multiple departments 1+ year of experience in the Food / Grocery Retail / CPG industry, or related industryDemonstrated proficiency in inventory management, vendor negotiation and purchasing processes, with an understanding of their financial and operational impacts Strong analytical, organizational, decision-making Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilitiesAdept at working in a fast-paced and ever-changing work environment, with an appetite for continuous learning 

Our Values at FreshDirect

We live these values every day:

A Passion for our customers

Our customers are at the heart of everything we do. We listen, innovate, and act quickly to exceed expectations with every order and interaction.

One team, one mission

Everyone contributes & every role matters. We break silos, lift each other up, and share a relentless focus on delivering results. That way, we win together.

Delivering excellence, every time

We take pride in the quality of our food, service, and the experience we create. Our team goes above and beyond to earn trust and guarantee 100% freshness.

Act with integrity

We operate with honesty, respect, and accountability in how we treat our customers, teammates, and partners. We own our outcomes and always do what’s right, even when no one is watching.

Make fast, bold decisions

We challenge the status quo, embrace technology, and take smart risks to build a better future. At the same time, we stay true to our NYC roots and care for our community.

We love food. Yes, literally all of us.

What You’ll Love About Working Here

A fast-paced, innovative environment where ideas turn into actionDirect impact on how thousands of customers experience food every day

Salary

$68,000 – $75,000

Total Rewards & Benefits

 Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits PTO, Safe & Sick Time, and Paid Holidays Medical, Vision, Dental, and Voluntary Disability coverage 401(k) with employer match and Life Insurance State-of-the-art Bronx campus with on-site basketball court, cafeteria, and employee market Onsite FREE parking FREE employee shuttle bus service from nearby Subway station Training, leadership development, and tuition discount at local colleges 20% employee discount on FreshDirect online orders and Brooklyn wine store Minimum 50% employee discount at our onsite employee market Mobile phone discounts through partnerships with T-Mobile and Verizon Gym membership discounts through NYSC

Our Culture

We embrace an in-office culture, composed of individuals who thrive on the collaboration and energy that comes from working together in a shared space. We are looking for people who excel in this environment, where physical presence enhances connections and engagement. At FreshDirect, we've created an environment that thrives on teamwork, where associates can innovate, grow, and have successful careers. Many of our leaders have successfully come up through our ranks. Because of our team's extraordinary efforts, we are a leading innovator in the e-commerce and grocery industries.

Equal Opportunity

rows.descriptionText:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Analyst, Account Management

Overview

Mastercard's Community Institutions team is launching Team Catalyst, an innovative new account management model designed to redefine how we partner with our longer-tail customers.

As customer expectations evolve and operational complexity increases, we are transforming from a traditional one-to-one account management structure to an agile, team-based model that enables us to deliver deeper expertise, greater consistency, and broader access to Mastercard's capabilities.

Team Catalyst is an incubation team focused on building the future of customer partnership and engagement. We are challenging conventional approaches, creating scalable strategies, leveraging data and automation, and finding new ways to bring the full power of Mastercard to our customers.

This role offers a unique opportunity to help design, build, and scale a new model while directly influencing customer growth, experience, and operational excellence across a portfolio of Community Institution customers.

If you thrive in fast-paced environments, enjoy turning ideas into action, and are energized by solving complex problems, we'd love to meet you.

The Role

As an Analyst, Account Management on Team Catalyst, you will manage a portfolio of Community Institution customers and help deliver an exceptional Mastercard experience.

You will build customer relationships, identify opportunities for growth, support business initiatives, and partner across Mastercard to address customer needs. Working within a highly collaborative team environment, you will help customers maximize the value of their Mastercard partnership while contributing to Team Catalyst's innovative account management model.

Key Responsibilities

Manage: Serve as the primary relationship manager for a portfolio of Community Institution customers, building trusted partnerships and supporting customer success.

Grow: Identify opportunities to expand customer engagement and adoption of Mastercard products, services, and solutions.

Advise: Develop an understanding of customer priorities, challenges, and goals to provide relevant recommendations and support.

Execute: Lead day-to-day account management activities, including customer communications, action planning, issue resolution, and follow-up.

Collaborate: Partner with teams across Product, Services, Technology, Operations, Marketing, and Sales to deliver solutions and address customer needs.

Support: Assist with renewals, pricing requests, presentations, business cases, and other commercial activities.

Educate: Deliver customer engagement activities including webinars, office hours, portfolio communications, and customer education programs.

Improve: Contribute ideas and process improvements that enhance customer experience, operational efficiency, and team performance.

All About You

 Relationship builder with a passion for customer success. Strong communicator who can build credibility with customers and internal stakeholders. Curious and proactive problem solver. Organized and able to manage multiple priorities effectively. Analytical mindset with the ability to turn insights into action. Collaborative team player who thrives in a fast-paced environment. Growth-oriented with a willingness to learn and take on new challenges. Adaptable, resourceful, and comfortable navigating change.


Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

Corporate Security Responsibility

 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;Report any suspected information security violation or breach, andComplete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Job Description

At Capital One, we believe great products begin with a deep understanding of our customers. From our earliest days, we pioneered the use of predictive modeling to individually personalize credit card offers, turning the entire industry on its head. As we’ve grown bigger, we’ve found more and more ways to use technology and face-to-face conversations to understand the human problems associated with money and finances.

About The Team

In the Retail Bank, we’ve combined this human-centered approach with our heritage of data-driven decision making to design, build, and test our way to truly enabling financial experiences. We’ve challenged ourselves to spend less time planning, more time doing, and, above all else, to see the world through the eyes of our customers as they work to understand and manage their money.

Are you passionate about improving the way people interact with their money? Are you driven by the delight you bring to customers? Do you keep asking “why” until you hit the root? It’s common to fall in love with solutions, but have you ever fallen in love with the problem? Do you have an opinion on whether shipping is more important than perfection? Do you have a healthy dose of skepticism for the impossible? If you’re nodding your head, then we want you!

As a Product Manager focusing on our Account Opening products, you’ll be joining a passionate team of product managers, designers, engineers, data scientists, and analysts working to redefine how millions of customers interact with their money. You might work on developing the next generation of our UI. You might solve the gnarly problems presented by the introduction of AI in finance management. You might reimagine the digital tools in comparing or bundling our financial products in the application. You might protect our customers from the bad guys. You might build solutions to solve problems we haven’t even discovered yet. One thing is for sure: you will dream and you will ship.

On any given day in the Bank you’ll be:

Empowered. Part of a team responsible for defining the central data strategy for Retail Bank. Delivering data platforms that will drive how we embrace emerging technologies and power our business agenda by enabling real-time, intelligent decisions and creating a competitive advantage for the Bank and Capital OneLearning constantly. Work deeply with customers, associates, designers, technologists and data scientists to build cutting edge solutionsInnovating relentlessly. Pushing big change by asking bold questions; starting small, testing, and learning your way to something dramatically betterSharing openly. Telling stories that change the way people think about building products and solving problems, and that illustrate the power of what software can do to make them even betterConnecting creatively. Jumpstarting a self-supporting community by sowing the right seeds, building the right tools, integrating the right off-the-shelf products and just plain elbow greaseSucceeding strategically. Solving the right problem and holding on the wrong one. 

In this role, you’ll learn the essentials of being a product manager, and we’ll invest in you to grow in four key areas:

Human Centered You’ll collaborate with tech teams to build comprehensive acceptance criteria, identifying and elevating any need for additional research to define future feature designYou'll breakdown business epics into features and further into user stories, driving your team towards lowest effort or Minimal Viable Product (MVP) for a valid feature test

Business Focused Demonstrating a growth mindset, you’ll effectively use hypothesis-driven assessment of data to ensure your product or feature delivers on real business needsYou’ll own and prioritize feature development roadmaps, ensuring all necessary processes and procedures are followed to manage risk

Technology Driven You’ll work autonomously in an agile environment, to conduct research and develop features that utilize new and evolving technology You’ll collaborate with designers, technologists, data scientists and subject-matter experts to build cutting edge solutions to help customersYou’ll deliver well-managed product platforms for customers by seeking to understand technology trends and architecture strategy

Transformational Leadership By actively participating in horizontal forums, you’ll harness a network of trusted relationships among tech teams, designers, key internal stakeholders and partner teamsYou’ll articulate a succinct product roadmap to deliver business value and share with with stakeholders, elevating your team’s results and becoming a product matter expert

Bachelor’s Degree or military experienceAt least 2 years of experience working in Product Management

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date:A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Information Systems or a related quantitative field)A Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Information Systems or a related quantitative field) or an MBA with a quantitative concentrationExperience translating business strategy and analysis into consumer facing digital products

Facilitates the site batch disposition process, participates in functional batch disposition meetings and follows up on any resulting actions with key stakeholders.

Drives batch impacting events towards closure to facilitate timely disposition of all relevant internal and external batches.

Supports other duties as required by supervisor/department management.

Job Summary

As an LP Analyst, you will help make sure investor records for private funds are accurate. You will support the daily, monthly, and quarterly checks of limited partner (LP) activity, including capital calls, distributions, and capital account statements. Compare LP capital account data from fund administrators and general partners against our internal records, and flag differences.Support daily and monthly reconciliation of capital calls, distributions, and capital account balances.Investigate differences in our reconciliation system. How private equity, venture, and other limited partnership funds work, and how their data is reconciled.How to solve LP and fund discrepancies using Clearwater’s resources and your team’s expertise.How Clearwater’s mission (aggregate, reconcile, report) applies to LP and fund data.Our reconciliation tools and reports, from routine tasks to more complex ones.Completion of new hire certifications, then intermediate-level training.

How You Will Grow

Year one is about learning. What We’re Looking For

The Global Merchant and Network Services (GMNS) Product team is at the heart of American Express and is a core function within the GMNS business unit. Each year, we power billions of transactions through our global payments network, serving Issuing & Acquiring partners in more than 170 markets worldwide. We grow revenue by driving strategic, multi-year initiatives to deliver differentiated value to our merchants, partners, and customers.

Our solutions deliver value to American Express’ Card Members, acquirers, and partners across the globe through both proprietary and third-party capabilities, facilitating secure and seamless transactions between issuers, acquirers, and merchants. Our goal is to enable Card Members to pay however and wherever they choose. We deliver on this by setting the vision and strategy for the Network, anchoring our priorities to enterprise objectives, and developing and managing a portfolio of products. We lead the end-to-end process, manage the partner lifecycle, and drive industry intelligence and engagement through key governing bodies.

The Agentic Commerce Solutions team is responsible for defining and enabling the future of Agentic Commerce across the Amex Global Network. As AI-driven agents, digital wallets, and automated commerce experiences evolve, we are shaping how the Network supports secure, scalable, and commercially compelling agent-based transactions. Our focus spans tokenization, digital identity, and emerging network capabilities required to power next-generation commerce.

The Senior Associate, Product Management will support the development and delivery of Agentic Commerce capabilities. Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology.

We believe our portfolio of businesses and investments in growth and transformation will result in a company with the scale, brand, capabilities, talent, and values to succeed as the digital revolution transforms our society and our industry.

Do you dream of well-designed and intuitive products and customer experiences? Do you want to be the one who introduces change to help tens of millions of customers make smarter financial choices? Do you want to change the way people manage their money? If you answered yes to all of these questions, then product management at Capital One may be a fit for you

In this role, you’ll learn the essentials of being a product manager, and we’ll invest in you to grow in four key areas:

Human Centered You’ll collaborate with tech teams to build comprehensive acceptance criteria, identifying and elevating any need for additional research to define future feature designYou'll breakdown business epics into features and further into user stories, driving your team towards lowest effort or Minimal Viable Product (MVP) for a valid feature test

Business Focused Demonstrating a growth mindset, you’ll effectively use hypothesis-driven assessment of data to ensure your product or feature delivers on real business needsYou’ll own and prioritize feature development roadmaps, ensuring all necessary processes and procedures are followed to manage risk

Transformational Leadership By actively participating in horizontal forums, you’ll harness a network of trusted relationships among tech teams, designers, key internal stakeholders and partner teamsYou’ll articulate a succinct product roadmap to deliver business value and share with with stakeholders, elevating your team’s results and becoming a product matter expert

Intellectually Curious. You ask why, you explore, you're not afraid to blurt out your crazy idea or follow an email chain for weeks to find someone with an answer. Job Title: IT Data Analyst III
Location: Corning, NY - 100% onsite
Duration: 12 Months

Schedule: Mon - Fri 8:00 am - 5:00 pm

Position Purpose
Client is consolidating 29 ERP platforms around the world to unite the organization under one common ERP solution, SAP S/4HANA Private. The Data Validation & Analytics Expert supports this transformation by validating that the correct data is transferred during ERP deployments for Req to Pay (RTP) and by improving how deployment data is analyzed, interpreted, and reported.
This role works closely with the ERP transformation data team, business leads, and key stakeholders to verify data accuracy, completeness, and alignment across deployment activities. The role combines hands-on data validation, profiling, cleansing, and analysis with the development of dashboards, reporting, and practical AI-enabled approaches that improve deployment readiness and business decision-making.

Key Responsibilities
Validate that RTP data is accurately transferred during ERP deployment activities
Partner with the ERP transformation data team, business leads, and users to confirm data requirements, validation criteria, priorities, and status updates
Collect data from primary and secondary sources and maintain relevant databases, files, and data systems that support validation and analysis activities
Develop and implement data collection processes, validation methods, and other strategies that improve data quality, consistency, and efficiency
Filter, cleanse, and review data using reports, reconciliations, and performance indicators to identify issues and improve reliability
Perform data profiling to identify, investigate, and understand anomalies, gaps, inconsistencies, and data transfer risks
Mine and analyze large data sets to draw valid conclusions and support deployment and business decision-making
Use statistical and analytical tools to interpret data sets, with attention to trends, patterns, and insights that may support diagnostic or predictive analytics efforts
Develop dashboards, graphs, visualizations, exception reporting, and reconciliation tools that enable quicker and more effective data analysis
Apply AI-enabled approaches, where appropriate, to support faster issue identification, pattern detection, and insight generation across validation activities
Translate validation and analytical findings into clear updates, recommendations, and reporting for management and stakeholders
Proactively identify trends, risks, and business improvement opportunities and make recommendations to stakeholders
Contribute to stronger data quality, lower deployment risk, and more reliable RTP process outcomes across the ERP transformation

Required Qualifications
Education: Bachelor's degree in IT, Science, or Business
5 year's experience in the following;
Experience in data validation, data analysis, ERP data support, or transformation-related roles
Strong ability to analyze complex data and identify inconsistencies, anomalies, gaps, and quality issues
Experience supporting ERP deployments, data migration, or system implementation activities
Understanding of RTP processes and related business data
Experience developing dashboards, reports, validation tools, or analytical methods to improve data review and decision-making
Experience working with data profiling, cleansing, reconciliation, and trend analysis
Ability to work effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders, and management
Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and follow-through
Strong written and verbal communication skills

Preferred Qualifications
Experience with SAP S/4HANA or similar ERP platforms
Experience supporting RTP data validation, migration, or deployment readiness activities
Familiarity with enterprise data quality, statistical analysis, reconciliation, or validation methods
Experience using AI, automation, or advanced analytics to improve data analysis processes (Databricks)
Experience working in cross-functional global transformation programs

Why This Role Matters
This role helps protect deployment quality by ensuring RTP data is transferred accurately and reliably during ERP go-lives while improving how quickly and effectively deployment data can be analyzed and used. Success in this role will reduce risk, improve business confidence in deployment data, and support a smoother, more insight-driven transition to Client common SAP S/4HANA platform.

Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Analyst, Operational Reporting & Metrics

The Global Statistics / Quarterly Mastercard Reporting (QMR) group is responsible for the collection, validation, analysis, and reporting of Mastercard’s operational performance metrics. The team plays a critical role in ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and timeliness of quarterly reported data while supporting business partners through data-driven insights, operational reporting, and reporting governance.

As a core member of the QMR team, you will participate in all quarterly reporting activities, partner closely with internal and external stakeholders, and help ensure the completeness and accuracy of customer-reported operational data. This highly visible role requires strong analytical capabilities, attention to detail, stakeholder management skills, and the ability to understand the downstream impact of reporting on operational metrics, financial reporting, and billing processes.

Role

 Support the collection, review, validation, and reporting of quarterly operational data submissions. Analyze customer-reported operational and transaction data to identify discrepancies, anomalies, trends, and potential revenue leakage. Investigate reporting variances and collaborate with customers and internal stakeholders to resolve issues within required timelines. Develop trusted relationships with internal and external stakeholders to support accurate and timely reporting submissions. Understand and assess the downstream impact of reporting activities on billing, operational metrics, and business reporting. Perform root cause analysis on reporting exceptions and recommend corrective actions. Deliver clear and actionable reporting insights to support operational and management discussions. Support quarterly QMR business updates and reporting reviews with regional finance and business partners. Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for inquiries, investigations, and issue resolution. Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes, controls, and operational efficiencies. Contribute to system enhancement initiatives, user acceptance testing, and process improvement projects. Provide customer support, guidance, and training on reporting requirements, reporting standards, and QMR-related processes. Participate in quarterly reporting close activities while ensuring adherence to established controls and governance procedures.


All About You

 Experience working with operational reporting, performance metrics, business reporting, or reporting governance functions. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate issues, identify root causes, and recommend solutions. Experience reviewing and validating large data sets with exceptional attention to detail and accuracy. Demonstrated ability to build trusted stakeholder relationships and effectively manage cross-functional partnerships. Exposure to operational, transactional, customer, or financial data analysis. Ability to communicate complex findings and reporting issues clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Self-starter who thrives in deadline-driven environments and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously. Strong organizational skills and commitment to data quality and process discipline. Experience identifying and implementing process improvements within operational environments. FP&A, operational reporting, revenue operations, reporting governance, or business operations experience preferred. Continuous improvement or Six Sigma experience is a plus. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills with proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and the ability to quickly learn internal systems and reporting tools.


Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

Corporate Security Responsibility

 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;Report any suspected information security violation or breach, andComplete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.


In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in the US, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive base salary and may be eligible for an annual bonus or commissions depending on the role. Mastercard benefits for interns generally include: 56 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time; jury duty leave; and on-site fitness facilities in some locations.

A Career with Point72's Market Intelligence Team

On our proprietary research team—Market Intelligence—you’ll partner with our investment professionals and Compliance team to work with alternative data to uncover insights about companies, industries, and the broader economy through deep fundamental research and applying data science and engineering techniques. You’ll work alongside a talented team with diverse skills, backgrounds, and perspectives. Our sector data analysts, data scientists, data managers, and engineers work together to build compliant research products that are incorporated into the research process of our investment professionals. We look for other bright, motivated, and collaborative people to join our team and grow with us—a majority of the leaders in our group were promoted from within.

The Data Strategy team within Market Intelligence takes a research-oriented and strategic approach to discovering new avenues of insight, manages the inflow of compliant data into our team’s process, and is responsible for managing effective and efficient data and research partnerships on behalf of the firm.

What You’ll Do

As a Data Sourcing and Strategy Operations analyst, you will collaborate with our team, colleagues across the firm, and external vendors to provide essential support required to source data and conduct research that may ultimately be used by our investment teams. Specifically, you will:

Assist the Data Sourcing and Strategy team in managing relationships with data and research providers, including facilitating requested service changes, ensuring internal use of services follows the firm’s contracts and obligations, and staying current on the evolving data marketHelp manage the team’s operations workflow by working closely with Legal, Compliance, Finance, and other internal stakeholdersMaintain and manage the Data Sourcing and Strategy knowledgebase by developing an understanding of system architectureDevelop strong internal relationships by assisting with questions and requests from investment teams, working closely with Data Compliance, and supporting new hire on-boardingCoordinate new content provider on-boarding and contract/subscription renewal processes, working with investment teams to assess content requirements, negotiating business terms, and coordinating approvals

What’s Required

2+ years of professional experienceCuriosity about AI and emerging technologies and their application to data and investment researchExcellent attention to detail, as well as organizational and project management skillsStrong verbal and written communication skillsProficiency in Microsoft ExcelSuperb business intuition and a solution-oriented, methodical approach to problem-solvingAbility to collaborate and build relationships across multiple business units within the firmCommitment to the highest ethical standards

What Success Looks Like

Integrity – You demonstrate 100% commitment to the highest ethical standardsOwnership – You take charge of your work, uphold your commitments, and always do your bestHumility – You welcome and are receptive to feedback and learn from past mistakesAdaptability – You can triage business needs and context switch quickly and efficientlyCommerciality – You focus on what matters most, ask questions when needed, and are cognizant about not wasting your time or that of othersLeadership Potential – You elevate the room through your work ethic, domain knowledge, work product, and solution orientated attitude

We Take Care of our People

We invest in our people, their careers, their health, and their well-being. When you work here, we provide:

Job Title: IT Data Analyst III
Location: Corning, NY - 100% onsite
Duration: 12 Months

Schedule: Mon - Fri 8:00 am - 5:00 pm

Position Purpose
Client is consolidating 29 ERP platforms around the world to unite the organization under one common ERP solution, SAP S/4HANA Private. The Data Validation & Analytics Expert supports this transformation by validating that the correct data is transferred during ERP deployments for Req to Pay (RTP) and by improving how deployment data is analyzed, interpreted, and reported.
This role works closely with the ERP transformation data team, business leads, and key stakeholders to verify data accuracy, completeness, and alignment across deployment activities. The role combines hands-on data validation, profiling, cleansing, and analysis with the development of dashboards, reporting, and practical AI-enabled approaches that improve deployment readiness and business decision-making.

Key Responsibilities
Validate that RTP data is accurately transferred during ERP deployment activities
Partner with the ERP transformation data team, business leads, and users to confirm data requirements, validation criteria, priorities, and status updates
Collect data from primary and secondary sources and maintain relevant databases, files, and data systems that support validation and analysis activities
Develop and implement data collection processes, validation methods, and other strategies that improve data quality, consistency, and efficiency
Filter, cleanse, and review data using reports, reconciliations, and performance indicators to identify issues and improve reliability
Perform data profiling to identify, investigate, and understand anomalies, gaps, inconsistencies, and data transfer risks
Mine and analyze large data sets to draw valid conclusions and support deployment and business decision-making
Use statistical and analytical tools to interpret data sets, with attention to trends, patterns, and insights that may support diagnostic or predictive analytics efforts
Develop dashboards, graphs, visualizations, exception reporting, and reconciliation tools that enable quicker and more effective data analysis
Apply AI-enabled approaches, where appropriate, to support faster issue identification, pattern detection, and insight generation across validation activities
Translate validation and analytical findings into clear updates, recommendations, and reporting for management and stakeholders
Proactively identify trends, risks, and business improvement opportunities and make recommendations to stakeholders
Contribute to stronger data quality, lower deployment risk, and more reliable RTP process outcomes across the ERP transformation

Required Qualifications
Education: Bachelor's degree in IT, Science, or Business
5 year's experience in the following;
Experience in data validation, data analysis, ERP data support, or transformation-related roles
Strong ability to analyze complex data and identify inconsistencies, anomalies, gaps, and quality issues
Experience supporting ERP deployments, data migration, or system implementation activities
Understanding of RTP processes and related business data
Experience developing dashboards, reports, validation tools, or analytical methods to improve data review and decision-making
Experience working with data profiling, cleansing, reconciliation, and trend analysis
Ability to work effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders, and management
Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and follow-through
Strong written and verbal communication skills

Preferred Qualifications
Experience with SAP S/4HANA or similar ERP platforms
Experience supporting RTP data validation, migration, or deployment readiness activities
Familiarity with enterprise data quality, statistical analysis, reconciliation, or validation methods
Experience using AI, automation, or advanced analytics to improve data analysis processes (Databricks)
Experience working in cross-functional global transformation programs

Why This Role Matters
This role helps protect deployment quality by ensuring RTP data is transferred accurately and reliably during ERP go-lives while improving how quickly and effectively deployment data can be analyzed and used. Success in this role will reduce risk, improve business confidence in deployment data, and support a smoother, more insight-driven transition to Client common SAP S/4HANA platform.

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Overview

 JOB DESCRIPTION 

The Jefferies Equity Research Data Strategy Team is a global team embedded within the Equity Research department, responsible for shaping and executing the department's data and AI strategy. On the data side, the team helps incorporate fundamental and alternative datasets into Analyst research reports, combining analysts’ domain expertise with our team’s technical skills to produce thoughtful, defensible, and actionable analysis of real-world behavior at scale. On the AI side, our team is responsible for building internal generative AI tooling along with evaluating third-party AI models and tools to enhance our analysts’ work. We help integrate AI capabilities into analysts’ daily workflows and ensure that first- and third-party datasets are fully AI-accessible to them. Statistics, data engineering, data science, and AI are cornerstones of our work.

As a Data Scientist at Jefferies, your focus will be to support the Research Analysts and the Data Strategy Team’s broader platform. The candidate will use technical and financial skills to implement ideas and requests from the Research Analysts, while also building and maintaining relationships with internal and external stakeholders, working in collaboration with the rest of the Global Data Strategy Team.

Key Responsibilities

 Query, transform, analyze, and combine large datasets in support of solving problems and implementing research ideas across sectors and data categories, occasionally developing statistical models to predict outcomes  Enhance our platform through the creation and maintenance of tools, AI agents, MCP servers, and processes that streamline, scale, and standardize our ability to evaluate, clean, analyze, and disseminate data  Contribute to the data centralization process, ensuring all first- and third-party data assets are AI-accessible and meet quality, lineage, and governance standards  Present highly technical methods to non-technical stakeholders and translate open-ended questions into data-driven insights  Maintain and build relationships with key internal and external stakeholders, including research teams, third-party data vendors, management, and possibly buy-side clients 

Qualifications

Required

 Transferable experience on the sell-side or buy-side, in data science, data research, or similar function  STEM degree with preference for Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, Quantitative Finance, and related disciplines  Strong proficiency with Python, intermediate or better proficiency with SQL and/or Apache Spark  Experience analyzing and visualizing large datasets  Experience with AI-assisted development (Claude Code, GitHub CoPilot, Cursor, etc.)  Familiarity with LLMs, LangChain, vector databases, and RAG pipelines  Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders 

Preferred

 Demonstrated interest in fundamental equity research and financial modelling  Experience with Databricks or Snowflake and cloud platforms such as AWS  Experience with Atlassian project management tools (JIRA, Confluence, Bitbucket)  Experience with knowledge graphs

AIG is reimagining the way we help customers manage risk. Join us as an Analyst in the Underwriting department to play your part in that transformation with opportunities to learn and grow your skills and experience as a valued member of the team.

About Us

At AIG, helping organizations and people discover new potential is our purpose. As a global risk leader, we do this for our clients every day. Through our deep expertise in their industries and our innovative solutions that help them smartly manage risk, we enable their growth in ways they never thought possible.

But we also do the same thing for our colleagues, because we know our people are our greatest strength – the source of every insight, every idea and every innovation. When we're working as one team to do what's right for our colleagues and our communities, we can achieve excellence together. We encourage colleagues to give back to the causes they care most about, supporting these efforts through our Volunteer Time Off and Matching Grants Programs.

Make your mark in Underwriting

AIG’s underwriting teams help businesses navigate complex and evolving risks by delivering innovative insurance and risk management solutions across a broad range of industries and exposures. Our underwriters work closely with brokers, clients, and internal partners to evaluate risk, analyze financial and exposure information, and develop tailored solutions that meet clients’ unique needs.

As an Underwriter, you will build expertise in risk assessment, financial analysis, and relationship management while gaining exposure to the commercial insurance industry. You will collaborate with experienced underwriting professionals and cross-functional partners, including claims, risk engineering, actuarial, and analytics teams, to make informed, data-driven decisions and help solve complex business challenges.

Opportunities are available across several underwriting businesses, including Financial Lines, Retail Property, Retail Casualty, Lexington Property, Lexington Casualty, Alternative Channels, Captive Solutions and Warranty. Each area provides the opportunity to develop specialized underwriting knowledge while building a strong foundation for a career in commercial insurance.

How You Will Make An Impact

When you join AIG, you will be part of a connected cohort community of early career talent participating in a program that equips you with learning experiences and skills needed to launch your career. From day one, you will develop your knowledge and understanding of AIG and the insurance industry and learn new skills through meaningful on-the-job experiences and instructor-led masterclasses. Through exposure to senior leaders, mentoring circles, networking and volunteering, you will build connections with colleagues across the organization. Collectively, these different experiences are designed to enable you to make an impact and build a rewarding and successful career.  

Responsibilities


Supporting the evaluation and analysis of risks to help determine appropriate coverage, terms, and pricing. Reviewing underwriting submissions, financial information, loss history, exposure data, and other relevant materials. Building relationships and communicating with brokers, clients, and internal business partners. Assisting with the preparation of quotes, proposals, renewals, and other underwriting documentation. Learning to apply underwriting guidelines, appetite, and risk selection strategies. Partnering with experienced underwriters and cross-functional teams such as Claims, Actuarial, Risk Engineering, and Analytics. Using data and analytical tools to support underwriting decisions. Developing knowledge of AIG’s products, industry trends, market conditions, and the specific business area in which they’re placed. Supporting portfolio management and helping identify opportunities for profitable growth. 

Minimum Qualifications

Our Early Careers programs are designed for students and recent graduates who are beginning their professional careers, generally within one year of completing their degree.

Education Requirements


Bachelor’s or Master’s degree to be received no later than June 2027 (unofficial transcript required upon application). 

Program Requirements


Available to start the Program on July 26, 2027. Analyst positions are in-person opportunities, requiring employees to work in the office at least four days per week. 

Core Qualifications


Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively in a professional environment. Demonstrated analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills, with strong attention to detail. Ability to collaborate effectively, manage multiple priorities, and adapt in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment. 

Preferred Qualifications


Demonstrated outstanding academic and extracurricular achievement. Excelled in previous work experience.

Application Deadline

Applications will be accepted through October 31, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. ET. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, and we encourage candidates to apply early. We reserve the right to close this posting prior to the application deadline based on application volume.

For applicants in Colorado, Jersey City, and New York City the base salary pay range for this position is $62,550 - $83,400.

At AIG, we value in-person collaboration as a vital part of our culture, which is why we ask our team members to be primarily in the office. This approach helps us work together effectively and create a supportive, connected environment for our team and clients alike.

Enjoy Benefits That Take Care Of What Matters

At AIG, our people are our greatest asset. We know how important it is to protect and invest in what’s most important to you. That is why we created our Total Rewards Program, a comprehensive benefits package that extends beyond time spent at work to offer benefits focused on your health, wellbeing and financial security—as well as your professional development—to bring peace of mind to you and your family.

Reimagining insurance to make a bigger difference to the world

American International Group, Inc. (AIG) is a global leader in commercial and personal insurance solutions; we are one of the world’s most far-reaching property casualty networks. It is an exciting time to join us — across our operations, we are thinking in new and innovative ways to deliver ever-better solutions to our customers. At AIG, you can go further to support individuals, businesses, and communities, helping them to manage risk, respond to times of uncertainty and discover new potential. We invest in our largest asset, our people, through continuous learning and development, in a culture that celebrates everyone for who they are and what they want to become.

Welcome to a culture of inclusion

We’re committed to creating a culture that truly respects and celebrates each other’s talents, backgrounds, cultures, opinions and goals. We foster a culture of inclusion and belonging through learning, cultural awareness activities and Employee Resource Groups (ERGs). With global chapters, ERGs are a cornerstone for our culture of inclusion. The talent of our people is one of AIG’s greatest assets, and we are honored that our drive for positive change has been recognized by numerous recent awards and accreditations.

AIG provides equal opportunity to all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, age, gender, gender expression, national origin, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected categories.

AIG is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to job applicants and employees with disabilities. If you believe you need a reasonable accommodation, please send an email to candidatecare@aig.com.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable law.
