rows.title: Music Research & Creative Development Internship
rows.descriptionText:
Music Research & Creative Development Intern
Surya Sound Temple | Bushwick, Brooklyn, NY
Part-Time Internship | Music, Recording, World Cultures & Wellness
About Surya Sound Temple
Surya Sound Temple is a private music sanctuary in Bushwick, Brooklyn, founded around a deep commitment to music, discipline, craftsmanship, cultural exploration, and consciousness.
Our work brings together traditional world music, modern recording technology, original instrument design, creative experimentation, and wellness practices. We are building something that extends beyond a conventional recording studio: an interconnected ecosystem of instruments, educational programs, products, and immersive experiences.
Our projects include Art of Tabla, Khartal, Electrobones, Speedbag Drummer, and Flakeb00k, alongside recording and production services, sound-based experiences, and classes exploring rhythm, movement, and meditation.
The Opportunity
We are looking for a curious, thoughtful, and musically passionate intern who wants to understand not only what Surya Sound Temple is today, but what it could become in the future.
This position goes beyond routine studio assistance. We want someone who will research our history, explore our projects, understand our founder’s vision, and help identify meaningful opportunities for future growth.
The ideal candidate is fascinated by world music, acoustic instruments, recording technology, sound and wellness, and the relationship between music and human experience.
We are looking for someone who can connect the dots, think independently, and contribute ideas that help shape the next chapter of Surya Sound Temple.
Responsibilities
* Research the history, philosophy, and evolution of Surya Sound Temple and its projects.* Study our websites, social media, products, classes, and creative work to develop a comprehensive understanding of our ecosystem.* Explore world music traditions, percussion instruments, recording techniques, and emerging approaches to sound and wellness.* Research musicians, artists, cultural practitioners, and potential collaborators who align with our vision.* Identify opportunities to grow our classes, recording services, original products, and creative experiences.* Assist with documenting studio sessions, instruments, research, and creative processes.* Contribute ideas for future projects, collaborations, educational programs, and media content.* Work directly with the founder to translate research and creative thinking into practical initiatives.
Who We’re Looking For
* A genuine passion for world music, percussion, recording, and sound.* An interest in meditation, wellness, contemplative practices, or the relationship between sound and consciousness.* Curiosity about music across cultures and traditions.* Strong research, communication, and critical-thinking skills.* An independent thinker who asks questions and sees possibilities.* Someone willing to study our existing work before proposing what comes next.* A collaborative, dependable person who respects the creative environment.
Musicians, music technology students, audio enthusiasts, researchers, and interdisciplinary creatives are encouraged to apply.
Experience with Pro Tools, audio recording, photography, videography, writing, or digital research is a plus.
What You’ll Gain
* Firsthand experience inside an independent music sanctuary.* Direct collaboration with the founder on creative and strategic projects.* Exposure to original instrument development, recording, music education, and experimental sound practices.* Opportunities to develop research, production, and creative project skills.* Portfolio-building opportunities and potential professional references based on your contributions.
How to Apply
We want to hear from people who take the time to understand what we do.
Before applying, follow us on Instagram: @suryasoundtemple and research our projects and history.
Please send us:
* A brief introduction and résumé, if available.* Your musical background and areas of interest.* Links to any relevant work, research, recordings, or creative projects.* A short response to this question:
After researching Surya Sound Temple, what do you believe our larger vision could become, and what would you contribute to help us get there?
We value original thought, genuine curiosity, and a meaningful connection to our work over a generic application.
We’re not simply looking for someone who wants studio experience. We’re looking for someone who sees the bigger picture and wants to help build it.

About Fountain House

For almost 80 years, Fountain House has been developing the clubhouse model, an intentionally designed community where people with serious mental illness support each other toward recovery and the achievement of personal, social, and employment & educational goals. This very intentional strengths-based and relationship-oriented culture requires staff who are fiercely optimistic, professionally curious, flexible, and resilient communitarians. You must be willing to take creative risks and to persist in finding solutions, maintaining hope in the face of all the challenges our resident members experience. We are looking for people who are energized by helping others and being part of a genuine and dynamic community.

Become a Social Practitioner and join a collaborative and inspiring movement to support individuals (Members) with serious mental illness (SMI). Fountain House is more than just an organization; it’s a community dedicated to fostering growth, collaboration and positive impact.

The Social Practitioner works to help the Members live their lives to the fullest and develop independent living skills and social connections. We use community as our tool to do this based in our Clubhouse environment.

This position requires interest in community, creativity, and flexibility. There will be no typical day as a Social Practitioner, but if you could see yourself fostering relationships and connections to community by making lunch, sharing a common interest over coffee, advocating at a social service provider, or helping one of your members stay in independent or supported housing in in the community, then this could be the position for you.

The Jefferies Equity Research Data Strategy Team is a global team embedded within the Equity Research department, responsible for shaping and executing the department's data and AI strategy. On the AI side, our team is responsible for building internal generative AI tooling along with evaluating third-party AI models and tools to enhance our analysts’ work. We help integrate AI capabilities into analysts’ daily workflows and ensure that first- and third-party datasets are fully AI-accessible to them. Statistics, data engineering, data science, and AI are cornerstones of our work.

As a Data Scientist at Jefferies, your focus will be to support the Research Analysts and the Data Strategy Team’s broader platform. The candidate will use technical and financial skills to implement ideas and requests from the Research Analysts, while also building and maintaining relationships with internal and external stakeholders, working in collaboration with the rest of the Global Data Strategy Team.

 Query, transform, analyze, and combine large datasets in support of solving problems and implementing research ideas across sectors and data categories, occasionally developing statistical models to predict outcomes  Enhance our platform through the creation and maintenance of tools, AI agents, MCP servers, and processes that streamline, scale, and standardize our ability to evaluate, clean, analyze, and disseminate data  Contribute to the data centralization process, ensuring all first- and third-party data assets are AI-accessible and meet quality, lineage, and governance standards  Present highly technical methods to non-technical stakeholders and translate open-ended questions into data-driven insights  Maintain and build relationships with key internal and external stakeholders, including research teams, third-party data vendors, management, and possibly buy-side clients 

Qualifications

Required

 Transferable experience on the sell-side or buy-side, in data science, data research, or similar function  STEM degree with preference for Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, Quantitative Finance, and related disciplines  Strong proficiency with Python, intermediate or better proficiency with SQL and/or Apache Spark  Experience analyzing and visualizing large datasets  Experience with AI-assisted development (Claude Code, GitHub CoPilot, Cursor, etc.)  Familiarity with LLMs, LangChain, vector databases, and RAG pipelines  Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders 

Preferred

 Demonstrated interest in fundamental equity research and financial modelling  Experience with Databricks or Snowflake and cloud platforms such as AWS  Experience with Atlassian project management tools (JIRA, Confluence, Bitbucket)  Experience with knowledge graphs

This is a direct service position requiring specific knowledge of mental health, and skills in crisis intervention and stabilization. substance use disorders.

Job Title: IT Data Analyst III
Location: Corning, NY - 100% onsite

Position Purpose
Client is consolidating 29 ERP platforms around the world to unite the organization under one common ERP solution, SAP S/4HANA Private. The Data Validation & Analytics Expert supports this transformation by validating that the correct data is transferred during ERP deployments for Req to Pay (RTP) and by improving how deployment data is analyzed, interpreted, and reported.
This role works closely with the ERP transformation data team, business leads, and key stakeholders to verify data accuracy, completeness, and alignment across deployment activities. The role combines hands-on data validation, profiling, cleansing, and analysis with the development of dashboards, reporting, and practical AI-enabled approaches that improve deployment readiness and business decision-making.

Key Responsibilities
Validate that RTP data is accurately transferred during ERP deployment activities
Partner with the ERP transformation data team, business leads, and users to confirm data requirements, validation criteria, priorities, and status updates
Collect data from primary and secondary sources and maintain relevant databases, files, and data systems that support validation and analysis activities
Develop and implement data collection processes, validation methods, and other strategies that improve data quality, consistency, and efficiency
Filter, cleanse, and review data using reports, reconciliations, and performance indicators to identify issues and improve reliability
Perform data profiling to identify, investigate, and understand anomalies, gaps, inconsistencies, and data transfer risks
Mine and analyze large data sets to draw valid conclusions and support deployment and business decision-making
Use statistical and analytical tools to interpret data sets, with attention to trends, patterns, and insights that may support diagnostic or predictive analytics efforts
Develop dashboards, graphs, visualizations, exception reporting, and reconciliation tools that enable quicker and more effective data analysis
Apply AI-enabled approaches, where appropriate, to support faster issue identification, pattern detection, and insight generation across validation activities
Translate validation and analytical findings into clear updates, recommendations, and reporting for management and stakeholders
Proactively identify trends, risks, and business improvement opportunities and make recommendations to stakeholders
Contribute to stronger data quality, lower deployment risk, and more reliable RTP process outcomes across the ERP transformation

Required Qualifications
Education: Bachelor's degree in IT, Science, or Business
5 year's experience in the following;
Experience in data validation, data analysis, ERP data support, or transformation-related roles
Strong ability to analyze complex data and identify inconsistencies, anomalies, gaps, and quality issues
Experience supporting ERP deployments, data migration, or system implementation activities
Understanding of RTP processes and related business data
Experience developing dashboards, reports, validation tools, or analytical methods to improve data review and decision-making
Experience working with data profiling, cleansing, reconciliation, and trend analysis
Ability to work effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders, and management
Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and follow-through
Strong written and verbal communication skills

Preferred Qualifications
Experience with SAP S/4HANA or similar ERP platforms
Experience supporting RTP data validation, migration, or deployment readiness activities
Familiarity with enterprise data quality, statistical analysis, reconciliation, or validation methods
Experience using AI, automation, or advanced analytics to improve data analysis processes (Databricks)
Experience working in cross-functional global transformation programs

Why This Role Matters
This role helps protect deployment quality by ensuring RTP data is transferred accurately and reliably during ERP go-lives while improving how quickly and effectively deployment data can be analyzed and used. Success in this role will reduce risk, improve business confidence in deployment data, and support a smoother, more insight-driven transition to Client common SAP S/4HANA platform.

rows.title: Analyst, Operational Reporting & Metrics
rows.descriptionText:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Analyst, Operational Reporting & Metrics

The Global Statistics / Quarterly Mastercard Reporting (QMR) group is responsible for the collection, validation, analysis, and reporting of Mastercard’s operational performance metrics. The team plays a critical role in ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and timeliness of quarterly reported data while supporting business partners through data-driven insights, operational reporting, and reporting governance.

As a core member of the QMR team, you will participate in all quarterly reporting activities, partner closely with internal and external stakeholders, and help ensure the completeness and accuracy of customer-reported operational data. This highly visible role requires strong analytical capabilities, attention to detail, stakeholder management skills, and the ability to understand the downstream impact of reporting on operational metrics, financial reporting, and billing processes.

Role

 Support the collection, review, validation, and reporting of quarterly operational data submissions. Analyze customer-reported operational and transaction data to identify discrepancies, anomalies, trends, and potential revenue leakage. Investigate reporting variances and collaborate with customers and internal stakeholders to resolve issues within required timelines. Develop trusted relationships with internal and external stakeholders to support accurate and timely reporting submissions. Understand and assess the downstream impact of reporting activities on billing, operational metrics, and business reporting. Perform root cause analysis on reporting exceptions and recommend corrective actions. Deliver clear and actionable reporting insights to support operational and management discussions. Support quarterly QMR business updates and reporting reviews with regional finance and business partners. Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for inquiries, investigations, and issue resolution. Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes, controls, and operational efficiencies. Contribute to system enhancement initiatives, user acceptance testing, and process improvement projects. Provide customer support, guidance, and training on reporting requirements, reporting standards, and QMR-related processes. Participate in quarterly reporting close activities while ensuring adherence to established controls and governance procedures.


All About You

 Experience working with operational reporting, performance metrics, business reporting, or reporting governance functions. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate issues, identify root causes, and recommend solutions. Experience reviewing and validating large data sets with exceptional attention to detail and accuracy. Demonstrated ability to build trusted stakeholder relationships and effectively manage cross-functional partnerships. Exposure to operational, transactional, customer, or financial data analysis. Ability to communicate complex findings and reporting issues clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Self-starter who thrives in deadline-driven environments and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously. Strong organizational skills and commitment to data quality and process discipline. Experience identifying and implementing process improvements within operational environments. FP&A, operational reporting, revenue operations, reporting governance, or business operations experience preferred. Continuous improvement or Six Sigma experience is a plus. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills with proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and the ability to quickly learn internal systems and reporting tools.


Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

Corporate Security Responsibility

 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;Report any suspected information security violation or breach, andComplete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.


In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in the US, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive base salary and may be eligible for an annual bonus or commissions depending on the role. The base salary offered may vary depending on multiple factors, including but not limited to location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Mastercard benefits for full time (and certain part time) employees generally include: insurance (including medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, disability, life insurance); flexible spending account and health savings account; paid leaves (including 16 weeks of new parent leave and up to 20 days of bereavement leave); 80 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time, 25 days of vacation time and 5 personal days, pro-rated based on date of hire; 10 annual paid U.S. observed holidays; 401k with a best-in-class company match; deferred compensation for eligible roles; fitness reimbursement or on-site fitness facilities; eligibility for tuition reimbursement; and many more. Mastercard benefits for interns generally include: 56 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time; jury duty leave; and on-site fitness facilities in some locations.

At American Express, we empower early career data and analytics colleagues to learn, innovate, and make an impact from day one. This role sits at the intersection of technology, finance, portfolio management, reporting, and data analytics. You may gather and validate data, build reports, analyze financial or delivery metrics, support dashboards, develop insights, and prepare clear recommendations that help leaders and teams make informed technology decisions.

Responsibilities

Collect, clean, validate, and organize data from portfolio, project, financial, operational, and technology delivery sources to support analysis and reporting. Analyze portfolio performance, budget, forecast, resource, delivery, schedule, quality, and risk information to identify trends, insights, and areas for follow up. Create and maintain dashboards, reports, key performance indicators, recurring analytics outputs, and leadership ready summaries for technology stakeholders. Develop financial models, cost views, forecast summaries, scenario analyses, and variance insights that support technology portfolio and project decision making. Support Software Development Lifecycle and Agile delivery reporting by analyzing delivery metrics, progress data, dependencies, and execution patterns. Qualifications

Interest or experience in data analytics, financial management, portfolio reporting, technology delivery, business intelligence, or data informed decision making. Foundational knowledge of data analytics concepts, including data collection, validation, analysis, visualization, and insight generation. Foundational understanding of financial management principles such as budgeting, forecasting, cost tracking, variance analysis, or financial modeling. Awareness of Software Development Lifecycle and Agile methodology concepts within a technology delivery environment. Foundational understanding of Generative AI concepts, responsible use, appropriate use contexts, prompt based workflows, and human validation of AI generated outputs. Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, communication, organization, problem solving, and collaboration skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

Coursework, projects, internships, student organizations, or extracurricular experience related to data analytics, finance, business analysis, reporting, portfolio management, or technology delivery. Experience using analytical, reporting, or presentation tools such as Excel, PowerPoint, SQL, Python, Tableau, Power BI, or similar platforms. Exposure to financial modeling, dashboard development, key performance indicator reporting, forecast reconciliation, cost analysis, or operational analytics. Interest in technology portfolio management, project performance reporting, resource planning, process improvement, or business intelligence modernization. Familiarity with project or portfolio tools such as Jira, Rally, Confluence, SharePoint, Microsoft Project, or related workflow platforms. Coursework, projects, research, or internship exposure to data requirements, source-to-target mapping, data quality and controls, metadata, lineage, or data governance. Exposure to financial modeling, dashboard development, statistical analysis, scenario analysis, model documentation, data quality review, metadata, or data lineage concepts. Interest in AI governance, model risk management, responsible AI, explainability, enterprise data architecture, predictive analytics, or quantum computing research. Curiosity about Agentic AI reporting, AI enabled analytics, productivity tools, automated insight generation, and responsible validation of AI generated recommendations. Ability to build clear narratives from data, communicate findings clearly, and work effectively across finance, technology, architecture, risk, product, and business teams.

Duties Description

 Duties Description 

Duties

Under the direction of Data Analyst 2, Data Analyst 1 will devise methods for identifying data patterns and trends in data sources. This role supports and collaborates with other NYSDOT program areas to service the Data needs of the Department. Duties include but are not limited to:

 Perform data extraction, aggregation, and quality checks from multiple sources and tables in support of trend identification and root cause analysis. Develop charts, graphs, tables, and graphics to interpret and present data in a meaningful way. Communicate insights and recommendations effectively. Contribute to data dictionary use, standards, training, and ongoing updates. Contribute to improving business performance and driving data-driven decision-making. Filter and clean data by reviewing computer reports, printouts, and performance indicators to locate and correct code and data problems. Verify data quality to ensure accurate analysis and reporting. Develop and implement databases, data collection systems and data analysis activities. Acquire data from primary or secondary data sources.

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

Team Description

As part of the US Card data science organization, this team focuses on the customer management business, and builds top tier machine learning solutions to meet the various needs such as real-time customer behavioral prediction and valuation forecasts. We work in a team environment, collaborating closely with cross-functioning teams including the business, engineers, analysts, data science/quants, products.

Role Description

In this role, you will:

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers loveLeverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual dataBuild machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementationFlex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals

The Ideal Candidate is:

Customer first. You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You know at the end of the day it’s about making the right decision for our customers. Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them. Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea. A leader. You challenge conventional thinking and work with stakeholders to identify and improve the status quo. You’re passionate about talent development for your own team and beyond. Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms. Statistically-minded. You’ve built models, validated them, and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series, and deep learning. A data guru. “Big data” doesn’t faze you. You have the skills to retrieve, combine, and analyze data from a variety of sources and structures. You know understanding the data is often the key to great data science. 

Basic Qualifications:

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date:A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 6 years of experience performing data analyticsA Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) or an MBA with a quantitative concentration plus 4 years of experience performing data analyticsA PhD in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 1 year of experience performing data analyticsAt least 1 year of experience leveraging open source programming languages for large scale data analysisAt least 1 year of experience working with machine learningAt least 1 year of experience utilizing relational databases

Preferred Qualifications:

PhD in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics) plus 3 years of experience in data analyticsAt least 1 year of experience working with AWSAt least 4 years’ experience in Python, Scala, or R for large scale data analysisAt least 4 years’ experience with machine learningAt least 4 years’ experience with SQL

rows.descriptionText:
Research

Morgan Stanley Investment Research is uniquely committed to being an essential part of our clients' investment process. We strive to be the sell-side research provider that best understands the buy side. Through relevant and timely conversations with leading investors, we focus resources on risk-reward essentials: identifying the investor debates, assessing the potential outcomes, and uncovering the evidence our clients need to validate their investment decisions. Our equity analysts cover some 3,000 stocks; our economists, strategists and fixed income analysts cover all major regions and other asset classes around the globe.

Equity Research

The Equity Research department is responsible for researching macroeconomic and microeconomic conditions, along with company fundamentals. It also collects and analyses financial information to make investment recommendations on stocks in specific sectors. Research analysts build financial models to explore alternative scenarios, examine industries and communicate with companies and investors. Equity Research team members discuss their analysis and investment recommendations in research notes. A career in investment research at Morgan Stanley demands a commitment to excellence and a passion for the markets as well as the highest level of integrity.

We are seeking an experienced Analyst/Associate member to join our Airlines & Freight Transportation team in New York City.

The Airlines & Freight Transportation research team covers 30+ stocks across airlines, rails, trucking, parcels, and logistics. The team is known for differentiated, out-of-consensus views that balance timely tactical calls with deep thematic research, including work on technology-driven disruption such as autonomous trucks, drones, eVTOLs, and freight digitization, supported by a highly developed data and modeling platform.

Primary Responsibilities

 Create and maintain financial, valuation, and industry models, leveraging skills in accounting, finance, and economics Translate company, industry, consumer, market, and alternative data into insightful research reports with clear investment debates, differentiated conclusions, and actionable stock calls Develop and maintain relationships with management and investor relations teams of companies under coverage, industry specialists, and other key leaders of opinion Engage with institutional investors by responding to in-depth questions, addressing bespoke requests, discussing companies and investment theses, and helping communicate the team’s highest-conviction views Support internal sales and trading teams with timely analysis of sector breaking news and relevant industry developments Adopt and apply AI-enabled research tools judiciously to accelerate information gathering, model maintenance, data analysis, and workflow execution while maintaining analytical rigor, source verification, data integrity, and quality control Conduct industry diligence and primary research through surveys, expert conference calls, and channel checks to evaluate industry trends and their implications for companies under coverage Collaborate with cross-functional teams to produce larger industry and thematic reports

Qualifications

 Ideally 1-2 years of professional experience in equity research or investment banking Experience or sector knowledge in airlines and/or freight transportation is highly desirable Proven experience using Excel to build and maintain financial models; advanced Excel proficiency is required Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present analysis clearly, defend conclusions, and contribute positively in client-facing discussions Demonstrated interest in public markets and a genuine curiosity about what drives stock performance, investor debates, and valuation Comfort adopting AI-enabled tools and new technologies to improve research efficiency, with the judgment to verify outputs, protect data integrity, and apply tools appropriately Demonstrated attention to detail and commitment to accuracy Ability to adapt quickly and work well under pressure High EQ, strong personal drive, energy, creativity, intellectual curiosity, organizational discipline, and a team-oriented mindset Ability to think independently, develop differentiated views, and operate with a self-starter mentality Experience with Python is a plus but not required CFA designation, or progress toward CFA is a plus but not required

What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.

To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices into your browser.

Expected base pay rates for the role will be between $110,000 and $125,000 per year for Analyst, and between $150,000 and $200,000 per year for Associate, at the commencement of employment. However, base pay if hired will be determined on an individualized basis and is only part of the total compensation package, which, depending on the position, may also include commission earnings, incentive compensation, discretionary bonuses, other short and long-term incentive packages, and other Morgan Stanley sponsored benefit programs.

Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Job Summary

As an LP Analyst, you will help make sure investor records for private funds are accurate. You will support the daily, monthly, and quarterly checks of limited partner (LP) activity, including capital calls, distributions, and capital account statements. You will work closely with the Reconciliation team, and you will have mentors to guide you as you learn.

What You Will Do

Compare LP capital account data from fund administrators and general partners against our internal records, and flag differences.Support daily and monthly reconciliation of capital calls, distributions, and capital account balances.Investigate differences in our reconciliation system. Ask mentors and experts for help when you need it.Check LP data against third-party and fund administrator sources.Track and report whether daily and monthly reconciliations were delivered on time.Build working relationships with data providers, fund administrators, and internal teams.Send clear questions and timely status updates to internal and external contacts.Learn our internal tools and processes for LP and fund reconciliation.

What You Will Learn

How private equity, venture, and other limited partnership funds work, and how their data is reconciled.How to solve LP and fund discrepancies using Clearwater’s resources and your team’s expertise.How Clearwater’s mission (aggregate, reconcile, report) applies to LP and fund data.Our reconciliation tools and reports, from routine tasks to more complex ones.Completion of new hire certifications, then intermediate-level training.

How You Will Grow

Year one is about learning. You will have mentors and clear processes to follow.You will handle simple and medium-difficulty questions on your own and get help on harder ones.You will be expected to learn from mistakes and not repeat them.You will manage your work against team productivity and quality goals.You will mostly work with fund administrators and data providers.

What We’re Looking For

A bachelor’s degree (or graduating soon) in accounting, finance, or a related field.Strong written and verbal communication skills.Strong organization and teamwork skills.Solid math and problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Excel (lookups, pivot tables, and filters are a plus).Basic accounting or finance coursework. Knowledge of capital calls, distributions, or private equity is a plus but not required.Curiosity, resilience, and a willingness to ask for help and learn from feedback.Interest in building a long-term career at Clearwater.

Duties Description

 Duties Description 

Duties

Under the direction of Data Analyst 2, Data Analyst 1 will devise methods for identifying data patterns and trends in data sources. This role supports and collaborates with other NYSDOT program areas to service the Data needs of the Department. Duties include but are not limited to:

 Perform data extraction, aggregation, and quality checks from multiple sources and tables in support of trend identification and root cause analysis. Develop charts, graphs, tables, and graphics to interpret and present data in a meaningful way. Communicate insights and recommendations effectively. Contribute to data dictionary use, standards, training, and ongoing updates. Contribute to improving business performance and driving data-driven decision-making. Collaborate with other Data Analysts and management across the Department to develop and build analytic models in support of policy development and budgetary proposals. Take ownership of individual projects to move collaborations forward. Utilize advanced analytical techniques to predict future infrastructure conditions and needs. Leverage programming expertise to build unique datasets and analytical programs. Filter and clean data by reviewing computer reports, printouts, and performance indicators to locate and correct code and data problems. Verify data quality to ensure accurate analysis and reporting. Develop and implement databases, data collection systems and data analysis activities. Acquire data from primary or secondary data sources.

Responsibilities may include serving a role within the Incident Command System to support the department’s response to regional and statewide emergency situations.

Bachelor’s degree in data or computer science, informatics, economics, statistics, mathematics, or a related field.

Bachelor’s degree in data or computer science, informatics, economics, statistics, mathematics, or a related field and one year of experience* in advanced excel analysis.

Data Analyst 1

Bachelor’s degree and either: satisfactory completion of a two-year traineeship or two years of experience* in data visualization, and statistical models and data mining tools.

Substitution: A master’s degree in data or computer science, informatics, economics, statistics, mathematics, or a related field, may substitute for one year of the specialized experience. A Ph.D. in the above fields may substitute for two years of the specialized experience.

FreeWheel, a Comcast company, provides comprehensive ad platforms for publishers, advertisers, and media buyers. Powered by premium video content, robust data, and advanced technology, we’re making it easier for buyers and sellers to transact across all screens, data types, and sales channels. As a global company, we have offices in nine countries and can insert advertisements around the world.

Job Summary

The Deal Desk Analyst serves as a critical operational and analytical partner within the Deal Desk organization, supporting the full deal lifecycle from opportunity qualification through contract execution. This role is responsible for maintaining Salesforce data integrity, supporting deal modeling, drafting professional memos, coordinating cross-functional stakeholders, and developing scalable processes that improve deal velocity. The Analyst will leverage strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and pattern recognition to identify trends across pricing, commercial terms, and deal structures. This individual will document best practices, create playbooks and deal matrices, and help establish repeatable frameworks that enable faster decision-making, and operational efficiency across the organization. This position serves as the operational foundation that enables Deal Desk Managers to act as strategic advisors to Sales and Leadership while ensuring disciplined execution of Deal Desk processes. This role reports to the Director, Deal Desk.

Responsibilities

Job Description

Deal Support & Analysis

Support the development and review of financial deal models across all opportunities. Draft professional memos and coordinate supporting documentation for stakeholder and executive approvals. Analyze commercial terms, pricing structures, profitability, and revenue implications to support deal reviews. Facilitate deal progression by partnering with Sales, Finance, Legal, Revenue Operations and Leadership teams. 

Salesforce Data Quality & Operational Excellence

Maintain accurate and complete Salesforce opportunity records to support pipeline management. Ensure required fields, pricing data, deal stages, and commercial terms are properly documented and maintained. Support process governance and data validation efforts that improve data accuracy and operational reporting. Identify and resolve data inconsistencies and process gaps that create friction in the deal lifecycle. Ensure deal documentation and financial assumptions are accurately captured. Provide reporting and insights to support executive and business reviews. 

Process Improvement & Enablement

Identify recurring deal structures, pricing models, and commercial patterns to develop scalable playbooks and best practices. Build and maintain deal matrices, operating procedures, and decision-making frameworks to improve consistency and efficiency. 

Cross-Functional Partnership

Act as a liaison between Sales, Finance, Legal, Revenue Recognition, Operations, and Leadership teams to find a “path to yes” that drives company growth. Ensure alignment across stakeholders and proactively communicate risks, dependencies, and approval requirements.

rows.descriptionText:
Programme start date: September 2027

Please review all the graduate programme opportunities and make one application. 

Our award-winning graduate programme provides the ideal springboard for an exciting and meaningful career in global financial markets.  

As a graduate, you will join the Data and Analytics Division. The division is a dynamic, fast-paced environment where instant reaction and long-term vision are equally important.  

Our Data & Analytics is one of the world’s largest providers of financial data and infrastructure. With over 40,000 customers and 400,000 end users, spanning over approximately 190 markets, Data & Analytics partners with the global financial community supplying extensive, quality data, news, information and analytics that inform investment decisions. 

We are the #1 supplier of real-time market data to the global financial and investor community, carrying up to 176 billion market messages, from over 150,000 data sources every day.  

This dynamic business offers graduates opportunities in London to join Data and Analytics and be aligned to Analytics or Data and Feeds. To allow us to place you in the right area we will get to know your skills and interest and how they align with the needs of the business.

To be eligible you must be a graduate who has completed your studies in 2026 or a final year undergraduate or Master’s student and have completed all the requirements of your course before summer 2027.

Highlights of the Graduate Programme  

Progress through a 12-month development journey aiming to build foundational skills that are key for your future success Build your foundational knowledge of LSEG, Financial Markets and the business during your global induction Divisional-led inductions to immerse graduates into the business through team-led overviews and introductions Participate in group projects which are aligned to LSEG goals Meet in person with your cohort at ‘Ignite’, the programme mid-point skills offsite. Explore key knowledge areas and skills Access opportunities to earn industry recognized qualifications, including 5 study days during programme Connect with global early careers community and opportunities and contribute to wider society via CSR initiatives and volunteering opportunities  

Our graduates join us on a permanent basis, and from day one you will be aligned to Data and Analytics, which will allow you to develop within a secure framework.

 

What we are looking for: 

We are passionate about recruiting people who have a genuine curiosity for Data, who want to understand the full breadth of our organisation, how it fits together, how it functions – and are interested in playing a part of our development, as it grows and diversifies. 

You should have a demonstrable interest in financial markets, which you’ve built through your studies, work experience or extracurricular activities.  A curiosity for data and an ability to analyse information to draw conclusions and propose solutions.  Customer centric and product led mindsetIndividuals who are able to connect the dots and think strategically.   The environment we work in is fast paced, you’ll need to demonstrate focus, resilience and the flexibility to adapt to changing demands.  People who can collaborate with others, using their strong communication skills in the process.  Ideal candidates will have the rights to work in the US without restrictions for the duration of the graduate programme and join us on a permanent basis.   

You will stand out to us if you can demonstrate and recognise that what you achieve is equally important as how you achieve it. 

 

Application close: 28 November, however we recommend an early application because we consider candidates on a rolling basis. Due to the volume of applications, we might close the applications earlier, so we recommend an early application.  

Recruitment Process:

The first stage of the recruitment process involves making an application and submitting your resume. The next stage of the application process is an untimed Immersive Online Assessment. The assessment is designed to give you an insight into what it’s like to work at LSEG. The second stage is a video interview where you will answer a series of questions using a strength-based-interview style The final stage is a half day assessment centre which involves several different types of exercises – further information is provided at the point of invite.  

  

Please review all the graduate programme opportunities and make one application. If you make more than one application, we will review your first application only.

Please note, all our assessment centres are held virtually.

 

At LSEG, we provide our employees with a comprehensive benefits portfolio as part of a competitive total rewards package. Our benefit plans are designed to supplement the financial, emotional and physical wellbeing of our employees and their families at all stages of their life. We encourage an appreciative, collaborative and inclusive culture that promotes employee and organisational wellbeing.  

We believe in remunerating our people with a variety of attractive benefits such as:  

Emotional Wellbeing: Annual wellness allowance; Employee assistance programme  Physical Wellbeing: Private Medical Insurance; Optional dental Insurance; Gym membership & discounts  Financial Wellbeing: Life Insurance; Income protection; Pension  Other benefits: MyOffers: access to a range of retail discounts  

We believe hybrid working makes more possible and recognise difference as a good thing. We want to set everyone up to bring their best self to work. Everyone will spend time with colleagues in the office (3 days), but you’ll be trusted to work flexibly, in a way that delivers excellence. 

Career Stage:

Associate

Compensation/Benefits Information:

LSEG is committed to offering competitive Compensation and Benefits. The anticipated base salary for this position is $62,800 - $104,600.

Please be aware base salary ranges may vary by geographic location, city and state. In addition to our offered base salary, this role is eligible for our Annual Incentive Plan (AIP/”bonus plan”). Target AIP rates will be commensurate with role level and posted career stage. Individual salary will be reflective of job related knowledge, skills and equivalent experience. LSEG roles (excluding internships and part-time roles of less than 20 hours per week) are typically eligible for inclusion in our LSEG Benefits program, which includes offerings of: Annual Wellness Allowance, Paid time-off, Medical, Dental, Vision, Flex Spending & Health Savings Options, Prescription Drug plan, 401(K) Savings Plan and Company match. LSEG’s Benefits plan also includes basic life insurance, disability benefits, emergency backup dependent care, adoption assistance commuter assistance etc.

London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information:

Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.

LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.

Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.

Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce.

We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.

You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas. We are committed to sustainability across our global business and we are proud to partner with our customers to help them meet their sustainability objectives. Our charity, the LSEG Foundation provides charitable grants to community groups that help people access economic opportunities and build a secure future with financial independence. Colleagues can get involved through fundraising and volunteering.

LSEG offers a range of tailored benefits and support, including healthcare, retirement planning, paid volunteering days and wellbeing initiatives.

About Atlas

Atlas is a trusted leader in environmental and infrastructure consulting services; we provide services that enable communities to flourish and thrive. With a team of 3,500 employees and offices throughout the US, we combine local expertise and a network of relationships to deliver solutions to both public and private clients. Our services help improve the quality of life in the communities where we live and work. We always aim for smart, safe, and sustainable results. At Atlas we understand that our future is everyone’s responsibility, and we create a better experience at every stage of a project.

Job Description

Atlas is seeking an IH Data Analyst I to support environmental and industrial hygiene projects throughout the New York region. In this role, you'll combine fieldwork, data analysis, and regulatory documentation to help ensure safe learning environments across schools and other facilities.

Working closely with industrial hygiene professionals and AHERA inspection teams, you'll contribute to inspections, analyze project data, maintain accurate records, and support the development of asbestos management plans. This position offers the opportunity to make a direct impact on environmental health and public safety while developing technical expertise in a collaborative team environment.

Support on-site industrial hygiene inspections and environmental field activities.Collect, review, and analyze project data to support client deliverables and regulatory requirements.Maintain accurate records and enter project information into client and company databases.Assist in the preparation of asbestos management plans and related documentation.Coordinate with AHERA inspection teams to support project execution and quality standards.Follow safety procedures, quality requirements, and regulatory guidelines throughout all project activities.

You’ll thrive here if you have

Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Industrial Hygiene, Environmental Studies, Computer Science, or a related field.Experience with environmental, industrial hygiene, inspection, or data management work.Current New York State Asbestos Inspector and Management Planner licenses.Strong written and verbal communication skills.Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.Strong attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate work.Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining quality and compliance.Ability and willingness to travel locally as needed.

rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

At American Express, we empower early career data and analytics colleagues to learn, innovate, and make an impact from day one. As an Analyst Data Analytics colleague in Enterprise Technology Services, you will join a full time graduate program and support analytics work that helps technology teams understand portfolio performance, delivery progress, financial trends, resource utilization, and operational outcomes.

This role sits at the intersection of technology, finance, portfolio management, reporting, and data analytics. You may gather and validate data, build reports, analyze financial or delivery metrics, support dashboards, develop insights, and prepare clear recommendations that help leaders and teams make informed technology decisions.

Responsibilities

Collect, clean, validate, and organize data from portfolio, project, financial, operational, and technology delivery sources to support analysis and reporting. Analyze portfolio performance, budget, forecast, resource, delivery, schedule, quality, and risk information to identify trends, insights, and areas for follow up. Create and maintain dashboards, reports, key performance indicators, recurring analytics outputs, and leadership ready summaries for technology stakeholders. Develop financial models, cost views, forecast summaries, scenario analyses, and variance insights that support technology portfolio and project decision making. Partner with technology, finance, product, project, and business teams to understand reporting needs and translate them into accurate analytical outputs. Support Software Development Lifecycle and Agile delivery reporting by analyzing delivery metrics, progress data, dependencies, and execution patterns. Prepare presentations, narratives, and stakeholder updates that communicate data backed insights to technical and non technical audiences. Use Agentic AI, reporting, data analytics, and productivity tools to support research, summarization, analysis, workflow efficiency, and human validated outputs. 

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

Must have earned a Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Information Technology, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Economics, or another relevant field before the full time start date.Students must have a graduation date between December 2026 and June 2027. Interest or experience in data analytics, financial management, portfolio reporting, technology delivery, business intelligence, or data informed decision making. Foundational knowledge of data analytics concepts, including data collection, validation, analysis, visualization, and insight generation. Foundational understanding of financial management principles such as budgeting, forecasting, cost tracking, variance analysis, or financial modeling. Awareness of Software Development Lifecycle and Agile methodology concepts within a technology delivery environment. Foundational understanding of Generative AI concepts, responsible use, appropriate use contexts, prompt based workflows, and human validation of AI generated outputs. rows.descriptionText:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Analyst, Operational Reporting & Metrics

The Global Statistics / Quarterly Mastercard Reporting (QMR) group is responsible for the collection, validation, analysis, and reporting of Mastercard’s operational performance metrics. The team plays a critical role in ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and timeliness of quarterly reported data while supporting business partners through data-driven insights, operational reporting, and reporting governance.

As a core member of the QMR team, you will participate in all quarterly reporting activities, partner closely with internal and external stakeholders, and help ensure the completeness and accuracy of customer-reported operational data. This highly visible role requires strong analytical capabilities, attention to detail, stakeholder management skills, and the ability to understand the downstream impact of reporting on operational metrics, financial reporting, and billing processes.

Role

 Support the collection, review, validation, and reporting of quarterly operational data submissions. Analyze customer-reported operational and transaction data to identify discrepancies, anomalies, trends, and potential revenue leakage. Investigate reporting variances and collaborate with customers and internal stakeholders to resolve issues within required timelines. Develop trusted relationships with internal and external stakeholders to support accurate and timely reporting submissions. Understand and assess the downstream impact of reporting activities on billing, operational metrics, and business reporting. Perform root cause analysis on reporting exceptions and recommend corrective actions. Deliver clear and actionable reporting insights to support operational and management discussions. Support quarterly QMR business updates and reporting reviews with regional finance and business partners. Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for inquiries, investigations, and issue resolution. Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes, controls, and operational efficiencies. Contribute to system enhancement initiatives, user acceptance testing, and process improvement projects. Provide customer support, guidance, and training on reporting requirements, reporting standards, and QMR-related processes. Participate in quarterly reporting close activities while ensuring adherence to established controls and governance procedures.


All About You

 Experience working with operational reporting, performance metrics, business reporting, or reporting governance functions. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate issues, identify root causes, and recommend solutions. Experience reviewing and validating large data sets with exceptional attention to detail and accuracy. Demonstrated ability to build trusted stakeholder relationships and effectively manage cross-functional partnerships. Exposure to operational, transactional, customer, or financial data analysis. Ability to communicate complex findings and reporting issues clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Self-starter who thrives in deadline-driven environments and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously. Strong organizational skills and commitment to data quality and process discipline. Experience identifying and implementing process improvements within operational environments. FP&A, operational reporting, revenue operations, reporting governance, or business operations experience preferred. Continuous improvement or Six Sigma experience is a plus. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills with proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and the ability to quickly learn internal systems and reporting tools.


Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

Corporate Security Responsibility

 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;Report any suspected information security violation or breach, andComplete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.


In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in the US, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive base salary and may be eligible for an annual bonus or commissions depending on the role. The base salary offered may vary depending on multiple factors, including but not limited to location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Mastercard benefits for full time (and certain part time) employees generally include: insurance (including medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, disability, life insurance); flexible spending account and health savings account; paid leaves (including 16 weeks of new parent leave and up to 20 days of bereavement leave); 80 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time, 25 days of vacation time and 5 personal days, pro-rated based on date of hire; 10 annual paid U.S. observed holidays; 401k with a best-in-class company match; deferred compensation for eligible roles; fitness reimbursement or on-site fitness facilities; eligibility for tuition reimbursement; and many more. Mastercard benefits for interns generally include: 56 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time; jury duty leave; and on-site fitness facilities in some locations.

Overview

 JOB DESCRIPTION 

The Jefferies Equity Research Data Strategy Team is a global team embedded within the Equity Research department, responsible for shaping and executing the department's data and AI strategy. On the data side, the team helps incorporate fundamental and alternative datasets into Analyst research reports, combining analysts’ domain expertise with our team’s technical skills to produce thoughtful, defensible, and actionable analysis of real-world behavior at scale. On the AI side, our team is responsible for building internal generative AI tooling along with evaluating third-party AI models and tools to enhance our analysts’ work. We help integrate AI capabilities into analysts’ daily workflows and ensure that first- and third-party datasets are fully AI-accessible to them. Statistics, data engineering, data science, and AI are cornerstones of our work.

As a Data Scientist at Jefferies, your focus will be to support the Research Analysts and the Data Strategy Team’s broader platform. The candidate will use technical and financial skills to implement ideas and requests from the Research Analysts, while also building and maintaining relationships with internal and external stakeholders, working in collaboration with the rest of the Global Data Strategy Team.

Key Responsibilities

 Query, transform, analyze, and combine large datasets in support of solving problems and implementing research ideas across sectors and data categories, occasionally developing statistical models to predict outcomes  Enhance our platform through the creation and maintenance of tools, AI agents, MCP servers, and processes that streamline, scale, and standardize our ability to evaluate, clean, analyze, and disseminate data  Contribute to the data centralization process, ensuring all first- and third-party data assets are AI-accessible and meet quality, lineage, and governance standards  Present highly technical methods to non-technical stakeholders and translate open-ended questions into data-driven insights  Maintain and build relationships with key internal and external stakeholders, including research teams, third-party data vendors, management, and possibly buy-side clients 

Qualifications

Required

 Transferable experience on the sell-side or buy-side, in data science, data research, or similar function  STEM degree with preference for Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, Quantitative Finance, and related disciplines  Strong proficiency with Python, intermediate or better proficiency with SQL and/or Apache Spark  Experience analyzing and visualizing large datasets  Experience with AI-assisted development (Claude Code, GitHub CoPilot, Cursor, etc.)  Familiarity with LLMs, LangChain, vector databases, and RAG pipelines  Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders 

Preferred

 Demonstrated interest in fundamental equity research and financial modelling  Experience with Databricks or Snowflake and cloud platforms such as AWS  Experience with Atlassian project management tools (JIRA, Confluence, Bitbucket)  Experience with knowledge graphs 

Primary Location Full Time Salary Range of $100,000 - $120,000.

Jefferies is a leading global, full-service investment banking and capital markets firm that provides advisory, sales and trading, research, and wealth and asset management services. With more than 40 offices around the world, we offer insights and expertise to investors, companies, and governments.

At Jefferies, we are committed to building a culture that provides opportunities for all employees regardless of our differences and supports a workforce that is reflective of the communities where we work and live. Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

Team Description

People Tech is a close-knit team of 480+ dedicated, talented and diverse individuals. Together, we're focused on delivering exceptional experiences and tech innovations for Capital One's associates and business partners. As a team, we deliver modern engineering capabilities, services, and platforms. We are the proud tech partner to the following enterprise lines of business: Brand, Corporate Development, Corporate Strategy, Experience Design, Enterprise Supplier Management, Global External Affairs, Human Resources, Legal, and Global Workplace Solutions.

In this role, you will: 

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, machine learning engineers and product managers to deliver AI powered products that change how customers interact with their money. Leverage a broad stack of technologies - Pytorch, AWS Ultraclusters, Hugging Face, LangChain, Lightning, VectorDBs, and more - to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data. Be the expert in Natural Language Processing (NLP) to harness the power of Large Language Models (LLMs), adapt and finetune them for customer facing applications and features. Build machine learning and NLP models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, and validation; partnering with engineering teams to operationalize them in scalable and resilient production systems that serve 80+ million customers. Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals. 

The Ideal Candidate is:

Experienced in taking models into production through the model risk compliance processCustomer first. You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You know at the end of the day it’s about making the right decision for our customers. Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them. Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea. A leader. You challenge conventional thinking and work with stakeholders to identify and improve the status quo. You're passionate about talent development for your own team and beyond. Technical. You’re comfortable with advanced ML and DL technologies including language models and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience working with LLMs and solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms. Influential. You are passionate about AI/ML and can bring along a cross functional team in breakthrough innovations. You communicate clearly and effectively to share your findings with non-technical audiences. You are experienced in training language models or large computer vision models as well as have expertise in one or more key subdomains such as: training optimization, self-supervised learning, explainability, RLHF. You have an engineering mindset as shown by a track record of delivering models at scale both in training data and inference volumes. You have experience in delivering libraries, platforms, or solution level code to existing products. 

Basic Qualifications:

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date:A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 6 years of experience performing data analyticsA Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) or an MBA with a quantitative concentration plus 4 years of experience performing data analyticsA PhD in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 1 year of experience performing data analyticsAt least 1 year of experience leveraging open source programming languages for large scale data analysisAt least 1 year of experience working with machine learningAt least 1 year of experience utilizing relational databases

Preferred Qualifications:

PhD in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics)At least 4 years of machine learning experienceAt least 4 years of AI modeling experience At least 4 years of experience in Python, Scala, or RAt least 4 years of experience with SQLExperience working with AWS
