parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Applied AI Scientist — Agentic Decision Systems

Location: Canada or United States (US time zones)

Experience: Typically 2+ years of relevant applied work, although we care substantially more about the quality and difficulty of the problems you have solved than the number of years you have been solving them.

About The Role

We are looking for exceptional quantitative thinkers to build agentic systems that help people make better decisions.

This is not primarily a conventional data science role, an LLM application-development role, or a prompt-engineering role. We are interested in people who want to understand how intelligent systems can reason over complex problems, use tools and models effectively, learn from evidence, and become systematically better over time.

A Central Question In This Role Is

How do we make an agentic system measurably better at the decisions it is intended to support?

That means moving beyond intuition, demos and prompt alchemy. You will think about objectives, observability, feedback, evaluation datasets, statistical uncertainty, experiments, simulation, failure modes and improvement loops. You should be interested not only in building agents, but in developing rigorous ways for those agents—and the systems around them—to improve.

You will work on ambiguous, consequential enterprise problems where the answer is rarely “use an LLM.” Sometimes the right solution will involve an agent. Sometimes it will involve statistical modelling, optimization, machine learning, simulation, rules, or a surprisingly simple piece of mathematics. Frequently it will involve several of these working together.

We want people who are technically ambitious, intellectually demanding, empirically minded and impatient with hand-waving.

What You Will Do

Design and build agentic decision-support systems that can reason over data, interact with tools and models, maintain state, decompose complex problems and support consequential human decisions.Develop mechanisms for systematic improvement. Design evaluation frameworks, feedback loops, benchmarks, experiments and instrumentation that allow us to determine where a system fails, why it fails and whether a proposed change genuinely improves it.Turn “make the agent better” into a quantitative problem. Define measurable objectives and failure modes; build representative test sets; analyze performance distributions rather than anecdotes; and distinguish real improvement from movement on a convenient metric.Explore self-improving agentic architectures. This may involve reflection and critique, adaptive tool or model selection, memory, search, planning, generated training/evaluation data, policy improvement, human feedback, simulation or other mechanisms. We are interested in what works—not in allegiance to a particular architecture.Bring statistical and machine-learning judgment to agentic systems. Use probabilistic modelling, statistical inference, ML, optimization or causal reasoning when they make the system more useful, more reliable or easier to improve.Generate high-quality software using AI coding systems. We expect you to work AI-natively. The objective is not to demonstrate how quickly you can type Python; it is to produce excellent software.Own difficult problems end to end. Work from an initially ambiguous business or decision problem through problem formulation, system design, implementation, evaluation and deployment.Challenge the problem definition. A technically sophisticated solution to the wrong problem is still the wrong solution. You should be comfortable questioning assumptions and reframing what is being optimized.Work directly with senior technical and business stakeholders. Explain complex ideas precisely without hiding behind jargon, and make uncertainty, assumptions and limitations explicit.

What We Are Looking For

Exceptional quantitative foundations

You have rigorous training in a highly quantitative discipline such as mathematics, physics, statistics, engineering, econometrics, operations research or another discipline involving substantial mathematical and quantitative reasoning.

A master's or PhD is welcome, but neither is a substitute for evidence of unusually strong analytical thinking. Exceptional candidates with a bachelor's degree are equally of interest.

You should be comfortable reasoning mathematically about unfamiliar problems rather than relying solely on methods you have used before.

Experience with agentic systems

You have meaningful hands-on experience designing or developing agentic systems.

We are particularly interested in experience involving some combination of:

multi-step reasoning and planning;structured outputs and stateful workflows;memory and context management;multi-agent or decomposed-agent architectures;agent evaluation;automated critique or refinement;feedback-driven adaptation;decision-support applications; andmechanisms intended to improve system performance over repeated iterations.

A chatbot with a system prompt is not, for our purposes, substantial experience building an agentic system. Neither is wrapping an LLM around a vector database and calling the result an agent.

Statistical and machine-learning literacy

You do not need to be a specialist in every branch of machine learning, but you should have enough statistical maturity to reason properly about evidence.

We expect practical familiarity with statistical modelling and machine learning and, more importantly, sound instincts around:

uncertainty;validation;sampling and selection effects;overfitting;experiment design;measurement;predictive versus causal claims;distribution shift; anddetermining whether a system actually works.

You should instinctively ask what the comparison is, how performance is being measured, whether the evaluation resembles the real problem, and how confident we should be in the result.

AI-native software engineering

You are extremely effective at producing software, but we do not equate software engineering ability with manually writing large quantities of code.

We expect you to use state-of-the-art coding agents extensively—potentially for essentially all implementations.

What matters is whether you can make those systems produce excellent code.

You Should Be Capable Of

designing a coherent software architecture before or while implementation emerges;decomposing work effectively for coding agents;inspecting and interrogating unfamiliar generated code;identifying bad abstractions, subtle bugs and unnecessary complexity;designing meaningful tests rather than merely achieving test coverage;maintaining reproducible environments;understanding APIs, data pipelines and production system boundaries;debugging systems whose implementation you did not personally type; andleaving behind code that another strong engineer can understand, extend and trust.

You are accountable for every line you ship even if you personally typed none of them.

The Intellectual Style We Value

The strongest candidates for this role tend to have several things in common.

They are deeply curious but difficult to impress. They enjoy abstraction, but they want abstractions to survive contact with data. They are happy to propose an ambitious architecture and equally happy to discard it when a simpler system performs better. They distinguish a compelling demonstration from convincing evidence. They are interested in why something works, where it stops working, and what experiment would distinguish competing explanations. They are willing to use LLMs aggressively without anthropomorphizing them or treating their behavior as magic. And when someone says, “This version feels better,” their instinct is to ask: “Better according to what measurement?”

You Will Probably Not Enjoy This Role If

Most of your interest is in conventional analytics, dashboards or notebook-based data science.Your experience with generative AI is primarily prompting, chatbot development or basic RAG applications.You prefer selecting an AI framework and following its abstractions to thinking from first principles about the underlying system.You regard agent behaviour as too unpredictable to evaluate quantitatively or you are satisfied with qualitative demonstrations when controlled measurement is possible.You believe increasingly elaborate agent architectures are inherently more intelligent.You enjoy writing code but are uncomfortable delegating implementation to AI systems.Conversely, you use AI-generated code without wanting to understand its architecture, test its assumptions or take responsibility for its quality.You need requirements to be fully specified before you can make progress.

Particularly Interesting, But Not Required

Experience with one or more of the following would be especially valuable:

decision science, causal inference, Bayesian modelling or optimization;reinforcement learning, contextual bandits, simulation or adaptive experimentation;agent evaluation, observability, benchmark construction or synthetic task generation;inference-time search, test-time computation, model routing or ensemble systems;human-in-the-loop or production agent architectures; andcomplex enterprise decision environments such as financial services, insurance, supply chain or logistics.

The role is product-oriented: you will shape the capabilities, workflows and evaluation systems that make our agentic products more useful, reliable and improvable.

You will turn difficult enterprise problems, user needs and client lessons into reusable product capabilities. Working with technical, product, domain and client-facing teams, you will identify high-leverage problems, formulate improvement hypotheses, and design experiments that distinguish genuine progress from superficial gains.

We expect you to move quickly from ideas to prototypes and measurable evidence without compromising reasoning, quality or technical integrity. The goal is not to build the most elaborate AI system, but products that make better decisions, whose performance we can understand, and which we know how to improve.

About Mphasis

Mphasis applies next-generation technology to help enterprises transform their businesses globally. Our work combines technology, domain expertise and applied innovation to solve complex problems for enterprise clients.

Originally built around basketball, our technology now scales across football, baseball, tennis, and more, powering multi-sport analytics at the enterprise level. You will turn raw event, tracking, and market data into signals, test whether they improve on market prices, and get the ones that work into production. The Role is NOT for Candidates Who:Have only coursework or Kaggle-style modeling experienceAren't genuinely interested in prediction markets and the sports betting spacePrefer pure research with no path to productionNeed a rigid structure or a predictable 9-to-5 scheduleAre looking for a fully remote role

Nice to Have:Experience with pricing, market making, or market microstructure in sports betting or prediction marketsA track record of building and running your own models in live marketsExperience with sports data, player tracking data, or play-by-play dataExperience deploying models to real-time or low-latency systemsExposure to AWS or GCP, Docker, and workflow orchestration tools

rows.title: AI Software Engineer

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Applied AI Scientist — Agentic Decision Systems

Location: Canada or United States (US time zones)

Experience: Typically 2+ years of relevant applied work, although we care substantially more about the quality and difficulty of the problems you have solved than the number of years you have been solving them.

About The Role

We are looking for exceptional quantitative thinkers to build agentic systems that help people make better decisions.

This is not primarily a conventional data science role, an LLM application-development role, or a prompt-engineering role. We are interested in people who want to understand how intelligent systems can reason over complex problems, use tools and models effectively, learn from evidence, and become systematically better over time.

A Central Question In This Role Is

How do we make an agentic system measurably better at the decisions it is intended to support?

That means moving beyond intuition, demos and prompt alchemy. You will think about objectives, observability, feedback, evaluation datasets, statistical uncertainty, experiments, simulation, failure modes and improvement loops. You should be interested not only in building agents, but in developing rigorous ways for those agents—and the systems around them—to improve.

You will work on ambiguous, consequential enterprise problems where the answer is rarely “use an LLM.” Sometimes the right solution will involve an agent. Sometimes it will involve statistical modelling, optimization, machine learning, simulation, rules, or a surprisingly simple piece of mathematics. Frequently it will involve several of these working together.

We want people who are technically ambitious, intellectually demanding, empirically minded and impatient with hand-waving.

What You Will Do

Design and build agentic decision-support systems that can reason over data, interact with tools and models, maintain state, decompose complex problems and support consequential human decisions.Develop mechanisms for systematic improvement. Design evaluation frameworks, feedback loops, benchmarks, experiments and instrumentation that allow us to determine where a system fails, why it fails and whether a proposed change genuinely improves it.Turn “make the agent better” into a quantitative problem. Define measurable objectives and failure modes; build representative test sets; analyze performance distributions rather than anecdotes; and distinguish real improvement from movement on a convenient metric.Explore self-improving agentic architectures. This may involve reflection and critique, adaptive tool or model selection, memory, search, planning, generated training/evaluation data, policy improvement, human feedback, simulation or other mechanisms. We are interested in what works—not in allegiance to a particular architecture.Bring statistical and machine-learning judgment to agentic systems. Use probabilistic modelling, statistical inference, ML, optimization or causal reasoning when they make the system more useful, more reliable or easier to improve.Generate high-quality software using AI coding systems. We expect you to work AI-natively. The objective is not to demonstrate how quickly you can type Python; it is to produce excellent software.Own difficult problems end to end. Work from an initially ambiguous business or decision problem through problem formulation, system design, implementation, evaluation and deployment.Challenge the problem definition. A technically sophisticated solution to the wrong problem is still the wrong solution. You should be comfortable questioning assumptions and reframing what is being optimized.Work directly with senior technical and business stakeholders. Explain complex ideas precisely without hiding behind jargon, and make uncertainty, assumptions and limitations explicit.

What We Are Looking For

Exceptional quantitative foundations

You have rigorous training in a highly quantitative discipline such as mathematics, physics, statistics, engineering, econometrics, operations research or another discipline involving substantial mathematical and quantitative reasoning.

A master's or PhD is welcome, but neither is a substitute for evidence of unusually strong analytical thinking. Exceptional candidates with a bachelor's degree are equally of interest.

You should be comfortable reasoning mathematically about unfamiliar problems rather than relying solely on methods you have used before.

Experience with agentic systems

You have meaningful hands-on experience designing or developing agentic systems.

We are particularly interested in experience involving some combination of:

multi-step reasoning and planning;structured outputs and stateful workflows;memory and context management;multi-agent or decomposed-agent architectures;agent evaluation;automated critique or refinement;feedback-driven adaptation;decision-support applications; andmechanisms intended to improve system performance over repeated iterations.

A chatbot with a system prompt is not, for our purposes, substantial experience building an agentic system. Neither is wrapping an LLM around a vector database and calling the result an agent.

Statistical and machine-learning literacy

You do not need to be a specialist in every branch of machine learning, but you should have enough statistical maturity to reason properly about evidence.

We expect practical familiarity with statistical modelling and machine learning and, more importantly, sound instincts around:

uncertainty;validation;sampling and selection effects;overfitting;experiment design;measurement;predictive versus causal claims;distribution shift; anddetermining whether a system actually works.

You should instinctively ask what the comparison is, how performance is being measured, whether the evaluation resembles the real problem, and how confident we should be in the result.

AI-native software engineering

You are extremely effective at producing software, but we do not equate software engineering ability with manually writing large quantities of code.

We expect you to use state-of-the-art coding agents extensively—potentially for essentially all implementations.

What matters is whether you can make those systems produce excellent code.

You Should Be Capable Of

designing a coherent software architecture before or while implementation emerges;decomposing work effectively for coding agents;inspecting and interrogating unfamiliar generated code;identifying bad abstractions, subtle bugs and unnecessary complexity;designing meaningful tests rather than merely achieving test coverage;maintaining reproducible environments;understanding APIs, data pipelines and production system boundaries;debugging systems whose implementation you did not personally type; andleaving behind code that another strong engineer can understand, extend and trust.

You are accountable for every line you ship even if you personally typed none of them.

The Intellectual Style We Value

The strongest candidates for this role tend to have several things in common.

They are deeply curious but difficult to impress. They enjoy abstraction, but they want abstractions to survive contact with data. They are happy to propose an ambitious architecture and equally happy to discard it when a simpler system performs better. They distinguish a compelling demonstration from convincing evidence. They are interested in why something works, where it stops working, and what experiment would distinguish competing explanations. They are willing to use LLMs aggressively without anthropomorphizing them or treating their behavior as magic. And when someone says, “This version feels better,” their instinct is to ask: “Better according to what measurement?”

You Will Probably Not Enjoy This Role If

Most of your interest is in conventional analytics, dashboards or notebook-based data science.Your experience with generative AI is primarily prompting, chatbot development or basic RAG applications.You prefer selecting an AI framework and following its abstractions to thinking from first principles about the underlying system.You regard agent behaviour as too unpredictable to evaluate quantitatively or you are satisfied with qualitative demonstrations when controlled measurement is possible.You believe increasingly elaborate agent architectures are inherently more intelligent.You enjoy writing code but are uncomfortable delegating implementation to AI systems.Conversely, you use AI-generated code without wanting to understand its architecture, test its assumptions or take responsibility for its quality.You need requirements to be fully specified before you can make progress.

Particularly Interesting, But Not Required

Experience with one or more of the following would be especially valuable:

decision science, causal inference, Bayesian modelling or optimization;reinforcement learning, contextual bandits, simulation or adaptive experimentation;agent evaluation, observability, benchmark construction or synthetic task generation;inference-time search, test-time computation, model routing or ensemble systems;human-in-the-loop or production agent architectures; andcomplex enterprise decision environments such as financial services, insurance, supply chain or logistics.

The role is product-oriented: you will shape the capabilities, workflows and evaluation systems that make our agentic products more useful, reliable and improvable.

You will turn difficult enterprise problems, user needs and client lessons into reusable product capabilities. Working with technical, product, domain and client-facing teams, you will identify high-leverage problems, formulate improvement hypotheses, and design experiments that distinguish genuine progress from superficial gains.

We expect you to move quickly from ideas to prototypes and measurable evidence without compromising reasoning, quality or technical integrity. The goal is not to build the most elaborate AI system, but products that make better decisions, whose performance we can understand, and which we know how to improve.

About Mphasis

Mphasis applies next-generation technology to help enterprises transform their businesses globally. Our work combines technology, domain expertise and applied innovation to solve complex problems for enterprise clients.

Equal Opportunity

Mphasis is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified candidates are considered without regard to characteristics protected by applicable federal, state, provincial or local law. Mphasis is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities throughout the recruitment process.

Join the pioneering AI Foundations Research team at IBM Research and contribute to shaping the future foundations of artificial intelligence. rows.title: Content Engineer

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Join in on pioneering procurement AI agents

Since 2019, Pactum has been at the forefront of transforming enterprise procurement with groundbreaking Agentic AI. We are not just automating a process; we are leading the industry in redefining how companies negotiate and manage supplier relationships. Our AI agents work around the clock, collaborating seamlessly with humans to discover negotiation opportunities and close supplier deals at scale. Trusted by over 50 of the world’s largest enterprises, including Walmart and Rolls-Royce, we deliver tangible value, drive agility, and unlock hidden potential.

Ready to make an impact? Join our passionate, global team and be part of a bold mission: to bring trust, transparency, and automation to every supplier negotiation.

As the first in our field, we address novel challenges with novel solutions. Our platform enables large enterprises to manage and monitor negotiations at scale, effectively saving money, boosting efficiency, and strengthening crucial supplier relationships. We’re built on a foundation of deep decision-making capabilities and cutting-edge innovation, which has allowed us to raise over $100 million in funding, including a Series C of $54 million in June 2025 led by Insight Partners. Our technology is proven—with notable achievements like a negotiation and signing carried out entirely by AI agents in just 87 seconds.

The Role

As a content engineer, you'll use generative tools to produce work a traditional marketer physically couldn't: visuals, video, and formats that would have needed a production team and a studio a year ago.

You'll operate across the full surface area of the brand: website, product launches, events, social, customer stories, and much more, because a category-defining company can't afford a content function that only does one thing well.

Your daily adventures will include

Build content across every format.Make things people stop scrolling for. Use tools like Midjourney, Higgsfield, Runway, and generative audio/video to create content that looks and feels like nothing else in procurement software.Own moments, not just assets. Turn a product launch, an event, or a customer win into a real content arc across web, social, and in-room experience.Think in category terms. rows.title: AI Software Engineer

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Applied AI Scientist — Agentic Decision Systems

Location: Canada or United States (US time zones)

Experience: Typically 2+ years of relevant applied work, although we care substantially more about the quality and difficulty of the problems you have solved than the number of years you have been solving them.

About The Role

We are looking for exceptional quantitative thinkers to build agentic systems that help people make better decisions.

This is not primarily a conventional data science role, an LLM application-development role, or a prompt-engineering role. We are interested in people who want to understand how intelligent systems can reason over complex problems, use tools and models effectively, learn from evidence, and become systematically better over time.

A Central Question In This Role Is

How do we make an agentic system measurably better at the decisions it is intended to support?

That means moving beyond intuition, demos and prompt alchemy. You will think about objectives, observability, feedback, evaluation datasets, statistical uncertainty, experiments, simulation, failure modes and improvement loops. You should be interested not only in building agents, but in developing rigorous ways for those agents—and the systems around them—to improve.

You will work on ambiguous, consequential enterprise problems where the answer is rarely “use an LLM.” Sometimes the right solution will involve an agent. Sometimes it will involve statistical modelling, optimization, machine learning, simulation, rules, or a surprisingly simple piece of mathematics. Frequently it will involve several of these working together.

We want people who are technically ambitious, intellectually demanding, empirically minded and impatient with hand-waving.

What You Will Do

Design and build agentic decision-support systems that can reason over data, interact with tools and models, maintain state, decompose complex problems and support consequential human decisions.Develop mechanisms for systematic improvement. Design evaluation frameworks, feedback loops, benchmarks, experiments and instrumentation that allow us to determine where a system fails, why it fails and whether a proposed change genuinely improves it.Turn “make the agent better” into a quantitative problem. Define measurable objectives and failure modes; build representative test sets; analyze performance distributions rather than anecdotes; and distinguish real improvement from movement on a convenient metric.Explore self-improving agentic architectures. This may involve reflection and critique, adaptive tool or model selection, memory, search, planning, generated training/evaluation data, policy improvement, human feedback, simulation or other mechanisms. We are interested in what works—not in allegiance to a particular architecture.Bring statistical and machine-learning judgment to agentic systems. Use probabilistic modelling, statistical inference, ML, optimization or causal reasoning when they make the system more useful, more reliable or easier to improve.Generate high-quality software using AI coding systems. We expect you to work AI-natively. The objective is not to demonstrate how quickly you can type Python; it is to produce excellent software.Own difficult problems end to end. Work from an initially ambiguous business or decision problem through problem formulation, system design, implementation, evaluation and deployment.Challenge the problem definition. A technically sophisticated solution to the wrong problem is still the wrong solution. You should be comfortable questioning assumptions and reframing what is being optimized.Work directly with senior technical and business stakeholders. Explain complex ideas precisely without hiding behind jargon, and make uncertainty, assumptions and limitations explicit.

What We Are Looking For

Exceptional quantitative foundations

You have rigorous training in a highly quantitative discipline such as mathematics, physics, statistics, engineering, econometrics, operations research or another discipline involving substantial mathematical and quantitative reasoning.

A master's or PhD is welcome, but neither is a substitute for evidence of unusually strong analytical thinking. Exceptional candidates with a bachelor's degree are equally of interest.

You should be comfortable reasoning mathematically about unfamiliar problems rather than relying solely on methods you have used before.

Experience with agentic systems

You have meaningful hands-on experience designing or developing agentic systems.

We are particularly interested in experience involving some combination of:

multi-step reasoning and planning;structured outputs and stateful workflows;memory and context management;multi-agent or decomposed-agent architectures;agent evaluation;automated critique or refinement;feedback-driven adaptation;decision-support applications; andmechanisms intended to improve system performance over repeated iterations.

A chatbot with a system prompt is not, for our purposes, substantial experience building an agentic system. Neither is wrapping an LLM around a vector database and calling the result an agent.

Statistical and machine-learning literacy

You do not need to be a specialist in every branch of machine learning, but you should have enough statistical maturity to reason properly about evidence.

We expect practical familiarity with statistical modelling and machine learning and, more importantly, sound instincts around:

uncertainty;validation;sampling and selection effects;overfitting;experiment design;measurement;predictive versus causal claims;distribution shift; anddetermining whether a system actually works.

You should instinctively ask what the comparison is, how performance is being measured, whether the evaluation resembles the real problem, and how confident we should be in the result.

AI-native software engineering

You are extremely effective at producing software, but we do not equate software engineering ability with manually writing large quantities of code.

We expect you to use state-of-the-art coding agents extensively—potentially for essentially all implementations.

What matters is whether you can make those systems produce excellent code.

You Should Be Capable Of

designing a coherent software architecture before or while implementation emerges;decomposing work effectively for coding agents;inspecting and interrogating unfamiliar generated code;identifying bad abstractions, subtle bugs and unnecessary complexity;designing meaningful tests rather than merely achieving test coverage;maintaining reproducible environments;understanding APIs, data pipelines and production system boundaries;debugging systems whose implementation you did not personally type; andleaving behind code that another strong engineer can understand, extend and trust.

You are accountable for every line you ship even if you personally typed none of them.

The Intellectual Style We Value

The strongest candidates for this role tend to have several things in common.

They are deeply curious but difficult to impress. They enjoy abstraction, but they want abstractions to survive contact with data. They are happy to propose an ambitious architecture and equally happy to discard it when a simpler system performs better. They distinguish a compelling demonstration from convincing evidence. They are interested in why something works, where it stops working, and what experiment would distinguish competing explanations. They are willing to use LLMs aggressively without anthropomorphizing them or treating their behavior as magic. And when someone says, “This version feels better,” their instinct is to ask: “Better according to what measurement?”

You Will Probably Not Enjoy This Role If

Most of your interest is in conventional analytics, dashboards or notebook-based data science.Your experience with generative AI is primarily prompting, chatbot development or basic RAG applications.You prefer selecting an AI framework and following its abstractions to thinking from first principles about the underlying system.You regard agent behaviour as too unpredictable to evaluate quantitatively or you are satisfied with qualitative demonstrations when controlled measurement is possible.You believe increasingly elaborate agent architectures are inherently more intelligent.You enjoy writing code but are uncomfortable delegating implementation to AI systems.Conversely, you use AI-generated code without wanting to understand its architecture, test its assumptions or take responsibility for its quality.You need requirements to be fully specified before you can make progress.

Particularly Interesting, But Not Required

Experience with one or more of the following would be especially valuable:

decision science, causal inference, Bayesian modelling or optimization;reinforcement learning, contextual bandits, simulation or adaptive experimentation;agent evaluation, observability, benchmark construction or synthetic task generation;inference-time search, test-time computation, model routing or ensemble systems;human-in-the-loop or production agent architectures; andcomplex enterprise decision environments such as financial services, insurance, supply chain or logistics.

The role is product-oriented: you will shape the capabilities, workflows and evaluation systems that make our agentic products more useful, reliable and improvable.

You will turn difficult enterprise problems, user needs and client lessons into reusable product capabilities. Working with technical, product, domain and client-facing teams, you will identify high-leverage problems, formulate improvement hypotheses, and design experiments that distinguish genuine progress from superficial gains.

We expect you to move quickly from ideas to prototypes and measurable evidence without compromising reasoning, quality or technical integrity. The goal is not to build the most elaborate AI system, but products that make better decisions, whose performance we can understand, and which we know how to improve.

About Mphasis

Mphasis applies next-generation technology to help enterprises transform their businesses globally. Our work combines technology, domain expertise and applied innovation to solve complex problems for enterprise clients.

Equal Opportunity

Mphasis is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified candidates are considered without regard to characteristics protected by applicable federal, state, provincial or local law. rows.title: Product Data Operations Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Reporting to: Bojan Gavric

Department: Product Build

Location: Boston, MA (Hybrid after 90 days)

Position Summary

Grand Circle Corporation is the leader in international travel, adventure and discovery for Americans aged 50+. Headquartered in Boston MA, and with more than 35 offices globally, more than two million Americans have traveled with our award-winning travel brands: Grand Circle Cruise Line, Overseas Adventure Travel and Grand Circle Travel.

We’re looking for a Product Data Operations Analyst to build, activate, maintain, and audit travel product data in GERT and related systems. This role protects the accuracy and integrity of product, pricing, inventory, linkage, schedule, and reservation-facing information so products can be sold, serviced, managed, and audited without preventable barriers. The analyst executes time-sensitive product changes, investigates data and system issues, validates results against approved sources, documents evidence, and works across Product Management, WW Finance, Revenue Management, Inventory, Operations, Web, Sales, Customer Service, and technology teams.

Key Responsibilities

Execute product changes: Complete assigned PCFs, reprices, rebuilds, calendar actions, corrections, and operational updates accurately and by the required deadline.Build and activate products: Create and maintain product hierarchy, product master data, program schedules, dates, extensions, hotels, ships, cabins, linkage, pricing, allotments, contracts, and related setup required for open-to-sales readiness.Maintain pricing: Process approved updates to base, air, single, pre/post, ship upgrade, optional, promotional, discount, and supplemental pricing; apply price protection and reservation maintenance when required.Protect data quality: Validate all work against approved flowcharts, CMS and Air Pricing grids, contracts, allotment documents, PCFs, reprice templates, and other authorized sources.Audit results: Perform product, pricing, linkage, inventory, gateway, allotment, schedule, reservation, upload-log, and before/after audits; complete secondary review for high-risk changes.Troubleshoot issues: Investigate inaccurate or incomplete data, booking barriers, upload failures, system limitations, and cross-system mismatches; identify root causes and coordinate resolution.Use data tools: Work with Excel, queries, uploads, macros, SQL-supported processes, MCTS, Python and internal audit tools to complete bulk updates, identify exceptions, and validate outputs.Track and document work: Maintain clear status, ownership, due dates, blockers, completion dates, evidence, and follow-up actions in the appropriate trackers and communication channels.Communicate and escalate: Follow up on missing approvals or source information, raise risks early, provide clear completion updates, and ensure unresolved dependencies have documented owners.Improve processes: Help test new tools, update SOPs, identify recurring errors and manual work, and recommend training, automation, or control improvements.

Qualifications

Strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate, complete work.Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and follow work through to closure.Analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to compare source documents with system results.Strong typing, data-entry, and general computer skills; experience working with databases or structured business systems.Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including lookups, filters, formulas, and data validation.Clear written and verbal English communication skills and the ability to follow detailed written procedures.Sound independent judgment, appropriate escalation, and the ability to maintain effective working relationships across departments.Ability to learn complex product structures, pricing rules, system dependencies, and audit requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with GERT, reservation, inventory, or master-data system.Experience with GCT products, pricing, inventory, reservations, product operations, finance operations, or data quality.Excel experience, including queries, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, macros, Python or structured templates.SQL, scripting, programming, upload, or automation experience.Experience testing system changes or tools and documenting defects, expected results, and acceptance criteria.Experience working from SOPs, maintaining audit evidence, and operating in a deadline-driven environment.

Key Competencies

Quality: Checks work carefully, uses approved sources, and treats audit evidence as part of completion.Speed: Prioritizes effectively and completes time-sensitive work without sacrificing accuracy.Teamwork: Shares information, supports peers, and coordinates smoothly across functions.Open & Courageous Communication: Raises risks, asks clarifying questions, and communicates ownership and status directly.Emotional Maturity: Remains professional, fact-based, and solution-focused during high-volume or changing work.Thriving in Change: Adapts to new products, processes, systems, tools, and priorities.Risk Taking: Tests better ways of working and contributes practical ideas for automation and process improvement.

Work Environment and Role Scope

This is a detail-intensive, deadline-driven role that combines transaction execution, analysis, quality control, documentation, and cross-functional coordination. Work volume may increase during build seasons, product launches, reprices, and major operational changes. The analyst is expected to protect customer and business outcomes by preventing inaccurate pricing, booking barriers, incomplete setup, reservation impact, and audit gaps.

Total Rewards

The base salary for this role is $70,000 annually for employees based in Boston, MA. Final compensation may vary and will be determined based on factors such as relevant experience, skills, internal equity, and geographic location. In addition to base pay, this role is eligible for an annual incentive bonus and first-class benefits, which include:

Health & wellness: Comprehensive and heavily subsidized medical, dental, and vision plans, plus on-site gym access, holistic wellness sessions, and group fitness classes Time for you: Substantial Paid Time Off (PTO), and 11 paid holidays- including Juneteenth, Memorial Day, and Labor Day – and Summer Fridays. Plus- extensive parental leave, with up to 12-16 weeks paid leave at 100% base salary.Travel more, spend less: 50% off our trips for you and a companion, 25% for additional immediate family members, and exclusive quarterly associate travel deals Your future, secured: 401(k) with company match, life insurance, and disability coverage Continuous growth: Tuition assistance for both professional and personal development, opportunities for professional development through oversees travel, and direct access to Pinnacle Leadership & Team Development.Extra perks: Commuter benefits, FSA options, pet insurance, home & auto discounts, and paid volunteer time off to give back to the community

To learn more, please visit our websites at www.gct.com, www.oattravel.com and www.grandcirclefoundation.org.

rows.title: Co-op - Robot Perception
rows.descriptionText:
Who We Are

With its A.I.-powered robotic technology platform, Symbotic is changing the way consumer goods move through the supply chain. Intelligent software orchestrates advanced robots in a high-density, end-to-end system – reinventing warehouse automation for increased efficiency, speed and flexibility.

Timeframe{{:}} Spring (Jan-May 2027)

At Symbotic, Early Career talent plays a meaningful role in helping us reimagine the future of supply chain automation. Through our Internship and Co-op programs, students have the opportunity to contribute to real projects, collaborate with experienced engineers and business leaders, and gain hands-on exposure to the technologies powering our end-to-end robotics and automation solutions. We are looking for curious, motivated students who are excited to solve complex problems, bring new perspectives to cross-functional teams, and see their work make an impact in a fast-moving, innovative environment.

Along the way, Interns and Co-ops are supported through mentorship, professional development, networking opportunities, and a robust calendar of events designed to help them build community and grow their careers. Symbotic offers transportation and housing benefits for students who meet our relocation requirements.

Continue reading below to learn more about this exciting opportunity!

About The Opportunities

Symbotic’s Robot Perception team is an accomplished group of engineers who are working on sophisticated algorithms in areas such as perception and computer vision.

Bot Perception interns will evaluate and propose new projects for replacing legacy tools with vision-based algorithms. These interns will scope projects from literature review, to dataset design and aggregation, training pipeline development, all the way through production deployment. Practical projects include vision-based collision avoidance. SLAM interns will develop and test algorithms for robust robot localization in complex, real-world environments, applying sensor fusion, state estimation, and probabilistic methods to solve SLAM challenges at scale.Industrial Vision interns will evaluate and enhance computer vision pipelines for accurate pose estimation of goods packaging in adapter cells using traditional and Machine Learning CV models.

What You’ll Do

Research and experiment with traditional computer vision methods and deep learning methods for object detection, classification, segmentation, pose estimation, anomaly detection on images or videos.Evaluate and benchmark computer vision methods on production data.Deploy software to production on robot hardware.Design data pre and post processing methods.Document designs, code, experiments, evaluations.Identify high-impact scenarios where AI Planning and machine learning can be applied to optimize the Symbotic robotics softwareAdapt state-of-the-art approaches or develop high-performance algorithms to solve real-world multi-robot problems.Conduct simulations and experiments to validate the performance of the multi-robot algorithms.Present results in verbal and written communications internally, and in top-tier academic venues.

What You’ll Need

Pursuing a Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related technical field.Proficiency in Python and/or C++, including experience writing code and working in Jupyter notebooks.Experience with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.Familiarity with computer vision and perception tools such as OpenCV, including image classification, object detection, segmentation, and camera calibration.Exposure to robotics perception concepts such as sensor fusion, SLAM, 3D pose representations, coordinate transforms, probabilistic graphical models, and Bayesian inference.Working knowledge of sensors, including RGB cameras, 3D sensors, and point cloud processing tools such as PCL.Experience working in Linux environments and using command-line tools.Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure, REST APIs, and/or SQL-based data tools such as Snowflake.Exposure to deployment or optimization tools such as Docker, ROS/ROS 2, Jetson, ONNX, VLMs, or Vision-Language-Action models is a plus.

What’s Good To Have

Publications at high-impact conferences/journals (e.g., CoRL, ICLR, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, RSS, ICRA, IROS, RAL, AAAI, ICAPS, IJCAI, JAIR, etc.) 

Our Environment 

Up to 10% of travel may be required. Employees must have a valid driver’s license and the ability to drive and/or fly to client and other customer locations.The employee is responsible for owning a credit card and managing expenses personally to be reimbursed on a bi-weekly basis.

Symbotic is an automation technology leader reimagining the supply chain with its end-to-end, AI-powered robotic and software platform. Symbotic reinvents the warehouse as a strategic asset for the world’s largest retail, wholesale, and food & beverage companies. Applying next-gen technology, high-density storage and machine learning to solve today's complex distribution challenges, Symbotic enables companies to move goods with unmatched speed, agility, accuracy and efficiency. As the backbone of commerce the Symbotic platform transforms the flow of goods and the economics of supply chain for its customers. For more information, visit www.symbotic.com.

rows.title: Associate Media Manager, Wellness
rows.descriptionText:
Our Beauty & Wellness division empowers consumers with trusted products that support self-care, from salon-quality styling tools to wellness devices like humidifiers and air purifiers. Our innovative products and solutions promote healthy living, elevating the lives of consumers every day. This business unit includes Braun, PUR, Honeywell, Vicks, Hot Tools, Drybar, Curlsmith, and Revlon brands, and this role may support one or more of these brands.

Look around your home, and you'll find us everywhere, in your kitchen, living room, bedroom, and bathroom. We are already making your everyday lives better. We are powered by knowledgeable, enthusiastic, and forward-thinking people committed to developing a culture of inclusion. Whether you are just starting your career or in need of a challenge, we recognize, develop, and empower talent!

Position: Associate Media Manager, Wellness

Department: Marketing for PUR, Braun, Vicks & Honeywell

Work Location: Marlborough, MA or Boston, MA (Hybrid; 3 days onsite per week). Employees based in Boston will be expected to work from the Marlborough office one day per week.

Hybrid Schedule: At Helen of Troy, we embrace a flexible hybrid work model designed to support collaboration and productivity. For roles eligible for hybrid work, our standard schedule includes in-office collaboration from Tuesday through Thursday, with the option to work remotely on Mondays and Fridays. Any updates to this model will be communicated in advance. Please note that hybrid eligibility and schedules may vary based on business needs and manager expectations.

What You Will Be Doing

We are seeking a data-driven and collaborative Associate Media Manager to support paid media strategy and execution for the Beauty & Wellness portfolio, including medical devices and air & water solutions. This role will help drive brand awareness, consumer acquisition, and revenue growth through optimized media campaigns across digital channels. The Associate Media Manager plays a pivotal role in shaping how consumers discover, engage with, and ultimately choose our portfolio of brands. As the day‑to‑day connective tissue between Brand Marketing, Sales, Creative, Analytics, and our media agency partners, you’ll help bring breakthrough campaigns to life and ensure they perform against business goals. This is an ideal role for someone who loves data-driven insights, thrives in cross‑functional environments, and wants to help build the future of wellness through smart, data‑driven activation.

The ideal candidate brings experience in consumer products or regulated categories, strong analytical skills, and a passion for improving consumer experience through effective media strategy.

Media Planning & Execution 

Support development and execution of full‑funnel paid media campaigns across digital, social, search, retail media, programmatic, and emerging channels for Wellness Brands. Translate brand and business goals into actionable media plans, calendars, and launch requirements. Partner closely with our media agency to ensure activation excellence, accurate flowcharts, and on‑time delivery for annual and tentpole campaigns. 

Performance Management & Optimization 

Monitor in‑flight performance across channels, tracking KPIs such as ROAS, CTR, CPC, conversion rate, and New‑to‑Brand sales for Beauty & Wellness, with a focus on Amazon media. Vet live tactics with agency partners and recommend agile optimizations to improve efficiency and scale. Build clear, insight‑driven reporting for internal teams with actionable next steps. 

Insights, Forecasting & Strategy Support 

Leverage consumer insights, market trends, and competitive intelligence to inform media strategy. Support testing agendas (A/B creative testing, audience segmentation, channel mix) to drive continuous improvement. Collaborate with brand, sales, and consumer insights teams to ensure media efforts align with consumer journeys and purchase behavior. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration 

Partner with Brand Marketing, Sales, Content and Analytics teams to align media strategies with business goals. Serve as the day‑to‑day bridge between Brand, Sales, Creative, eCommerce, and the media agency. Provide creative teams with channel specific guidance to ensure assets meet platform best practices. Align campaign needs across brands, ensuring smooth launches and cohesive consumer experiences. 

Budget & Vendor Management 

Track pacing, actualization, and budget adherence across campaigns. Support agency management, ensuring clarity on deliverables, timelines, and performance expectations. Investigate performance trends and push partners toward continuous improvement. 

Skills Needed To Be Successful In This Role

Track record of improving digital/media performance and KPIs.Strong problem-solving skills with a proven ability to navigate complex, fast-paced, multi-stakeholder environments with incomplete information and competing priorities.Experience with media budgeting and spend management, including pacing, forecasting, and optimization.Knowledge of media planning processes and deliverables, including media plans, flowcharts, creative specifications, and billing.Understanding of eCommerce, retail media ecosystems, consumer behavior, and the purchase journey.Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable recommendations that support business and revenue goals.Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to clearly present performance insights and recommendations to stakeholders.Self-starter with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset and the ability to work independently while driving results.Strong project management skills with the ability to prioritize multiple deadlines while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.Demonstrated ownership, accountability, adaptability, and agility in dynamic environments.Curious, collaborative team player with a commitment to continuous learning.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or related field. 2+ years of experience in digital media, performance marketing, or media planning.Retail media experience, ideally with Amazon Ads and Walmart Connect.Experience working with agencies and managing external partners. Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams (Brand, eCommerce, Sales, Creative, Regulatory). Digital media planning and execution (paid social, search, display, retail media). Performance marketing expertise (CAC, ROAS, conversion optimization). Proficiency in Google Ads, Meta, Amazon Ads, DSPs, The Trade Desk.Experience with analytics and reporting tools (Excel, Google Analytics, BI platforms). Authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

Preferred Qualifications

Advertising agency experience.Experience in consumer products, wellness, healthcare, or regulated categories.

In Massachusetts, the standard base pay range for this role is $70,447 - $88,059 annually. This base pay range is specific to Massachusetts and may not be applicable to other locations. Actual salaries will vary based on several factors, including but not limited to location, experience, skill level, and performance. The range listed is just one component of the total compensation package for employees.

Benefits: Salary + Bonus, Healthcare, Dental, Vision, Paid Holidays, Paid Parental Leave, 401(k) with company match, Basic Life Insurance, Short Term Disability (STD), Long Term Disability (LTD), Paid Time Off (PTO), Paid Charitable (volunteer) Leave, and Educational Assistance.

Wondering if you should apply? Helen of Troy welcomes people as diverse as our brands! Have the confidence to come as who you are because your point of view, skills, and experience will make us stronger. If you're eager to share new ideas and try new things, we want to hear from you.

For more information about Helen of Troy, visit www.helenoftroy.com. You can also find us on LinkedIn, and Glassdoor.

Helen of Troy is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where all employees can thrive. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, pregnancy, genetic information, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected category under applicable federal, state, and local laws.

We will provide individuals with disabilities with reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application process. To request an accommodation, please contact Human Resources at (915) 225-8000. 

Founded in 1968, Helen of Troy is a leading global consumer products company with operations across North America, South America, Europe, and Asia. Our portfolio includes trusted brands such as OXO, Hydro Flask, Osprey, Honeywell, PUR, Braun, Vicks, Hot Tools, Drybar, Curlsmith, Revlon, and Olive & June – many of which rank among the top brands in their consumer goods categories.

We grow and strengthen our brands through innovation, operational excellence, and a collaborative culture focused on delivering exceptional products and experiences for consumers worldwide.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed and are not intended to be an exhaustive list of responsibilities.

Management reserves the right to modify the duties and responsibilities of the position at any time.

rows.title: AVP, Senior Azure DevOps Developer
rows.descriptionText:
CREA, LLC is a full-service low-income housing tax credit (LIHTC) syndicator forming long-term relationships with investors and developers that cultivate success and improve lives. With over 20 years in affordable housing, CREA has raised $14.1 billion - resulting in the formation of 106K+ homes within 1,122 communities across the country. Thanks to the contribution of over 130 employees, CREA continues to look for talented and passionate individuals who are excited about opportunities to grow with us into the future.
Physical Presence: In-Office | Tue – Thu; Flexible | Mon & FriOpen to: Indianapolis, IN, or Boston, MAReports to: VP, Software DevelopmentWork Authorization: CREA does not provide employment visa sponsorship. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship from CREA.
We are seeking an experienced AVP / Senior Azure DevOps Developer with a minimum of 7 years of relevant professional experience; 10+ years is preferred. This hands-on leadership role combines Azure engineering, DevSecOps, infrastructure automation, full-stack software development, and Microsoft 365 integration. The successful candidate will help modernize applications, strengthen cloud operations, improve reliability, and establish scalable engineering practices.
Primary Responsibilities:Azure Cloud Engineering & OperationsDesign, deploy, configure, and maintain secure, scalable Azure environments across development, test, and production.Support Azure services including App Service, Functions, Virtual Machines, Storage, Key Vault, Monitor, Log Analytics, Azure SQL Database, SQL Managed Instance, and private networking.Implement monitoring, alerting, logging, backup, disaster recovery, reliability, and operational support practices.Apply cloud governance, tagging, capacity planning, cost optimization, and platform standards.
DevOps, CI/CD & Infrastructure as CodeBuild and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and/or GitHub Actions for application and infrastructure releases.Automate infrastructure provisioning through Terraform and/or Azure Bicep using reusable, source-controlled modules.Automate configuration, deployments, testing, approvals, rollback, and release validation using YAML, PowerShell, Bash, or Python.Advance DevSecOps practices by integrating code quality, dependency, secret, and security controls into delivery pipelines.
Full-Stack Application DevelopmentDesign, develop, test, and maintain responsive web applications using Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.Develop and support backend applications and services using PHP and Laravel.Create secure REST APIs, reusable services, background jobs, and integrations with enterprise systems.Troubleshoot across front-end, API, database, identity, network, and cloud hosting layers.

Security, Compliance & ReliabilityApply secure coding, least privilege, secrets management, encryption, network segmentation, and identity-first design practices.Partner with cybersecurity and compliance teams on vulnerabilities, audit evidence, access controls, and remediation.Participate in incident response, root cause analysis, problem management, and continuous improvement.
Technical Leadership & CollaborationProvide hands-on technical leadership, architecture guidance, code reviews, engineering standards, and mentoring.Work with business, engineers, vendors, and business stakeholders within Agile delivery practices.Produce architecture diagrams, technical specifications, deployment runbooks, operating procedures, and troubleshooting guides.
Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.Minimum 7 years of professional experience across software development, Azure cloud engineering, DevOps, or platform operations.Hands-on experience deploying and supporting production workloads in Microsoft Azure.Strong development experience with Angular and TypeScript, together with PHP and Laravel.Practical experience creating and troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines and source-control workflows.Experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Azure Bicep, or an equivalent technology.Experience developing and consuming REST APIs and integrating applications with identity and enterprise platforms.Working knowledge of SQL Server, T-SQL, and Azure database services.Proficiency with at least one automation language such as PowerShell, Bash, or Python.Demonstrated technical leadership, troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Preferred:10+ years of relevant professional experience across software development, Azure cloud engineering, DevOps, or platform operations.Experience developing Microsoft Office Add-ins for Outlook, Excel, or Word.Experience with Microsoft Graph API, SharePoint Online, Entra ID application registrations, and single sign-on.Experience with Docker and container-based delivery; exposure to Azure Kubernetes Service is beneficial.Experience with Power Platform, Azure API Management, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, or Azure AI services.Experience modernizing on-premises applications and databases for Azure.Experience in regulated or audit-focused environments.Microsoft certifications such as AZ-104, AZ-204, AZ-305, or AZ-400.
Core Competencies:Cloud: Azure App Service, Functions, VMs, Storage, Key Vault, Monitor, Log Analytics, networkingDevOps: Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Git, YAML, release automation, testing, approvals, rollbackInfrastructure as Code: Azure Bicep, reusable modules and environment configurationDevelopment: Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, PHP, LaravelMicrosoft Integration: Office Add-ins, Microsoft Graph, SharePoint Online, Entra ID, OAuth 2.0, OpenID ConnectData: SQL Server, T-SQL, Azure SQL Database, SQL Managed Instance, REST/JSONAutomation: PowerShell, Bash, Python; Power Automate and Power Apps beneficial
Our Values:We work as a family, investing in each other, worthy causes, and the communities we serve.We have integrity in all that we do; we embrace differences and treat others with kindness and respect.We believe that, with teamwork, we can accomplish anything and pursue inventive solutions for our clients.
CompensationCompensation for this position is determined based on factors such as education, qualifications, relevant experience, and geographic location.Boston, MA: $135,000 – $155,000Indianapolis, IN: $110,000 – $130,000

Own the QA process across multiple projects and run comprehensive QA testing for new promotions, marketing automations, and feature releases across the iLottery platform, mobile app, and website.Compose, build and finalize test plans, test cases, and regression testing procedures to validate technical functionality, platform improvements, and player-facing features.Ensure that new promotions, player journeys, and segmentation logic function as encouraged from both a technical and customer-facing perspective.Log, track, and analyze defects in collaboration with internal teams and vendor partners; clearly document issues for effective resolution.Work closely with product managers, developers, and marketing leads to ensure business and technical requirements offer clarity across business units and translate into effective QA plans. rows.descriptionText:
Job Title:

Pricing & Commercial Analytics Co-op

Job Description:

Here at Entegris, we use advanced science to enable technologies that transform the world, and we are seeking employees who have the drive to continue the mission.

The Role:

Our site in Bedford, MA is seeking a Pricing & Commercial Analytics Co-op to join our team for the Spring 2027 season. This assignment is intended to be 6 months in duration.

The Pricing & Commercial Analytics Co-op will support Entegris global pricing and commercial strategy initiatives. The individual will work closely with the Pricing & Commercial Strategy team to analyze pricing performance, evaluate market opportunities, develop customer-level insights, and support strategic projects that drive profitable growth. This role provides exposure to executive-level commercial decision making, pricing strategy development, sales effectiveness initiatives, market analysis, and data-driven business planning.

What You’ll Do:


Support pricing analysis for products, customers, and regions.Develop dashboards and reports to monitor pricing, margins, and commercial performance.Analyze market trends, competitive activity, and pricing opportunities.Assist with price increase planning and execution activities.Support rebate, contract, and Long-Term Agreement (LTA) analytics.Perform profitability and customer segmentation analyses.Collaborate with Sales, Finance, Marketing, and Business Unit teams on commercial initiatives.Support AI-enabled pricing and sales analytics projects.


What We Seek:


Strong analytical and quantitative skills.Intellectual curiosity and willingness to challenge assumptions.Strong Excel and data analysis capability required. Experience with Power BI, Tableau, SQL, or Python preferred. Excellent communication and presentation skills.Self-motivated and highly collaborative.


Desired Major(s) & Graduation Year:


Pursuing a degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Data Analytics, Engineering, or related field.Expected graduation year 2027 or later preferred.


Eligibility:


Must be a currently enrolled studentAvailable to work 40 hours a week, M-F (8a-5p) beginning in January through JuneMust be familiar with the university’s requirements to participate in a co-op program


WHY WORK AT ENTEGRIS?

Lead. Inspire. Innovate. Define Your Future. 

Not everyone who works for a global company shares the same background, experiences and perspectives. We leverage the differences of our employees to bring new ideas to the table. Every employee throughout the company is encouraged to share input on projects and initiatives. Our decision-making process is truly a collaborative effort as we realize there are leaders at every level of the organization. We put our values at the core of how we operate as an organization — not just when it’s convenient, but in a lasting and meaningful way. We want the time and energy you spend here to have a positive impact on your life inside and outside of the office.

Our total rewards package goes above and beyond just a paycheck. Whether you’re looking to build your career, improve your health, or protect your wealth, we offer generous benefits to help you achieve your goals.Compensation: $20-$30/hour range with actual pay dependent on candidate overall skills for the roleValues-driven culture with colleagues that rally around People, Accountability, Creativity and Excellence Entegris does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role.

rows.title: Customer Experience Co-Op
rows.descriptionText:
At Bose Corporation, we believe sound is the most powerful force on earth — and for over 60 years, we have been a company built on innovation, excellence, and independence. Privately owned, fiercely customer-focused, and driven by our values, we continue to lead industries and transform lives through sound.

Today, Bose Corporation is entering an exciting new era. Across multiple global Business Units and Global Functions, we are shaping the future of audio technology, automotive, luxury, and premium experiences. We invite you to join us in this transformation.

Job Description

ABOUT THE CO-OP PROGRAM

Bose Corporation is seeking students to participate in our Co-op Program who share our belief that sound is power. During the six-month co-op, students will have the chance to apply classroom learning in a hands-on work environment. Co-op participants will network across the business to gain diverse perspectives within Bose Corporation. Additionally, co-ops will connect with other students and colleagues, building valuable professional relationships for the future.

Spring Co-op: Candidates must be available to work full-time (40 hours per week) in a hybrid, in-office format from January 11 through June 25, 2027. No relocation assistance is available.

Being currently authorized to work in the U.S. is a precondition of employment for this position.

THE ROLE

Role

We're looking for a Customer Experience Co-Op to join the Customer Experience Strategy and help us elevate our brand and commercial experiences across our priority digital touchpoints. In this role you will:

Contribute to the execution of website campaigns across product, brand, and commercial initiativesAssist in the production and maintenance of Bose Stories pages, ensuring content is engaging, on-brand, and aligned to campaign objectivesManage ongoing content maintenance, including refreshes, updates, and content expirationContribute to testing and optimization initiatives to enhance engagement and conversionAnalyze customer feedback surface insights and inform recommendations.Conduct competitive research to identify trends, best practices, and opportunities to improve the Bose customer experience.Develop and refine customer journey maps that bring together customer needs, pain points, and opportunities to inform future experience improvements.Support review initiatives, including but not limited to: review seeding, incentivized reviews, always on review programs.Own defined workstreams independently, proactively managing timelines, coordinating with cross-functional partners, and communicating progress and risks.

Requirements

To excel in this role, candidates should possess the following:

In progress of or recently obtained Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Digital Media or similar fieldFamiliarity with principles and concepts within digital marketing, web content, or eCommerceFamiliarity with Microsoft Office Suite, and special preference to experience with Jira, Contentsquare, and Google AnalyticsExperience with meeting management, program coordination, and workback planningStrong organizational and project management skills with attention to detailComfort leveraging approved AI tools to improve efficiency and enhance output qualityExcellent communication and collaboration skillsEager to learn and continuously improveCurious mindset with a desire to explore new ideas and approachesAdaptable and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a fast-paced environmentProactive self-starter with a strong sense of ownershipPassionate about developing and honing craft within digital experience and contentCollaborative team player who builds strong cross-functional relationships

At Bose, you're inspired to be and do your best and are rewarded for your unique talents! Our compensation is thoughtfully tailored to your skills, experience, education, and location, and goes beyond base salary. The hiring range for this position in the primary work location of Atlanta, Georgia is: $22.00-$28.00 per hour.The hiring range for other Bose work locations may vary. In addition to competitive base pay we offer rewards including bonus programs, comprehensive health and welfare benefits, a 401(k) plan, plus exclusive perks designed to support your wellbeing, and a generous employee discount where you can immerse yourself in our products and experiences. We are a proudly independent company—driven by purpose, guided by our values, and united by a belief in the power of sound. As the world leader in audio experiences, we’re creating what’s next—pushing boundaries and delivering transformative sound experiences for people everywhere. Join us and make your next career move a mic-drop. Let’s Make Waves.

rows.title: Analyst Financial Services
rows.descriptionText:
SPEED & SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy and all genders are welcome. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.
