Social Strategy Deployment & Hub Operations

Help shape and deliver a best-in-class social strategy, transforming how our brands engage with consumers across social platforms.Operationalise the global social strategy into scalable, practical playbooks, toolkits, and ways of working for global and regional teams.Launch and scale our Social Hub model across brands and regions, embedding consistent social operating processes and standards.Support Regional leads, with reactive content requirements, efficiently and effectively.

Social Activation & Campaign Delivery

Lead end-to-end campaign delivery, day-to-day agency management, in-flight optimization, publishing schedules, and multi-market content calendars.Drive influencer and creator campaign governance while building active, highly engaged, and responsive online communities.

Governance, Risk & Brand Stewardship

Guard global social governance, ensuring adherence to brand strategy, tone of voice, responsible marketing, and regulatory requirements.Partner closely with Legal, Consumer Care, and Corporate Affairs to manage compliance and brand escalation protocols across markets.Lead agency content social reviews, i.e. “Walk the wall”, Annual Planning, North Star workshops, Brand Day. 

Measurement, Analytics & Partnerships

Lead social reporting dashboards, benchmarks, and optimization cycles to translate engagement data into actionable creative recommendations.Manage social agency partnerships daily, support JBP relationships with social platform partners, and share emerging trends and innovations.

What can you expect from Mars?

Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus.

rows.title: Head of Product & Product Design
rows.descriptionText:
Who are we?

Hi, we’re Tails.com – we turn good days into great years for dogs and their humans.

We’re working towards longer lives for millions of healthy, happy dogs by providing tailored nutrition that adapts to each dog’s unique needs. It all starts with a few simple questions about their age, breed, zoomie level and tastebuds. From there, owners can create a personalised meal plan that’s delivered to their door every month. No guesswork, no overwhelm. Just exactly the right care for every dog, every day. It’s pretty clever stuff.

As a certified B Corp, being a responsible business is built into how we work – upholding high social and environmental standards to create better walkies for generations to come.

Now, we’re cooking up big plans. Having created an entirely new category in dog food, we have the backing of Purina – one of the world’s largest pet food companies. You’ll join a bunch of smart people working towards these same goals (and a bunch of very smart office dogs, all working on their own thing).

Job Title

Head of Product & Product Design

Reporting of the role

Director of Proposition and Product

Overview Of The Job

This is a senior leadership role responsible for setting the product vision, strategy and ways of working across Product Management and Product Design at Tails.com.

In this role, you’ll lead and grow a high-performing team of 5 Product Managers and 4 Product Designers, ensuring we create compelling digital and physical experiences that delight our customers and deliver meaningful commercial impact. You’ll work closely with senior leaders across Engineering, Commercial, Marketing, Data and the wider business to shape priorities, guide investment decisions and ensure products and services are successfully delivered from ideation through launch and beyond.

This role is a blend of strategic leadership and hands-on product stewardship, stretching from shaping company-level strategy to ensuring teams are set up to deliver high-quality outcomes through strong discovery, delivery and continuous improvement.

3 Best Things About The Job

Digital experiences with a physical consequence. Here you get to build digital experiences that have immediate physical consequences. The algorithms and journeys you are in charge of, lead to personalisation that is more than just Markefing fluff, it creates a fully customised meal plan designed to help dogs live longer.Shape the direction of the company and the product strategy. Use your knowledge and expertise to feed back up into the business direction and strategy and translate long-term company goals into a concrete product strategy and roadmap, acting as a strong bridge to unite engineering, design, marketing and more around one excellent digital experience.Shape how product operates, not just what gets shipped. You’re inheriting a talented team of PMs and Designers, with a good foundation. The opportunity is now upgrading the operating model that gives them a clear craft standard, embedding strong discovery and experimentation habits, and protecting their space to solve real problems.

Measures of success – In the first few months, you would have:

Got to know your team inside and out. You know what makes each PM and Designer tick, what’s currently holding them back, and where they need your backing or coaching.Built honest relationships across the business. You’ve spent time with Engineering, Customer, Marketing, Data, Ops leads and more, cementing how Product partners with them day to day.Wrapped your head around the business model and digital experience. You understand our subscription unit economics, retention levers, and how digital decisions actually affect operations.You know the digital experience well now, and can confidently map opportunities to the right part of the customer journey.Led your first quarterly planning cycle. You helped your team turn competing stakeholder priorities and problems to solve into a clear, focused roadmap that is bold and contributes to commercial targets but realistic and ensures smooth running in teams.Spotted the friction points in how we work. You’ve identified the first pragmatic improvements to our discovery, experimentation or delivery habits, without trying to rewrite the entire playbook on day one.

Roles & Responsibilities:

PeopleLeading, mentoring, inspiring and developing Product Management and Product Design into a high-performing, outcomes-focused function within the businessSetting and embedding best practice across product management and product design, including discovery, test-and-learn approaches, stakeholder communication, customer engagement, analytics and experimentationProductEnsuring products and services are successfully delivered end to end, from ideation and discovery through launch, iteration and continuous improvementBuilding, owning and championing a culture of accountability, with clear ownership of metrics and outcomes, and reporting that meets the needs of different stakeholder groupsOwning and evolving the overall product vision and strategy, ensuring alignment with company strategy and clear articulation of customer and commercial valueContributing to the assessment and prioritisation of strategic and large-scale initiatives, bringing product leadership expertise to shape direction, sequencing and investment decisionsProcessPartnering closely with the Leadership team to build and maintain a product roadmap that balances customer needs, commercial impact, team capacity and long-term strategyRepresenting product and design to leadership and the businessWorking in deep partnership with senior leaders across Engineering, Research, Brand, Marketing and other functions to build strong relationships, enable effective decision-making and drive successful deliveryWhat you will need:

Significant experience as a Head of Product, Group Product Manager or Lead Product Manager, with a proven track record of building, leading and developing teams of both PMs and Designers.

Specifically for this Role

Build trust through transparency and proactive communication, especially with hands-on senior stakeholdersStrong instincts for organisational design, not just people leadership, including levelling, competencies and future resourcingEnergised by building structure rather than expecting it to already existHands-on people leadership. Regular 1:1s, visible career development and proactive check-ins aren't optional extras here, they're core to the roleComfortable quantifying the revenue impact of product decisions and holding your own in financial and commercial forumsConfidence to hold product boundaries with other functions, protecting the team's ability to own problems, not just execute requestsExperienced leading designers, directly or through a design lead. Holds design to customer and commercial outcomes, and trusts the Design Lead to own craft, quality and how the design team runs day to day.

Classic Product Skills

Defines and delivers product strategy and roadmaps tied to clear business, customer and commercial outcomesApplies product discovery to ambiguous, complex problems and turns them into clear goals and plansInfluences prioritisation and decision-making at senior levels across the organisationBuilds experimentation and testing into ways of working, not just intuition-led betsWorks as a true peer to engineering, not just a requester of deliveryDeep passion for commercially viable, omnichannel customer experiences

Nice to have

Experience applying AI to product workflows to improve speed and/or qualityExperience in D2C subscription businessesExperience of running a product department during a digital transformation

A few of our core benefits:

Private Healthcare through AXAA 9 day fortnight - our office is closed every other Friday!25 days of Annual Leave and 8 additional remote working days

For more information on our benefits, perks and what makes us unique, please visit our website here

What’s next?

If this sounds like it matches your experience and what you’d love to do, we can’t wait to hear from you! If you’re unsure whether you fit our criteria exactly, please get in touch anyway. And because we believe that diverse teams perform better, we’d especially love to hear from you if you’re from an under-represented demographic.

Here’s a taster of how our recruitment process works:

Once you have applied your CV will be reviewed by the Talent Acquisition Team.If selected, you will then have a call with the TA Team who will tell you more about us and the role, as well as learning more about your skills and experience.Should you be successful, the next stage will be a video call with the hiring manager.If successful, you will be invited to present a task back to a panel of interviewers.The final stage is an interview with Leadership.

Our Commitment

We’re proud to be an active equal opportunity employer. We want to give everyone a fair chance to join us in changing the world of pet food for good. We do this by conducting a structured recruitment process for all candidates, as well as actively promoting our roles to communities that are under-represented at Tails.com.

During your interview process you’ll meet some of our team with varying levels of responsibility and experience. We want to give every candidate a fair interview process and if you need any reasonable adjustments made, please let us know.

,

The Strategy & Digital Manager is the primary architect of the plant’s future-state operating model. This dual-purpose leadership role is responsible for orchestrating the site’s five-year strategic roadmap—aligning capacity, sourcing, and "Funding the Growth" initiatives with long-term business objectives—while simultaneously spearheading the plant’s Industry 4.0 transformation.

As the site’s central strategist and digital gatekeeper, you will bridge the gap between long-term operational planning and a digitally-enabled shop floor. Maintain factory capacity utilization models following the release of monthly forecasts. Digital Transformation

Act as the central gatekeeper for all plant-level digital requests and technology needs. Partner with plant functional leads to evaluate digital opportunities based on ROI, operational pain points, and technical feasibility. Drive the cultural shift toward digital ways of working through structured training, communication, and building a network of digital champions. Drive the utilization of both operational advanced analytics at all levels in the site to optimize production, minimize waste, and improve process efficiencies.

Experience using analytical skills and working knowledge of databases and spreadsheets. Experience in Manufacturing Operations, Logistics, Planning, Quality, Safety, or Finance.

Proficiency in Agile/Scrum and project or product lifecycle managementStrong interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate complex data to all levels of the organization.

,

Required

rows.title: Data Scientist
rows.descriptionText:
JOB DETAILS

JOB BAND: C – Data Scientist

CONTRACT TYPE: Permanent

DEPARTMENT: BBC CCOG Audiences Data

LOCATION: London Broadcasting House or Salford Dock House – Hybrid (2 days a week in the office on average).

PROPOSED SALARY RANGE: £40,000 - £50,000 depending on relevant skills, knowledge and experience. The expected salary range for this role reflects internal benchmarking and external market insights.

We're happy to discuss flexible working. If you'd like to, please indicate your preference in the application – though there's no obligation to do so now. Flexible working will be part of the discussion at offer stage.

PURPOSE OF THE ROLE

Fancy working on one of the largest media datasets in the world, helping the BBC model how audiences discover, consume and engage with content?

The BBC is a major stakeholder in industry-leading audience measurement systems. Alongside this, our digital products—including iPlayer, Sounds, News and Sport—reach millions of people every week and generate billions of audience interactions.

As a Data Scientist, you will develop statistical and machine learning models that help understand audience behaviour, improve audience measurement, and support strategic decision-making across the BBC. Working with a range of data sources, from digital behavioural data to audience panels and surveys, you'll deliver robust analysis that influences how the BBC measures success and plans for the future.

WHY JOIN THE TEAM

You'll join a team of around 12 Data Scientists working on a diverse range of modelling challenges. Our work spans audience measurement, forecasting, consumer behaviour, experimentation and applied machine learning.

We work closely with data engineers, researchers, analysts and stakeholders across the BBC, giving you the opportunity to contribute to high-impact projects with visible organisational value.

You'll also be part of a wider data science community and have dedicated time to develop your technical skills, explore new approaches and contribute to best practice across the organisation.

Your Key Responsibilities And Impact

 Apply statistical and machine learning techniques to answer business questions and improve understanding of audience behaviour, combining data from multiple sources including digital activity data, audience panels and surveys. Contribute to the design, development and evaluation of analytical models and solutions, working with senior data scientists and engineering partners to support project delivery and production deployment where appropriate. Develop reproducible analytical workflows using SQL, Python or R on our data and machine learning platform, including exploratory analysis and proof-of-concepts. Develop an understanding of the BBC and wider media landscape to contextualise models and analysis, and communicate findings, assumptions and recommendations appropriately to non-technical stakeholders. Keep up to date with developments in machine learning and generative AI, applying relevant techniques appropriately and contributing ideas for improving team practices.

Essential Criteria

YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

 Further degree in mathematics, statistics, computer science, econometrics or related field, or equivalent work experience. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience applying data science and statistical techniques to solve business problems by translating ambiguous business questions into practical analytical solutions and selecting appropriate methods, models or algorithms. Understanding of statistical inference, experimental design and causal reasoning, with the ability to analyse audience behaviours and preferences, distinguish meaningful patterns from statistical noise, and draw robust, evidence-based conclusions. Proven ability to communicate analytical findings clearly and confidently to stakeholders, adapting detail and recommendations to different audiences. Good programming skills in Python or R with version control (Git or others), alongside strong SQL skills for working with large datasets, including data preparation and validation.

Desired But Not Required

 Experience in a commercial, research or consulting analytical role. Experience applying data science techniques to audience, consumer, marketing or media measurement problems. Experience working with audience behaviour data, digital activity data or related panel datasets, in a research, marketing, strategy or product environment. Experience building machine learning models to scale and deploying them into production. Experience writing clean, well-structured and maintainable code, with an understanding of software engineering best practices such as unit testing, test-driven development, version control and collaborative development using GitHub. Familiarity with applying modern AI techniques, including large language models, to analytical or operational problems.

If you can bring some of these skills and experience, along with transferable strengths, we’d love to hear from you and encourage you to apply.

Freelancers are eligible to apply if they have been on a Worker Contract (more info here) continuously for 6 months. If less than 6 months (or they have had a break of 3 weeks or more between engagements), they must seek Divisional HR approval to apply.

Disclaimer

This job description is a written statement of the essential characteristics of the job, with its principal accountabilities, incorporating a note of the skills, knowledge and experience required for a satisfactory level of performance. This is not intended to be a complete, detailed account of all aspects of the duties involved.

Please note: If you were to be offered this role, the BBC will conduct Employment screening checks which include Reference checks; Eligibility to work checks; and if applicable to the role, Safeguarding and Adverse media/Social media checks. Any offer made is conditional on these checks being satisfactory.

Before your start date, you may need to disclose any unspent convictions or police charges, in line with our Recruitment policy. This allows us to discuss any support you may need and assess any risks. Failure to disclose may result in the withdrawal of your offer.

For any general queries, please contact: bbchr@bbc.co.uk

We are unable to accept applications via CV and only applications made online will be considered. Please click on the APPLY NOW button to proceed with your application.

Redeployment

The BBC is committed to redeploying employees seeking suitable alternative employment within the BBC and they will be given priority consideration ahead of other applicants. Priority consideration means for those employees seeking redeployment their application will be considered alongside anyone else at risk of redundancy, prior to any individuals being considered who are not at risk.

What you'll be doing Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines for iOS and Android on GitLab CIArchitect pipeline stages for fail-fast execution: cheapest checks first (lint, compile, static analysis), expensive checks last (device farm tests)Build smart test routing: analyze MR diffs to determine which tests need physical devices and which can run on emulators, so 80% of MRs never touch the device farmBuild flaky test detection and quarantine systems. You measure failure rates, waste rates, device utilization, and pipeline duration and you use those numbers to prioritize your workPreferred Qualifications Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible, or equivalent) for managing cloud and on-premises infrastructureWorking knowledge of WiFi and BLE protocols enough to understand why tests that exercise radio communication behaves differently from pure software testsExperience with mobile test automation frameworks (XCUITest, Espresso, Appium) not to write tests, but to understand what they need from infrastructureExperience scaling CI for high-volume, automated code generation (agentic engineering, bot-authored MRs)  What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. rows.title: Credit Risk Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Join us at Barclays as a Credit Risk Data Analyst. As part of the A-IRB Programme, you will support the delivery of critical regulatory objectives by translating business and regulatory requirements into clear requirements, data specifications, and solution designs. Working across business, risk, and technology teams, you will drive requirements capture, stakeholder engagement, data analysis, and support testing and governance activities to enable successful A-IRB implementation.

To be successful as a Credit Risk Data Analyst, you should have experience with:


Solid business & data analysis capability, including translating regulatory (IRB) requirements into structured requirements and data specificationsExperience working with credit risk data (e.g. PD, LGD, EAD) and understanding data lineage, quality, and controlsExperience in IRB / Basel / regulatory change programmes or similar risk transformation initiativesAbility to engage stakeholders across business, risk and technology to gather, challenge and refine requirements


Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include


Knowledge of data tooling, data modelling, or MI/reporting environmentsExperience working in structured delivery environments (e.g. L0–L3 requirements, Agile or large-scale programmes)


You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

This role can be based in Canary Wharf, Northampton or Glasgow.

Purpose of the role

To support the organisation, achieve its strategic objectives by the identification of business requirements and solutions that address business problems and opportunities.

Accountabilities


Identification and analysis of business problems and client requirements that require change within the organisation.Development of business requirements that will address business problems and opportunities.Collaboration with stakeholders to ensure that proposed solutions meet their needs and expectations.Support the creation of business cases that justify investment in proposed solutions.Conduct feasibility studies to determine the viability of proposed solutions.Support the creation of reports on project progress to ensure proposed solutions are delivered on time and within budget.Creation of operational design and process design to ensure that proposed solutions are delivered within the agreed scope.Support to change management activities, including development of a traceability matrix to ensure proposed solutions are successfully implemented and embedded in the organisation.


Vice President Expectations


To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.


All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

rows.title: Product Owner, Economic Crime Hub
rows.descriptionText:
Join us as a Product Owner, Economic Crime Hub

This is an exciting opportunity to join an expanding Product Team within the newly formed Economic Crime Hub, where Fraud, Financial Crime and Data & Analytics have come together to create a market-leading capability. You'll play a pivotal role in developing innovative, data-driven solutions that stay one step ahead of increasingly sophisticated AI-enabled fraud and scam activity, helping to protect millions of customers and the wider economyTake ownership of products that make a real difference. You'll define and deliver a compelling product vision and roadmap that supports the Economic Crime Hub's mission to combat evolving fraud and financial crime threats through data, analytics and cutting-edge technologyWork alongside experts across Fraud, Financial Crime, Data & Analytics and Technology, building strong relationships and harnessing customer and stakeholder insights to develop products that create meaningful business and customer outcomesJoin a culture that values curiosity, innovation and continuous learning. Leveraging Agile ways of working, you'll inspire teams to innovate, embrace change and deliver products that help us stay one step ahead of criminal activity in an increasingly AI-driven landscape

What you'll do

As a Product Owner, you’ll work closely with Data Analytics, Engineering and Architecture teams to shape and build our new Fraud Profiling and Decisioning platform. You’ll play a key role in defining and delivering critical capabilities, navigating complex data environments and ensuring functional and non-functional requirements are clearly understood and translated into effective solutions.

As well as this, you’ll bring the point of view of our customers, end users or stakeholders to the forefront of understanding the product vision. With exceptional leadership skills, you’ll drive your team towards this vision, regularly stopping along the way to checkin, adjust, calibrate and move forward. We’ll also look to you to make sure that stories and enablers meet acceptance and quality criteria, keeping them inline with the vision and strategic objectives.

Your responsibilities will include:

Ensuring your delivery teams are aligned to and delivering against the product vision, working closely with customers and users to validate priorities, incorporate feedback and maximise value at every stage of deliveryParticipating in iteration ceremonies to enable continuous improvementWorking with enterprise architects and teams to understand and prioritise the enablersSupporting the development of your teams by answering any questions and removing impedimentsTracking progress, and attending any retrospective spanning all delivery teams that are involved with delivering the product

The skills you'll need

You’ll be a decisive, commercially minded product leader with strong Agile expertise and a clear focus on customer and business outcomes.

You’ll also need:

The ability to lead complex financial platforms from early build through to production and scale, confidently shaping direction and technical trade-offs with architecture and engineering teamsFraud or Financial Crime experience is strongly preferredThe ability to connect customer journeys across Retail, Wealth and Commercial, identify gaps in fraud profiling and decisioning, and own a credible migration plan and its outcomesStrong senior stakeholder and multi-vendor management skills, translating real business problems into clear product direction and a compelling platform story that builds belief and momentumA commercial mindset, with experience building and defending business cases, tracking ROI and benefits realisation, and applying strong product fundamentals across prioritisation, backlog management and delivery governance

rows.title: Senior Data Engineer I (Data Platform)
rows.descriptionText:
Our vision is to give everyone the belief they can make their move. We aim to make moving simpler, by giving everyone the best place to turn to and return to for access to the tools, expertise, trust, and belief to make it happen.

We’re home to the UK’s largest choice of properties and are the go-to destination for millions of people planning their next move, reading the latest industry news, or just browsing what’s on the market.

Location: London office / Hybrid (2 days per week in the office)

Reporting to: Data Engineering Manager

The Role

Millions of people visit the Rightmove website every month. We have a huge amount of data about how people use the site, and what this means to our customers.

You’ll be joining our growing Data Engineering & Infrastructure team, a collaborative, high-performing group of engineers that uses this data to build the infrastructure that powers the UK’s favourite property site.

In this role, you will take ownership of the systems and infrastructure that ingest, process, and serve data across Rightmove. You will be responsible for the infrastructure, tooling, and engineering practices that power our data ecosystem, including data ingestion, orchestration, storage, and the developer experience for data producers and consumers.

You will bring strong hands-on expertise to our GCP-based data platform, design reusable patterns and tools, write robust Python and SQL, and deploy infrastructure with Terraform, while influencing the standards and technical decisions that the wider data engineering team works to.

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will be a technical leader and multiplier within the data platform team. You will own the infrastructure, frameworks, and internal tooling that power Rightmove’s data ecosystem. You will contribute to the technical direction for how data is ingested, processed, and served across the business, and consistently apply and promote engineering best practices that raise the quality of the team’s work.

Join an inclusive and collaborative engineering culture where you'll work alongside talented engineers, tackle complex technical challenges, and continue to grow your skills. You'll leverage a modern GCP stack and apply your data engineering expertise to build products and services used by millions across the UK every day.

A note from your future manager: "This role designs and builds the pipelines and infrastructure that keep our data flowing reliably, so every team can build with confidence and speed."

What You’ll Be Doing

Define the technical approach to our most complex and ambiguous data challenges, setting direction where others would wait for clarity, making high-quality architectural decisions, and ensuring the right trade-offs are made for the long-term health of the platformOwn the end-to-end technical leadership of cross-functional projects, from shaping requirements with product owners and domain teams through to delivery. Take accountability for outcomes, not just the engineering contributionDesign and build data platform infrastructure and internal tooling, contributing to the architectural direction for how teams across Rightmove work with dataOwn the design and evolution of reusable batch and real-time data ingestion and processing frameworks, ensuring they are reliable, scalable, and serve the needs of teams across the businessManage infrastructure, security and code deployment with Terraform and CI/CD pipelinesOptimise performance, scalability, and cost efficiency of our data platformChampion engineering best practices across the team, including testing, documentation, and observability, share knowledge and support others through code reviews and technical discussions, helping raise the bar and embed standards in how the team worksPartner with engineers, data scientists, and analytics teams to enable self-service data workflows, acting as a technical enabler and setting the patterns others follow

We're Looking For Someone Who

Has a strong track record of delivering significant impact in data engineering or data platform engineering, with deep experience building and operating large-scale, cloud-based data platformsThrives in ambiguity, able to define the problem, identify the right technical approach, and drive complex cross-functional projects to completion without needing fully formed requirementsIs a strong Python and SQL engineer, with mastery of software engineering fundamentals, and is able to raise the standard across the teamHas deep, hands-on experience with GCP (or comparable cloud platforms) and managing infrastructure as code with Terraform, and can influence how the team approaches cloud engineeringHas a strong track record of designing, building, and operating production-grade data pipelines and real-time processing frameworks at scaleHas built and managed CI/CD pipelines for data and infrastructure, and can lead the team in adopting reliable, automated deployment practicesHas a track record of raising the technical bar across the team through introducing better practices, leading technical reviews, and driving engineering improvements that outlast individual projectsHas knowledge of GDPR and data security best practicesUnderstands data storage, data modelling principles, best practices and tools (e.g. dbt)Communicates with clarity and confidence, able to lead design discussions, articulate technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders, and build alignment across teamsIs curious, self-directed, and proactive, identifying problems before they are assigned, and drives improvements to the platform without being asked

Life at Rightmove

Despite Our Growth, We’ve Remained a Friendly, Supportive Place To Work, With Employee #1 Still Working Here! We’ve Done This By Placing The Rightmove Hows At The Heart Of Everything We Do. These Are The Essential Values That Reflect Our Culture, And Include

We create value…by delivering results and building trust with partners and consumers.We think bigger…by acting with curiosity and setting bold aspirations.We care deeply…by being real, having fun, and valuing diversity.We move together…by being one team - internally collaborative, externally competitive.We make a difference…by focusing on delivering measurable impact.



We believe in careers that open doors and help our team develop by providing an open and inclusive work environment, offering ongoing training opportunities, and supporting charity fundraising events. And with 89% of Rightmovers saying we’re a great place to work, we’re clearly doing something right!

Cash plan for dental, optical and physio treatments.Private Medical Insurance, Pension and Life Insurance, Employee Assistance Plan.27 days holiday plus two (paid) volunteering days a year to give back, and holiday buy schemes.Contributory stakeholder pension.Life assurance at 4x your basic salary to a spouse, family member or other nominated person in your life.Competitive compensation package.Paid leave for maternity, paternity, adoption & fertility.Travel Loans, Bike to Work scheme, Rental Deposit Loan.Charitable contributions through Payroll Giving and donation matching.Access deals and discounts on things like travel, electronics, fashion, gym memberships, cinema discounts and more.We offer hybrid working with a minimum of 2 days in the office. For our roles, such as Field or Home-based positions, different working arrangements apply - full details will be shared during the recruitment process.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, Rightmove will never discriminate based on age, disability, sex, race, religion or belief, gender reassignment, marriage / civil partnership, pregnancy/maternity or sexual orientation. 

At Rightmove, we believe that a diverse and inclusive workforce leads to better innovation, productivity, and overall success. We are committed to creating a welcoming and inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of their background or identity, to develop and promote a diverse culture that reflects the communities we serve.

By applying, you confirm that you are aged at least 18 or over and that you’ve read and understood our Privacy Policy, which explains how we handle and protect your personal information during the recruitment process.

rows.title: Product Owner, Economic Crime Hub
rows.descriptionText:
Join us as a Product Owner, Economic Crime Hub

This is an exciting opportunity to join an expanding Product Team within the newly formed Economic Crime Hub, where Fraud, Financial Crime and Data & Analytics have come together to create a market-leading capability. You'll play a pivotal role in developing innovative, data-driven solutions that stay one step ahead of increasingly sophisticated AI-enabled fraud and scam activity, helping to protect millions of customers and the wider economyTake ownership of products that make a real difference. You'll define and deliver a compelling product vision and roadmap that supports the Economic Crime Hub's mission to combat evolving fraud and financial crime threats through data, analytics and cutting-edge technologyWork alongside experts across Fraud, Financial Crime, Data & Analytics and Technology, building strong relationships and harnessing customer and stakeholder insights to develop products that create meaningful business and customer outcomesJoin a culture that values curiosity, innovation and continuous learning. Leveraging Agile ways of working, you'll inspire teams to innovate, embrace change and deliver products that help us stay one step ahead of criminal activity in an increasingly AI-driven landscape

What you'll do

As a Product Owner, you’ll work closely with Data Analytics, Engineering and Architecture teams to shape and build our new Fraud Profiling and Decisioning platform. You’ll play a key role in defining and delivering critical capabilities, navigating complex data environments and ensuring functional and non-functional requirements are clearly understood and translated into effective solutions.

As well as this, you’ll bring the point of view of our customers, end users or stakeholders to the forefront of understanding the product vision. With exceptional leadership skills, you’ll drive your team towards this vision, regularly stopping along the way to checkin, adjust, calibrate and move forward. We’ll also look to you to make sure that stories and enablers meet acceptance and quality criteria, keeping them inline with the vision and strategic objectives.

Your responsibilities will include:

Ensuring your delivery teams are aligned to and delivering against the product vision, working closely with customers and users to validate priorities, incorporate feedback and maximise value at every stage of deliveryParticipating in iteration ceremonies to enable continuous improvementWorking with enterprise architects and teams to understand and prioritise the enablersSupporting the development of your teams by answering any questions and removing impedimentsTracking progress, and attending any retrospective spanning all delivery teams that are involved with delivering the product

The skills you'll need

You’ll be a decisive, commercially minded product leader with strong Agile expertise and a clear focus on customer and business outcomes.

You’ll also need:

The ability to lead complex financial platforms from early build through to production and scale, confidently shaping direction and technical trade-offs with architecture and engineering teamsFraud or Financial Crime experience is strongly preferredThe ability to connect customer journeys across Retail, Wealth and Commercial, identify gaps in fraud profiling and decisioning, and own a credible migration plan and its outcomesStrong senior stakeholder and multi-vendor management skills, translating real business problems into clear product direction and a compelling platform story that builds belief and momentumA commercial mindset, with experience building and defending business cases, tracking ROI and benefits realisation, and applying strong product fundamentals across prioritisation, backlog management and delivery governance

rows.title: Senior Scientist - Marketplace (Multiple Teams)

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
About The Role Of Science

End-to-end product development from a data, analytics, modeling, and experimentation perspective. Specifically, formulating ambiguous business problems, prototyping various machine learning & optimization & causal inference & marketplace dynamics models, producing data insights, and designing & analyzing experiments.

We are building the future of Uber's mobility and logistics platforms. Our teams drive innovation across critical areas including:

 A central pillar of Uber's delivery products, serving as the "brain" of the operation. We drive every decision that enables orders to go from point A to point B - from Uber Eats & Grocery, to newer verticals like Uber Direct and Connect. We're responsible for running an efficient marketplace with dispatch & pricing decisions.  We enhance user experience and growth for Uber One, a fast-growing program providing members with exclusive benefits, best prices, and priority across the platform. 

 What you will do  

 Solve ambiguous, challenging business problems using data-driven approaches including ML, Optimization, Causal Inference.  Develop and implement statistical/econometric methodologies to improve results validity, power and generalizability.  Develop data-driven business insights and work with cross-functional customers to find opportunities and recommend prioritization of product, growth, and optimization initiatives.  Design and analyze experiments, and present results that provide actionable recommendations.  Orient the teams around data-driven product development by driving the creation of logging, metrics, data visualization, and diagnostic tools, and experimentation paradigms.  Define how our teams measure success, by developing metrics, in close partnership with cross-functional partners.  Own the product development cycle end to end from data and science aspects. 

 Basic Qualifications 

 Ph.D., M.S. or Bachelor's degree in Economics, Statistics, Machine Learning, Operations Research, or other quantitative fields.  4+ years of industry experience as an Applied or Data Scientist or equivalent (or 2+ years with Ph.D.).  Background in at least one programming language (eg. Python, R, Java, Ruby, Scala/Spark or Perl)  Ability to use Python or similar technologies to work efficiently with large data sets and prototype algorithms & models  Coding and SQL proficiency and ability to develop statistical analysis and algorithm prototyping in Python or R.  Design experiments and interpret the results to draw detailed and actionable conclusions across a variety of key performance indicators 

 Preferred Qualifications 

 Ph.D. in Economics, Statistics, Machine Learning, Operations Research or other quantitative fields.  Excellent communication and collaboration skills: Able to lead initiatives across multiple product areas and communicate findings with leadership and product teams  Experience in leading key technical projects and substantially influencing the scope and output of others  Thought leadership to drive multi-functional projects from concept to production.  Experience in large-scale marketplace algorithm design, membership / consumer growth, or experimentation platform.  Experience with exploratory data analysis, statistical analysis and model development  Strong programming skills to prototype models in at least one of Python (preferably), R, Java, Go, Scala 

For New York City, NY-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $190,000 per year - USD $211,000 per year.

For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $190,000 per year - USD $211,000 per year.

For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.

rows.title: Analytical Lead, Online Food Delivery Advertising
rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

Uber is the largest mobility and delivery platform in the world, with billions of insights from millions of users. Uber Advertising's vision is to connect Uber's platform users (eaters, riders, earners) with advertisers in meaningful ways. By leveraging Uber's location-based and shopping data, and closed-loop attribution across Mobility and Delivery, we enable advertisers to engage consumers throughout the funnel - from awareness to purchase to loyalty.

The Measurement & Analytics Solutions team partners directly with enterprise advertisers and Uber Sales teams to translate complex data into actionable strategies, demonstrate incrementality, and maximize advertiser ROI across Uber Ads solutions. By combining first-party behavioral intent signals with sophisticated measurement frameworks, we serve as trusted advisors to help top brands unlock sustainable growth, optimize full-funnel media investments, and achieve their strategic business objectives.

Uber Advertising's Measurement & Analytics Solutions team is looking for an analytical and strategic problem solver to collaborate tightly with Sales in order to deepen advertiser relationships, helping to achieve our revenue targets.

You will serve as a strategic extension of the Sales team, collaborating cross-functionally to harness quantitative and qualitative data to unlock breakthrough insights, spearhead business transformation, and accelerate advertiser growth across Uber Eats and Mobility surfaces.

What You'll Do

 Partner with Sales and advertisers to understand customer objectives and provide proactive, full customer-lifecycle insights, turning performance data and audience insights into strategic recommendations for Uber's highest-priority/ -revenue driving clients  Design client-specific measurement & analytics roadmaps that include audience and data collaboration strategies, controlled 1P/ 3P experiments and incrementality tests to validate advertiser hypotheses, prove ROI, and compel increased investment in Uber Ads  Deliver polished presentations and recommendations that frame complex analytics as clear business impact and ROI  Conduct regular and bespoke analyses and insights for some of the world's largest advertisers to drive growth across advertiser KPIs and help them grow their businesses with Uber  Exhibit deep analytical ability, and develop great expertise in Uber's proprietary metrics, working to constantly evolve how we analyze and communicate data driven insights to our advertisers 

Basic Qualifications

 5+ years experience in data analytics, data science, measurement and insights, advertising, AdTech, consulting or similar industries  Bachelor's degree, preferably in mathematics, statistics, economics, computer science, operational research or similar quantitative field  Proficient in SQL 

Preferred Qualifications

Python expertise Working knowledge of applied statistics and modeling (hypothesis testing, regression, confidence intervals) used to measure campaign lift and ROI  Knowledge of brand lift and attention driven measurement  Experience designing and analyzing A/B tests and other controlled experiments  Experience presenting to executive audiences  Experience working with large OFD (online food delivery) customers in a digital advertising organization  Intermediate to advanced skills in data analysis (e.g. MS Excel / Google Sheets / Python), story-telling (e.g. providing actionable insights based on analysis), advanced data querying (e.g. SQL), leveraging data visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Google Data Studio, Tableau)  Experience with marketing / advertising measurement, analytics, and reporting within an advertising agency/consulting  Experience with online advertising, targeting and measurement systems and methodologies (ad servers, DSPs, DMPs, etc.)  Experience with 3rd party measurement studies (brand lift, sales lift, foot-traffic, etc.)  Experience with ROI, incrementality, and attribution modeling, and with building consultative, pre-sales analytics for advertisers  Experience with multivariate test design, causal inference, and advanced statistical or machine learning techniques

In this role, you'll work closely with Product Design, Data Science, Engineering, Business teams and other partners across Uber's businesses and geographies. You will lead with deep customer insights and empathy, relying on data and UXR to make informed decisions grounded in strong product intuition. You'll be both creative and bring deep expertise in consumer product to the table, as well as analytically rigorous, driving experimentation and knowing your metrics. You'll operate with an owner's mindset, obsessing over every detail of the end-to-end experience.

What The Candidate Will Need / Bonus Points

---- What the Candidate Will Do ----

Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Design, Data Science, Engineering and Ops, to identify opportunities to make the experience better and drive business outcomes. Distill the vision and strategy for the team and effectively present and communicate to cross-functional partners and executive leadership to generate enthusiasm and drive alignment. Develop and execute a roadmap of product initiatives, and implement data-driven experiments to improve the core consumer experience for Uber Eats. Anticipate and remove obstacles that slow down or prevent the team from delivering on operational, product, and business objectives. 

 Basic Qualifications

5+ years of Product Management experience delivering highly successful and innovative products with your fingerprints all over them. You have a knack for taking on complex product challenges and finding elegant solutions that are delightfully simple for our users. Consumer product experience with a track record of delivering highly successful and innovative products with your fingerprints all over them. Experience building and leading scaled businesses, including ownership and optimization of business performance metrics. Experience leading geographically distributed cross-functional teams in an energetic, high-octane environment

 Preferred Qualifications

A "Driver" mindset. You are biased toward action, a great collaborator, a master disambiguator/simplifier, and constantly pushing toward clarity and delivery. rows.title: Safety Measurement & Insights Lead

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

The Safety Risk Measurement & Insights Lead owns how Uber defines, measures, and reasons about safety risk on the platform. This role makes us smart about measurement itself - ensuring that our indicators of safety risk (both outcome metrics like Safety Incident Rate and the leading, input, and predictive signals that precede harm) are well-defined, governed, trusted, and continuously improved, and then translating them into clear, actionable insight for business leadership and external reporting.

This role sits at the center of Analytics, Operations, and cross-functional partners to unify metric definitions, strengthen data quality, accelerate insight generation, and improve how safety performance is understood and acted upon across the organization. This role will also help shape how Safety uses smarter tooling and AI-enabled workflows to scale measurement, analytics, and reporting.

What You'll Do

Metric Governance & Foundations:  Drive governance for Safety's most critical metrics, including Incident Rate and leading indicators of safety risk. Recommend durable definitions, inclusion/exclusion logic, auditability, lineage, and consistency over time. Ensure metric frameworks remain credible as the platform, product, and risk landscape evolve.

Data Quality & Measurement Integrity:  Serve as Safety's measurement steward - lead end-to-end accountability for the quality and reliability of safety data. Partner with DS / Eng / Ops to resolve issues, and establish clear monitoring and escalation mechanisms that improve trust in reported safety outcomes.

Analytical Investigation, Insight Generation & Business Translation: Lead deep dives into performance shifts, emerging risks, and measurement anomalies, combining quantitative analysis with operational context to identify what is happening, why it is happening, and what Safety should do next; then turn those insights into crisp, credible narratives that help leaders make decisions, prioritize investments, and communicate clearly to senior stakeholders.

AI-Enabled Insights & Scalable Workflows: Define and advance the future state of Safety analytics by identifying opportunities to automate recurring analysis, improve self-serve access, and use AI-enabled workflows to accelerate insight generation without compromising rigor

Safety Ops Enablement:  Enable Safety Operations and regional partners to use trusted safety metrics consistently and effectively. Build or shape dashboards, reporting tools, education materials, and analytical resources that improve understanding, speed up decision-making, and strengthen stakeholder influence.

Reporting & Decision Support:  Ensure executive- and external-facing reporting is rigorous, defensible, and efficient, with clear underlying methodology and a consistent measurement framework.

What You'll Need

 Analytical Leadership & Data Acumen: Strong analytical foundation with the ability to understand statistical concepts, challenge assumptions, partner credibly with Data Science, and turn complex data into clear, actionable insights.  Business Acumen & Strategic Thinking: Strong understanding of the broader business context and Safety's role within it, with the ability to frame trends, tradeoffs, and recommendations in a way that supports executive decision-making.  Influence & Communication: Excellent communicator and storyteller with a track record of building trust, influencing cross-functional stakeholders, and driving alignment without direct authority.  Systems Thinking: Able to understand end-to-end processes, dependencies, and organizational dynamics to identify root causes and durable solutions.  AI & Analytical Innovation: Curious and practical user of AI, automation, or emerging analytical tools to accelerate insight generation, improve decision-making, and scale analytical work. 

Basic Qualifications 

 8+ years of experience in analytics, strategy, business operations, data science, or a related field.  Bachelor's Degree in Economics, Engineering , Data Science, Finance or technical field. 

Preferred Qualifications

 Experience in Trust & Safety, Risk, Marketplace Integrity, Fraud, or other complex operational domains.  Experience at a technology platform, marketplace, gig economy, e-commerce, social media, dating, or similar trust-based ecosystem.  Experience defining, governing, or evolving critical business metrics used by senior leadership.  Experience building self-service analytics, measurement frameworks, or analytical products.  Track record of coaching, educating, or upskilling teams on analytical concepts and best practices.  Experience driving accountability and raising the quality bar for insight generation across an organization.  PHD in Economics, Engineering , Data science, Finance or technical field. 

 Why This Role Matters 

This role ensures Safety has the measurement foundations it needs to make good decisions, hold the right line on rigor, and communicate performance credibly inside and outside the company. It is both a governance role and an insight role: trusted numbers, better decisions, stronger execution.

As part of a small, high-impact team, you'll help bring expertise from Uber's mobility and delivery marketplaces into a rapidly evolving industry, developing pricing, matching, recommendation, and optimization systems that will disrupt the freight industry ($1T TAM). Uber Freight is at a very early stage, with just 0.4% of the pie now, and it's a rare opportunity to solve challenging marketplace problems with AI/ML and marketplace optimization while shaping how the freight industry transforms.

We are looking for a highly motivated Machine Learning Engineer to join Uber's Marketplace team to modernize the Uber Freight marketplace team. It is a fascinating area with challenges in predictive modeling, causal inference, constrained optimization, reinforcement learning, marketplace design, etc. The business is about to elevate and this role has a huge growing opportunity.

What You'll Do

This role requires end to end ownership for the ML models in UF marketplace (cost prediction, booking probability, demand elasticity, etc.). While your job is mostly about model development, you will work with backend engineers together to put them in production and make sure they work as expected.

Basic Qualifications

 6+ years of experience developing ML models to solve business problem.  Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields.  Familiar with modern AI/ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch). 

Preferred Qualifications

 Product experience will be a big plus for this role. Adaptive development of ML models to the business context is critical.  Previous experience with state-of-the-art marketplace technology is preferred.  Experience with causal inference and constrained optimization

rows.title: 2027 Human Resources Placement
rows.descriptionText:
JOB DESCRIPTION 

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

As a participant in our 12-month Corporate Placements Programme in the Human Resources Department, you’re not just gaining hands-on experience at our Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA) Headquarters in Watford – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by contributing to the memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Here’s what you can look forward to as a programme participant:

Prepare for a career in hospitality: Embark on a 12-month transformative journey, encompassing a structured framework of learning and development opportunities, business support activities, and ownership of your own project-based initiatives.Gain hands-on operational experience: From day one, you’ll be fully integrated into Team Hilton. Connect with professionals across the business and gain insight into Human Resources. Take the opportunity to gain insight into at least one other business area, paving the way for valuable future relationships.Work on real-world projects: Apply your skills on the job through business-driven projects to reinforce your learning and gain hands-on experience.Develop your skills through world-class training and support: Access Hilton University’s e-learning modules and business library while building knowledge through business-driven projects.Grow with personalised guidance: Benefit from regular feedback and coaching to ensure your progress is supported at every stage of the programme.Hilton Perks: Including our Go Hilton Team Member Travel Program, which provides you with access to heavily reduced hotel room rates for you, your family & friends. Salary & Benefits: £27,500 gross per annum & private healthcare. Location: At our EMEA Headquarters in Watford, with some flexibility depending on team and business need. You will benefit from a subsidised restaurant, a games area and a free in-house gym. 

Our Placement Opportunities

We have a range of placement opportunities within our highly talented Human Resources team:

Talent Acquisition.EMEA Compensation & Benefits.Corporate HR Consulting.

Talent Acquisition

Gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced, people-focused Talent Acquisition team, supporting the attraction and hiring of talent across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.

Where You Could Be Placed:

You will join one of the following Talent Acquisition sub-teams:

General Manager & Operations: Supporting recruitment for hotel leadership and operational positions. Contributing to both operational appointments and strategic projects, including succession planning, talent mapping, new hotel openings, organisational growth initiatives, and executive talent pipelining across the portfolio.Early Careers: Supporting the recruitment of our graduate programmes and internships across EMEA. Contributing to campaigns, assessment centres, university outreach and engagement activities, data analysis and reporting and projects focused on enhancing the candidate experience.

Whichever team you join, you will gain a broad exposure across all sub-teams of our Talent Acquisition function.

What You’ll Be Involved In:

Supporting recruitment processes, including screening and interview coordination.Engaging with candidates to deliver a positive candidate experience.Assisting with events such as careers fairs and assessment centres.Analysing data and producing reports to support hiring decisions.Building experience with recruitment systems and processes.

By the end of the placement, you’ll have a strong foundation in recruitment and valuable experience to support a future career in HR.

EMEA Compensation & Benefits

You will gain hands-on experience in helping us reward, recognise, and support Team Members across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. This is your chance to see how global HR works while developing analytical, communication, and project management skills.

What You’ll Be Involved In:

Benefits & Wellbeing: Assisting with the design and promotion of initiatives, working with external consultants, and contributing ideas to evolve our offering.Reward Projects: Supporting our annual compensation review, salary surveys, and bonus programmes to ensure fairness and competitiveness whilst adhering to local legislation.Data & Insights: Researching market trends, analysing data, and creating reports to support decision-making.Collaboration: Partnering with colleagues across HR and the business and preparing materials for senior leaders.Recognition & Engagement: Helping to manage our Hilton Marketplace discount and recognition platform, sourcing new offers for team members.Communication & Creativity: Producing content to bring our benefits and wellbeing programmes to life.

Corporate HR Consulting

You will gain experience in a fast-paced HR generalist team which offers diverse exposure across all the different areas of HR and partners closely with business stakeholders at all levels. This team works with the business and our Team Members to create an inclusive, engaging and positive, and award-winning working environment and culture for our corporate teams across EMEA.

Where You Could Be Placed:

HR Consulting: This role would be supporting our HR Consulting leads, who partner with our corporate functions across EMEA to advise on all people matters, including employee relations, regional people initiatives, office events and activations, engagement, recognition and inclusion initiatives and leading HR projects. This role also supports our HR Shared Service team across all aspects of the employee lifecycle.HR Operations: This role works with the HR team supporting our HR operations across EMEA hotels, including contributing towards talent and succession planning, executive level HR storytelling and events, supporting hotel opening HR activities and projects and initiatives to support our regional EMEA HR operations teams. In addition, the role provides support to the HR Consulting and HR Shared Services team as above.

What You'll Be Involved In:

Supporting HR Consulting leads with employee relations matters. Conducting and providing people and business data analytics and insights to support projects, initiatives, business proposals and HR storytelling.Working on culture and wellbeing initiatives, including office, engagement and recognition events and activations which contribute towards Hilton being voted #1 Great Place to Work in the UK.Working with the HR Shared Services team to support all employee lifecycle processes including liaising with Team Members and people leaders, shared mailbox management and process administration.Support on any HR projects and communications within the offices and the region.Gain exposure to the huge variety of HR generalist work, such as talent management, succession planning, compensation and benefits, recruitment, inclusion, culture and engagement and learning and development.Collaborate across the business and different HR centres of excellence to support with all of the above, gaining great exposure across HR and the wider business.

By the end of the internship, you will have gained fully rounded generalist knowledge and experience into the different areas of HR, with valuable skills and insights that will support a future career in any area of HR.

What We’re Looking For

We are seeking individuals who embody the Hilton Values in addition to the following criteria:

A strong sense of alignment to our culture and values.A current bachelor’s or master’s student completing a degree that includes a required 12-month year in industry placement.Availability to begin full-time employment on 5th July 2027, for a full-time 12-month placement.You must have the independent right to work in the UK for the full duration of the 12-month placement. Please note that this role is not eligible for visa sponsorship under the Skilled Worker route, so we are unable to consider applications from candidates who would require sponsorship. If you hold a visa or status that allows you to work in the UK full-time without sponsorship (e.g. Settled Status, Pre-Settled Status, where a 12-month work placement is a permitted, required & assessed part of your UK University degree, or other independent work permissions), you are welcome to apply.Fluency in English (spoken and written).You should be able to demonstrate a genuine interest in Human Resources.

Click here to learn more about Hilton's Corporate Placements

Selection Process

Applications are now open—don’t miss your chance to apply! Submissions close on Sunday 1st November 2026

Our selection process is designed to bring out your best and help us get to know you. It includes:

Online assessments.Assessment centre at our EMEA Headquarters in Watford (10th December 2026).

While the process is rigorous, it’s also the first step in your personal growth journey with Hilton. If selected, you’ll begin developing the skills, connections, and confidence to thrive in your career.

To ensure every application receives fair consideration, invitations to final-stage assessment centres will be issued after applications have closed. Please complete each stage promptly and keep an eye on your inbox for updates.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing reasonable adjustments for applicants and employees with disabilities. If you require any support or adjustments during the recruitment process or to carry out the essential requirements of the role, please contact us.

rows.title: Merchandise Coordinator
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

About the Team

You will be part of a collaborative team responsible for creating assortment strategies based on analyzing sales and trend. Our job blends creativity, analytics, and marketing.

About The Role

In the Merchandise Coordinator role, you will work closely with a very passionate and collaborative group of team members. The Merchandise Coordinator will provide support and coordination for the Associate Buyer and Sr. Buyer in specified merchandise categories for all channels of sales. We strive for operational excellence while developing best in class merchandising strategies each season.

Responsibilities


 Own sample management – communicating and partnering with our photo and warehouse teams to track sample positions  Work in Merchandise Buyer systems to set up and maintain all SKUs  Enter and maintain all price/cost changes for relevant categories  Prepare reporting as directed and assist Assistant Buyers with business opportunities  Maintaining data accuracy and integrity 


Criteria


 BA/BS degree required  Previous experience in Merchandising preferred  Passion for product  Ability to handle multiple priorities, shifting tasks and timelines  Ability to work autonomously, strong decision making skills with good judgement  Strong written and verbal communication to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams  Detail-oriented – takes the appropriate time to complete tasks and reviews work to ensure accuracy  Ability to work in a fast pace, often changing environment  Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel/Word/PowerPoint); ability to create pivot tables and experience with advanced formulas such as VLOOKUP a plus  Ability to transport samples including: lifting, moving, carrying objects up to 50 pounds on a limited basis  This role requires being onsite in our San Francisco office Monday through Thursday and Friday as optional in the office  Occasional travel may be required within the bay area for photo shoots and floor sets. 


Our Culture & Values 

We believe that taking care of our people is vital to our success and we strive to offer equitable and transparent practices for all. We prioritize connection, growth, and wellbeing.

People First 

Putting People First means investing in overall well-being and opportunities to grow and advance within the organization. Depending on the position and location, here are a few highlights of what benefits may be available:

Benefits


 A generous discount on all WSI brands  A 401(k) plan and other investment opportunities  Paid vacations, holidays, and time off to volunteer  Health benefits, dental and vision insurance, including same-sex domestic partner benefits  Tax-free commuter benefits  A wellness program that supports your physical, financial and emotional health 


Continued Learning


 In-person and online learning opportunities through WSI University  Cross-brand and cross-function career opportunities  Resources for self-development  Advisor (Mentor) program  Career development workshops, learning programs, and speaker series 


 WSI will not now or in the future commence an immigration case or "sponsor" an individual for this position (for example, H-1B or other employment-based immigration).

 Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Williams-Sonoma, Inc. will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, or other applicable state or local laws and ordinances.

Actual pay will be determined based on experience and other job-related factors permitted by law. Founded in 1956, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of high-quality products for the kitchen and home in the United States.
