rows.title: Manager, Social Media Engagement & Community
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

This role is based at one of our corporate offices in Dallas, TX or McLean, VA

This is your chance to be part of a Marketing team that attracts customers to Hilton through powerful storytelling, award-winning loyalty, and unforgettable guest experiences and partnerships. As Manager, Social Media Engagement & Community reporting to the Senior Manager Social Media Strategy, you will be one of the voices behind Hilton's social presence — helping our brands show up with relevance, personality, and humanity across social platforms. Sitting at the intersection of social media, culture, community, and hospitality, you will help shape how Hilton participates in conversation, builds relationships with guests and fans, and turns everyday interactions into moments that strengthen brand love and advocacy. You will lead day-to-day social engagement and community management across Hilton's priority social channels, identifying opportunities for proactive engagement, cultural participation, real-time storytelling, surprise and delight, and community-first activations. You'll also serve as a critical source of community intelligence, translating conversations, behaviors, and sentiment into insights that inform our broader social, content, and brand strategies.

What You'll Do During a Typical Day

Own and execute Hilton's cross-platform community engagement approach, managing proactive and reactive engagement across TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, X, and emerging platforms.Serve as a voice of Hilton, writing unmistakably on-brand responses across comments, DMs, mentions, community posts, and real-time conversations.Identify where and how Hilton should participate in culture and conversation beyond our owned content, spotting emerging trends, fan moments, creator conversations, competitive opportunities, and unexpected places where the brand can authentically add value.Monitor brand mentions, guest conversations, category trends, competitor activity, and cultural signals to identify opportunities, emerging sentiment, reputational considerations, and actionable community insights.Build relationships with guests, fans, creators, and brand advocates through thoughtful interaction and proactive outreach that turns individual engagements into positive experiences and long-term brand affinity.Develop and execute surprise-and-delight, fan recognition, gifting, and community activation opportunities that bring Hilton hospitality to life both online and in the real world.Identify and help amplify compelling guest stories, user-generated content, creator content, and organic brand advocacy across Hilton's social ecosystem.Stay deeply immersed in platform behavior, internet culture, creator trends, memes, emerging formats, and evolving community behaviors to ensure Hilton's engagement feels native to the platforms and communities where we participate.Help evolve Hilton from reactive community management toward an insight-led engagement strategy designed to drive conversation, participation, advocacy, and brand relevance.Manage agency and vendor relationships supporting community management, social listening, surprise-and-delight, and innovative engagement programming.

How You'll Collaborate With Others

Partner closely with Social Strategy, Content, Creative, Influencer, Customer Care, PR, Legal, Hotel teams, and agency partners to ensure Hilton shows up in social conversation with a consistent voice and coordinated approach.Translate community conversations, guest feedback, fan behavior, cultural signals, and sentiment into actionable insights that can inform social strategy, content development, campaigns, guest experience, and broader marketing opportunities.Partner with Content and Creative teams to quickly translate emerging conversations and community behaviors into platform-native creative and real-time social opportunities.Collaborate with Customer Care, PR, and Legal partners to develop clear escalation pathways around reputation-sensitive interactions.Support agencies and internal partners with clear briefs, response guidance, brand voice direction, platform-specific recommendations, and engagement best practices.Champion the voice of Hilton's social community internally, helping teams understand not only what our audiences are saying, but what Hilton should do with those insights.

Deliverables You'll Take Ownership Of

Community management guidelines, brand voice guidance, response frameworks, escalation protocols, and platform-specific engagement guides.Proactive and reactive social engagement across comments, DMs, mentions, community posts, cultural conversations, and real-time moments.Surprise-and-delight concepts, fan recognition programs, gifting opportunities, and community-first activations.Social listening and community intelligence reporting, including sentiment, emerging conversation themes, cultural opportunities, competitive activity, engagement performance, and recommendations.Engagement trackers and measurement frameworks that demonstrate how community activity contributes to brand affinity, advocacy, participation, and positive sentiment.Identification and amplification of high-value UGC, guest stories, organic advocacy, and community-created content.Editorial calendar support to ensure accurate publishing and coordinated engagement across Hilton's social channels.Performance storytelling for internal stakeholders and leadership, connecting individual social moments to broader consumer and brand insights.

What It Takes to Make the Stay

You Have These Minimum Qualifications

Five (5) or more years of professional experience in social media, community management, social engagement, content strategy or a related field.Demonstrated experience managing high-volume social engagement and community management for a large consumer-facing brand.Proven skill to identify and execute proactive and real-time engagement opportunities, including cultural moments and conversations beyond a brand's owned social channels.Deep understanding of social platform behavior, particularly TikTok and Instagram, with strong fluency across Threads, X, Facebook, and emerging platforms.An understanding of reputation-sensitive social environments, including the skill to assess tone, timing, context, risk, and relevance before engaging.Experience translating social listening, community behavior, and engagement performance into actionable recommendations.Hybrid schedule from Hilton's McLean, VA or Dallas, TX office.

It Would Be Useful If You Have

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Hospitality, or a related field.Experience with social media management, listening, publishing, moderation, and analytics tools such as Sprinklr, Brandwatch, Dash Hudson, Meta Business Suite, or similar platforms.Experience executing surprise-and-delight, gifting, seeding, fan advocacy, UGC, or community activation programs for a consumer-facing brand.Experience supporting creator-led content, cultural moments, real-time marketing, or community-first brand activations.Experience developing social response frameworks, escalation protocols, brand voice guidance, or community management guides.Experience identifying consumer insights from social conversation and translating them into content, campaign, brand, or customer experience recommendations.Curiosity and creativity to keep pace with rapidly evolving platforms, behaviors, and cultural conversations.

How We'll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we're known for doesn't end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members' wellbeing, supporting you through all of life's moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel programOwn a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial futurePaid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parentsPersonalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved onesCrisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional careMental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)Generous paid time off (PTO) – Recharge, relax, and take time for what matters mostHealth & welfare benefits – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family coveredFinancial security for your future – Our retirement plans make it easier to save for what's nextBenefits availability may vary depending on Team Member's location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

Hilton offers its eligible team members a comprehensive benefits package to support their mental and physical well-being, so they can Thrive personally and professionally. The pay range for this role is $90,000 – $120,000 and is determined based on applicable and specialized experience and location. Subject to plan terms and conditions, you will be eligible to participate in the Hilton Annual Incentive (Bonus) Plan, consistent with other team members at the same level and/or position within the Company.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

rows.descriptionText:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. About The Team And Role

This role is part of eBay’s Buying Conversion team and will lead the Buyer and Seller Initiated Offers & Marketplace Conversion portfolio. You will serve as the portfolio lead across planning, sequencing, testing, and implementation. You will also measure business impact for customer-facing communications. These communications help buyers and sellers move through offer-based shopping moments.

Offers is one of eBay’s most important marketplace conversion mechanics. These experiences span email, push notifications, in-app notifications, and emerging CRM channels.

In this highly visible role, you will build how eBay delivers the right offer, right message, and right timing to customers while balancing conversion growth, customer relevance, marketplace health, and notification fatigue. You will partner closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics, CRM, Data Science, and partner product teams across the customer experience to improve the intelligence, quality, and efficiency of offer communications.

Operating at the intersection of marketplace dynamics, seller economics, buyer psychology, and technical systems, you will define how Offers experiences leverage customer signals, trigger logic, dynamic pricing incentives, and contact strategy to drive measurable conversion.

This is an end-to-end Technical Product Management role requiring close partnership with Engineering and Data Science to build scalable offer-ranking engines, PRDs, and experimentation frameworks. If you thrive on solving complex buyer/seller negotiation mechanics, time-bound transaction urgency, and two-sided marketplace conversion, this is a high-impact opportunity to build eBay’s core offer experiences.

What You Will Accomplish

Own the Offers CRM Communications portfolio, including vision, strategy, roadmap, experimentation, performance, and measurable business outcomes.Build and deliver customer-facing CRM experiences across email, push notifications, in-app notifications, hub, and future owned-channel surfaces that help buyers and sellers move through offer-based shopping moments.Lead roadmap planning and prioritization across multiple programs and features, balancing customer value, conversion impact, operational complexity, technical feasibility, marketplace dynamics, and long-term strategic value.Partner with Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, CRM, Design, and partner product teams to improve offer signal quality, trigger logic, audience eligibility, ranking, suppression, frequency capping, send-time optimization, channel orchestration, and measurement.Translate customer problems, marketplace opportunities, and portfolio priorities into clear product requirements, MVPs, experiments, and execution plans; create PRDs, manage dependencies, and drive execution from discovery to launch.Lead and mentor PM partners, helping them increase their impact, sharpen product judgment, and deliver high-quality outcomes across the Offers roadmap.


What You Will Bring

7–9 years of product management experience, including experience in technical product management, growth product management, lifecycle/CRM communications, marketplace products, personalization, conversion optimization, or user behavior-based trigger systems.Experience owning complex customer-facing product portfolios with measurable business outcomes, ideally in a marketplace, e-commerce, consumer technology, or large-scale digital platform environment.Proven experience building or optimizing lifecycle communications across email, push, in-app, hub, or similar owned channels, including audience strategy, trigger logic, messaging, experimentation, and measurement.Strong customer and product judgment, with the ability to understand buyer and seller needs, customer fatigue, offer dynamics, urgency, marketplace incentives, and conversion trade-offs.Working knowledge of AI/ML-powered product systems, with the ability to partner effectively with Data Science, Analytics, Recommendations, and Engineering teams on signal quality, model or rules-based decisioning, inputs and outputs, performance measurement, and governance.A growth mindset and demonstrated ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives, communicate clearly with technical and non-technical partners, influence without authority, and turn ambiguity into actionable strategy and execution.

Description & Requirements

The Company 

Bloomberg ignites the power of information and technology to bring clarity to a sophisticated world. As a global leader in financial information, news, and analytics, Bloomberg gives decision-makers a critical edge by connecting them to a dynamic network of data, people, and ideas. Through innovative technology, the company delivers real-time market intelligence and insights to more than 350,000 subscribers worldwide.

A career at Bloomberg means helping power the products, systems, and relationships that help drive global financial markets. You'll join a team of problem-solvers in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where continuous learning, innovation, and client impact are at the center of everything we do. With a diverse workforce and a culture built on inclusion, curiosity, and excellence, Bloomberg empowers employees to do their best work while building meaningful careers.

What's the Role? 

As a Bloomberg Customer Support Representative, you will serve as a trusted partner to a diverse global client base, helping users maximize the value of Bloomberg's products and services. Sitting at the intersection of technology, financial markets, and client engagement, you'll provide responsive support and solutions across Bloomberg's products and services, while developing expertise that serves as a strong foundation for career growth across the company.

You will troubleshoot software, hardware, connectivity, authentication, and application-related issues; support product installations, onboarding, and account access; and help clients navigate the tools and workflows they rely on to make critical business decisions. Through phone, instant messaging, and email, you'll diagnose issues, coordinate with internal partners, and ensure a seamless client experience.

Beyond troubleshooting and support, you will educate clients on Bloomberg products and workflows, helping them build confidence and proficiency while strengthening long-term relationships. You'll collaborate with colleagues across regions and functions to resolve complex challenges, drive process improvements, and deliver the high-quality service our clients depend on every day.

As part of our global Customer Support team of hundreds of professionals supporting clients in over 15 languages, you'll gain exposure to financial markets, enterprise technology, and client engagement while building a strong foundation for long-term career growth at Bloomberg.

What's in it for you? 

Industry-Leading Training 

We invest heavily in your development from day one through an immersive 8-week training program designed to build your knowledge of Bloomberg products, client workflows, financial markets, technical troubleshooting, and service excellence.

Continuous Learning 

Following training, you'll join a global team that supports clients around the clock while continuing to expand your expertise through hands-on experience, mentorship, and ongoing learning opportunities. You'll gain exposure to financial institutions, market participants, and Bloomberg's technology solutions, developing valuable skills in client engagement, problem solving, communication, and technical support.

Bloomberg is committed to internal mobility and long-term career growth. Customer Support provides a strong foundation for a variety of career paths across the company, including Analytics & Sales, Data, Enterprise Services, Finance, Product Support, and Corporate Functions.

Who you are? 

You are naturally curious, solutions-oriented, and energized by helping others succeed. You thrive in fast-moving environments, enjoy solving problems, and are motivated by delivering exceptional client experiences. You can quickly absorb new information, balance multiple priorities, and communicate effectively with a wide range of audiences.

You are interested in financial markets and technology, approach challenges with a growth mindset, and enjoy collaborating with others to find solutions. Most importantly, you take ownership, act with urgency, and are committed to delivering a high standard of service every day.

You'll Need to Have 

The legal right to work in the UK without current or future visa sponsorhsip. Unfortunately we cannot sponsor VISAs for this roleBachelor's degree or equivalent experience Eligibility to start a full-time role in either February or July 2027Fluency in one of the following languages in addition to English: Japanese or Mandarin (written and verbal) Strong communication and customer service skills, with the ability to support clients through phone, email, and messaging channels Demonstrated interest in financial markets, technology, and client-focused problem solving Strong analytical, critical thinking, and troubleshooting skills Ability to quickly learn new technologies and workflows while managing multiple priorities with accuracy and attention to detail Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, global environment Intellectual curiosity, a growth mindset, and interest in building a long-term career at Bloomberg 

We'd Love to See 

Experience in a client-facing, customer service, support, or operations-focused role Interest in financial services, fintech, or capital markets Aptitude for troubleshooting technology-related challenges and navigating software-based environments Awareness of data privacy, information security, and responsible data handling practices Demonstrated initiative through internships, leadership experiences, projects, extracurricular activities, or community involvement A collaborative mindset and passion for improving client and team outcomes 

You'll Need To Be Able To

Start full-time work in 2027 Occasionally work weekends or on a bank holiday (weekday off in lieu)

This helps us accurately assess your skills and potential, while also ensuring a fair and consistent experience for all candidates.

If This Sounds Like You

Apply if you think we're a good match. We'll get in touch to let you know what the next steps are, but in the meantime feel free to have a look at:  https://www.bloomberg.com/company

Accommodations 

Bloomberg provides reasonable adjustment/accommodation to individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable adjustment/accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable adjustment/accommodation include but are not limited to making a change to the application process or work procedures, providing documents in an alternate format or using specialized equipment. To request an adjustment/accommodation to apply for a job, please email EMEA_recruit@bloomberg.net. Equal Opportunity

Bloomberg is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination in employment. It is Bloomberg’s policy to provide equal opportunity and access for all persons, and the Company is committed to attracting, retaining, developing, and promoting the most qualified individuals without regard to age, ancestry, color, gender identity or expression, genetic predisposition or carrier status, marital status, national or ethnic origin, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, self-identified or perceived sex, sexual and other reproductive health decisions, parental or caring status, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, or parental leave, protected veteran status, status as a victim of domestic violence, or any other classification protected by applicable law (each, a “Protected Characteristic”). rows.descriptionText:
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com.

As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.

Job Function

Marketing

Job Sub Function

Job Category

Professional

All Job Posting Locations:

Boston, Massachusetts, United States of America, Palm Beach Gardens, Florida, United States of America, Raynham, Massachusetts, United States of America, Warsaw, Indiana, United States of America, West Chester, Pennsylvania, United States of America

Job Description

DePuy Synthes Companies of Johnson & Johnson is recruiting for a Senior Analyst Marketing Insights, Advanced Technologies, Global Digital & Robotics Innovation.

Have a passion for deriving data-driven insights to inform strategic decisions? This Senior Analyst Marketing Insights will report into the Marketing Director, Advanced Technologies and inform the vision and direction for DePuy Synthes' Digital and Robotics Innovation across Orthopeadic applications with market, tech landscape, competitive, and financial insights. This individual will produce market, tech, and financial analyses and comparisons to inform definition, size and priority of unmet need opportunities including navigation, robotics, augmented reality, and artificial intelligence. The ideal candidate will have market and financial analytics experience and fluency with artificial intelligence (AI) tools for productivity.

Fueled by innovation at the intersection of biology and technology, we’re developing the next generation of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments.

Are you passionate about improving and expanding the possibilities of Orthopaedics? Ready to join a team that’s reimagining how we heal? Our Orthopaedics teams help keep more than 6 million people moving each year while delivering clinical and economic value to surgeons and healthcare systems. Our teams build solutions for joint reconstruction; trauma and craniomaxillofacial; sports, extremities, and elective foot and ankle; spine; and robotics and digital surgery.

Your unique talents will help patients on their journey to wellness. Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/medtech

Responsibilities: 

Produce market, tech, and financial analyses and comparisons to inform definition, size, and priority of opportunities. Conduct market and customer research to inform opportunity analysis and prioritization. Define early-stage technology scouting and success criteria backed by data-driven insights. Support feasibility assessments of new and early-stage technology with business modeling, financial analysis, and customer research. Leverage and create AI-enabled tools for the organization to stay current with market trends, competitive intelligence and the technology landscape. Report on key trends, updates and interface with senior leadership. Partner with external agencies to achieve business insight goals. 

 

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in marketing, finance, engineering or an analytics related field. Minimum of 2 years’ experience in marketing, finance, engineering or analytics related field. Strong skills in business modeling and analytics in tools like excel required. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Experience and/or knowledge of AI (artificial intelligence) tools for market research and analytics productivity. Strong analytical skills to interpret data and make data-driven recommendations. Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team environment. Strong organizational skills with great attention to detail. Experience distilling complex and high volumes of data into simple KPIs and data visualizations / dashboards / scorecards. Up to 40% travel  

On October 14, 2025, Johnson & Johnson announced plans to separate our Orthopaedics business to establish a standalone orthopaedics company, operating as DePuy Synthes. The planned separation is anticipated to be completed within 18 to 24 months, subject to legal requirements including consultation with works councils and other employee representative bodies, as may be required, regulatory approvals and other customary conditions and approvals.

It is anticipated following conclusion of the transaction, you would be an employee of DePuy Synthes, and your employment would be governed by Orthopaedics employment processes, programs, policies, and benefit plans. Details of any planned changes would be provided to you by Orthopaedics at an appropriate time and subject to any necessary consultation processes.

Johnson & Johnson is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by federal, state or local law. We actively seek qualified candidates who are protected veterans and individuals with disabilities as defined under VEVRAA and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act.

Description & Requirements

Bloomberg Intelligence (BI) delivers independent, data-driven research and interactive datasets integrated into the Bloomberg Terminal, helping investment professionals make decisions faster. With 500+ research professionals, BI provides company, credit, industry and strategy research across major global markets, covering 135+ industries and 2,000+ companies, including perspectives on company fundamentals as well as government policy, litigation and ESG. BI combines analyst expertise with interactive data, proprietary models and emerging technologies, including AI, to deliver faster, deeper and more differentiated research. BI Associate Analyst – Credit Strategy: BI is seeking an Associate to support Senior Strategists in the US. The right candidate will be tasked with sourcing, overseeing and generating data and insights based on a mix of fundamental and quantitative approaches.

You will have a steep learning curve with great exposure to the market experts in Bloomberg Intelligence. The successful candidate will have familiarity with the Microsoft suite of tools, and ideally the Bloomberg terminal. Strong coding skills, including Python, and knowledge of statistics are essential.

We'll Trust You To

 Actively contribute to the team’s daily research activities (i.e. data aggregation and analysis, modeling, written research, idea generation) Manage significant data analysis and modeling responsibilities; synthesize the results, draw conclusions and develop concise narratives that communicate the story behind the data Conceptualize, construct and maintain research dashboards Help to identify, support and maintain critical data and functionality on the Bloomberg terminal Develop and maintain relationships with internal and external constituencies Interact regularly with clients via our online messaging systems, telephone and client visits Participate in department-wide special projects

As an HR Business Advisor (HRBA) at Bloomberg, you’ll be a key member of our Human Resources Business Partnering function, working with Senior HR Business Partners, focused on providing support to team leaders and mid-level managers across the organization. Your focus will be on implementing strategic HR initiatives, delivering both enterprise-wide and bespoke HR programs, and enabling effective HR process execution. Job Description

DePuy Synthes Companies of Johnson & Johnson is recruiting for a Senior Analyst Marketing Insights, Advanced Technologies, Global Digital & Robotics Innovation.

Have a passion for deriving data-driven insights to inform strategic decisions? This Senior Analyst Marketing Insights will report into the Marketing Director, Advanced Technologies and inform the vision and direction for DePuy Synthes' Digital and Robotics Innovation across Orthopeadic applications with market, tech landscape, competitive, and financial insights. This individual will produce market, tech, and financial analyses and comparisons to inform definition, size and priority of unmet need opportunities including navigation, robotics, augmented reality, and artificial intelligence. The ideal candidate will have market and financial analytics experience and fluency with artificial intelligence (AI) tools for productivity.

Fueled by innovation at the intersection of biology and technology, we’re developing the next generation of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments.

Are you passionate about improving and expanding the possibilities of Orthopaedics? Ready to join a team that’s reimagining how we heal? Conduct market and customer research to inform opportunity analysis and prioritization. Define early-stage technology scouting and success criteria backed by data-driven insights. Support feasibility assessments of new and early-stage technology with business modeling, financial analysis, and customer research. Leverage and create AI-enabled tools for the organization to stay current with market trends, competitive intelligence and the technology landscape. Strong skills in business modeling and analytics in tools like excel required. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Experience and/or knowledge of AI (artificial intelligence) tools for market research and analytics productivity. Strong analytical skills to interpret data and make data-driven recommendations. Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team environment. Strong organizational skills with great attention to detail. Experience distilling complex and high volumes of data into simple KPIs and data visualizations / dashboards / scorecards. Up to 40% travel

 Bachelor's degree required; postgraduate qualification in a related field preferred. 5+ years of experience in Marketing, Product Management, Strategy, Innovation, Engineering, or a related discipline. Experience in Medical Devices, Orthopaedics (Spine), Surgical Technologies, Navigation, Robotics, Digital Surgery, or related healthcare technologies. Proven track record developing product strategies, innovation roadmaps, technology portfolios, and business cases that inform investment decisions. Demonstrated ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives from concept through commercialisation while influencing stakeholders in a matrix organisation. Strong strategic, analytical, and commercial acumen with the ability to prioritise and deliver multiple high-impact initiatives with a high degree of autonomy. Experience defining long-term strategic vision, translating insights into execution plans, and delivering measurable business results. Exceptional communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to work within cadaver lab and operating room environments is required. Preferred: Experience leading surgeon advisory boards, customer engagement programmes, market development initiatives, and innovation governance processes. Preferred: Experience in Digital Health, Software, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Analytics, Navigation, Robotics, or enabling surgical technologies.

Contract Location: London onsite full time Monday to Friday 08:30 - 18:30hrs

Contract Start Date: Immediate

Contract End Date: December 2026 (with potential rolling contract extensions dependent on performance)

Contract Classification: Inside IR35

Payroll provider: Rockford Payroll Info for Contingent Workers – Rockford Pay

Overview

Deloitte is recruiting on behalf of a Tier 1 global financial services organisation for an Equities Client Integration Operations Analyst to join a high-performing Global Banking & Markets team.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a fast-paced front-to-back operations environment supporting the onboarding of institutional clients across global markets. The successful candidate will work closely with business, operations, technology and clients to ensure new client relationships are successfully established while delivering an exceptional client experience.

The role offers excellent exposure across the trade lifecycle and provides the opportunity to work with multiple stakeholders within a leading investment banking environment.

Key Responsibilities

Equity Operations is a key part of Global Banking & Markets Division. The business encompasses pre and post execution client services across Equities.

The Client Integration Team supports the onboarding of new Equities clients globally and is focused on efficiency, good client experience and front to back straight through processing.

The Client Integration Team is located in London, New York and Hong Kong.

 The key responsibility within the group is to work in partnership with other operations teams and Equities business to ensure that new clients are on-boarded accurately, and in a timely manner to achieve a good client experience. Develop management skills across a broad range of topics.  The role specifically will be to coordinate the onboarding configuration of new clients trading Equity products, cash, synthetics, and listed options, and additionally enabling existing clients with new products and markets within Equities.  The individual will work directly with clients to obtain their post execution preferences and work to understand their requirements in entirety.  This role will allow the candidate to liaise with multiple teams globally across operations, technology and business, and build a good understanding of front to back trade lifecycle for Equities.  It is also the responsibility of the team to proactively ensure any newly on-boarded clients have no issues after the trading commences. This will be done by monitoring the client’s pilot trade activity to ensure front to back straight through processing.  The successful candidate will be helping the existing team support the new business and clients. 

Essential Skills & Experience

 Previous experience of equities (cash or synthetic) products in a middle office, onboarding or client service-related environment Understanding the equities prime and franchise business.  Experience in applying strong technical skills in order to find innovative and creative solutions to problems within a continuously changing environment Display a high degree of professionalism and integrity through their work

WHAT YOU’LL NEED/SKILLS:9+ years of experience in marketing analytics or business intelligence, with a focus on analytics.Strongly preferred experience at a Media/Advertising agency.Proven experience leading a team of 5 or more.Extensive experience in the digital space.Ability to lead data workstreams and represent analytics in new business pitches.Experience providing company-wide points of view and training on emerging technologies and new analytics methodologies.Act as the primary analytics point of contact for clients, with a deep understanding of data management principles and advanced analytics techniques, including statistical modeling, audience cluster segmentation, and lifetime value analysis.Capable of contributing expertise and leading efforts in advanced analytics and consumer research.Track record of implementing operational excellence across multiple analytics functions.
WHO YOU ARE:Detail-oriented and adaptable.Open, flexible, and a problem solver, comfortable working across various partners and deliverables.Self-motivated, with the ability to multi-task and prioritize under tight deadlines.Highly responsive, organized, and strategically minded.Demonstrated leadership capabilities, with a commitment to mentoring junior team members.

rows.title: Cyber Insider Risk Senior Consultant
rows.descriptionText:
Cyber Defense & Resilience - Senior Consultant

Are you interested in working in a dynamic environment that offers opportunities for professional growth and new responsibilities? If so, Deloitte & Touche LLP could be the place for you. Traditional security and integrated risk programs have often been unsuccessful in unifying the need to both secure, automate and support technology innovation required by the business.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you'll do

As an Insider Risk Senior Consultant on the Cyber team, you will be responsible for:

 Assisting in developing comprehensive strategies for insider risk programs, including program assessments and roadmaps, using Deloitte's Insider Risk capability framework and industry practices Assisting in the operation of client insider risk programs, including the triage, analysis, investigation, and remediation of insider risk-related inquiries Leading client workshops, interviews, and process walkthroughs with cross-functional stakeholders, including Human Resources, Legal, Privacy, and Security, to document business processes, goals, and program requirements Aligning insider risk indicator and policy development with business needs and industry-leading standards, frameworks, and practices, including the CERT Insider Threat Framework, National Insider Threat Task Force guidelines, and MITRE ATT&CK for Enterprise Designing and implementing insider risk detection use cases, monitoring processes, and escalation workflows using Security Information and Event Management, User and Entity Behavior Analytics, and Data Loss Prevention capabilities Evaluating insider risk scenarios, high-risk user groups, and crown jewel assets to help clients prioritize and deploy monitoring, detection, response, and program management capabilities

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

 Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team Effective written and verbal communication skills Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product Ability to build and sustain professional relationships Ability to lead projects or workstreams Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor Ability to meet deadlines Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Cyber team helps complex organizations more confidently pursue their growth, innovation and performance agendas through proactive management of the associated business and cyber risks. Our professionals provide advisory and implementation services that integrate risk, regulatory, and technology skills to help clients transform their legacy programs. We work across a variety of different risk and compliance programs that extend well beyond Cyber Risk. Learn more about Deloitte Advisory's Cyber Risk Services practice.

Qualifications

Required:

 3+ years of experience in insider risk, security operations, investigations, compliance, data protection, or enterprise risk management 1+ years of experience managing an insider risk program or conducting insider risk investigations and monitoring insider risk behaviors Experience using Security Information and Event Management, User and Entity Behavior Analytics, and Data Loss Prevention tools to support insider risk operations Experience developing insider risk procedures, playbooks, workflows, metrics, or governance models Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders such as Human Resources, Legal, Privacy, Ethics, or Security Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

 Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience Experience in consulting or professional services Experience responding to and recovering from cybersecurity incidents Hands-on experience configuring, tuning, and operationalizing UEBA and/or User Activity Monitoring (UAM) platforms to support insider risk detection (e.g., Splunk UEBA, Proofpoint ITM, Microsoft Purview IRM, etc.) Hands-on experience with at least one Data Loss Prevention solution such as Microsoft Purview, Proofpoint DLP, or Zscaler DLP One or more of the following certifications: CERT Insider Threat Program Senior Consultant Certificate, CERT Insider Threat Analyst, CERT Insider Risk Measure Management Measures of Effectiveness, Certified Information Systems Security Professional, Certified Information Privacy Professional, Certified Information Security Senior Consultant, or Certified Information Systems Auditor

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $105,400 to $207,800.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

rows.title: SAP AI Transformation - Consultant - SAP Finance
rows.descriptionText:
Join Deloitte's SAP practice and build a career at the forefront of business transformation, where innovation, industry insight, and leading technology come together to solve complex challenges. You'll work with dynamic teams and leading organizations to modernize core processes, enable digital transformation, and help clients unlock lasting value through SAP-enabled solutions.

In this SAP AI Transformation role, you'll contribute to Agentic ERP transformations that help clients advance toward the autonomous enterprise. Combining SAP expertise with AI-enabled delivery approaches, cross-functional collaboration, and industry insight, you'll help address complex business challenges and create measurable client impact.

Recruiting for this role ends on 1/15/2027.

 Work you'll do 

As a Consultant in Deloitte's SAP practice, with a focus on SAP Finance, you will work side by side with functional and technical client team members to rapidly prototype and deliver high-impact solutions that support Agentic ERP transformations. With Deloitte Ascend™, you'll leverage AI accelerators and SAP capabilities to help clients modernize business processes and advance toward the autonomous enterprise.

This role requires a highly motivated professional who moves with speed and precision, builds practical solutions, and engages confidently with senior stakeholders and delivery teams to help generate measurable business impact.

 Support SAP Finance and Controlling workstreams by tracking work-plan activities, identifying dependencies, risks, and issues, and preparing deliverables.  Participate in and facilitate portions of opportunity-identification, fit-to-standard, and Agentic ERP solution-design workshops.  Translate finance requirements into SAP S/4HANA solutions and support functional design and configuration for assigned FICO areas, including GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting, Bank Accounting, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, and Profitability Analysis.  Support coordination of finance integration requirements with procurement, sales, supply chain, tax, treasury, and reporting teams.  Contribute to data migration, testing, defect resolution, cutover, deployment, hypercare, and stabilization activities.  Apply an AI-native approach to SAP delivery by using AI tools to accelerate analysis, solution design, prototyping, testing, and documentation, while maintaining human oversight to review, validate, and curate outputs.  Communicate project progress, decisions, risks, and action items with client and Deloitte team members; support training, change adoption, post-go-live activities, proposal development, and reusable SAP practice assets. 

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

 Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team  Effective written and verbal communication skills  Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product  Ability to build and sustain professional relationships  Ability to lead projects or workstreams  Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment  Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor  Ability to meet deadlines  Ability to provide clear guidance to others 

 The team 

Deloitte's SAP practice helps clients design, implement, and sustain SAP-enabled transformations that modernize operations, improve business performance, and create lasting value. Our teams bring together industry knowledge, functional expertise, technology capabilities, and emerging AI solutions to support first-time implementations, business-led enhancements, and large-scale SAP S/4HANA programs.

Professionals in the practice work with leading organizations across industries to help advance the autonomous enterprise through Agentic ERP, cloud, automation, analytics, artificial intelligence, and machine learning. Depending on client needs, our work spans strategy, design, implementation, integration, data, testing, deployment, change, and post-go-live support.

Qualifications

 Required: 

 Bachelor's degree; or an associate degree and 4+ years of SAP, enterprise resource planning (ERP), or consulting experience in lieu of a bachelor's degree.  2+ years of experience in SAP consulting, enterprise resource planning (ERP) implementation, or SAP/ERP technology transformation in a consulting or industry environment.  Experience supporting at least one full-lifecycle SAP implementation from project initiation through go-live and hypercare.  Experience supporting at least one SAP S/4HANA implementation, transformation, or migration program.  1+ year of hands-on functional configuration experience in SAP Financial Accounting and Controlling (FICO) in one or more of the following areas: General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Bank Accounting, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, or Profitability Analysis.  Experience working directly with client finance stakeholders to support requirements gathering, testing, or deployment activities on at least one SAP implementation, transformation, or support project.  Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. 

 Preferred: 

 Experience applying artificial intelligence (AI) tools-including generative AI, intelligent automation, machine learning, conversational AI, or AI agents-to support enterprise transformation initiatives, including solution design, implementation, testing, or human-in-the-loop review and validation.  Experience supporting or facilitating SAP design workshops, demonstrations, or testing activities.  Experience supporting SAP cloud programs or SAP transformation programs deployed across multiple countries.  Experience applying SAP Activate, Agile, or Waterfall methodologies on SAP implementation programs.  Experience contributing to proposals, estimates, solution designs, or client presentations.  One or more SAP certifications 

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $ 82,600 to $ 162 ,8 00.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Experience in relevant domains such as budgeting, planning, or federal programsOneStream certification progressExperience with similar EPM platforms that could accelerate the OneStream ramp-up

rows.title: Lead Forward Deployed Engineer, ServiceNow
rows.descriptionText:
At Deloitte, Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE) don't just build AI solutions, they help clients turn AI ambition into enterprise-scale impact, pairing leading class engineering with pod-based delivery and vertical expertise. If you thrive at the intersection of product, engineering, problem-solving, and client impact, this role puts you at the forefront of AI transformations.

Recruiting for this role ends on 10/30/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Lead ServiceNow FDE, you will serve as the senior practitioner-leader embedded directly with our most strategic clients, leading forward-deployed engineering pods that develop and deploy GenAI solutions into production for Deloitte's most strategic clients. You'll set technical direction, remove delivery blockers, and stay hands-on; designing, reviewing, and debugging systems with the team. You'll translate engineering trade-offs into clear decisions for client leaders when needed. Your ability to influence decisions at the C-suite level, while maintaining hands-on technical credibility, is what sets you apart. Role Overview: As a ServiceNow Lead Applied AI Engineer II , you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to building and enhancing high-visibility, full-stack products that serve the business and its users. Your expertise will be pivotal in delighting customers and users, while driving tangible value across Deloitte's product and AI investments. Key Responsibilities:

Outcome-Driven Accountability: Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for customer and business outcomes-and for the cost of achieving them. Manage dependencies, code design, implementation, quality, data, and ongoing maintenance and operations. Stay hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks. Create technical specifications, and write high-quality, supportable, scalable code and review code of other engineers, mentoring them, to ensure all quality KPIs are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams.Customer-Centric Engineering: Develop lean engineering solutions through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to solve customer needs. Engage with customers and product teams before, during, and after delivery to ensure the right solution is delivered at the right time.Incremental and Iterative Delivery: Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, delivering lean, supportable, and maintainable solutions.Cross-Functional Collaboration and Integration: Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional teams including product management, experience, and delivery. Integrate diverse perspectives to make well-informed decisions that balance feasibility, viability, usability, and value. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation.Advanced Technical Proficiency: Possess deep expertise in modern software engineering practices and principles, including AI and Agentic SSDLC to deliver daily product deployments using full automation from discovery to production to operations with all quality checks through SSDLC lifecycle. Be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize solutioning and product delivery. Demonstrate strong understanding of the full lifecycle product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning.Domain Expertise: Quickly acquire domain-specific knowledge relevant to the business or product. Translate business/user needs, architectures, and UX/UI designs into technical specifications and code. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff.Effective Communication and Influence: Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives.Engagement and Collaborative Co-Creation: Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions.

It helps power Deloitte's success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world's largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.

Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care.

A bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or related discipline. integrations, ServiceNow application development and deployment patterns, LangChain, LangGraph, as well as unit and integration testing frameworks.3+ years of experience building AI/ML and agentic applications, with hands-on GenAI experience across LLM integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models), RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, vector databases, evaluations, and AI agent orchestration, and applied AI capabilities on platforms such as ServiceNow.3+ years of experience with cloud-native engineering, using FaaS, PaaS, micro-services, or enterprise platform deployment MLflow, and agentic AI frameworks (e.g. ServiceNow NASK, MCP, LangFuse, LangSmith, or equivalent multi-agent orchestration tools) etc. to deliver high-quality products rapidly.ServiceNow engineering Senior Consultant - AI Assisted Process, Risks and Controls Transformation - Investment Management - Enterprise Operations & Risk 

Our Deloitte Regulatory, Risk & Forensic team helps client leaders translate multifaceted risk and an evolving regulatory environment into defensible actions that strengthen, protect, and transform their organization. Join our team and use advanced data, AI, and emerging technologies with industry insights to help clients bring clarity from complexity and accelerate their path to value creation.

 Work you'll do 

As a Senior Consultant, you will have opportunities to:

rows.descriptionText:
Cyber Defense & Resilience - Senior Consultant

Are you interested in working in a dynamic environment that offers opportunities for professional growth and new responsibilities? If so, Deloitte & Touche LLP could be the place for you. Traditional security and integrated risk programs have often been unsuccessful in unifying the need to both secure, automate and support technology innovation required by the business.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you'll do

As an Insider Risk Senior Consultant on the Cyber team, you will be responsible for:

 Assisting in developing comprehensive strategies for insider risk programs, including program assessments and roadmaps, using Deloitte's Insider Risk capability framework and industry practices Assisting in the operation of client insider risk programs, including the triage, analysis, investigation, and remediation of insider risk-related inquiries Leading client workshops, interviews, and process walkthroughs with cross-functional stakeholders, including Human Resources, Legal, Privacy, and Security, to document business processes, goals, and program requirements Aligning insider risk indicator and policy development with business needs and industry-leading standards, frameworks, and practices, including the CERT Insider Threat Framework, National Insider Threat Task Force guidelines, and MITRE ATT&CK for Enterprise Designing and implementing insider risk detection use cases, monitoring processes, and escalation workflows using Security Information and Event Management, User and Entity Behavior Analytics, and Data Loss Prevention capabilities Evaluating insider risk scenarios, high-risk user groups, and crown jewel assets to help clients prioritize and deploy monitoring, detection, response, and program management capabilities

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

 Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team Effective written and verbal communication skills Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product Ability to build and sustain professional relationships Ability to lead projects or workstreams Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor Ability to meet deadlines Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Cyber team helps complex organizations more confidently pursue their growth, innovation and performance agendas through proactive management of the associated business and cyber risks. Our professionals provide advisory and implementation services that integrate risk, regulatory, and technology skills to help clients transform their legacy programs. We work across a variety of different risk and compliance programs that extend well beyond Cyber Risk. Learn more about Deloitte Advisory's Cyber Risk Services practice.

Qualifications

Required:

 3+ years of experience in insider risk, security operations, investigations, compliance, data protection, or enterprise risk management 1+ years of experience managing an insider risk program or conducting insider risk investigations and monitoring insider risk behaviors Experience using Security Information and Event Management, User and Entity Behavior Analytics, and Data Loss Prevention tools to support insider risk operations Experience developing insider risk procedures, playbooks, workflows, metrics, or governance models Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders such as Human Resources, Legal, Privacy, Ethics, or Security Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

 Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience Experience in consulting or professional services Experience responding to and recovering from cybersecurity incidents Hands-on experience configuring, tuning, and operationalizing UEBA and/or User Activity Monitoring (UAM) platforms to support insider risk detection (e.g., Splunk UEBA, Proofpoint ITM, Microsoft Purview IRM, etc.) Hands-on experience with at least one Data Loss Prevention solution such as Microsoft Purview, Proofpoint DLP, or Zscaler DLP One or more of the following certifications: CERT Insider Threat Program Senior Consultant Certificate, CERT Insider Threat Analyst, CERT Insider Risk Measure Management Measures of Effectiveness, Certified Information Systems Security Professional, Certified Information Privacy Professional, Certified Information Security Senior Consultant, or Certified Information Systems Auditor

rows.descriptionText:
Senior Consultant - AI Assisted Process, Risks and Controls Transformation - Investment Management - Enterprise Operations & Risk 

Our Deloitte Regulatory, Risk & Forensic team helps client leaders translate multifaceted risk and an evolving regulatory environment into defensible actions that strengthen, protect, and transform their organization. Join our team and use advanced data, AI, and emerging technologies with industry insights to help clients bring clarity from complexity and accelerate their path to value creation.

 Work you'll do 

As a Senior Consultant, you will have opportunities to:

 Learn how to identify, evaluate, and prioritize business, operational, regulatory, and technology risks across investment management processes, and apply AI-enabled techniques to improve detection, monitoring, and mitigation of those risks  Support clients in designing and implementing AI-enabled governance across the process, risk and control lifecycle including regulatory and compliance impact assessment, process modeling and risk and control mapping, risk identification, control review, testing and enhancement, and issue management and reporting  Assist with continuous controls monitoring by leveraging AI to perform simultaneous, continuous anomaly detection across transactions, reconciliations, valuations, and other high-volume operational activities to surface discrepancies earlier.  Help deploy AI to enhance process and control effectiveness across the middle/back office processes, including monitoring data flows between systems and data platforms and alerting teams to integration/control issues.  Support the development and operationalization of model risk management (MRM) practices for AI and traditional models across the model lifecycle (development, testing/validation, deployment, monitoring), including clearer roles, accountability, and control environment expectations. 

The successful candidate would possess these skills

 Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team Effective written and verbal communication skills Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product Ability to build and sustain professional relationships Ability to lead projects or workstreams Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor Ability to meet deadlines Ability to provide clear guidance to others

 The Team 

Our Enterprise Operations & Risk offering enables clients to achieve profitable growth and competitive advantage by optimizing "heart of the business" operations. We leverage deep domain expertise to extend enterprise resilience, agility and remediation. Our professionals address client needs which span the organization and impact strategy, operations, performance and reputation.

Required

 Qualifications 

 Bachelor's degree.  3+ years of experience in financial services or consulting with exposure to investment management operations, compliance, risk, internal audit, and/or technology/data functions.  Demonstrated knowledge of investment management processes (trade lifecycle, reconciliations, collateral/margin, pricing/valuation support, fund/investment accounting, performance/reporting) and where operational risks and controls typically sit.  Experience applying AI/advanced analytics to process, risk, and control management, including one or more of:  Continuous anomaly detection and exception triage for transactions and operational processes  Risk assessment enhancement using broader data inputs and more real-time updates (where applicable)  Generative AI (GenAI) use cases with appropriate controls (e.g., drafting control narratives/test scripts, summarizing policies/procedures, generating action reports and recommendations), paired with human review and audit trails  Techniques to reduce control burden while maintaining governance in a highly regulated environment  Experience or familiarity with MRM and AI governance concepts, including documentation, validation, monitoring, and oversight needed to maintain transparency, fairness, and accountability for AI systems in investment management.  Understanding of AI risk considerations (e.g., bias/fairness, reliability, hallucinations, privacy/security, and attribution/copyright risk) and how to mitigate them via governance and controls.  Strong project/program management skills and ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines with high-quality delivery.  Strong oral and written communication skills, including supporting proposals and executive-ready presentations.  Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.  Ability to travel up to 75%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

rows.descriptionText:
WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORKWe are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
WHO YOU’LL WORK WITHYou'll be a core member of Bain's Martech team, partnering closely with marketing stakeholders across all functions. You'll also work directly with technology and engineering teams, external implementation partners, and platform vendors.
Day to day, you'll act as a deeply embedded co-pilot to the MarTech Director, helping translate strategy into executable plans, keeping initiatives on track, and ensuring that what gets built sees its full potential. As agentic workflows mature, there is also an opportunity to grow into product management across agents.
WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM Marketing technology is evolving quickly, and so is the way Bain's marketing organization works. We're actively building toward an AI-augmented operating model, bringing agentic tools into how we get the right content in front of the right people. This role sits at the center of that work: a product-minded partner who helps new technology initiatives land well and continuously shapes how marketing gets done.
You'll work directly alongside the Director, MarTech Strategy & Product Ownership, embedded in a function that touches every part of Bain's global marketing organization. The work is project-based by nature, moving across platforms, initiatives, and teams, applying product thinking and marketing strategy wherever the next build is happening.
WHAT YOU’LL DOSitting at the intersection of marketing, product, and technology, you'll help Bain's marketing organization navigate a period of meaningful transformation. The specific initiatives will evolve, but the through-line is consistent: take complex technology builds and make them successful.
Product and requirementsPartner with the MarTech Director to translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements for engineering and implementation teamsSupport product backlog management, writing and refining requirements as builds evolveContribute to product decisions by bringing a grounded understanding of both marketing strategy and technical constraintsChampion a test-and-learn approach, helping teams move from pilot to scaled adoptionStakeholder and program managementManage cross-functional workstreams across marketing, IT, and external partners, keeping progress visible and blockers clearedBuild strong relationships with marketing stakeholders to understand their needs and objectives, surface pain points, and validate that solutions are workingPrepare and maintain program communications and stakeholder-facing materialsFacilitate working sessions and reviews, ensuring the right people are aligned at the right moments
Strategy and operationsHelp define how marketing processes evolve as new tools enter the stack, including how humans and agentic systems work togetherIdentify opportunities to apply product management best practices across new and existing platform investmentsSupport governance and change management as the MarTech landscape grows more complexContribute to vendor evaluation and onboarding as new tools are introduced
