rows.title: Accelerate Graduate Programme - Enterprise Data & Analytics
rows.descriptionText:
Job Title: Capgemini Invent, Enterprise Data & Analytics, Graduate Programme (Associate Consultant)

Location & Start Months:

August: London

September: Manchester & Newcastle

November: London

Please note, due to high volumes of applications, this role may closed earlier than advertised.

Eligibility

To be eligible for this programme, you must have obtained, or be studying towards, a minimum 2:2 degree. If you are currently studying, you must have completed your degree prior to proposed start date. We recognise that mitigating circumstances can have an impact on academic performance. If you have experienced any circumstances that you would like us to take into consideration, please provide details in your application.

About The Role You Are Considering

The Enterprise Data Analytics (EDA) pathway of the Accelerate Programme is designed for talented graduates who are passionate about data and AI. In EDA, we help clients unlock value from their data by combining data strategy, analytics, data science and AI innovation. Through our Accelerate Programme, you will develop a strong foundation in consulting while gaining hands on experience across a broad range of data and AI disciplines.

The Accelerate Programme

The Accelerate Programme is Capgemini Invent UK's award winning graduate development programme. Over approximately 19 to 21 months, you'll progress from Associate Consultant to Consultant through a blend of structured learning, coaching, mentoring and hands on client experience. Following an initial three week induction and a twelve week consulting training programme delivered by the Institute, you'll move into your chosen pathway, applying your skills on live client projects while benefiting from ongoing development, regular feedback and a strong graduate community. Travel to client sites may be required, and candidates should live within reasonable commuting distance of their chosen office location.

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business. It will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home. Please note that you will be unable to work from home 100 percent of the time.

Your Role

As an Associate Consultant, you will develop the skills and experience needed to become a well rounded consultant, helping clients solve complex business challenges and deliver meaningful outcomes. From day one, you will gain hands on experience on client projects, take early responsibility, and contribute to transformation programmes that drive real business value.

Alongside Your Project Work, You Will Benefit From a Structured Learning And Development Programme Through The Enterprise Data Analytics Academy, Designed To Accelerate Both Your Professional And Technical Growth. You Will Have The Opportunity To

Build core consulting skills in areas such as business analysis, stakeholder management, agile delivery, design thinking, storytelling, and communicationSupport clients in solving complex business, data, analytics, and AI challenges. Develop expertise in modern technologies, including AI, data visualisation, cloud platforms, automation tools, and programming languages such as Python and SQLApply your skills on live client engagements, delivering innovative solutions and tangible business outcomes. Contribute to large scale transformation programmes, working collaboratively across teams and stakeholdersAchieve industry recognised certifications and access continuous learning opportunities tailored to your interests and career goalsCollaborate with specialist communities, contribute to thought leadership and knowledge sharing initiatives, and participate in innovation challenges and hackathons.

At Capgemini, building an inclusive future is part of everyday life and will be part of your working reality. We have built a representative and welcoming environment for everyone.

Your Skills And Experience

We are particularly interested to learn if you have experience or are interested in working in the industries we operate in and are keen to start a career in an environment where you can drive change.

Ideally, You Will Have

A strong interest in data, analytics, AI, and technology driven problem solvingExperience with, or an interest in, tools and technologies such as Python, R, SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Google Analytics, Generative AI, and Large Language Models (LLMs)Strong analytical and logical thinking skills, with the ability to interpret business challenges and identify insights from dataExcellent communication and teamwork skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non technical audiencesThe ability to work independently, manage priorities effectively, and adapt in a fast paced environment. A passion for continuous learning and personal development

An interest in one or more of the following areas is desirable:

Data analysis and insight generationData and AI strategy, governance, and architectureData science, AI, and innovationData platforms, engineering, and AI deploymentOperational analytics and data driven decision making

At Capgemini Invent, we take a holistic approach to recruitment. While academic achievement is considered, we equally value potential, curiosity and mindset, which will be assessed throughout the recruitment process.

What You'll Love About Working Here

Join a global community of innovators, technologists and consultants who are helping clients transform their businesses through technology. You'll gain hands on experience, continuous learning opportunities and the support to develop your career while contributing to meaningful work that creates lasting impact for clients, communities and society.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini Is Proud To Be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) Under The UK Government's Disability Confident Scheme. As Part Of Our Commitment To Inclusive Recruitment, We Will Offer An Interview To All Candidates Who

Declare they have a disabilityMeet the minimum essential criteria for the role

Please opt in during the application process.

Need to Know

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre employment checks, including identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back three continuous years, and an unspent criminal record check (known as a Disclosure and Barring Service check). You will also need to undergo Baseline Personnel Security Standard Checks. There are other criteria and checks required for BPSS and, throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility including, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients' businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask. When you join Capgemini, you'll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts. We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what's possible. It's why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world's leading businesses, and it's how you'll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future. By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge and always pushing yourself to do better, you'll build the skills you want. You'll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is the business transformation partner for enterprises in the age of AI. We help organizations imagine and build an intelligent, sustainable future, combining AI, technology and human ingenuity to transform how they operate, innovate and grow. With unique end to end capabilities spanning strategy, technology, engineering and intelligent operations, we bring together deep industry expertise and market leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data to turn ambition into measurable business outcomes at scale. Supported by a robust ecosystem of partners and nearly 60 years of expertise, Capgemini is a responsible and diverse global organization of over 410,000 team members in more than 50 countries. The Group reported 2025 revenues of €22.5 billion.

Make it real | www.capgemini.com

rows.title: Digital & Technology Solutions Degree Apprenticeship - Consulting - Capgemini Invent UK
rows.descriptionText:
Why choose an apprenticeship with Capgemini? 

Start your career in technology and consulting through a paid degree apprenticeship with Capgemini Invent. Over the 3-year programme, you will combine structured study from Sheffield Hallam University with practical consulting experience, working alongside Capgemini Invent colleagues to help our clients address real business, data, AI and technology challenges. Your programme will begin with a 10-week campus-based bootcamp, giving you the foundations and support to transition into your Invent role.

You’ll develop digital and technical capabilities alongside consulting, delivery and professional skills. From your very first week, you’ll meet inspiring people and start to build relationships. After your bootcamp and foundation training, you’ll transition into the Public Sector or Enterprise Data & Analytics Invent team and begin applying your learning in a professional consulting environment.

At Capgemini, we’re committed to helping you succeed. You’ll be encouraged to grow your confidence, explore new ideas, and develop your personal brand in a supportive and inclusive environment where your voice matters.

You’ll benefit from: 

A permanent, paid role with salary progression each year, the starting salary for this role is £26,500 A fully funded degree while gaining real work experience A strong support network, including mentors, experts, and a wider community of apprentices and graduates 

This apprenticeship is ideal for anyone passionate about technology, problem-solving, and building digital solutions that make an impact.

Locations 

Your Capgemini office base will be Manchester or Newcastle, and you should live within reasonable commuting distance of your chosen location. Due to the nature of our work, you may also need to travel to other Capgemini offices, Sheffield Hallam University and client locations. Some assignments may require regular on-site attendance or work in secure environments. Travel requirements will vary by assignment, so you should be prepared to be away from home for extended periods of time.

Eligibility: 

To be eligible for this apprenticeship, you must have:

7 GCSEs at grades A* -C (or 4-9), including Maths and English, or equivalent qualifications. 

In addition, you must have one of the following:

3 A-Levels at grades A*-C across all three subjects (AS Levels are not accepted) A completed Level 3 apprenticeship A BTEC with grade profile of Merit, Distinction, Distinction minimum 

Your Role:

As a Digital & Technology Solutions Degree Apprentice, you’ll work as part of a team delivering and improving digital services for real clients. You’ll gain practical experience, learn from industry experts, and play an active role in building solutions that help organisations run more effectively.

When you join, you’ll start on one of the below pathways, depending on your skills and interests: 

Data Analyst 

In this pathway, you’ll learn how to use data to help organisations understand performance and make informed decisions.

You may: 

Build data pipelines and work with cloud platforms Support data analysis and real-time insights Create dashboards and reports Create AI products 

Software Engineer 

In this pathway, you’ll learn how to design, build and improve software, systems and digital tools.

You may: 

Learn programming languages and frameworks Work with databases and cloud technologies Be part of agile teams delivering real software projects 

IT Consultant 

In this pathway, you’ll learn how to understand organisational needs and help shape effective technology solutions.

You may: 

Gather and document user and business requirements Analyse processes, systems and service needs Support the design, testing and implementation of technology solutions 

What To Expect

Join our Public Sector or Enterprise Data & Analytics consulting team Work on real projects from early on Learn from experienced professionals and industry experts Be part of a collaborative and supportive team Develop your technical skills, consulting skills and professional confidence 

Who We Are Looking For

You do not need to begin the programme as a technology expert. We are looking for people who are curious, enjoy solving problems and are motivated to learn. You should be comfortable working with others, communicating your ideas and balancing university study with a professional role. An interest in how technology, data, AI and digital services can improve organisations and people’s experiences will help you succeed.

Need to Know 

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre employment checks, including identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back three continuous years, and an unspent criminal record check (known as a Disclosure and Barring Service check). You will also need to undergo Baseline Personnel Security Standard Checks. There are other criteria and checks required for BPSS and, throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility including, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.

rows.title: CRM  Marketing Specialist
rows.descriptionText:
Why This Role Matters

This is a pivotal role supporting our O+O (Offline & Online) strategy, to deliver a joined-up, customer-focused approach to marketing across our European business units. Working closely with CRM, digital, analytics and marketing teams, you will use customer, traffic and performance data to identify opportunities to improve engagement, retention and customer lifetime value. You will help business units make better marketing decisions by connecting insights across channels, identifying opportunities for growth and supporting the delivery of consistent customer experiences across our brands, that shapes how millions of customers experience our brands so we can put a smile on our customers' faces today and tomorrow.

What You'll Be Doing

Build a clear understanding of how digital channels, CRM activity and store marketing work together to attract, engage and retain customers.Support marketing teams across Europe to improve customer engagement, increase traffic and grow long-term customer value through CRM channels including email, push notifications and SMS.Use customer and marketing data to identify opportunities, spot trends and provide recommendations that support better marketing decisions.Help connect activity across CRM, search, paid media, social media, affiliate marketing, websites, apps and store marketing to create a more consistent customer experience.Review performance across the customer journey, balancing immediate results with opportunities to build loyalty, retention and repeat engagement.Work with marketing specialists to develop and evaluate tests, share results and help apply successful ideas across different markets.Build strong relationships with marketing teams, data specialists and external partners, bringing together insights and recommendations that support business growth.

What You'll Bring

 Experience in CRM, digital marketing or customer marketing, with a strong understanding of how different marketing channels work together to engage customers.The ability to interpret customer, marketing and performance data, turning insights into clear recommendations and actions.Experience using customer data, audience segmentation and personalisation to improve marketing performance and customer experience.A strong understanding of customer behaviour and how different marketing activities influence customer decisions and experiences.Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex information in a clear and engaging way.Excellent relationship-building skills, with a positive and engaging approach that helps bring people together and gain support for new ideas.A positive, proactive approach, bringing energy, curiosity and a genuine desire to learn, share ideas and help others succeed.

How You Will Make An Impact

Help marketing teams make smarter decisions by turning customer and performance data into clear, actionable recommendations.Identify opportunities to improve how different marketing channels work together, creating a more connected and consistent customer experience.Help teams focus on the opportunities that will have the greatest impact on customers and business performance.Share insights, ideas and best practice that help teams build confidence in using data, testing and personalisation to improve results.Bring people together around a shared understanding of performance, helping teams prioritise opportunities that will have the greatest impact.Bring together different perspectives, data and expertise to help teams make confident, well-informed decisions.Use curiosity, initiative and a fresh perspective to uncover new opportunities that drive growth and improve the customer experience. 

Who We Are

You may not have heard of us, but you'll know our brands! AS Watson is the world's largest international health and beauty retailer, with over 17,000 stores across 31 markets serving over 5.3 billion customers each year.From Superdrug, Kruidvat and Watsons, The Perfume Shop and many more, our brands are loved by customers around the world. Behind them are passionate people who are encouraged to innovate, collaborate and grow.What You'll Get From UsCompetitive Salary and Bonus SchemeExclusive Discounts - Enjoy savings across our iconic brands.Holiday entitlementHybrid Working ModelRefer-a-friend schemeLearning and Development Opportunities - Grow your skills with tailored programmes.Mental Health and Wellbeing SupportLife AssuranceInterest Free Loans

rows.title: AI & Data Science - Multi Level Consultant to Senior Manager
rows.descriptionText:
CAPGEMINI INVENT

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.

The Data & AI Innovation team brings together our AI Product Innovation and Data Science Consulting capabilities. We help organisations turn ambitious AI ideas into production-ready products and measurable business outcomes, bringing together expertise across AI engineering, data science, product management and responsible AI.

YOUR ROLE

We are looking for AI and Data Science professionals from Consultant to Senior Manager to help organisations unlock value from AI, machine learning, data science and intelligent automation.

As a leading Data and AI Professional, depending on your experience and area of expertise, your focus may range from hands-on technical delivery and solution development through to leading client engagements, shaping AI strategy, developing teams and contributing to account and capability growth.

You do not need to cover every area of AI. We value strong foundations, relevant depth and the ability to learn as technology and client needs evolve.

In this role you will play a key role in:

 Designing, building and deploying machine learning, generative AI and agentic AI solutions, turning business challenges into practical prototypes, products and scalable enterprise capabilities. Developing applications and pipelines that connect AI models, enterprise data, APIs, tools and existing technology platforms, applying appropriate software engineering, MLOps, LLMOps and AI governance practices. Working with clients and multidisciplinary teams to understand business objectives, shape solutions and deliver measurable outcomes through AI and data-driven transformation. Depending on your grade and experience, leading workstreams, client engagements or multidisciplinary teams, and helping clients shape AI strategies, operating models and transformation roadmaps. Contributing to client account growth and the development of propositions, colleagues and Capgemini Invent's AI capability.

As part of your role, you will have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories:

 Business Development – Leading/contributing to proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitch contribution, client hosting at events. Practice Development – Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities), offering development. Learning & development – Training, certifications and professional development opportunities that support your career and the skills needed within the company.

YOUR PROFILE

You bring strong problem-solving skills and can turn ambiguous requirements into practical actions, communicate technical ideas clearly and work constructively with clients, colleagues and other stakeholders.You have experience, or for more junior candidates the potential, to deliver technical work within a team environment, balancing experimentation, quality, risk and business value.You have experience or potential in one or more areas including Data Science, Applied AI, Generative AI, AI Engineering, Machine Learning Engineering, Agentic AI, MLOps/LLMOps, AI Architecture or Data & AI Consulting. You are not expected to have expertise across every area, and the breadth and depth expected will depend on the grade.You build positive working relationships, communicate with credibility and connect technical decisions to business outcomes. At more senior grades, you bring strong commercial awareness, develop trusted client relationships, coach colleagues and contribute to propositions and account growth.

Ideally, you will bring a combination of consulting experience and the relevant technical expertise.

WHAT YOU’LL LOVE ABOUT WORKING HERE?

We are a collaborative and learning-focused team. We share knowledge, support each other and take a practical approach to solving complex client challenges as the AI landscape evolves.

Through regular learning and development days, knowledge-sharing initiatives and inclusive team events, you will have opportunities to deepen your expertise, broaden your experience and contribute to a connected community working on exciting AI projects.

NEED TO KNOW

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in inclusion, we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Inclusive Futures for All campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self At Cap to work.

We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.

Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

 Declare they have a disability, and Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

Please note : Candidates applying to these roles, need to live in England or Wales at the time of application.

CSR:

We’re also focused on using tech to have a positive social impact. So, we’re working to reduce our own carbon footprint and improve everyone’s access to a digital world. It’s something we’re really serious about. In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year. When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing.

Whilst you will have London, Manchester or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice.

We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion.

Develop expertise in modern technologies, including AI, data visualisation, cloud platforms, automation tools, and programming languages such as Python and SQLApply your skills on live client engagements, delivering innovative solutions and tangible business outcomes. Contribute to large scale transformation programmes, working collaboratively across teams and stakeholdersAchieve industry recognised certifications and access continuous learning opportunities tailored to your interests and career goalsCollaborate with specialist communities, contribute to thought leadership and knowledge sharing initiatives, and participate in innovation challenges and hackathons.

At Capgemini, building an inclusive future is part of everyday life and will be part of your working reality. We have built a representative and welcoming environment for everyone.

Your Skills And Experience

We are particularly interested to learn if you have experience or are interested in working in the industries we operate in and are keen to start a career in an environment where you can drive change.

Ideally, you will have:

A strong interest in data, analytics, AI, and technology driven problem solvingExperience with, or an interest in, tools and technologies such as Python, R, SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Google Analytics, Generative AI, and Large Language Models (LLMs)Strong analytical and logical thinking skills, with the ability to interpret business challenges and identify insights from dataExcellent communication and teamwork skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non technical audiencesThe ability to work independently, manage priorities effectively, and adapt in a fast paced environment. A passion for continuous learning and personal development

An interest in one or more of the following areas is desirable:

Data analysis and insight generationData and AI strategy, governance, and architectureData science, AI, and innovationData platforms, engineering, and AI deploymentOperational analytics and data driven decision making

At Capgemini Invent, we take a holistic approach to recruitment. While academic achievement is considered, we equally value potential, curiosity and mindset, which will be assessed throughout the recruitment process.

What You'll Love About Working Here

Join a global community of innovators, technologists and consultants who are helping clients transform their businesses through technology. You'll gain hands on experience, continuous learning opportunities and the support to develop your career while contributing to meaningful work that creates lasting impact for clients, communities and society.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government's Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

Declare they have a disabilityMeet the minimum essential criteria for the role

Please opt in during the application process.

Need to Know

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre employment checks, including identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back three continuous years, and an unspent criminal record check (known as a Disclosure and Barring Service check). You will also need to undergo Baseline Personnel Security Standard Checks. There are other criteria and checks required for BPSS and, throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility including, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients' businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask. When you join Capgemini, you'll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts. We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what's possible. It's why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world's leading businesses, and it's how you'll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future. By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge and always pushing yourself to do better, you'll build the skills you want. You'll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is the business transformation partner for enterprises in the age of AI. We help organizations imagine and build an intelligent, sustainable future, combining AI, technology and human ingenuity to transform how they operate, innovate and grow. With unique end to end capabilities spanning strategy, technology, engineering and intelligent operations, we bring together deep industry expertise and market leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data to turn ambition into measurable business outcomes at scale. Supported by a robust ecosystem of partners and nearly 60 years of expertise, Capgemini is a responsible and diverse global organization of over 410,000 team members in more than 50 countries. The Group reported 2025 revenues of €22.5 billion.

Make it real | www.capgemini.com

rows.title: Data AI Client & Delivery Lead - Columbus, OH
rows.descriptionText:
We are seeking a Senior Principal, Data & AI Go To Market to accelerate growth across the Ohio Valley region (Columbus, Cincinnati, Cleveland, and Charleston, WV). This is a senior, client-facing growth role for an AI-forward leader with deep Data & AI expertise who brings a strong point of view on the rapidly evolving AI / data landscape and can confidently engage both executives and technical leaders. You'll support opportunities surfaced by sales, client, and account teams, and create follow-on demand through your own relationships and delivery insight. The ideal candidate is Columbus-based and highly engaged in the local market. This role reports to the Director of Data & AI Go-To-Market for Ohio Valley.What You'll DoLead Data & AI technical solutioning: Shape architectures and roadmaps across data modernization, data and AI engineering, data and AI governance, conversational BI, and data & AI strategy.Qualify and solution opportunities: Partner with client teams and sellers on discovery, executive conversations, workshops, RFPs, and multi-capability solution design.Generate account-embedded demand: Create follow-on opportunities through client relationships, delivery insight, and account collaboration; use selective thought leadership and events.Deliver blended outcomes: Balance hands-on billable delivery leadership with market growth contribution.Drive revenue impact: Meet revenue contribution target by helping close sales revenue, originating deals, and managing delivery revenue in a leader capacity.Build GTM capability: Contribute reusable assets, market insight, and capability input to Data & AI Go-To-Market.Serve Ohio Valley region: Work from Columbus, OH office three days weekly; client site as needed; travel up to 30% annually across the Ohio Valley market.
What You Bring8+ years of relevant experience: Including 5+ years in consulting across Data, AI, and Analytics.Proven consulting sales-motion experience: Guide Data & AI opportunities from discovery through solution design and delivery mobilization.Broad Data & AI solutioning fluency: Depth across the capability set above, with a strong AI-forward mindset. Experience with one of Azure, AWS, or GCP for client solutioning.Modern data platform experience: Experience with Databricks or Snowflake; recommend practical platform approaches.Executive presence and collaboration: Engage senior client stakeholders and technical audiences and build credibility.Columbus-based market commitment: Live near Slalom Columbus office.
About UsSlalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries partner with clients to co-create powerful customer experiences, modern ways of working, and meaningful impact. What sets us apart? We believe work should be challenging and fulfilling, not perfect, but possible. That’s why we prioritize purpose, flexibility, connection, and recognition, so our people can thrive and love what they do, most days.  Compensation and BenefitsSlalom prides itself on helping team members thrive in their work and life. As a result, Slalom is proud to invest in benefits that include meaningful time off and paid holidays, parental leave, 401(k) with a match, a range of choices for highly subsidized health, dental, & vision coverage, adoption and fertility assistance, and short/long-term disability. We also offer yearly $350 reimbursement account for any well-being-related expenses, as well as discounted home, auto, and pet insurance. Slalom is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices.  The targeted base salary pay range for a Senior Principal is $165K to $200K. In addition, individuals may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. Actual compensation will depend upon an individual’s skills, experience, qualifications, location, and other relevant factors. The salary pay range is subject to change and may be modified at any time.    
We are committed to pay transparency and compliance with applicable laws. If you have questions or concerns about the pay range or other compensation information in this posting, please contact us at: peopleone@slalom.com. Please note, this recipient is not able to support recruitment inquiries beyond this purpose. EEO and AccommodationsSlalom is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to attracting, developing and retaining highly qualified talent who empower our innovative teams through unique perspectives and experiences. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Slalom will also consider qualified applications with criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Slalom welcomes and encourages applications from individuals with disabilities. Reasonable accommodations are available for candidates during all aspects of the selection process. Please advise the talent acquisition team or contact accomodationrequest@slalom.com if you require accommodations during the interview process.

Strategy Insights and Planning Associate Consultant

ZS's Strategy Insights and Planning teams partner with clients to design and deliver solutions to help them tackle a broad range of business challenges. Our teams work on multiple projects simultaneously, leveraging advanced data analytics and problem-solving techniques. Our recommendations and solutions are based on rigorous research and analysis underpinned by deep expertise and thought leadership.

What You’ll Do

Leverage problem solving skills and frameworks to develop solutions to our clients business problems Assist in structuring and conducting market research and/or desk research to derive insights and contribute to client decision making Design custom analyses using tools like Excel, Access, Confirmit and ZS's proprietary software Synthesize and communicate results to clients and ZS teams through oral and written presentations Develop client relationships and serve as key point of contact on certain aspects of projects Actively support management of the program plan and conduct regular status updates with the client – risk and issue mitigation. You will also assist in driving the project forward to ensure project goals and deadlines are met Advance problem-solving skills and improve ZS's capabilities Mentor and support development of Associates on your projects and teams 

What You’ll Bring

PhD or Masters with bachelor’s degree in a field with quantitative coursework such as business, economics, marketing, psychology, life sciences and social sciences. In lieu of a PhD, 2-5 years of relevant post-study professional experience will be considered. High motivation, good work ethic, maturity and personal initiative Strong oral and written communication skills Empathy, adaptability and high personal impact Strong attention to detail, with a quality-focused mindset Self-discipline for planning and organizing tasks Aptitude for, and enjoyment of, team leadership Fluency in EnglishClient-first mentalityIntense work ethicCollaborative spirit and problem-solving approach

How you’ll grow:

Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathwaysMilestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunitiesInternal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions

Perks & Benefits:

At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in United States, visit ZS US office locations | Where we work | ZS.

Hybrid working model:

We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on-site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face-to-face connections.

Travel:

Travel is a requirement at ZS for client facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. Travel provides opportunities to strengthen client relationships, gain diverse experiences, and enhance professional growth by working in different environments and cultures.

Considering applying?

At ZS, we honor the visible and invisible elements of our identities, personal experiences, and belief systems—the ones that comprise us as individuals, shape who we are, and make us unique. We believe your personal interests, identities, and desire to learn are integral to your success here. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. Learn more about our inclusion and belonging efforts and the networks ZS supports to assist our ZSers in cultivating community spaces and obtaining the resources they need to thrive.

If you’re eager to grow, contribute, and bring your unique self to our work, we encourage you to apply.

ZS is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment and advancement opportunities without regard to any class protected by applicable law.

Work Authorization:

This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must have authorization to work in the United States that does not now or in the future require employer sponsorship.

To complete your application:

An on-line application, including a full set of transcripts (official or unofficial), is required to be considered.

NO AGENCY CALLS, PLEASE.

rows.title: Principal, Management Consulting
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

As a Principal, you will actively participate in the growth and development of the Management Consulting and Strategy practice at Publicis Sapient. Your role will focus on shaping goal-oriented Digital Business Transformations for our clients and delivering strategic advice in the early stages of these transformations. You will work in multidisciplinary teams comprised of management consultants, creative and experience strategists, as well as technology engineers.

We are hiring for this role across multiple locations in North America including, but not limited to: New York, Chicago, Boston, and Washington DC.

Qualifications

Over 6 years of Strategy and/or Management Consulting experience within a global major consulting firm Prior experience of large-scale transformations within corporate strategy at a global scale and reachSkilled at building senior relationships and delivering high impact work for your clientsTeam player, driven by business value creationExcellent written, verbal, numerical, and presentation skillsThorough consulting skills and experience consulting to C-level clientsDeep problem solving intrinsics and analytics skillsAppreciation for Agile ways of workingInterest and experience in technology and using technology to strengthen business valueOpenness to travel and work on client site in order to deliver the first-class services we pride ourselves in

Additional Information

Pay Range: $155,000 - $303,000. The range shown represents a grouping of relevant ranges currently in use at Publicis Sapient. Actual range for this position may differ, depending on location and specific skillset required for the work itself. As part of our dedication to an inclusive and diverse workforce, Publicis Sapient is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity without regard for race, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, protected veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or religion. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at hiring@publicissapient.com or you may call us at +1-617-621-0200.

Company Description

Publicis Sapient is a digital transformation partner helping established organizations get to their future, digitally-enabled state, both in the way they work and the way they serve their customers. We help unlock value through a start-up mindset and modern methods, fusing strategy, consulting and customer experience with agile engineering and problem-solving creativity. United by our core values and our purpose of helping people thrive in the brave pursuit of next, our 20,000+ people in 53 offices around the world combine experience across technology, data sciences, consulting and customer obsession to accelerate our clients’ businesses through designing the products and services their customers truly value.

rows.title: Principal, Management Consulting
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

As a Principal, you will actively participate in the growth and development of the Management Consulting and Strategy practice at Publicis Sapient. Your role will focus on shaping goal-oriented Digital Business Transformations for our clients and delivering strategic advice in the early stages of these transformations. You will work in multidisciplinary teams comprised of management consultants, creative and experience strategists, as well as technology engineers.

We are hiring for this role across multiple locations in North America including, but not limited to: New York, Chicago, Boston, and Washington DC.

Qualifications

Over 6 years of Strategy and/or Management Consulting experience within a global major consulting firm Prior experience of large-scale transformations within corporate strategy at a global scale and reachSkilled at building senior relationships and delivering high impact work for your clientsTeam player, driven by business value creationExcellent written, verbal, numerical, and presentation skillsThorough consulting skills and experience consulting to C-level clientsDeep problem solving intrinsics and analytics skillsAppreciation for Agile ways of workingInterest and experience in technology and using technology to strengthen business valueOpenness to travel and work on client site in order to deliver the first-class services we pride ourselves in

Additional Information

Pay Range: $155,000 - $303,000. The range shown represents a grouping of relevant ranges currently in use at Publicis Sapient. Actual range for this position may differ, depending on location and specific skillset required for the work itself. As part of our dedication to an inclusive and diverse workforce, Publicis Sapient is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity without regard for race, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, protected veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or religion. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at hiring@publicissapient.com or you may call us at +1-617-621-0200.

Company Description

Publicis Sapient is a digital transformation partner helping established organizations get to their future, digitally-enabled state, both in the way they work and the way they serve their customers. We help unlock value through a start-up mindset and modern methods, fusing strategy, consulting and customer experience with agile engineering and problem-solving creativity. United by our core values and our purpose of helping people thrive in the brave pursuit of next, our 20,000+ people in 53 offices around the world combine experience across technology, data sciences, consulting and customer obsession to accelerate our clients’ businesses through designing the products and services their customers truly value.

rows.title: Senior Principal, Data & AI Go-To-Market
rows.descriptionText:
We are seeking a Senior Principal, Data & AI Go To Market to accelerate growth across the Houston market and broader TOLA (Texas, Oklahoma, Louisiana, and Arkansas) region. This is a senior, client-facing growth role for an AI-forward leader who can translate deep Data & AI expertise into compelling client conversations, differentiated solutions, and new business opportunities. The ideal candidate is Houston-based and highly engaged in the local market; they bring a strong point of view on the rapidly evolving AI landscape and can confidently engage executives and technical leaders alike to assist opportunities surfaced by sales, client, and account teams, and in addition to creating follow-on demand through relationships and delivery insight. This role reports to the Director or Senior Director of Data & AI Go-To-Market for TOLA.What You'll DoLead Data & AI technical solutioning: Shape architectures and roadmaps across AI engineering, data modernization, Data & AI governance, conversational BI, and Data & AI strategy.Qualify and solution opportunities: Partner with client teams and sellers on discovery, executive conversations, workshops, RFPs, and multi-capability solution design.Generate account-embedded demand: Create follow-on opportunities through client relationships, delivery insight, and account collaboration; use selective thought leadership and events.Deliver billable outcomes: Maintain 65% utilization (approximately 30 hours per week) through billable client delivery.Drive revenue impact: Meet revenue contribution target by helping close sales revenue, originating deals, and managing delivery revenue in a leader capacity.Build GTM capability: Contribute reusable assets, market insight, and capability input to Data & AI Go-To-Market.Serve Houston and TOLA: Work from Houston office three days weekly; client site as needed; travel up to 30% annually across Texas, Oklahoma, Louisiana, and Arkansas. What You Bring8+ years of relevant experience: Including 5+ years in consulting across Data, AI, and Analytics.Proven consulting sales-motion experience: Guide Data & AI opportunities from discovery through solution design and delivery mobilization.Broad Data & AI solutioning fluency: AI engineering, modernization, governance, conversational BI, and Data & AI strategy; strong AI-forward mindset.Experience with one of Azure, AWS, or GCP for client solutioning.Modern data platform experience: Experience with Databricks or Snowflake; recommend practical platform approaches.Bring frontier-AI capabilities from organizations such as OpenAI and Anthropic to client solutions.Executive presence and collaboration: Engage senior client stakeholders and technical audiences across AI engineering, modernization, governance, conversational BI, and Data & AI strategy.Houston-based market commitment: Live near Slalom Houston office or be willing to relocate to Houston. About UsSlalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries partner with clients to co-create powerful customer experiences, modern ways of working, and meaningful impact. What sets us apart? We believe work should be challenging and fulfilling, not perfect, but possible. That’s why we prioritize purpose, flexibility, connection, and recognition, so our people can thrive and love what they do, most days.  Compensation and BenefitsSlalom prides itself on helping team members thrive in their work and life. As a result, Slalom is proud to invest in benefits that include meaningful time off and paid holidays, parental leave, 401(k) with a match, a range of choices for highly subsidized health, dental, & vision coverage, adoption and fertility assistance, and short/long-term disability. We also offer yearly $350 reimbursement account for any well-being-related expenses, as well as discounted home, auto, and pet insurance. Slalom is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. For this role, we are hiring at the following levels and targeted base pay salary ranges: The targeted base salary pay range for a Senior Principal is $165K to $195K. In addition, individuals may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. Actual compensation will depend upon an individual’s skills, experience, qualifications, location, and other relevant factors. The salary pay range is subject to change and may be modified at any time.    
We are committed to pay transparency and compliance with applicable laws. If you have questions or concerns about the pay range or other compensation information in this posting, please contact us at: peopleone@slalom.com. Please note, this recipient is not able to support recruitment inquiries beyond this purpose. EEO and AccommodationsSlalom is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to attracting, developing and retaining highly qualified talent who empower our innovative teams through unique perspectives and experiences. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Slalom will also consider qualified applications with criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Slalom welcomes and encourages applications from individuals with disabilities. Reasonable accommodations are available for candidates during all aspects of the selection process. Please advise the talent acquisition team or contact accomodationrequest@slalom.com if you require accommodations during the interview process.

rows.title: Client Insights & Market Research Associate Consultant

parsed.text: South San Francisco, CA, United States

rows.descriptionText:
ZS is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by bringing together data, science, technology and human ingenuity to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a client-first mentality to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.

Strategy Insights and Planning Associate Consultant

ZS's Strategy Insights and Planning teams partner with clients to design and deliver solutions to help them tackle a broad range of business challenges. Our teams work on multiple projects simultaneously, leveraging advanced data analytics and problem-solving techniques. Our recommendations and solutions are based on rigorous research and analysis underpinned by deep expertise and thought leadership.

What You’ll Do

Lead and support market research projects for a global biopharmaceutical client, helping answer key commercial and strategic business questions.Design and execute primary and secondary market research initiatives, synthesizing findings into actionable recommendations for clients.Partner directly with client stakeholders and serve as a day-to-day point of contact for project updates, deliverables and strategic discussions.Coordinate and manage project execution across global teams, including colleagues based in India and Argentina, ensuring high-quality deliverables and adherence to timelines.Conduct market research analyses and leverage data to uncover insights related to customer needs, market dynamics and business opportunities.Translate complex research findings into clear, compelling presentations and recommendations for both client and internal leadership teams.Support project planning, risk management and status communications to ensure successful project delivery.Contribute to the development of junior team members through coaching, mentorship and collaborative problem solving.Demonstrate curiosity, attention to detail and a willingness to learn while developing expertise in the healthcare and life sciences industry.

What You’ll Bring

PhD or Master's degree with a bachelor's degree in business, economics, marketing, psychology, life sciences, social sciences or another quantitative discipline. In lieu of a PhD, candidates with 2-5 years of relevant professional experience will be considered.2+ years of professional experience outside of academic research, ideally in market research, consulting, strategic insights, customer insights or a related business-focused environment.Experience managing client relationships and presenting findings to stakeholders. Strong market research experience, including primary and/or secondary research methodologies.Demonstrated ability to manage multiple workstreams and collaborate with global teams.Strong analytical, problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate complex findings to non-technical audiences.High attention to detail, strong organizational skills and a commitment to producing high-quality work.Proven ability to work independently while thriving in a collaborative team environment.Willingness to learn and develop expertise in the healthcare and life sciences industry.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology or healthcare industry.Previous consulting experience, either at a consulting firm or in a client-facing advisory role.Experience supporting commercial strategy, customer insights, brand strategy or market access initiatives.

How you’ll grow:

Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathwaysMilestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunitiesInternal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions

Perks & Benefits:

At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in United States, visit ZS US office locations | Where we work | ZS.

Hybrid working model:

We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on-site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face-to-face connections.

Travel:

Travel is a requirement at ZS for client facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. Travel provides opportunities to strengthen client relationships, gain diverse experiences, and enhance professional growth by working in different environments and cultures.

Considering applying?

At ZS, we honor the visible and invisible elements of our identities, personal experiences, and belief systems—the ones that comprise us as individuals, shape who we are, and make us unique. We believe your personal interests, identities, and desire to learn are integral to your success here. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. Learn more about our inclusion and belonging efforts and the networks ZS supports to assist our ZSers in cultivating community spaces and obtaining the resources they need to thrive.

If you’re eager to grow, contribute, and bring your unique self to our work, we encourage you to apply.

ZS is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment and advancement opportunities without regard to any class protected by applicable law.

Work Authorization:

This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must have authorization to work in the United States that does not now or in the future require employer sponsorship.

To complete your application:

An on-line application, including a full set of transcripts (official or unofficial), is required to be considered.

NO AGENCY CALLS, PLEASE.

Find Out More At:

www.zs.com

rows.title: Technical Program Manager, Infrastructure Software Systems
rows.descriptionText:
The Meta Infra Technical Program Management (TPM) community is pioneering technologies to bring people and businesses closer together at a global scale. Infra TPMs are the enablers for our toughest business strategies to become technical realities, requiring direct and close partnership with both Engineering and Product teams to make products come to life with incredible scale, reliability, and efficiency.Meta's infrastructure software stack is being upgraded for a world where the primary consumer of our platforms is an agent, not a human at a terminal, and our core infrastructure stack is being upgraded for the rigor, speed, and scale required of modern training, inferencing, and app development. These shifts change how we design APIs and interfaces, how we onboard and support internal and external partners, how we plan features, and how we measure adoption and success. We are looking for a Technical Program Manager to own that transformation for a major surface of Meta's Infra software stack.In this role, you will partner with Engineering and Product leadership to shape the technical roadmap for the platforms you own, drive the design and rollout of the interfaces those platforms expose, and own end-to-end delivery and adoption with the partner teams who build on top of them. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy on ambiguous, cross-organizational problems turning open-ended strategic questions into concrete programs with a credible path to success and you will set the technical program management standard for the teams around you.

Technical Program Manager, Infrastructure Software Systems Responsibilities:

Own technical program management for a core area of Meta's infrastructure software stack, spanning platform strategy, technical design, delivery, and partner adoptionPartner with Engineering and Product to define the multi-quarter roadmap: shaping feature plans, participating substantively in technical design and API/interface design reviews, and making tradeoff recommendations that leadership acts onDrive platform adoption end to end — defining the onboarding path for partner teams, removing friction in integration, and holding the bar on the partner experience from first evaluation through steady-state production useTranslate the needs of demanding internal customer organizations into platform requirements, and broker the prioritization conversations required to land themDefine and instrument the metrics that determine whether the platform is succeeding — adoption, reliability, efficiency, and developer/agent effectiveness — and use them to drive decisions rather than to report statusLead technical discussions and act as a thought leader in program and design reviewsbe the cross-functional partner engineering leaders pull into their hardest problemsIdentify and solve systemic problems that span organizational boundaries, and build the lightweight operational constructs that accelerate team momentum without adding overheadPerform risk assessment, risk mitigation, and change management across a portfolio of concurrent technical programsArticulate technical vision, requirements, goals, and milestones to stakeholders up to and including VP-level leadershipProvide hands-on program management through design, development, testing, rollout, and post-launch phasesMentor and raise the bar for other technical program managers, and influence how TPM is practiced across the broader organization

Minimum Qualifications:

12+ years of experience in software engineering, systems engineering, or technical product/program managementExperience delivering technical platforms or infrastructure software programs from inception through production adoptionExperience leading large-scale, cross-functional programs with significant organizational impactExperience driving strategic technical initiatives and influencing roadmaps across multiple engineering teamsExperience with platform or developer-facing software, including API and interface design, partner onboarding, and adoption of a platform by teams outside the one that builds itExperience working with AI/ML or agentic systems, and translating their requirements into platform and infrastructure decisionsExperience with executive-level communication, including presenting to and influencing senior leadershipExperience navigating ambiguity and defining structure for complex, multi-quarter technical programsExperience communicating and translating between non-technical and technical requirements and audiencesExperience mentoring and developing other technical program managersExperience establishing working relationships across multi-disciplinary teams and partners in multiple time zones

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience building or operating agent-facing platforms, tooling, or APIs, including agent orchestration and evaluationExperience partnering with large internal customer organizations to migrate them onto a shared platformDemonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologiesExperience defining and driving developer or platform effectiveness metricsDemonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize or redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)Experience supporting AI/ML infrastructure — training, inference serving, or the software layers that sit on top of them

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. rows.descriptionText:
Responsibilities

Team Introduction:

Global E-Commerce (TikTok Shop) is one of TikTok's fastest-growing businesses and a core driver of the company's revenue growth. Our Global E-Commerce Content Recommendation team owns the end-to-end recommendation stack for e-commerce video and image-text content on TikTok worldwide — retrieval, ranking, and multi-queue blending; supply ecosystem and cold start; and the browsing-to-purchase experience for hundreds of millions of users.

We believe recommendation is being rewritten in the compute era. ID-based collaborative filtering and supervised learning built today's systems and still run most of the industry — but their returns are diminishing, and we are betting the next order of magnitude on rebuilding the stack on LLM foundations. Our ambition is to build the most advanced recommendation system in the world, and the next generation after that.

We are looking for talented individuals to join us for an internship. Our internship program offers students hands-on experience, industry exposure, and opportunities to apply their knowledge to real-world challenges while building a strong foundation for personal and professional growth.

Interns will gain practical experience, explore potential career paths, and participate in social events, learning programs, and development workshops alongside industry professionals.

Candidates may apply to a maximum of two positions across Our Company and its affiliates globally. Applications will be considered in the order they are submitted.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply early. Please clearly state your availability in your resume, including your start and end dates.

Responsibilities:

You will help build — and rewrite — an industrial recommendation system serving a billion-scale user base across short-video, livestream, and product scenarios, covering retrieval, pre-ranking, ranking, and blending end to end. Every iteration ships to production and directly moves user experience and GMV.

 Scale recommendation models like LLMs. Push ranking models from hundreds of millions to billions of parameters and chart the scaling laws of recommendation: behavior-corpus pretraining; multi-scenario, multi-task, multi-stage joint training; ultra-long behavior-sequence modeling (10K+ events) with KV caching, sequence compression, user/generation (U-G) disaggregated serving, speculative decoding, and dynamic batching — raising MFU while holding a strict millisecond latency budget. Build one-stage generative retrieval. Reframe retrieval as generation: tokenize the item space into semantic IDs (RQ-VAE / SID) and train autoregressive models, grounded in MLLM semantics, to generate what a user wants next — collapsing the traditional "multi-channel retrieval + ranking" funnel into a single generative stage. The open problems span the full stack: item tokenizers that balance semantic content against collaborative signal, and SIDs that stay stable while millions of new items arrive daily; post-training the generator directly on live user feedback (preference optimization, GRPO-style RL); and decoding under a millisecond budget — beam search, decoding constrained to the valid item space, and test-time scaling that trades inference compute for better recommendations. The prize is a system freed from its path dependence on ID memorization, where cold-start generalization comes from semantics rather than impression history. Inject world knowledge. Use large models' real-world knowledge to mine latent user interests and semantic representations beyond what pure ID co-occurrence can express; use reasoning models to run explicit chain-of-thought inference over long-horizon user intent, making the system materially better at discovery and novelty. Push training and inference to the hardware limit. Custom CUDA / Triton fused kernels, memory and computation-graph optimization, distributed training and inference acceleration, mixed precision and low-bit quantization — engineered for what makes recommendation hard: sparse embeddings, variable-length sequences, and many task heads. Rewrite R&D with agents. We are embedding coding agents deep into the algorithm-development loop: automated feature mining and pipeline generation, experiment configuration and training orchestration, automated evaluation and online-diagnosis attribution, bad-case mining and patrol. You will be both a user and a builder of this system. Do original work on open problems. Long-term value modeling, repurchase and retention, transaction attribution, fatigue modeling, new-user recommendation, incremental value modeling, interest exploration, LLM4Rec — problems where industry has no standard answers. We expect, and support, original research: internal papers, patents, and publication at top external venues.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

 Currently pursuing a Undergraduate in Software Development, Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related discipline. Solid ML and engineering fundamentals: you understand the math behind the models, and you write clean, efficient, reproducible code with a strong command of algorithms and data structures. Deep research or engineering practice in at least one of: LLMs / foundation models, NLP, CV, RL, or recommendation / search / ads — and you can articulate why you made the choices you made, and where they fell short. Genuine enthusiasm for LLM / LRM techniques: you want frontier methods live in production, not parked at offline metrics. Strong problem definition and decomposition: faced with an ambiguous problem that has no standard answer, you find your own foothold.

Preferred Qualifications:

 Publications at KDD, SIGIR, RecSys, WWW, ACL, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, or comparable venues — or high-quality open-source work. CUDA / Triton kernel development, source-level deep-learning-framework optimization, large-scale distributed training, or high-performance inference deployment. Hands-on experience with LLM post-training (SFT / RLHF / DPO / GRPO), agent-system construction, or inference acceleration. Led or deeply contributed to a key project in search, ads, recommendation, or large models, with a complete problem-to-online-impact loop. Awards in ACM-ICPC, NOI, Kaggle, or comparable competitions. Heavy user of AI coding and agentic workflows for building systems and optimizing models.

rows.title: Machine Learning Engineer Intern (E-Commerce Recommendation Live)- 2027 Summer
rows.descriptionText:
Responsibilities

Team Introduction:

The Global E-commerce Recommendation Live Algorithm team is responsible for the core recommendation stack for live commerce, covering the full pipeline from recall and pre-ranking to ranking and mixed ranking. The team operates in a highly dynamic environment where live room status changes in real time, conversion signals are sparse, and user intent must be understood across content, commerce, and transaction scenarios.

By combining generative recommendation, large recommendation models, multimodal representation learning, and cross-domain value modeling, the team works on some of the most important algorithmic problems in live commerce. Our goal is to improve user experience, optimize ecosystem efficiency, and drive sustainable business growth for TikTok Shop across global markets.

We are looking for talented individuals to join us for an internship. Our internship program offers students hands-on experience, industry exposure, and opportunities to apply their knowledge to real-world challenges while building a strong foundation for personal and professional growth.

Interns will gain practical experience, explore potential career paths, and participate in social events, learning programs, and development workshops alongside industry professionals.

Candidates may apply to a maximum of two positions across Our Company and its affiliates globally. Applications will be considered in the order they are submitted.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply early. Please clearly state your availability in your resume, including your start and end dates.

Responsibilities:

 Build and optimize recommendation models across recall, pre-ranking, ranking, and mixed ranking to improve GMV, conversion, watch time, and long-term user value. Develop cross-domain and multimodal modeling solutions that connect videos, live streams, products, and user behavior to better power live commerce recommendations. Advance next-generation recommendation technologies, including generative recommendation, large recommendation models, reinforcement learning, and long-term value optimization. Partner with cross-functional teams to launch scalable solutions, run experiments, and turn research into measurable business impact.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

 Currently pursuing a Undergraduate in Software Development, Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related discipline. Solid foundation in machine learning and at least one of the following areas: recommendation systems, search, advertising, NLP, multimodal learning, or large-scale applied AI. Strong programming skills in Python or C++, and hands-on experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch. Good understanding of data structures, algorithms, and large-scale model training or production machine learning systems. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business problems into effective modeling solutions. Self-driven and results-oriented, with the ability to take ownership of model iteration and online impact from end to end.

Preferred Qualifications:

 Experience in recommendation systems, especially in live commerce, e-commerce, search, ads, or other large-scale consumer products. Experience with generative recommendation, large recommendation models, retrieval and ranking systems, or related recommendation architecture upgrades. Experience with LLMs or multimodal foundation models, including pre-training, post-training, representation learning, contrastive learning, SFT, or RL-based optimization. Experience in cross-domain transfer learning, LTV modeling, long-term value optimization, causal inference, or debiasing. Publications in top-tier conferences such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, KDD, ACL, CVPR, SIGIR, or RecSys, or strong achievements in major technical competitions.
